perks.name: Hot Swap
perks.description:
Switching to this weapon while you are damaged strongly increases its handling for a short duration.

Swords gain increased charge speed, guard resistance, and guard endurance instead.
perks.descriptionZh:
在受到伤害的情况下切换至此武器会使其操控性在短时间内大幅上升。

刀剑会获得更高的充能速度、防御抗性、防御持久。

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant an improved amount of health.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可恢复更多的生命值。

perks.name: Reciprocity
perks.description: When healing projectiles from this weapon strike allies, you also receive an increased amount of healing.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的治疗射弹击中盟友时，你也会获得更多治疗。

perks.name: Enduring Snare
perks.description: Snareweaver traps last longer.
perks.descriptionZh: 织陷者的陷阱持续时间更长。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Solar Weapon Surge
perks.description: Your Solar weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的烈日武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Class Forged
perks.description: +3 Class
perks.descriptionZh: +3 职业

perks.name: Live Fire Sale
perks.description: Raid Banners sold from Hawthorne cost less.
perks.descriptionZh: 霍桑售卖的突袭旗帜减价。

perks.name: Cast No Shadows
perks.description: Dealing melee damage increases this weapon's handling and loads a small amount of ammo from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成近战伤害会提升此武器的操控性，并从备弹中填装少量弹药。

perks.name: Fastball
perks.description: Increases grenade throw distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手雷投掷距离。

perks.name: Unflinching Solar Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Solar weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低用烈日武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高微型冲锋枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Radiolaria Breach
perks.description: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，在短时间内获得生命值属性加成并向周围释放一股活性放射体液。

perks.name: Collective Power
perks.description: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有分支职业增益时，造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact. Improves reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 射弹命中后产生范围效果爆炸。提高填装速度。

perks.name: Vanishing Step
perks.description: Dodging makes you invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身可使你获得隐形效果。

perks.name: Void Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Shot Package
perks.description: Aggressive frame Shotgun modified to have decreased pellet spread while aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 对攻击型框架霰弹枪进行改造以降低瞄准时的弹片散射。

perks.name: Facet of Generosity
perks.description: Defeating targets while transcendent creates Orbs of Power for your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于超凡状态时击败目标，会为盟友生成能量球。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Mechanized Autoloader
perks.description: This weapon automatically reloads on ammo pickup.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拾取弹药时自动填装。

perks.name: Heavy Hunter Armor
perks.description: Improved resilience.
perks.descriptionZh: 更强的韧性。

perks.name: Desperation
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or a final blow with a Cursed Thrall explosion increases your rate of fire and improves stability and aim assist.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得精准最后一击后填装或以诅咒怨魂爆炸造成最后一击会提升你的射速，改善稳定性和瞄准辅助。

perks.name: Conducting Prime Recon
perks.description: The next engram earned from Ops activities will be a Prime Engram.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过行动活动获得的下一个记忆水晶将是至高记忆水晶。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Frenzied Hunger
perks.description: Rapid final blows while Devour is active grant a bonus to reload and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 吞食启用时的快速最后一击会提供填装和操控性加成。

perks.name: Emergency Flare
perks.description: Emergency Reinforcements consumes all but 1 Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 紧急增援将消耗全部护甲充能，直至剩余1层。

perks.name: Fell the Revenant
perks.description:
Deal increased weapon damage to Scorn. 

Wearing Shadestalker Armor (currently {var:1903370001} of 4) increases the bonus damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
对嗤魅造成更多武器伤害。

穿戴阴影潜行者护甲（当前{var:1903370001}件，共4件）会提升该额外伤害。

perks.name: Enhanced Ether Generator
perks.description:
Dark Ether Reaper origin trait has a chance to spawn an extra Dark Ether charge.

Weapons with the Dark Ether Reaper origin trait are overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
黑暗乙太收割者原始特性有几率生成一次额外的黑暗乙太充能。

该修改器生效期间，具有黑暗乙太收割者原始特性的武器将过充。

perks.name: Killing Breeze
perks.description: Rapid weapon final blows grant you a bonus to mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速武器最后一击会为你提供额外的敏捷。

perks.name: One with Frost
perks.description: While Frost Armor is active, [Stasis] Stasis weapons gain increased reload speed and stability. Stasis Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰霜护甲启用时，冰影武器的填装速度和稳定性提升。冰影刀剑的防御抗性提升。

perks.name: Light Reactor
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on Fusion Rifle kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 融合步枪击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Paracausal Pellets
perks.description: Landing nearly all Stasis pellets will freeze targets; landing nearly all Solar pellets will ignite targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 击中几乎所有的冰影弹片可冻结目标；击中几乎所有的烈日弹片可点燃目标。

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可在持用者保持移动时获得稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成。

perks.name: Crucible Pink
perks.description: Adds a pink Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色熔炉纹章。

perks.name: Mobius Conduit
perks.description: Activating Gathering Storm calls down lightning.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活风起云涌会召唤闪电。

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高瞄准速度。提高稳定性。

perks.name: Fury Conductors
perks.description: Melee hits grant Armor Charge and store explosive Arc energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战命中会获得护甲充能并储存爆炸电弧能量。

perks.name: Horns of Doom
perks.description: Defeating targets with Void damage grants a bonus to Void weapons, and defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy. Improves Sentinel Shield.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空伤害击败目标可提供虚空武器加成，使用虚空近战击败目标可提供超能能量。改善哨兵圣盾。

perks.name: Biotic Enhancements
perks.description: Being surrounded buffs damage and weapon handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 被包围时强化伤害和武器操控性。

perks.name: Bleak Domain
perks.description: Bleak Watcher turrets are enhanced and grant icicle projectiles to weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 凄凉观察者炮台已强化，可为武器提供冰锥射弹。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: Deprecated Perk
perks.descriptionZh: 弃用的特性

perks.name: All-Seeing Eye
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on destinations with a linked obelisk.
perks.descriptionZh: 在有已连接的方尖碑的目的地上，可探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Rocket Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高火箭发射器的填装速度。

perks.name: Iron Grip
perks.description: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 以牺牲填装速度为代价，大幅提升武器的稳定性。

perks.name: Major Resist
perks.description: Gain extra damage resistance against powerful combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得对抗来自强大敌人的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Small Offerings
perks.description: Unlocks an additional weekly bounty for Hawthorne.
perks.descriptionZh: 额外解锁一个霍桑的周常悬赏。

perks.name: Ignoble Deeds
perks.description: Gain charges by inflicting subclass debuffs on targets. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon gains significantly more handling, reload speed, and Sword charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过对目标施加分支职业减益来获得充能。击败战斗人员来消耗充能。充能时，此武器获得显著提升的操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度。

perks.name: Freehand Grip
perks.description: Significantly increases accuracy and ready speed while firing from the hip.
perks.descriptionZh: 显著提升腰射时的精度和准备速度。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Scout Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的斥候步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: CQC Optics: High
perks.description: Slightly increases zoom magnification.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅提高变焦倍率。

perks.name: Adept Reload
perks.description: +10 Reload
perks.descriptionZh: +10填装

perks.name: Enhanced Auto Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型自动步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高自动步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Pulse Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高脉冲步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Nessus Scout Reports
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Nessus for all members of the fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在涅索斯上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Chimera
perks.description: After this weapon fires, equipped Kinetic and Power weapons gain a brief period of increased handling and accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器射击后，在一小段时间内提高装备的动能和能量武器的操控性和精度。

perks.name: Thar Be Treasure!
perks.description: Adds a treasure chest appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个宝箱外观。

perks.name: Spark of Discipline
perks.description: Spark of Discipline
perks.descriptionZh: 纪律火花

perks.name: The Perfect Fifth
perks.description: Every five hits attaches a delayed detonation.
perks.descriptionZh: 每五次命中会附加一次延迟引爆。

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会生成一个略有提升的能量球。

perks.name: Swift Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating combatants with Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, or Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用脉冲步枪、手枪或微型冲锋枪快速消灭战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Sidearm Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Special ammo while you have a Sidearm equipped that uses Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备使用特殊弹药的手枪后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Auto Rifle Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定自动步枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用自动步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Arc Aligned—Rank 4
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do tons of damage with Arc power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用电弧能量可造成惨重的伤害。

perks.name: Arc Aligned—Rank 5
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a ludicrous amount of damage with Arc power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用电弧能量可造成恐怖程度的伤害。

perks.name: Arc Aligned—Rank 1
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do more damage with Arc power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用电弧能量可造成很多的伤害。

perks.name: Arc Aligned—Rank 2
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a lot more damage with Arc power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用电弧能量可造成更多的伤害。

perks.name: Arc Aligned—Rank 3
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do significantly more damage with Arc power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用电弧能量可造成极多的伤害。

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil for a longer duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高精度和稳定性，同时改善垂直后坐力，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Health Font
perks.description: You gain a bonus to your health stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外生命值属性。你的护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Reef Shimmer
perks.description: Adds an Awoken pointillistic appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个觉醒者点彩外观。

perks.name: Reef Oracle
perks.description: Adds an Awoken circle appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个觉醒者环外观。

perks.name: Corrupt Ether
perks.description: Adds a corrupted Ether appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个腐化乙太外观。

perks.name: Reef Awoken
perks.description: Adds an Awoken teleportation appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个觉醒者传送外观。

perks.name: Resonant Entrance
perks.description: Adds a resonant appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个共振外观。

perks.name: Prismatic Entrance
perks.description: Adds a prismatic appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个棱镜外观。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perks.description: Aiming down sights loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against  [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 举枪瞄准会装载一个高爆载荷，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Quantum Nova
perks.description: Fires lacerating Weakening rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射撕裂目标的削弱弹药。

perks.name: Unplanned Reprieve
perks.description: Projectiles attach and detonate.
perks.descriptionZh: 子弹会吸附然后爆炸。

perks.name: Bow Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善弓箭的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Shatter Shot
perks.description: This weapon's uncharged projectiles deal bonus damage to Stasis crystals and frozen targets. Rapidly destroying multiple Stasis crystals reloads this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的未充能射弹可对冰影水晶造成额外伤害并冻结目标。快速摧毁多个冰影水晶可从弹药储量中填装此武器。

perks.name: Aerodynamics
perks.description: Grants increased blast radius and projectile speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高爆炸范围和射弹速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Shield Duration
perks.description: +10 Shield Duration
perks.descriptionZh: +10 护盾持续时间

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准击杀可产生元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Echo of Persistence
perks.description: Void buffs applied to you (Invisibility, Overshield, and Devour) have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 你获得的虚空增益（隐身，覆盖护盾，吞食）的持续时间延长。

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换至此武器后短时间内充能时间缩短，操控速度提高。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description: High damage, moderate charge time. Fires a horizontal volley.
perks.descriptionZh: 高伤害，充能时间适中。进行一次水平齐射。

perks.name: +10 Health ▲
perks.description: +10 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perks.name: Stacks on Stacks
perks.description: Gain an extra stack of Charged with Light for every stack you gain.
perks.descriptionZh: 每层光之充能都将给予你额外一层充能。

perks.name: Precisely Charged
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by getting multiple rapid precision final blows with Linear Fusion Rifles or Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用线性融合步枪或狙击步枪快速精准最后一击击杀多名敌人来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Extra Reserves
perks.description: While Charged with Light, defeating combatants with Void damage grants a chance to drop Special ammo. This effect consumes all stacks of Charged with Light. The more stacks you have, the higher your chance of gaining the ammo drop.
perks.descriptionZh: 当充斥光能的时候， 以虚空伤害消灭敌方战斗人员将有几率掉落特殊弹药。此效果 消耗全部层数 的光之充能。消耗的层数越多，掉落特殊弹药的几率越高。

perks.name: Protective Light
perks.description: While Charged with Light, you gain significant damage resistance against combatants when your shields are destroyed. This effect consumes all stacks of Charged with Light. The more stacks consumed, the longer the damage resistance lasts.
perks.descriptionZh: 当充斥光能的时候， 当你的护盾被摧毁时，你将获得对于敌方战斗人员显著的伤害减免。此效果 消耗全部层数 的光之充能。消耗的层数越多，获得的伤害减免持续时间越久。

perks.name: Forge's Kin
perks.description: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant significantly more ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration significantly increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 黑色军械库武器最后一击会在武器再次被举起时短暂提供显著提升的弹药生成、填装速度和对战斗人员的伤害。装备的每一件黑色军械库武器都会显著提升增益的强度和持续时间。

perks.name: Green Beam
perks.description: Adds a green beam to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束绿色光束。

perks.name: The Game is Afoot!
perks.description: Follow the clue trail and see where it leads.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着线索追踪，看它通向何方。

perks.name: -20 Weapon ▼
perks.description: -20 Weapon ▼

perks.name: Solar Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用烈日分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Spark of Beacons
perks.description: While you are amplified, your Arc Special or Heavy ammo weapon final blows create a blinding explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于增幅状态时，你的电弧特殊或重型弹药武器最后一击会造成一个致盲爆炸。

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 击杀可在短时间内为所有武器提供更高的操控性。

perks.name: Minor Weapons Mod
perks.description: Increases the Weapons stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升武器属性。

perks.name: BrayTech Signal
perks.description: This signal will draw out House Salvation techno squads hunting for Golden Age tech in the Europa Eclipsed Zone.
perks.descriptionZh: 此信号会吸引在木卫二日蚀区搜寻黄金时代技术的救赎氏族技术小队。

perks.name: Subjugation
perks.description:
Weapon adapts to targets. When dealing damage:

• To weak targets: shots explode
• To strong targets: targets become exhausted
• To Guardians: the weapon's flinch resistance increases

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
武器可自适应目标。造成伤害时：

• 较弱目标：子弹爆炸
• 较强目标：使目标变得疲惫
• 守护者：武器的抖动抗性提升

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Aggressive Glaive
perks.description: [Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield
perks.descriptionZh: [瞄准]  ：举起护盾

perks.name: Surprising Gift
perks.description: Adds a surprise gift appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个惊喜礼物外观。

perks.name: Peppermint Burst
perks.description: Adds a pepperminty appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个薄荷外观。

perks.name: Paragon Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Paragon archetype, which has Super as its primary stat and Melee as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落楷模典范框架：超能为主要属性，近战为次要属性。

perks.name: Blade Focus
perks.description: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑短暂格档来让利刃专注就绪。利刃专注就绪时，用刀剑命中目标会在一定时间内提升刀剑伤害和前冲距离。

perks.name: Combat Meditation
perks.description: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑命中返还手雷和职业能量。如果启用利刃专注，还将获得额外能量。

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges at a faster rate.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成最后一击会更快地周期性生成黑暗乙太充能。

通过武器射击或与其接触可提前引爆充能，并从弹药储备中为此武器填装弹药。

perks.name: Suppression Mastery
perks.description: Suppression effects you create have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 你制造的压制效果持续时间增加。

perks.name: Spark of Recharge
perks.description: While critically wounded, your melee and grenade energy regenerates more quickly.
perks.descriptionZh: 身受重伤时，你的近战和手雷能量回复速度会加快。

perks.name: Enhanced Ashes to Assets
perks.description: Gain even more Super energy on grenade kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷击杀可提供更多额外超能能量。

perks.name: Funeral Pyre
perks.description: Firefly deals more damage while Memento Mori is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 终有一死激活时，萤火虫会造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Fists of Havoc
perks.description: Supercharge your fists and slam the ground with the force of a maelstrom.
perks.descriptionZh: 对双拳进行超级充能，接着使用漩涡之力猛击地面。

perks.name: Häkke Heavy Burst Fire
perks.description: Fires a less stable burst of two high-damage, high-range rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 较不稳定地连续发射两发高伤害远射程子弹。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Scout Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的斥候步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Shotgun Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding ammo while you have a Shotgun equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备霰弹枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Physic
perks.description: Rapidly healing allies grants the intrinsic elemental benefit to you. This benefit is more potent for you and your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速治疗盟友可为你提供固有特性元素增益。该增益对你和盟友都更为强效。

perks.name: Charge Harvester
perks.description: While you are not Charged with Light, any kill or assist has a small cumulative chance to cause you to become Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 若你未充斥光能，任意击杀或助攻将有少量累积几率使你充斥光能。

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣中最后的几发弹药可造成更高伤害。弹匣中更高伤害的弹药增多。

perks.name: Coral Rabbit
perks.description: Adds a pink rabbit crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色兔子纹章。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Submachine Guns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的微型冲锋枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Marksman Optics: Low
perks.description: Slightly reduces zoom magnification.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅降低变焦倍率。

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭虚空减益目标可提供覆盖护盾，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Lock and Load
perks.description: While surrounded by multiple combatants, defeating a combatant with a Fusion Rifle, Shotgun, Sidearm, or Submachine Gun adds ammo for that weapon to your reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 当被多名战斗人员包围时，以融合步枪、霰弹枪、手枪或微型冲锋枪消灭一个战斗人员将向该武器备弹中添加弹药。

perks.name: Break the Bank
perks.description: Blighted targets take damage over time and blight the nearby area on death.
perks.descriptionZh: 被凋零的目标会受到持续伤害并在死亡时对附近区域造成凋零效果。

perks.name: Repulsor Force
perks.description: Impulse push that suppresses targets' abilities. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 可以压制目标技能的斥力。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Rapid Regen
perks.description: With the Operator Augment, you gain periodic bursts of healing when your health is depleted.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有操作员增益时，你会在生命值较低时获得周期性爆发治疗效果。

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标后填装此武器会短时间过充武器，下次命中时震颤敌人。

perks.name: -10 Weapon ▼
perks.description: -10 Weapon ▼

perks.name: On Your Mark
perks.description:
Activating your class ability or landing precision hits grants you and nearby allies increased reload speed and Weapons stat for a short duration. Stacks ten times.

Final blows while at ten stacks cure you.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能或造成精准命中可让你和附近盟友在短时间内提升填装速度和武器属性。可叠加十次。

达到十层时造成最后一击将治愈你。

perks.name: Omni-Telemetry
perks.description: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon final blow.
perks.descriptionZh: 在任意元素武器最后一击时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Banshee Special
perks.description: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon final blow at an increased rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 在任意元素武器最后一击时以更快的速度生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Spark of Recovery
perks.description: Spark of Recovery
perks.descriptionZh: 恢复火花

perks.name: Tactical
perks.description: Grants slightly increased vent speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 略微提升排气速度和操控性。

perks.name: Forge Master
perks.description: Summon your Throwing Hammer back to you.
perks.descriptionZh: 将你的投掷飞锤召回。

perks.name: Electric Styx
perks.description: Increases the maximum number of Dynamic Charge stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加动态充能的最高堆叠层数。

perks.name: Spinning Up
perks.description: Holding down the trigger increases rate of fire. Final blows while spun up grant bonus Special ammo progress.  [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Dual Speed Receiver.
perks.descriptionZh: 按住扳机可提升射速。旋转加速期间造成最后一击可提供特殊弹药进度加成。按下[替换武器动作] 切换至双重速率接收器。

perks.name: Tangled Shore Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Enhanced Vent Speed
perks.description: +10 Vent Speed
perks.descriptionZh: +10排气速度

perks.name: Beyond The Veil
perks.description: Guardians you make invisible gain damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 被你隐形的守护者获得伤害抗性。

perks.name: Spindle
perks.description: Threadling damage increases this weapon's damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 线虫伤害可提升此武器的伤害。

perks.name: Elemental Armaments
perks.description: Combatant weapon final blows with a damage type that matches your subclass element have an escalating chance to spawn an elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 用符合你的分支职业元素类型的伤害类型取得战斗人员武器最后一击有更高几率生成元素井。

perks.name: Apollonic Tangent
perks.description: Arrows fired through a Guidance Ring release seeking projectiles, which scorch targets and do more damage based on distance traveled. Precision hits help guide these seekers toward their targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 穿过指引光环的箭会放出追踪射弹灼烧目标，离目标距离越远，命中后伤害越高。精准命中可帮助追踪弹锁定目标。

perks.name: Unflinching Submachine Gun Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用微型冲锋枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Touch of Winter
perks.description:
Your Glacier, Duskfield, Coldsnap, and Shatter grenades have enhanced functionality.

Glacier Grenade: Adds a [Stasis] Stasis crystal and changes the formation.

Duskfield Grenade: Increases slow-field size and creates a small [Stasis] Stasis crystal on impact.

Coldsnap Grenade: Seekers duplicate after freezing a target and create a [Stasis] Stasis crystal on detonation.

Shatter Grenade: Creates additional shrapnel projectiles on detonation. Hitting frozen targets with this grenade refunds some grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的冰川、暮域、急冻和碎裂手雷的功能增强。

冰川手雷：增加一个冰影水晶，并改变其结构。

暮域手雷：扩大减速力场的范围，并在撞击时生成一个小冰影水晶。

急冻手雷：追踪弹在冻结目标后将会复制，并在引爆时生成冰影水晶。

碎裂手雷：引爆时产生额外碎片射弹。用此手雷命中被冻结的目标会返还部分手雷能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Lightweight Frame
perks.description: One-shot, status effect grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射单发的状态效果榴弹。

perks.name: Explosive Wellmaker
perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with explosive damage spawns a Solar elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用爆炸伤害快速消灭战斗人员可产生一个烈日元素井。

perks.name: Widow's Silk
perks.description:
You have an additional grenade charge.

Your Grappling Hook creates a Grapple Tangle at the grapple point.
perks.descriptionZh:
你拥有一次额外手雷充能。

你的抓钩会在抓取点生成一个抓取缠结。

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.
perks.descriptionZh: 友军在附近时，大幅提高操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: Multi-Siphon Mods
perks.description: Grants access to Helmet armor mods that combine the effects of the Strand Siphon and Arc Siphon mods.
perks.descriptionZh: 可使用将缚丝虹吸与电弧虹吸模组效果相结合的头盔护甲模组。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Melee
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your melee are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响近战所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Strand
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Strand weapons are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响缚丝武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Void
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Void weapons are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响虚空武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Arc
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Arc weapons are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响电弧武器所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Power from Pain
perks.description: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grant you Devour.
perks.descriptionZh: 对被削弱的战斗人员造成快速最后一击为你提供吞食效果。

perks.name: Riposte
perks.description: Shortly after guarding with a Sword, your light and heavy attacks stun unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑格挡后不久，你的轻攻击与重攻击会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Rapid Remedy
perks.description: Machine Gun rapid final blows heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 机枪快速最后一击会治疗你。

perks.name: Fierce Proxemics
perks.description: Finisher final blows grant grenade and melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击提供手雷和近战能量。

perks.name: Press The Advantage
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

perks.name: Reload at Range
perks.description: Precision hits with Bows and Sniper Rifles grant a stacking bonus to their reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用弓箭和狙击步枪的精准命中会为其填装速度提供可叠加的加成。

perks.name: Kinetic Synthesis
perks.description: Sustained Kinetic weapon damage and rapid final blows have a chance to generate a unique ammo brick. Collecting this brick will grant ammo to equipped Kinetic damage weapons and grant Special and Heavy ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续的动能武器伤害和快速最后一击有几率生成独特弹药盒。拾取该弹药盒会为已装备的动能伤害武器提供弹药，同时提供特殊和重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Ember of Tempering
perks.description:
Solar weapon final blows grant you and your allies increased health for a short duration. Stacks 3 times.

While Ember of Tempering is active, your weapons have increased airborne effectiveness, and your Solar weapon final blows create a Firesprite.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日武器最后一击可让你和盟友在短时间内获得更高的生命值。可叠加3层。

激活回火余烬时，你的武器将拥有更高的空中效率，并且烈日武器最后一击可生成一个焰灵。

perks.name: Cataclysm
perks.description: Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks enemies. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles. Fire your weapon at the Nova Bomb to detonate it early.
perks.descriptionZh: 新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪敌人。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性弹头。使用武器射击新星炸弹可提前引爆它。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善手炮的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Auto Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Auto Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的自动步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Kinetic Stabilization Mod
perks.description: Reduces recoil for the equipped Kinetic weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低已装备动能武器的后坐力。

perks.name: Enhanced Nightmare Banisher
perks.description: Grants additional damage to your Super against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的超能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Supreme Nightmare Banisher
perks.description: Grants additional damage to your Super against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的超能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Stasis Weapon Surge
perks.description: Your Stasis weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的冰影武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time. Improves base stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成伤害可逐渐减少后坐力和抖动。提高基础稳定性。

perks.name: Play with Your Prey
perks.description: The Void rocket suppresses combatants. The Solar rocket scorches.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空火箭压制战斗人员。烈日火箭可造成灼烧。

perks.name: Whirlwind Blade
perks.description: Rapid Sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for an improved duration. Guarding ends the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速刀剑打击将增加此武器的伤害，持续时间延长。防御将中断此效果。

perks.name: Unflinching Bow Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低弓瞄时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Elemental Light
perks.description: Defeating a combatant with your Super spawns an elemental well that matches your subclass energy type.
perks.descriptionZh: 用超能击败战斗人员会生成一个符合你的分支职业能量类型的元素井。

perks.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
perks.description: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成多次命中会将你的下一发子弹变成一枚制导微型导弹。

perks.name: Once activated, walk into the portal on the Relocator Pad to teleport to the Exit Pad.
perks.nameZh: 激活后，走进重定位器板上的传送门来传送到出口板。
perks.description: Once activated, walk into the portal on the Relocator Pad to teleport to the Exit Pad.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活后，走进重定位器板上的传送门来传送到出口板。

perks.name: Reflex Action
perks.description: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换到热量武器、微型冲锋枪或手炮会在短时间内提升操控性和精度。使用该武器造成伤害可延长此效果。

perks.name: Hotshot
perks.description: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在反射动作生效时造成最后一击会获得武器属性提升，并在一定时间内提升热量武器、微型冲锋枪和手炮的稳定性、填装和瞄准辅助。

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.
perks.descriptionZh:
投掷手雷或使用充能近战击中目标可提供武器稳定性、操控性和射程叠加加成。

使用超能可提供最大叠加次数。

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.description: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.
perks.descriptionZh: 对拥有覆盖护盾的目标造成额外伤害。对战斗人员的护盾造成少量额外伤害。

perks.name: Halberdier's Reach
perks.description: Improves Glaive melee. Glaive projectile final blows cause detonations.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升偃月近战。偃月射弹最后一击会引起爆炸。

perks.name: Impact Absorber
perks.description: Increases this armor's resilience, allowing you to absorb more damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高这件护甲的韧性，以提高你的伤害接受能力。

perks.name: Artifice Armor
perks.description: Bonus socket for stat adjustments.
perks.descriptionZh: 用于属性调整的额外插槽。

perks.name: Dragonfly Spec
perks.description: Increases the radius and damage of Dragonfly.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高蜻蜓的爆炸范围和伤害。

perks.name: Expanding Abyss
perks.description: Void sources deal increased damage to weakened targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空来源对被削弱目标造成的伤害增加。

perks.name: Argent Blade
perks.description: While you have Armor Charge, dealing damage with a Sword consumes an Armor Charge and empowers your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and energy charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你有护甲充能时，使用刀剑造成伤害会消耗护甲充能，并在短时间内为你的刀剑赋能，使其获得额外伤害和充能速度。

perks.name: Prismatic Transfer
perks.description: When you cast your Super, each member of your fireteam with a Super type different than yours gains a bonus to weapon damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放超能时，你的火力战队中与你的超能类型不同的每位成员可获得武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Shock and Awe
perks.description: When you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业的情况下，处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

perks.name: Sniper's Meditation
perks.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one.
perks.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

perks.name: Transference
perks.description:
Gain increased grenade and melee damage while transcendent.

Weapon final blows while transcendent refund Light and Dark energy after Transcendence ends.
perks.descriptionZh:
处于超凡状态时，可获得更高的手雷和 近战伤害。

处于超凡状态时，武器最后一击在超凡结束后可返还光能和暗影能量。

perks.name: Shieldcrush
perks.description:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void Overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are amplified or radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，你的 近战充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

当你处于增幅或焕光状态时，你的 手雷充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.description: Reloading a short time after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后短时间内进行填装时可以为收起的武器也进行填装。

perks.name: Pumpkin Bomb
perks.description: Adds a pumpkin appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个南瓜外观。

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 可提升弹药和备弹，但会减少伤害、爆炸范围和填装速度。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高榴弹发射器的填装速度。

perks.name: Bitterspite
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage accelerates its next reload.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可加速其下次重新填装。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

perks.name: Starlight Beam
perks.description: Fires a stable beam of pure Arc energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一束稳定的纯净电弧能量。

perks.name: End of the Rainbow
perks.description: Adds a rainbow appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个彩虹外观。

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 当敌人接近时，填装速度、稳定性和操控性均会提高。

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成最后一击，将有几率在目标位置产生实验性子弹药。

perks.name: Honed Edge
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Consume the magazine and load a more powerful round.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ： 消耗弹匣以填充一枚更强大的弹药。

perks.name: Lightweight Frame
perks.description: Recurve. Charge quick, move fast.
perks.descriptionZh: 反曲弓。快速拉弓，移动迅速。

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Substantially increases stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.
perks.descriptionZh:
根据当前装备的超能显著增加属性。
•  加快填装速度。
•  增加操控性。
•  增加稳定性。
•  适度地控制后坐力，并提高瞄准时的移动速度。
•  提升空中效率。

perks.name: Invigoration
perks.description: Reduces melee cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短近战技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Machine Gun Loader
perks.description: Increases the reload speed of Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高机枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Horde Shuttle
perks.description: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a threadling.
perks.descriptionZh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。

perks.name: tier5_mod3
perks.description: tier5_mod3
perks.descriptionZh: tier5_mod3

perks.name: Hail The Storm
perks.description:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

perks.name: tier5_mod5
perks.description: Firing a Rocket Launcher consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed until you reload or stow your Rocket Launcher.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射火箭发射器会消耗一层护甲充能，在你填装或收起火箭发射器前可提升伤害和填装速度。

perks.name: tier5_mod4
perks.description: tier5_mod4
perks.descriptionZh: tier5_mod4

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Sidearm Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高手枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器破坏战斗人员的护盾，使他们对动能伤害的承受力更低，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Causality Quiver
perks.description:
Perfectly drawn arrows that detonate Sacred Flames increase arrow damage.

Striking targets unaffected by Sacred Flame instead refreshes Causality Arrows' duration.
perks.descriptionZh:
完美的搭弓射箭会引爆神圣之焰，提升箭矢伤害。

击中未收到神圣之焰影响的目标会刷新因果箭矢的持续时间。

perks.name: Titan Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on the moon Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 在土卫六上探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: On the Prowl
perks.description:
Periodically marks a nearby combatant as a priority target for you and your team. Entering invisibility immediately marks a target.

Defeating priority targets creates a weakening cloud of smoke that makes you and allies invisible when passing through it. 

When priority targets are defeated, you and nearby allies gain increased weapon reload speed and stability for a short duration and are granted grenade, melee, and class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
周期性将附近的一名战斗人员标记为你和你队伍的首要目标。进入隐形状态会立即标记一个目标。

击败首要目标会生成具有削弱效果的烟雾云，你和盟友穿过它时会获得隐身状态。

当首要目标被击败时，你和附近的盟友会在短时间内提升武器填装速度和稳定性，并获得手雷、近战和职业技能能量。

perks.name: Grenade Kickstart
perks.description: When your grenade energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain grenade energy for each Armor Charge used.
perks.descriptionZh: 在手雷能量完全耗尽时，你的护甲充能会被消耗，每一层被消耗的护甲充能都会赋予你额外的手雷能量。

perks.name: Proximity Ward
perks.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher.
perks.descriptionZh: 在使用终结技时获得一个强大的力场护盾。

perks.name: Enhanced Small Arms Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型小型武器装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Hand Cannons, Sidearms, Submachine Guns, and Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高手炮、手枪、微型冲锋枪和弓箭的填装速度。

perks.name: Green Dawning Lantern
perks.description: Adds a green Dawning lantern to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色曙光灯笼。

perks.name: Edge
perks.description: Greatly increases charge rate and guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升充能速度和防御抗性。

perks.name: Whisper of Rending
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons do increased damage to [Stasis] Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 主弹药武器对冰影水晶以及被冻结的目标造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Whisper of Conduction
perks.description: Nearby [Stasis] Stasis shards track to your position.
perks.descriptionZh: 附近的冰影碎片会追踪至你的位置。

perks.name: Whisper of Rime
perks.description: Your Frost Armor has increased duration and maximum stack count.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的冰霜护甲拥有更久的持续时间和最大层数。

perks.name: Whisper of Hunger
perks.description: Increases the melee energy gained from picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加拾取冰影碎片时得到的近战能量。

perks.name: Splintered Gladius
perks.description:
Defeating Cabal Centurions grants Gunsmith Materials.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭卡巴尔百夫长可获得枪匠材料。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description: High damage, high recoil.
perks.descriptionZh: 高伤害，高后坐力。

perks.name: Scorn Slayer
perks.description: Grants additional rewards when you're defeating Scorn.
perks.descriptionZh: 当击败嗤魅时有机会获得额外奖励。

perks.name: Vanguard Valiant
perks.description: Grants a chance to receive an extra Vanguard token whenever you get one.
perks.descriptionZh: 任何时间得到一枚先锋代币时都有几率获得一枚额外代币。

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Mercury Scout Reports
perks.description: Highlights nearby loot caches on Mercury for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你和你的火力战队在水星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.description: Sword final blows grant increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑最后一击可提高充能速度和防御，效果持续至收起此武器。

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.description: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可调整其伤害输出和效率来对抗与其伤害类型不匹配的能量护盾。

perks.name: Color Variants
perks.description: This transmat effect may be awarded in pink or purple color variants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此传送效果可能出现粉色或紫色变幻。

perks.name: Radar Booster
perks.description: Slightly increases the range at which radar detects enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 在雷达监测到敌人时，侦测范围略微提高。

perks.name: Vestian Ward
perks.description: Spending a Defiant Key at the end of a Season of Defiance Battleground in which you received Favors of Grace, Justice, and Zeal will award an additional Defiant Engram and War Table reputation.
perks.descriptionZh: 在你获得优雅、正义和狂热恩惠的抗战赛季战场结束时，花费抗战密钥可奖励额外抗战记忆水晶和战争圆桌声望。

perks.name: Taking Flight
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

perks.name: Ember of Eruption
perks.description: Your Solar ignitions have increased area of effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的烈日点燃范围效果获得提升。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Sprint Grip
perks.description: Greatly increases the weapon's ready speed and aim down sights speed temporarily after sprinting.
perks.descriptionZh: 在冲刺后短暂地大幅提升武器的准备速度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Dynamic Charge
perks.description: Final blows and precision hits build up Dynamic Charge. Swapping to Arc Seeker mode increases damage and partially reloads the magazine based on the number of charges. Charged Arc Seeker hits grant, and can spend, Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击和精准命中会积累动态充能。切换至电弧追踪弹模式时，根据充能数量增加伤害并填装部分弹匣。充能电弧追踪弹命中可获得和消耗电光充能。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Strand
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Strand weapons are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响缚丝武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Void
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Void weapons are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响虚空武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Solar
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your Solar weapons are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响烈日武器的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Grenades
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your grenades are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响手雷的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Multi-Siphon Mods
perks.description: Grants access to armor mods in your helmet that combine the effects of the Strand Siphon mod with the Solar Siphon and Void Siphon mods.
perks.descriptionZh: 可在头盔中使用将缚丝虹吸模组与烈日虹吸及虚空虹吸模组效果相结合的护甲模组。

perks.name: Wire Rifle
perks.description: Swap between scopes to alter firing mode. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换瞄准镜来改变射击模式。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Tithe Collector's Sigil
perks.description:
Defeating Cabal combatants grants a small amount of Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭卡巴尔战斗人员可获得少量微光。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Arc Impact Accelerator
perks.description:
Arc melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
提高电弧近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Pinpoint Slug Frame
perks.description: Fires a single slug round.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射单发弹头。

perks.name: Drengr's Lash
perks.description:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: UNLOCKED BY QUEST
perks.description:
ASPECT OF INFLUENCE
Purchase this Stasis Aspect from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
perks.descriptionZh:
感应之星相
在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影星相。

perks.name: Graceful Impala
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Whisper of Fissures
perks.description: Increases the damage and size of the burst of [Stasis] Stasis when you destroy a [Stasis] Stasis crystal or defeat a frozen target.
perks.descriptionZh: 摧毁冰影结晶或消灭被冻结的目标时，提高 冰影的伤害和爆炸范围。

perks.name: Bottomless Grief
perks.description: Increases magazine size. While you are the last living member of your fireteam, each final blow refills your magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弹匣容量。如果你是火力战队中唯一生还的成员，每次最后一击都会为你回满弹匣。

perks.name: Taken Spec
perks.description: Increased damage against Taken enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高对傀儡敌人的伤害。

perks.name: Shocked Glyphkeeper
perks.description: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, Machine Guns, and Submachine Guns to deal additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的脉冲步枪、手枪、机枪和微型冲锋枪造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Ember of Ashes
perks.description: You apply more scorch stacks to targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 你可对目标施加更多灼烧层数。

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.
perks.descriptionZh:
根据当前装备的超能增加属性。
•  加快填装速度。
•  增加操控性。
•  增加稳定性。
•  适度地控制后坐力，并提高瞄准时的移动速度。
•  提升空中效率。

perks.name: Counterbalance Stock
perks.description: Reduces recoil deviation for the weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低武器的后坐力偏转。

perks.name: Strike Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Strikes.
perks.descriptionZh: 在打击中微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Seeker of Opulence
perks.description: Exotic drops from encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" have a 50% chance of being a Year 1 Exotic not already in your collection.
perks.descriptionZh: “利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战所掉落的异域装备，有50%的几率是你的收藏中未包含的首年异域装备。

perks.name: Bones Akimbo
perks.description: Adds an explosion of bones appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个骨头爆炸的外观。

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 拿出此武器前使用其他武器击败目标，可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。此效果可基于击败目标的数量溢出弹匣。

perks.name: Trace Evidence
perks.description: Dealing precision damage to combatants affected by Arc debuffs spawns an Ionic Trace.
perks.descriptionZh: 用精准伤害消灭被电弧减益状态影响的战斗人员，会产生一个离子轨迹。

perks.name: Amped Up
perks.description: Stay amplified longer.
perks.descriptionZh: 保持增幅状态更久。

perks.name: Thunderous Retort
perks.description: Grants bonus Arc Super damage if cast while critically wounded or while amplified. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.
perks.descriptionZh: 在重伤或增幅状态下施放可获得电弧超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

perks.name: Sundering Glare
perks.description: Rapid precision hits against distant combatants weaken them for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对远距离战斗人员的快速精准命中会在短时间内削弱他们。

perks.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
perks.description: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance for a longer duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的职业技能后，使用此武器造成最后一击可在更长的时间内获得额外的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Once More
perks.description: Reloading increases this weapon's damage if you hit with at least half the rounds in the magazine, but fail to defeat anything.
perks.descriptionZh: 在消耗了至少一半的弹匣却没有造成击败的情况下，填装会增加武器造成的伤害。

perks.name: Crucible Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while in the Crucible.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场中获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Hymn of Desecration
perks.description:
Greatly increases the chance of a weapon drop from your next Necropolis or Chamber of Suffering encounter in the Pit of Heresy.

Effect lasts until the dungeon encounter is completed.
perks.descriptionZh:
大幅提高你在“异端深渊”里的墓地或苦难之穹战斗后武器掉落概率。

此效果将持续到地牢战斗完成为止。

perks.name: Glacial Inheritance
perks.description: Defeating targets with your Stasis Super refunds Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的冰影超能击败目标可返还超能能量。

perks.name: Arm's Reach
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy when defeating a combatant near a limb of the Witness.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败靠近见证者肢体的战斗人员可获得额外超能能量。

perks.name: Encore
perks.description: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会赋予该武器可叠加的射程奖励。非精准最后一击将移除叠加射程奖励，但会在所有叠加射程被消除后奖励额外精准度和稳定性。

perks.name: Minor Class Mod
perks.description: Increases the Class stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升职业属性。

perks.name: Enhanced Sniper Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化狙击步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高狙击步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Echoes of Glory
perks.description: Grants additional Failsafe vendor reputation from all sources. For each piece of armor equipped with this perk, this bonus increases.
perks.descriptionZh: 可从所有来源获得额外智能失效保险商人声望。具有此特性的护甲装备得越多，此加成越高。

perks.name: Energy Converter
perks.description: While Charged with Light, using your grenade attack grants you Super energy, consuming all stacks of Charged with Light. The more stacks you have, the more energy you gain, up to a maximum of 50% of your Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，使用你的手雷进行攻击可获得超能能量，消耗全部光之充能层数。你拥有的层数越多，你获得的能量越多，最高可获得50%的超能能量。

perks.name: Taken Ambition
perks.description: Blight generated increases the longer this weapon remains on a target. Blighted Seekers burrow into targets and explode.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器持续瞄准目标的时间越长，生成的凋零阴影就越多。凋零追踪弹会钻入目标体内并爆炸。

perks.name: Sidearm Scavenger
perks.description: Sidearms that use Special ammo get bonus reserves when you pick up Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用特殊子弹的手枪在拾取特殊弹药时获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Machine Gun Reserves
perks.description: Increase the amount of Machine Gun ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的机枪弹药储量。

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed for an improved amount.

Swords gain improved charge rate and guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器击败目标或造成伤害会逐渐提升其射程、稳定性、操控性、填装速度，提升量更多。

刀剑会获得进一步提升的充能速度和防御抗性。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chances of finding Special ammo while you have a Hand Cannon that uses Special ammo equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备使用特殊弹药的手炮后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

perks.name: Shiver Quiver
perks.description: Freezing or slowing a target grants this weapon faster draw speed for a short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 冻结或减速目标可在短时间内为此武器提供更快的拉弓速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Range
perks.description: +10 Range
perks.descriptionZh: +10 射程

perks.name: Spark of Strength
perks.description: Spark of Strength
perks.descriptionZh: 力量火花

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: [轻攻击]  ：短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供刀剑的弹药。

perks.name: Bastion
perks.description:
Cast your Super to grant Overshield to nearby allies. 

Casting your Barricade grants Overshield to yourself and nearby allies and empowers it, enabling it to slowly regenerate the Overshield of allies bunkering behind it and extend their Overshield duration.
perks.descriptionZh:
施放超能来赋予附近盟友覆盖护盾。

施放屏障可赋予自己和附近盟友覆盖护盾，并为其赋能，使其缓慢恢复躲在后面的盟友的覆盖护盾，并延长他们的覆盖护盾持续时间。

perks.name: Enhanced Sidearm Loader
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高手枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Arc Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Arc weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善电弧武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Blood Magic
perks.description: Weapon kills while in a rift extend the rift's duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在裂痕中的武器击杀延长裂痕的持续时间。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 线性融合步枪装弹装置
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高线性融合步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Radiant Heat
perks.description: Powerful combatant final blows with Solar weapons grants Radiant. Must have a Solar subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日武器对强力战斗人员造成最后一击可获得焕光效果。必须装备烈日分支职业。

perks.name: Beam Effects
perks.description: Adds beam elements to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加光束元素。

perks.name: Restoration Ritual
perks.description: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Handling is improved.
perks.descriptionZh: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。提升操控性。

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊或重型弹药可填装武器至超出正常弹药储存量，储存量进一步提高。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Glaive
perks.description: [Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield
perks.descriptionZh: [瞄准]  ：举起护盾

perks.name: Arc Conductor
perks.description: Heavy attacks surge lightning from the user.
perks.descriptionZh: 重攻击会从使用者发出闪电。

perks.name: Close the Gap
perks.description: Charges to fire a high-powered laser. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能以发射一道高能激光。

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for an improved short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
perks.descriptionZh: 在更短的一小段时间内瞄准此武器而不射击可提高射程和精准伤害，射击或退出瞄准后重置。

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.description: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 一发弹药的所有弹片均命中同一敌人可在短时间内提高近战伤害。

perks.name: Temporal Manipulation
perks.description: Arc and Stasis modal weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧和冰影模型武器。

perks.name: Air-Cooled Core
perks.description: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺可在短时间内提升排气或填装速度。处于低热量或满弹匣时，瞄准可获得更高的操控性和移动速度。

perks.name: Grasp of the Devourer
perks.description: Melee hits inflict potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战命中会施加随时间造成递增伤害的强效腐化。

perks.name: Strength Armorer
perks.description: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Strength, and are more likely to drop with higher Strength.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点力量，且很可能掉落时带有更多的力量。

perks.name: Solar Aligned—Rank 5
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a ludicrous amount of damage with Solar power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成恐怖程度的伤害。

perks.name: Solar Aligned—Rank 4
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do tons of damage with Solar power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成惨重的伤害。

perks.name: Solar Aligned—Rank 3
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do significantly more damage with Solar power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成极多的伤害。

perks.name: Solar Aligned—Rank 2
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a lot more damage with Solar power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成更多的伤害。

perks.name: Solar Aligned—Rank 1
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do more damage with Solar power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用烈日能量可造成很多的伤害。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高斥候步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Whirling Maelstrom
perks.description: Destroying a Tangle will weave a violent, writhing mass of [Strand] Strand fibers. The Strand mass seeks out and damages targets, emitting Unraveling projectiles when it defeats them.
perks.descriptionZh: 摧毁缠结会织出一团猛烈扭动的缚丝纤维。缚丝纤维团会寻找目标并对其造成伤害，在目标被击败后发出瓦解射弹。

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次精准射击命中后蓄力时间缩短。

perks.name: Pinpoint Guidance Module
perks.description: Improved tracking on projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高对弹头的追踪。

perks.name: Resurrected Shadow
perks.description: Adds a resurrected shadow appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个复活阴影外观。

perks.name: Unspun Fate
perks.description: Adds an unspun fate appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个命运使然外观。

perks.name: Hail Storm
perks.description: Direct hits with Stasis arrows freeze combatants and slow opposing Guardians. Stasis arrows that impact the environment create Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用冰影箭矢直接命中可冻结战斗人员并减速敌方守护者。击中环境物体的冰影箭矢会生成冰影水晶。

perks.name: Harmonic Siphon
perks.description: Rapid weapon final blows with damage matching your subclass type create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用伤害匹配你的分支职业类型的武器达成快速最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description:
Powerful, heavy swings.
[Heavy Attack]  : Slam.
perks.descriptionZh:
强力挥击。
[重攻击] ：猛击。

perks.name: Lightning Reflexes
perks.description: You are harder to kill while dodging.
perks.descriptionZh: 进行闪身时，你将更难被击杀。

perks.name: Slideways
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行可装填武器的一部分弹药，并暂时性地大幅提高武器操控性和稳定性。

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.description: Deals improved bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.
perks.descriptionZh: 对拥有覆盖护盾的目标造成更多额外伤害。对战斗人员的护盾造成少量额外伤害。

perks.name: Third Tail
perks.description: Adds another rocket to the volley that deals Arc damage and jolts combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 在齐射中再增加一枚火箭，可造成电弧伤害并震颤战斗人员。

perks.name: Superstructure Medic
perks.description: While you are standing on a sync plate or are near a conflux, weapon attacks that hit powerful Vex combatants have a high chance to create a burst of healing for you and allies near you.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你站在同步板上或汇流附近时，击中强力Vex战斗人员的武器攻击有高几率对你和你附近的友军进行爆发治疗。

perks.name: Aggressive Oracle Disruptor
perks.description: Your equipped Auto Rifles, Fusion Rifles, Grenade Launchers, Trace Rifles, and Rocket Launchers deal additional damage to Oracles.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的自动步枪、融合步枪、榴弹发射器、追踪步枪和火箭发射器会对神谕造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Vex Destroyer
perks.description: Defeating a Vex with a grenade attack has a chance to spawn an Orb of Power. Multiple copies of this mod increase the Super energy granted when those Orbs are picked up.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷攻击消灭Vex有机会刷出能量球。多个此模组可以增加拾起产生的能量球时获得的超能能量。

perks.name: Kinetic Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Kinetic weapons over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 逐渐填装你已收起的动能武器。

perks.name: Recombination
perks.description: Elemental final blows increase the damage of this weapon's next shot. Damage accelerates faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 元素最后一击会提升此武器的下一击伤害。伤害提升速度加快。

perks.name: Elemental Armaments
perks.description: Combatant weapon final blows with a damage type that matches your subclass element have an escalating chance to spawn an elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 用符合你的分支职业元素类型的伤害类型取得战斗人员武器最后一击有更高几率生成元素井。

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.
perks.descriptionZh: 根据填装之前完成的快速击杀数可过量填充弹匣。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Voltaic Mote Collector
perks.description: Gain an overshield after you collect 5 Motes. This mod's effect does not stack with other copies of this mod.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集5个萤光后可获得力场护盾。此模组的效果无法与其他副本叠加。

perks.name: Facet of Justice
perks.description: While transcendent, your ability final blows explode.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于超凡状态时，你的技能最后一击会造成爆炸。

perks.name: Flash Counter
perks.description: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets for an improved period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 举起防御阻挡伤害后会释放出一道使目标迷失方向的短程冲击波，效果持续时间更长。

perks.name: Consecration
perks.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
perks.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可向前发射一波烈日能量，跃向空中的同时对前方目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战技能可猛击地面，生成第二波更大的烈日伤害能量。如果能量波击中灼烧目标，则会将其点燃。

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成更多的近战能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Wave Sword Frame
perks.description:
Heavy attack deploys a shockwave uppercut and launches the user into the air.
An immediate follow-up swing after the uppercut deploys a homing strike that aggressively seeks a target.
perks.descriptionZh:
重攻击会激发一股上行震荡波，将使用者抛到空中。
在上行震荡波发生后立即进行后续攻击，会发射一次主动搜寻目标的制导打击。

perks.name: Grenadier Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Grenadier archetype, which has Grenade as its primary stat and Super as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落掷雷手框架：手雷为主要属性，超能为次要属性。

perks.name: Dimensional Tithes
perks.description: Defeating Taken combantants has a chance to grant a small amout of Glimmer.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭傀儡军团战斗人员有几率获得少量微光。

perks.name: Nessus Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Super ▼
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Super ▼

perks.name: Vivid Spectrum
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a slightly increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会在稍微延长的时间内增加所有来源的弹药量表进度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Glimmer Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 赫拉斯盆地微光回收利用
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 在赫拉斯盆地的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Void Aligned—Rank 1
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do more damage with Void power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用虚空能量可造成很多的伤害。

perks.name: Void Aligned—Rank 2
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a lot more damage with Void power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用虚空能量可造成更多的伤害。

perks.name: Void Aligned—Rank 3
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do significantly more damage with Void power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用虚空能量可造成极多的伤害。

perks.name: Void Aligned—Rank 4
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do tons of damage with Void power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用虚空能量可造成惨重的伤害。

perks.name: Void Aligned—Rank 5
perks.description: By aligning with the Festival Flame, you do a ludicrous amount of damage with Void power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过与节日之焰结盟，使用虚空能量可造成恐怖程度的伤害。

perks.name: Determination
perks.description: Determination
perks.descriptionZh: 决绝

perks.name: Unflinching Trace Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Trace Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低追踪步枪瞄时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Overcharge Wellmaker
perks.description: Defeating a combatant with a finisher spawns 2 Arc elemental wells.
perks.descriptionZh: 用终结技击败战斗人员可产生2个电弧元素井。

perks.name: Warlord's End
perks.description: Powered melee kills create a burst of energy that weakens nearby enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 能量近战击杀可制造一次能量爆发，削弱附近的敌人。

perks.name: Imperial Allegiance
perks.description: Being near allies grants further increased cooling or charge rate, and increased damage while at high heat or low guard energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 靠近盟友时，进一步提升冷却或充能速度；高热量或低格挡能量时，提升伤害。

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中目标会暂时大幅提高稳定性和填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Legendary Deeds
perks.description: Spending a Defiant Key at the end of a Season of Defiance Battleground on Legend difficulty increases the amount of gear granted.
perks.descriptionZh: 在传说难度的抗战赛季战场结束时花费抗战密钥可提升获得的装备数量。

perks.name: Mercury Scanner
perks.description: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在水星上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Old Martian Diplomacy
perks.description: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 在击败一名强力战斗人员或守护者后收起武器，会为自身恢复少量生命值，并使附近战斗人员迷失方向。

perks.name: High Noon
perks.description: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
perks.descriptionZh: 新拔出的武器在短时间内对战斗人员造成的精准伤害获得提升。装备特克斯平衡枪托原始特性的武器或由特克斯机械铸造厂制造的异域装备将获得进一步的提升。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Mortal Polarity
perks.description: Precision hits create a lightning storm.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中会制造一场闪电风暴。

perks.name: Composite Propellant
perks.description: Rockets eject burning fuel. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭会喷射出燃烧燃料。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Enhanced Linear Fusion Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型线性融合步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高线性融合步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: MIDA Software Package
perks.description:
Final blows periodically apply modifications to this weapon, providing additional stats and benefits per modification:
  •  Chip: Faster handling and aim speed
  •  Barrel: Bonus range and stability
  •  Optics: Improved target acquisition
  •  Ammo: Shots detonate on impact
perks.descriptionZh:
最后一击定期为此武器应用改造，每项改造提供额外属性和增益：
  •  芯片：提升操控性与瞄准速度
  •  枪管：增加射程与稳定性
  •  光学瞄准镜：提升目标捕获能力
  •  弹药：射击命中时引爆

perks.name: Tactical
perks.description: Grants increased vent speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升排气速度和操控性。

perks.name: Void Analyzer
perks.description: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on Void weapon final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 在虚空武器最后一击时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Endless Siege
perks.description: Hammers create a Sunspot on impact. While standing in Sunspots, you throw Hammers faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 战锤在命中后制造一个太阳黑子。站在太阳黑子中时，你投掷战锤的速度更快。

perks.name: Echo of Leeching
perks.description: Melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击会为你和你附近的友军带来生命恢复效果。

perks.name: Barrel Constrictor
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon significantly reduce its projectile spread for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可大幅降低其弹道分布，持续时间延长。

perks.name: +20 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +20 Grenade ▲

perks.name: Bounteous
perks.description: Grants a chance to receive an additional bounty when redeeming a clan bounty.
perks.descriptionZh: 当兑换公会悬赏时，有机会获得额外一个悬赏。

perks.name: Echo of Exchange
perks.description: Melee final blows grant grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击将赋予手雷能量。

perks.name: Reversal of Fortune
perks.description: Missing 2 shots returns a bullet to the magazine after a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 射偏2发子弹会在短时间后将1发子弹返回弹匣。

perks.name: Kintsugi
perks.description: Revive provides an overshield to you and nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 复活可为你和附近的同伴提供覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Cold and Bright
perks.description: Adds a Dawning flourish to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加曙光节的繁华。

perks.name: Shining Winter
perks.description: Adds a Dawning flourish to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加曙光节的繁华。

perks.name: Terrordactyl
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Parasitism
perks.description: This weapon does more damage to enemies based on the number of SIVA nanites that attach to them.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器会根据附着在敌人身上的湿婆纳米蜂群数量造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.description: Significantly increases handling, decreases target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅增加操控性，降低目标捕获能力。

perks.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perks.name: Solidus Strike
perks.description:
Defeating Cabal combatants with finishers grants extra Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用终结技消灭卡巴尔战斗人员可获得额外微光。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.description: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability for an extended duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 投身战斗一小段时间会在更长的时间内提升操控性和稳定性。

perks.name: Heavy Finisher
perks.description: Finishers generate Heavy ammo. Requires one-half of your Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技可生成重型武器弹药。需要 1/2 的超能能量。

perks.name: Volatile Conduction
perks.description: Grants bonus Arc Super damage if cast while critically wounded. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.
perks.descriptionZh: 在重伤状态下施放可获得电弧超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会更快地灼烧目标。对被灼烧的目标造成伤害会施加灼烧效果。

perks.name: Moon Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% while on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 在月球上的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Diamond Lance
perks.description:
Shatter or defeat targets with abilities or [Stasis] Stasis weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用技能或冰影武器碎裂或击败目标来生成冰影长矛。

[射击]  ：投掷长矛以冻结被命中的目标。

[近战]  ：使用长矛猛击地面以冻结小范围内的目标。

perks.name: Umbral Sustenance
perks.description: This weapon's magazine is automatically reloaded when you gain Devour, a Void overshield, or become invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的弹匣在你获得吞食、虚空覆盖护盾或隐身时会自动填装弹药。

perks.name: Thread of Warding
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Woven Mail.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会提供织造铠甲。

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 附近有三名或更多目标时，此武器可造成更高的额外伤害。

perks.name: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Super ▼
perks.description: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Super ▼

perks.name: Enhanced Fusion Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高融合步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Stasis Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Stasis damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的冰影伤害。

perks.name: Sundering
perks.description:
Destroying vehicles and constructs or breaking target shields grants this weapon additional bonus reload speed and charge rate.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
摧毁载具和构造体或击碎目标护盾可以额外增加此武器的填装速度和充能速度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Thread of Rebirth
perks.description: [Strand] Strand weapon final blows have a chance to create a Threadling.
perks.descriptionZh: 缚丝武器最后一击有几率生成一个线虫。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Prized Shooting
perks.description:
Defeating combatants or opponents with Hand Cannons or Sidearms grants a small amount of Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用 手炮 或 手枪 击败战斗人员或对手可获得少量微光。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: -10 Class ▼
