perks.description: -10 Class ▼

perks.name: Support Frame
perks.description: Capable of healing allies and hurting foes. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and bestows restoration to your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 能够治疗盟友和伤害对手。对目标造成伤害会积累治疗充能。当武器充满时，对盟友腰射可治疗他们。快速治疗会增加武器伤害并为盟友提供恢复。

perks.name: -20 Super ▼
perks.description: -20 Super ▼

perks.name: Tangled Shore Glimmer Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 纷争海岸微光回收利用
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸上的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Voltaic Mirror
perks.description: Attacks you redirect with your Arc Staff deal massively increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 被你的电弧法杖偏转的攻击造成的伤害会大幅提升。

perks.name: +5 Super ▲
perks.description: +5 Super ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 超能 ▲

perks.name: Black Hole
perks.description: Second shot in burst does high damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 点射的第二发会造成高伤害。

perks.name: +5 All Stats ▲
perks.description: +5 All Stats ▲
perks.descriptionZh: 所有属性+5▲

perks.name: Paracausal Shot
perks.description: Final round damage for precision hits.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中的最后一发子弹伤害。

perks.name: Kinetic Stabilization Mod
perks.description: Reduces recoil for the equipped Kinetic weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低已装备动能武器的后坐力。

perks.name: Void Siphon
perks.description: Rapid Void weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速虚空武器最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会使附近目标变得虚弱。

perks.name: -20 Class ▼
perks.description: -20 Class ▼

perks.name: Gunpowder Gamble
perks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败目标可充能临时烈日爆炸。

[手雷]  ：投掷出可在半空被击中，造成点燃的烈日爆炸。

perks.name: Paracausal Imbuement
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant Super energy. This weapon gains bonus damage once your Super expires.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可获得超能能量。超能结束后，此武器将获得额外伤害。

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在短时间内提高射弹伤害。

perks.name: Rampager's Handle
perks.description: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain moderately increased damage resistance from being in combat for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 传统防御被禁用，转而偏好进攻能力。处于战斗状态时，一定时间内获得中幅增加的伤害抗性。

perks.name: -10 Super ▼
perks.description: -10 Super ▼

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战和此武器获得击杀可提高此武器造成的伤害。

perks.name: Bottomless Grief
perks.description: Substantially increases magazine size. While you are the last living member of your fireteam, each final blow refills your magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高弹匣容量。如果你是火力战队中唯一生还的成员，每次最后一击都会为你填充弹匣。

perks.name: Siegebreaker Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Siegebreaker archetype, which has Health as its primary stat and Grenade as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落突围者框架：生命值为主要属性，手雷为次要属性。

perks.name: Adept Persistence
perks.description: +10 Persistence
perks.descriptionZh: +10 坚韧

perks.name: XP Boost
perks.description: Increased XP gain.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得更多经验值。

perks.name: The Fourth Magic
perks.description: Weapon final blows boost grenade damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会强化手雷伤害。

perks.name: Aeon's Vow
perks.description: Gain class ability energy and take reduced damage from combatants for a short time when an ally dies or when you resurrect an ally.
perks.descriptionZh: 当一名盟友死亡或复活一名盟友时，可获得职业技能能量，并在短时间内减少战斗人员对你造成的伤害。

perks.name: Lightgiver Chant
perks.description: Nearby critically wounded allies take reduced damage from combatants. Nearby Aeon Cult allies who do not have the Sect of Vigor role equipped also gain class ability energy while critically wounded.
perks.descriptionZh: 战斗人员对附近受重伤的盟友所造成的伤害减少。附近未装备活力学派角色的永劫邪教盟友还会在受重伤时获得职业技能能量。

perks.name: -30 Class ▼
perks.description: -30 Class ▼

perks.name: Power Preservation
perks.description: Your Super final blows create extra Orbs of Power for your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的超能最后一击会为你的盟友创造出额外的能量球。

perks.name: Splicer Surge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after dealing damage grants the weapon an improved stacking reload speed and handling bonus until stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害后填装此武器，可为其叠加更多填装速度并提供操控性加成，直到收起武器。

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成最后一击可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。提高弹匣容量。

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成溅射伤害会赋予更多的手雷属性加成。

perks.name: Tempest Strike
perks.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to unleash a devastating uppercut attack that travels along the ground in front of you, damaging and jolting targets it hits.

Defeating jolted targets grants a stack of Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
在滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能，沿着你前方的地面施展一次毁灭性的上挑攻击，对命中的目标造成伤害并使其震颤。

击败被震颤的目标可提供一层电光充能。

perks.name: Glacial Inheritance
perks.description: Defeating targets with your Stasis Super refunds Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的冰影超能击败目标可返还超能能量。

perks.name: Blackheart Growth
perks.description: Adds a Black Garden appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个黑暗花园外观。

perks.name: Vex Invasion Effects
perks.description: Adds Vex effects to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex效果。

perks.name: Eager Edge
perks.description: Gain further increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换到此武器后立即大幅提高刀剑前冲距离。

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷或此武器获得最后一击可提高此武器的伤害和操控性，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Facet of Courage
perks.description: Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的电弧、烈日和虚空技能会对受到暗影减益效果影响的目标造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Uncatchable
perks.description: Gain damage resistance against combatants while sprinting.
perks.descriptionZh: 在冲刺时获得对战斗人员的伤害减免。

perks.name: Nail, Meet Hammer
perks.description: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants bonus Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo, or Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾更有效。使用此武器摧毁护盾时，若使用的是主武器或重型弹药，则提供额外的特殊弹药进度；若使用的是特殊弹药，则提供重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Kinetic Munition Mod
perks.description: Improves reload speed for equipped Kinetic weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高已装备动能武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Void Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Void weapons over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 逐渐填装你已收起的虚空武器。

perks.name: Micro-Missile Frame
perks.description: Fires self-propelled micro-missiles that explode on impact for high damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射自推进微型导弹。命中时会爆炸，造成高额伤害。

perks.name: Storm of Lead
perks.description: Gain Super energy on Machine Gun final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 机枪最后一击获得超能能量。

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭会在碰撞时粘附，延迟一定时间后引爆。爆炸范围扩大且伤害提高。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Property: Undecidable
perks.description: Damage type matches your grenade.
perks.descriptionZh: 伤害类型与你的手雷相匹配。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Super ▼
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Super ▼

perks.name: Peerless Edge
perks.description: Increases the damage bonus of Honed Edge when four bullets are consumed.
perks.descriptionZh: 消耗四颗子弹时，砥砺刀锋会造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Schwarzschild Condenser
perks.description:
Void melee abilities [Stagger] stun unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
虚空近战技能会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Reflection Effects
perks.description: Adds an Osiris theme to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个奥斯里斯主题。

perks.name: Consul's Pitch
perks.description: Improves Hellion.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升地狱火。

perks.name: Fang and Claw
perks.description: Increases reload speed and stability. While Release the Wolves is active, damaging targets with this weapon applies Scorch. When aiming down sights, defeating a target spreads Scorch to those nearby.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升填装速度和稳定性。狼群出动生效时，使用此武器对目标造成伤害会施加灼烧。瞄准时，击败目标会将灼烧扩散至附近目标。

perks.name: Enhanced Nightmare Breaker
perks.description: Grants additional damage against shields created by Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在攻击梦魇狩猎首领制造的护盾时可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Supreme Nightmare Breaker
perks.description: Grants additional damage against shields created by Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在攻击梦魇狩猎首领制造的护盾时可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Crucible Paragon
perks.description: A member of your match has used a Fireteam Medallion, granting all players in the match increased XP gains and loot from match completion.
perks.descriptionZh: 比赛中的一位成员使用了火力战队大勋章，将增加所有玩家在比赛中获得的经验值和赛后战利品。

perks.name: The Relocator Launcher deals Void damage and applies a weakening effect.
perks.nameZh: 重定位发射器造成虚空伤害并施加削弱效果。
perks.description: The Relocator Launcher deals Void damage and applies a weakening effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 重定位发射器造成虚空伤害并施加削弱效果。

perks.name: Desperado
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成精准最后一击或快速击败目标后进行填装可提升你的射速，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 长时间处于战斗状态会提升此武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度，持续直到脱离战斗。

perks.name: Void Mastery
perks.description: When empowerment ends, you gain a Void Overshield, the strength of which depends on how long you were empowered.
perks.descriptionZh: 赋能结束时，你会获得一个虚空覆盖护盾，其力量取决于你获得赋能的时间。

perks.name: Impulse Recycler
perks.description: Grenade final blows grant grenade energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase the amount of energy gained.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击奖励手雷能量。多个此模组可以增加奖励的能量。

perks.name: Serve the Colony
perks.description: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 在未装备群居者的情况下，机器人榴弹可快速从储备弹药转移到弹匣中。

perks.name: Inverse Relationship
perks.description:
When you deal damage with this weapon, it gains increased handling, takes reduced flinch, and movement speed is increased for a short time.

When you are at reduced health, this weapon deals additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成伤害时，它的操控性会提升，抖动会减少。短时间内移动速度会提高。

当你的生命值减少时，此武器会造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Compounding Force
perks.description: Fires slugs that cause massive damage to combatant shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射的弹药会对战斗人员元素护盾造成巨大的伤害。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Mindspun Invocation
perks.description:
Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的抓取、束缚手雷、线虫手雷和切线手雷拥有强化性能。

你的抓取近战会生成三个线虫。

[手雷]  ：按住消耗你的束缚手雷并激活编织者之境。编织者之境激活时造成最后一击可生成一次悬停爆炸。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的线虫手雷，使其在命中地点编织一个不断生成线虫的线虫巢穴。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的切线手雷。该手雷最终爆炸时将发射子弹药并在其路径上留下一个缠结。

perks.name: Focused Fire
perks.description: After a final blow with this weapon, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to return ammo to the magazine and swap to a tighter spread that deals increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击后，[替换武器动作]来将弹药返回弹匣并切换到更紧密的扩散范围，以造成更大的伤害。

perks.name: Trickle Charge
perks.description: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads the magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 接收或释放电光充能会从备弹中填装弹匣的一部分。

perks.name: Titan Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 在土卫六上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Brimming with Exhaustion
perks.description: Reduce duration of the Drained of Light debuff by 2 seconds. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 光能耗尽减益的持续时间减少2秒。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Adaptive Burst
perks.description: Well-rounded, reliable, 3-round burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 全面，可靠，3发点射。

perks.name: Sol Invictus
perks.description:
Solar ability final blows, Hammer of Sol impacts, and defeating scorched targets creates Sunspots. Your abilities regenerate faster, and your Super drains more slowly while standing in a Sunspot.

Sunspots apply scorch and deal damage to targets inside. Entering a Sunspot applies restoration.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日技能最后一击、烈焰战锤击中以及消灭灼烧目标可生成太阳黑子。站在太阳黑子中时你的技能恢复速度将加快，超能消耗速度将减缓。

太阳黑子可对其内部的目标施加灼烧效果并造成伤害。进入太阳黑子可施加恢复效果。

perks.name: Dragon's Vengeance
perks.description: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills, and it gains bonus range, charge rate, and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

perks.name: Minor Resist
perks.description: Gain extra damage resistance against rank-and-file combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得对抗来自普通敌人的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Ferocity
perks.description: If you have not gone flawless this week, losses after three wins reset you to back to three wins.
perks.descriptionZh: 如果你本周未达到无瑕，那么三胜后的负场会将你重置为三胜。

perks.name: [Super] : With full charge, create a blast of energy, disabling shields on some combatants and objects.
perks.nameZh: [超能] ：充能完毕后，释放能量爆破，可解除部分战斗人员和物体的护盾。
perks.description: [Super] : With full charge, create a blast of energy, disabling shields on some combatants and objects.
perks.descriptionZh: [超能] ：充能完毕后，释放能量爆破，可解除部分战斗人员和物体的护盾。

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 拿出此武器前使用其他武器击败目标，可从储备弹药中转移额外弹药至弹匣。此效果可基于击败目标的数量溢出弹匣。

perks.name: Improved Void Analyzer
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Void weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在虚空武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善微型冲锋枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Survival Well
perks.description: More Orbs from Supers. Casting Barricade heals.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能产生更多光球。施放屏障产生治疗脉冲。

perks.name: Auto-Loading Link
perks.description: Steadily reloads your equipped Auto Rifle's or Machine Gun's mag.
perks.descriptionZh: 稳步填装已装备的自动步枪或机枪弹匣。

perks.name: Sunfire Furnace
perks.description: Enhanced abilities with a charged Solar Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有已充能的烈日超能时强化技能。

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成重复伤害会施加震颤。

增幅状态下震颤施加速度更快。

perks.name: Accelerator: Score Multiplier
perks.description: Earn an extra score with a score multiplier in Ops activities.
perks.descriptionZh: 在行动活动中借助得分系数获得额外得分。

perks.name: Ionic Interment
perks.description: Collecting an Ionic Trace partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集离子轨迹可使储存弹药填装部分弹匣。

perks.name: Shock Blast
perks.description: Fires high-damage Arc blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射高伤害电弧冲击。

perks.name: Highly Commendable
perks.description: Adds a highly commendable appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个难能可贵外观。

perks.name: Crystalline Breakout
perks.description: Adds a crystalline breakout appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个冰晶爆发外观。

perks.name: Invader +3
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Invader +2
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Invader +1
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion. Improves reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击可产生元素伤害爆炸。提高填装速度。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高融合步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Improved Io Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版木卫一缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 在木卫一上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Augmented Armaments
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 主弹药武器对迷失方向的战斗人员造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Augmented Explosives
perks.description: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的手雷技能在爆炸不久后额外释放一次扰乱脉冲。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Submachine Gun Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定微型冲锋枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用微型冲锋枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: From Whence You Came
perks.description: Increases ability damage to Taken and Scorn combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对傀儡军团和嗤魅战斗人员的技能伤害。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization I
perks.description:
Improves the benefits provided by the Sundering, Nano-Munitions, and Nanotech Tracer Rockets Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
perks.descriptionZh:
提升分离、纳米弹药和纳米技术追踪火箭原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

perks.name: Flame, Fiber, and Freeze
perks.description: Combines the Solar/Strand and Solar/Stasis Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将烈日/缚丝和烈日/冰影虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Blast Radius
perks.description: Rapid final blows with Rocket Launchers and Grenade Launchers grant Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器和榴弹发射器快速最后一击会提供护甲充能。

perks.name: Kindling Trigger
perks.description: Radiant causes Solar weapons to apply scorch to unscorched combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 焕光会使烈日武器获得灼烧未被灼烧的战斗人员的能力。

perks.name: Backup Mag
perks.description: Increases magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弹匣容量。

perks.name: Persistence
perks.description: Reaching seven wins rewards the weekly Adept weapon. When you are not in a full fireteam, losses following a win remove the win from the card. Reaching seven wins without losing a match grants access to the Lighthouse.
perks.descriptionZh: 赢得七场胜利会奖励每周专家武器。若你处于未满员的火力战队，则获胜后的负场会从卡片上移除该胜场。没有负场的情况下赢得七场胜利，则可进入灯塔。

perks.name: Heal Thyself
perks.description: While you are Charged with Light, grenade final blows heal you and consume one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你 充斥光能的时候，手雷最后一击将治疗你并 消耗一层 光之充能。

perks.name: Firepower
perks.description: While Charged with Light, regain a portion of your grenade energy when you use your grenade, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 当充斥光能的时候， 当你使用手雷技能时重新获得一部分的手雷能量， 消耗一层 光之充能。

perks.name: Blast Radius
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple combatants with Grenade Launchers or Rocket Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用榴弹发射器或火箭发射器快速击败多名战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Charged Up
perks.description: Allows for 1 additional stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高一层光之充能积累上限。

perks.name: Prototype Trueseeker
perks.description: This weapon's rockets have tracking.
perks.descriptionZh: 这款武器的火箭有追踪能力。

perks.name: Stasis Scavenger
perks.description: Stasis weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该冰影武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Eager Edge
perks.description: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换到此武器后立即提高刀剑前冲距离。

perks.name: Elemental Contestant Entrance
perks.description: Adds a competitive appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个竞技外观。

perks.name: Shattered Records Entrance
perks.description: Adds a record-shattering appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个破纪录外观。

perks.name: Mobile Hunter Armor
perks.description: Improved mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 更高的敏捷度。

perks.name: Parting Gift
perks.description: Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身会在原地留下一个延时引爆的爆炸装置，对周围目标造成伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Unflinching Stasis Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Stasis weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低用冰影武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Loyal Moths
perks.description: Final blows and rapid direct hits with this weapon create a loyal moth. The moth will seek out nearby targets and detonate, damaging and blinding them.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击和快速直接命中会产生一只忠诚飞蛾。这只飞蛾会寻找附近的目标并引爆，对目标造成伤害和致盲效果。

perks.name: Right Hook
perks.description:
Dealing melee damage gives this weapon greatly improved target acquisition and range for a short period of time.
Dealing melee damage again extends the effect.
perks.descriptionZh:
造成近战伤害会在短时间内大幅提升此武器的目标捕获能力和射程。
再次造成近战伤害可延长此效果。

perks.name: Heirloom Catalyst
perks.description: Direct hits with charged shots scorch the target. This weapon deals more damage against scorched targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能射击直接命中会灼烧目标。此武器对被灼烧的目标造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Crystalline Transistor
perks.description: Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 来自动能武器的最后一击会根据你已装备超能的元素产生爆炸。

perks.name: Battle-Hearth
perks.description: Gain Super energy for kills and assists inside Well of Radiance.
perks.descriptionZh: 身处光焰之井中时完成击杀或助攻可获得超能能量。

perks.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对重型弹药量表的所有计入效果。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Trace Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高追踪步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Lightweight Frame
perks.description: Move faster with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备时移动速度提高。

perks.name: THE END DRAWS NEAR
perks.description: The air buzzes with anticipation. You feel an itch in your mind as the Witness bends the Light to its will, reshaping reality. Soon its power will be beyond your reckoning. It must be stopped.
perks.descriptionZh: 空气中弥漫着期待的嗡嗡声。当见证者让光能屈服于它的意志，重塑现实时，你心痒难耐。很快，它的力量将超出你的理解范围。你必须阻止它。

perks.name: Creeping Attrition
perks.description: Rapid precision hits slow targets. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中会减速目标。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
perks.description: Higher base damage. High heat generated, [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
perks.descriptionZh: 高基础伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

perks.name: Carrion Munitions
perks.description: Final blows on tougher combatants create insectoid robots that chase combatants and create greater explosions.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击会产生追击战斗人员并猛烈爆炸的类虫机器人。

perks.name: Flutter By
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Concussive Dampener
perks.description: Reduces incoming area-of-effect damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自敌方战斗人员的范围伤害。

perks.name: Reaping Wellmaker
perks.description: After activating your class ability, your next weapon final blow on a combatant spawns a Void elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 在启用职业技能之后，你下一次对战斗人员的武器最后一击将产生一个虚空元素井。

perks.name: Overload Auto Rifle
perks.description:
Landing sustained hits on combatants with any Auto Rifle you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

After any member of your fireteam stuns a Champion, your Auto Rifles gain a temporary bonus to damage against Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意自动步枪对战斗人员的连续命中可扰乱敌人并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

任意火力战队成员眩晕勇士后，你的自动步枪获得对勇士的临时伤害加成。

perks.name: Echo of Expulsion
perks.description: Void ability final blows cause targets to explode.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空技能最后一击将造成目标爆炸。

perks.name: Arc Staff
perks.description: Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.
perks.descriptionZh: 生成一支充斥着纯粹电弧能量的法杖，华丽地击杀你的敌人。

perks.name: MIDA Synergy
perks.description: Lightweight. Final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.
perks.descriptionZh: 轻质。最后一击会为米达多功能提供改造进度。

perks.name: Sticker Shock
perks.description: Arc Flux, Magnetic, and Fusion Grenades deal more damage when attached to combatants; on final blows, they release several micro-missiles that seek nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧粘性电浆手雷、磁性手雷和融合手雷在黏附到战斗人员时会造成更多伤害；造成最后一击时，释放几枚自动追踪附近战斗人员的微型导弹。

perks.name: Tazer Tag
perks.description: Arc-powered melee hits jolt combatants and deal further damage for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧充能近战命中会震颤战斗人员，并在短时间内造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Void Infestation
perks.description: Defeating a weakened target spawns a tracking projectile that weakens other targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败被削弱目标会生成削弱其他目标的追踪射弹。

perks.name: Sword Storm Combo
perks.description: Performing three Sword light attacks followed by a heavy attack summons penumbral blades that surround you to damage and disorient combatants. Sword final blows extend the duration of these penumbral blades.
perks.descriptionZh: 施展三次刀剑轻攻击后跟进一次重攻击，会召唤出环绕自己的半影利刃，伤害战斗人员并使其迷失。刀剑最后一击可延长半影利刃的持续时间。

perks.name: Sniper's Meditation
perks.description: Sniper Rifle hits grant stacking Sniper Rifle damage, stability, and reload bonuses for a short time. Heavy ammo Sniper Rifle hits count as more than one hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪命中会在短时间内提供可叠加的狙击步枪伤害、稳定性和填装加成。重型弹药狙击步枪命中被视为多次命中。

perks.name: Kinetic Rupture
perks.description: Kinetic weapon damage against a powerful combatant has a chance to create a Kinetic Rupture. Targeting this Rupture causes a damaging explosion that staggers combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成动能武器伤害有几率生成一个动能裂口。以此裂口为目标会造成眩晕战斗人员的伤害性爆炸，克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
perks.description: [Arc]Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown or shot to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去或射击造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

perks.name: Opening Act
perks.description: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷造成最后一击会为热量武器提供稳定性和排气速度加成，并为主弹药武器提供稳定性和填装速度加成。

perks.name: Room Clearing
perks.description: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用热量武器或主弹药武器造成多次最后一击，会为武器和手雷属性提供加成，并提升热量武器和主弹药武器的弹药生成。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description: Increases rate of fire after kill.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高击杀后的射速。

perks.name: Bannered Arrival
perks.description: Adds a banner appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个旗帜的外观。

perks.name: Linear Actuators
perks.description: Faster sprinting and chain melee damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 更快的冲刺速度和连锁近战伤害。

perks.name: Jump Jets
perks.description: Buffs maneuverability, hip firing, and firing in Lift.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化机动能力、腰射以及跃升时射击。

perks.name: Mecha Holster
perks.description: Reloads stowed SMGs and allows instant ready.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用微型冲锋枪可增强填装、稳定性、移动和操控性。

perks.name: Reaper +2
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Reaper +1
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Reaper +3
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Traveler's Valor
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased melee ability regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强近战技能回复的临时增益。

perks.name: Traveler's Grace
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that randomly provides the effects of one of the other Pale Blessing mods.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可随机提供另一项苍白祝福模组效果的临时增益。

perks.name: Traveler's Remedy
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased health regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强生命值回复的临时增益。

perks.name: Traveler's Resurgence
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased grenade ability regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强手雷技能回复的临时增益。

perks.name: Traveler's Facet
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased class ability regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强职业技能回复的临时增益。

perks.name: Traveler's Aegis
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides a regenerating overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可提供再生覆盖护盾的临时增益。

perks.name: Traveler's Insight
perks.description: Upon interaction with a Traveler's Flower, gain a temporary buff that provides increased Super ability regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 与旅行者之花互动后，获得可增强超能技能回复的临时增益。

perks.name: Enhanced Blast Radius
perks.description: +10 Blast Radius
perks.descriptionZh: +10 爆炸范围

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击或持续精准命中，会在更长时间内增加此武器的射速。

perks.name: Build a charge by collecting blast cores and stunning combatants.
perks.nameZh: 收集爆破核心和眩晕战斗人员来积累充能。
perks.description: Build a charge by collecting blast cores and stunning combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集爆破核心和眩晕战斗人员来积累充能。

perks.name: Melee Conduction
perks.description: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有焕光、恢复或治愈时，你的近战命中会释放灼烧目标的冲击波。

perks.name: Regenerative Threshold
perks.description: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 施展终结技会存储能量。下一次你的护盾被击破时，消耗储备的能量立即获得治疗并开启生命值回复。

perks.name: Northern Lights
perks.description: Adds an aurora borealis appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个北极光的外观。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Unflinching Fusion Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用融合步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Arc Alignment
perks.description: Dealing Arc damage from any source aligns the battery's coils. When alignment is complete, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to disengage the safety and enable hip-fired Starlight Beam to apply Jolt to any targets damaged for a short time.  Aim down sights to slow the rate at which the battery drains.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成任何来源的电弧伤害可校准电池线圈。校准完成时，按下[替换武器动作] 来解除保险装置，并使腰射的星光光束在短时间内对任何受到其伤害的目标施加震颤效果。瞄准会减缓电池耗尽的速率。

perks.name: Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of ammo you can carry for any rifle-class weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高你可以携带的所有步枪武器的弹药数量。

perks.name: Resonance Redirection
perks.description: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有稳定共振时，持续造成武器伤害偶尔会产生共振爆发，伤害目标并使其疲惫。

perks.name: Stable Resonance
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败强力战斗人员会生成稳定共振，在持续时间内提供伤害抗性和提升武器伤害。

perks.name: Synapse Junctions
perks.description: Chained Arc Staff hits buff damage and duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 连续电弧法杖攻击可提高伤害和持续时间。

perks.name: Probability Matrix
perks.description: Improves Arcbolt Grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善电光手雷。

perks.name: Wraithmetal Mail
perks.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging increases this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身可装填武器，并提高速度和操控性。

perks.name: Io Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 在木卫一上探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Mulligan
perks.description: Missing a shot has an improved chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 子弹未命中时有更高几率直接向弹匣返还弹药。

perks.name: Legacy PR-55 Frame
perks.description: Customized frame with dramatically increased accuracy, stability, and targeting while hip firing.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高精准度、稳定性和腰射瞄准性能的定制型。

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器击败目标或造成伤害会逐渐增加其射程、稳定性、操控性、填装速度。

刀剑会获得提升的充能速度和防御抗性。

perks.name: Ambush
perks.description: Improves range, handling, and damage against combatants during the opening moments of an engagement.
perks.descriptionZh: 在刚开始交火时，提升对战斗人员的射程、操控性和伤害。

perks.name: Confidence
perks.description: Grants bonus rewards from Flawless Chest.
perks.descriptionZh: 从无暇宝箱中获得额外奖励。

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，稳定性和精度随之大幅提高。

perks.name: Hungering Quarrel
perks.description: Double fires tracking bolts that leech health.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射两发可吸取生命值的追踪射弹。

perks.name: The Fate of All Fools
perks.description: Chain precision shots to increase non-critical hit damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 连续精准射击可提升非暴击命中伤害。

perks.name: Armsbearer Chant
perks.description: When you use a finisher on an Elite, you generate Special ammo for your fireteam; when you use a finisher on a boss or miniboss, you generate Heavy ammo for your fireteam. Nearby Aeon Cult allies who do not have the Sect of Insight role equipped also gain a burst of Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你对精英敌人使用终结技时，会为你的火力战队生成特殊弹药；当你对首领或初级首领使用终结技时，会为你的火力战队生成重型弹药。附近未装备洞察学派角色的永劫邪教盟友会获得大量超能能量。

perks.name: Aeon's Inspiration
perks.description: Successive precision weapon takedowns have a chance to drop an Orb of Power for your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 取得连续精准武器击杀有几率为你的队友生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Umbral Harbinger
perks.description: Adds a cauldron of bats appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蝙蝠熔炉外观。

perks.name: Luminous Cocoon
perks.description: Adds a webbed escape appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蛛网外观。

perks.name: Prime Attunement
perks.description: Chance to receive a powerful Prime Engram by defeating challenging enemies or completing Crucible matches.
perks.descriptionZh: 在击败具有挑战性的敌人或完成熔炉竞技场比赛时，有机会获得一个强大的至高记忆水晶。

perks.name: The Master
perks.description: Precision hits improve weapon performance.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中会提升武器性能。

perks.name: Unflinching Machine Gun
perks.description: Reduces hit flinch from incoming fire while aiming Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用机枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Cherry Blossom Entrance
perks.description: Adds a cherry blossom petal appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个樱花花瓣出现效果。

perks.name: Cyber Class Entrance
perks.description: Adds bright neon class logo to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个明亮霓虹职业标志效果。

perks.name: The Lost Voice
perks.description: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret.
perks.descriptionZh: 治愈手雷会生成一个恢复炮台。

perks.name: Supercharged
perks.description: You can have 2 additional stacks of Charged with Light, up to a maximum of 5.
perks.descriptionZh: 你可以拥有2层额外的光之充能，最高可拥有5层。

perks.name: Pace Yourself
perks.description: Tapping the trigger gives this weapon less recoil and improves accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 轻扣扳机可以减少此武器的后坐力并提高精度。

perks.name: The Wanderer
perks.description:
Tangles you throw attach to targets and detonate into a suspending burst. Destroying a Tangle creates a suspending burst after a short delay.

Threadling final blows create Tangles or reduce your current Tangle cooldown.
perks.descriptionZh:
你投掷的缠结会附着在目标身上，并引爆成一个悬停爆发。摧毁一个缠结会在短暂延迟后生成一个悬停爆发。

线虫最后一击会生成一个缠结或减少你当前的缠结冷却时间。

perks.name: Orbs of Restoration
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a small amount of energy to your ability with the least energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会为当前能量最少的技能填充少量能量。

perks.name: Precision Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating combatants with precision kills from Bows, Hand Cannons, and Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用弓箭、手炮和斥候步枪的精准击杀快速消灭战斗人员来充斥光能。

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 若附近无目标，提升填装、射程和精度。

perks.name: [Melee] : control morphable objects to create new pathways
perks.nameZh: [近战] ：控制可变形物体，开辟全新通路
perks.description: [Melee] : control morphable objects to create new pathways
perks.descriptionZh: [近战] ：控制可变形物体，开辟全新通路

perks.name: Emperor's Blaze
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, your Solar abilities deal 25% more damage.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，你的烈日技能可造成25%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Duelist's Trance
perks.description: Sword final blows grant greatly increased charge rate and defense until this weapon is stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑最后一击可大幅提高充能速度和防御，效果持续至收起此武器。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Trace Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善追踪步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Chosen of the Warmind
perks.description: Collecting or destroying a Warmind Cell creates a concussive blast that pushes enemies away.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集或摧毁一个战争思维电池会制造一场击退敌人的震荡冲击波。

perks.name: Bow Reloader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弓箭的搭箭速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Athletics
perks.description: Increases your base movement speed and jump height.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升你的基础移动速度和跳跃高度。

perks.name: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_jump_button###] : Jump
perks.description: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_jump_button###] : Jump
perks.descriptionZh: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_jump_button###] ：跳跃

perks.name: Traveler's Proliferation
perks.description: Defeating combatants with any source of Strand damage produces Threadlings. Defeating powerful combatants produces more Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用任意缚丝伤害源击败战斗人员可生成线虫。击败强力战斗人员会生成更多线虫。

perks.name: Nightmare Crusher
perks.description: Grants additional damage to your melee and grenade abilities against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的近战和手雷技能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Nightmare Banisher
perks.description: Grants additional damage to your Super against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的超能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Dreambane Mod
perks.description: Reduces the damage you take from Nightmare Hunt bosses. Multiple copies of this mod stack for greater effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低你从梦魇狩猎首领的攻击受到的伤害。多个此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Nightmare Breaker
perks.description: Grants additional damage against shields created by Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在攻击梦魇狩猎首领制造的护盾时可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予近战属性加成。

perks.name: Storm and Stress
perks.description: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用永不分离武器造成最后一击会填装此武器，并为弹匣溢装额外伤害弹药。使用额外伤害弹药造成最后一击会提升永不分离武器的弹匣容量。

perks.name: Synergy
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create an Elemental pickup matching its damage type, or an Orb of Power for weapons that deal Kinetic damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成最后一击，有几率生成与其伤害类型匹配的元素拾取物，或为造成动能伤害的武器生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Overload Bow
perks.description: Damage by fully drawn arrows disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 拉满弓所射出的箭会扰乱战斗人员并将其眩晕，延缓技能能量回复并降低输出。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Unflinching Void Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Void weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低用虚空武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在此武器收起时使用武器或技能完成最后一击可在短时间内提高其操控性、稳定性和填装速度。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Hand Cannons over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的手炮装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Melee Momentum
perks.description: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成近战最后一击可为其提供额外能量，并在格挡时提供更高的移动速度。

perks.name: Timed Payload
perks.description: Projectiles attached to enemies explode after a short delay.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹药可粘附在目标上，并在短暂延迟后爆炸。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Knit Together
perks.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被击破后的短时间内，你接下来的几次线虫命中会回复生命值。

perks.name: Sinew Stitching
perks.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到来自战斗人员的伤害时可能生成一只线虫。

perks.name: String Theory
perks.description: Hits against marked targets deal increased damage and have a chance to refund ammo to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中标记的目标会造成更多伤害，并有几率将弹药返还至弹匣。

perks.name: Charged Bolts
perks.description:
Bolts attached to targets deal damage over time.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
perks.descriptionZh:
附着在目标身上的弩弹会随时间造成伤害。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

perks.name: Full Auto Retrofit
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.
perks.descriptionZh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。

perks.name: Umbral Hastening
perks.description: While you have several stacks of Pervading Darkness, you gain increased mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 在数个弥漫暗影效果叠加时，提高你的敏捷度。

perks.name: Improved Moon Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 已改良月球缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 在月球上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭目标会用储存弹药填装部分弹匣，弹药数量提高。

perks.name: Double XP: Artifact
perks.description: Artifact progression is currently doubled for a limited time!
perks.descriptionZh: 限时内神器进度获取速度加倍！

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在连射中，每一次射击命中都会在短时间内提高此武器的伤害并减少充能时间。

perks.name: Bolt Scavenger
perks.description: Recovering a bolt increases reload speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 回收弩弹会提升填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Class ▼
perks.description: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Class ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲ /-5 职业 ▼

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会根据目标身上被施加的每个元素减益效果造成更多伤害。伤害加成提升。

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会提供可叠加的额外伤害。从高处攻击目标可立即获得最大层数。提升填装速度。

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.
perks.descriptionZh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: UNLOCKED BY QUEST
perks.description:
ASPECT OF CONTROL
Purchase this Stasis Aspect from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
perks.descriptionZh:
控制之星相
在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影星相。

perks.name: Deluge
perks.description: Dealing final blows creates a chance to spawn ability wells under enemy combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成最后一击有几率在敌方战斗人员下方生成技能井。

perks.name: Passive Guard
perks.description: Receive less damage from combatants that are close to you while you are wielding a sword.
perks.descriptionZh: 挥舞刀剑时，靠近你的战斗人员对你造成的伤害降低。

perks.name: Cryocannon
perks.description: This weapon's projectiles create Stasis crystals and freeze nearby targets. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的射弹会产生冰影水晶，冻结附近的目标。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Spread the Wealth
perks.description: Gain additional Glimmer when looting engrams.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取记忆水晶时获得额外微光。

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.description: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装的弹药会根据先前完成快速最后一击次数造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Cayde's Retribution
perks.description: Acquire Orbs to fire Golden Gun shots.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取能量球以发射黄金枪。

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision final blows with this weapon substantially increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器完成精准最后一击可以大幅提高填装速度并使目标爆炸，对附近的目标造成烈日伤害。

perks.name: Lesser Core Harvest (Vanguard)
perks.description: Defeating bosses in Vanguard playlist strikes or Nightfalls has a chance to award an Enhancement Core.
perks.descriptionZh: 在先锋游戏列表打击或日落中击败首领有几率奖励一个强化核心。

perks.name: Greater Core Harvest (Vanguard)
perks.description: Defeating bosses in Vanguard playlist strikes or Nightfalls has a chance to award an Enhancement Prism.
perks.descriptionZh: 在先锋游戏列表打击或日落中击败首领有几率奖励一个强化棱镜。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Hand Cannon ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的手炮弹药数量。

perks.name: Resupply
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，你的下一次最后一击提供额外弹药进度并生成一个能量球。

perks.name: From the Storm
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，缓慢获得冰霜护甲直到你再次进入战斗。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Unburied Treasure
perks.description: Readying this weapon grants a period of rapidly decaying accuracy and range. Swords gain increased lunge distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器准备就绪后会在一段时间内获得快速衰减的精度和射程。刀剑获得更远的前冲距离。

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
perks.descriptionZh: 射空此武器的弹匣时，会根据命中次数从储存弹药中填装。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高微型冲锋枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Power Weapon Targeting
perks.description: Slightly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Power weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 略微改善威能武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Stormtrance
perks.description: Chain Arc Lightning from your hands and electrify enemies with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 从你的手中释放弧光闪电，用极具破坏力且随着时间增强的电弧之光流来电击敌人。

perks.name: Overload Submachine Gun
perks.description:
Your equipped Submachine Guns fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你装备的微型冲锋枪会发射扰乱子弹，使目标眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Overload Sword
perks.description:
Your equipped Swords disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你装备的刀剑会扰乱战斗人员，使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Aggressive Burst
perks.description: Hard-hitting four-burst fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 四发强力冲击射击。

perks.name: Soulforge
perks.description: Targets afflicted by corruption from Soulfire Charges coalesce into soulfire crystals when defeated. Crystals detonate in a damaging radius when destroyed.
perks.descriptionZh: 被来自魂火充能的腐化所影响的目标会在被击败时凝聚成魂火晶体。晶体被摧毁时会爆炸，对一定半径内造成伤害。

perks.name: Roast 'Em
perks.description: Improves Proximity Knife effectiveness and regeneration speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升感应飞刀效率和再生速度。

perks.name: Rapid Cooldown
perks.description: Sprinting gives energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺提供能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Return Stroke
perks.description: Causing a lightning strike with this weapon partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成闪电打击可使储存弹药填装部分弹匣。

perks.name: Minor Health Mod
perks.description: Increases the Health stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升生命值属性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Destabilizers
perks.description: [Brake]  : Use while airborne to release roll stabilizers, and move [Movement] to roll.
perks.descriptionZh: [刹车]  ：在空中使用以松开翻滚稳定装置，使用[移动]进行翻滚。

perks.name: Crucible White
perks.description: Adds a white Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个白色熔炉纹章。

perks.name: Raven's Wings
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可提升敏捷、武器射程和操控性，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 手雷 ▲ /-5 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Leviathan's Sigh
perks.description: When fully drawn, the bolt creates a large concussive blast that knocks combatants back and makes them volatile.
perks.descriptionZh: 拉满弓后所射出的箭矢可以产生一次震荡大爆炸，击退战斗人员并造成不稳定状态。

perks.name: More to Give
perks.description: Increases magazine size. Holstering this weapon automatically reloads it after a short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加弹匣容量。收回枪套一小段时间后，这把武器会自动装填弹药。

perks.name: +10 Health ▲
perks.description: +10 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +10 生命值 ▲

perks.name: Taken Arrival
perks.description: Adds a Taken rift appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个傀儡裂痕外观。

perks.name: Unforeseen Repercussions
perks.description: This weapon's beam superheats its targets upon impact, causing delayed scorching explosions.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器的光束会使命中的目标过热，片刻之后引发灼烧爆炸。

perks.name: Shattering Blade
perks.description: If your heavy attack consumes the last of your ammo, it deals significantly increased damage. Excludes aerial attacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 如果你的重攻击消耗掉的是你的最后一发弹药，它造成的伤害将大幅提高。空袭除外。

perks.name: Arc Weapon Surge
perks.description: Your Arc weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的电弧武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速消灭目标可触发生命值恢复。守护者和高阶战斗人员视为不止一个击杀。

perks.name: Ascendant Escape
perks.description: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，你获得隐形。

perks.name: Iron Sharpens Iron
perks.description: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 对守护者和强力战斗人员造成最后一击时生成额外的弹药进度。

perks.name: Primary Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the drop chance of Primary ammo on kill.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高完成击杀时主武器弹药的掉落几率。

perks.name: UNLOCKED BY QUEST
perks.description:
ASPECT OF DESTRUCTION
Purchase this Stasis Aspect from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
perks.descriptionZh:
毁灭之星相
在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影星相。

perks.name: +20 Health ▲
perks.description: +20 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +20 生命值 ▲

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击或使用充能近战造成伤害会从储存弹药中填装此武器的弹匣。

perks.name: Improved Arc Analyzer
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Arc weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在电弧武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: -20 Melee ▼
perks.description: -20 Melee ▼

perks.name: Unflinching Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming any Rifle-class weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用任意步枪类武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Firepower
perks.description: Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的手雷最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Fall from Grace
perks.description: The weapon has become partially Taken. Detonations produce Taken energy that aggressively seeks out nearby targets and Blights them.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器部分傀儡化。爆炸会产生傀儡能量，主动追踪附近目标并使其凋零。

perks.name: +15 Weapons ▲
perks.description: +15 Weapons ▲

perks.name: Hand Cannon Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手炮的填装速度。

perks.name: Genesis
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器打破战斗护盾可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。若能量武器与战斗护盾伤害类型吻合，击中目标时可重生弹药。

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成溅射伤害会赋予手雷属性加成。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Sniper Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定狙击步枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用狙击步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Silver Contender's Boon
perks.description:
This buff commemorates a Silver Tier score in the Guardian Games Rushdown activity on Expert mode.

Weapons and abilities empower each other. Defeating combatants with abilities grants increased weapon damage. Defeating combatants with weapons grants increased ability recharge speed.

Empowerment stacks 3 times.

While at maximum empowerment, defeat combatants to gain a boost to mobility.

Active only in Guardian Games Rushdown activities. This buff will expire on weekly reset.
perks.descriptionZh:
此增益用于纪念在专家模式的守护者游戏急速强攻活动中的白银阶得分。

武器与技能可互相赋能。使用技能击败战斗人员可增加武器伤害。使用武器击败战斗人员可提高技能充能速度。

赋能可叠加3次。

当达到最大赋能次数时，击败战斗人员可获得敏捷提升。

仅在守护者游戏急速强攻活动中有效。此增益将在周重置时过期。

perks.name: Nano-Assault
perks.description: Quicksilver nanites that attach to the wielder charge the blade. [Alternate Weapon Action]  when fully charged to overclock the attached nanites, enhancing the blade's offensive capabilities. Light attacks deal increased damage to targets; fully charged Heavy attacks create a flaming Quicksilver swarm-nado.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞬变纳米蜂群附着使用者时会为利刃充能。完全充能时[替换武器动作] 超频纳米蜂群，增强利刃的进攻能力。轻攻击对目标造成的伤害提升；完全充能的重攻击会生成烈焰瞬变蜂群旋风。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Guardians United
perks.description: When in a fireteam with a linked friend, increases experience gains up to level 50.
perks.descriptionZh: 当与一名链接的好友同属同一火力战队时，可增加经验值至50级。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Power Munition Mod
perks.description: Improves reload speed for equipped Power weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高已装备威能武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Glaive Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Glaives.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高偃月的收举速度。

perks.name: Power Munition Mod
perks.description: Improves reload speed for equipped Power weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高已装备威能武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高斥候步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.description: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高填装速度，但会减少弹匣容量。

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会降低热量。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: EDZ Scout Reports
perks.description: Highlights nearby loot caches in the EDZ for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你和你的火力战队在欧洲无人区中标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Bright Paragon
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Fireteam Medallion, granting all members of the fireteam increased XP gains and loot from strikes, public events, and the Crucible.
perks.descriptionZh: 火力战队的一名成员使用了火力战队大勋章，将增加小组所有成员在打击、公共事件和熔炉竞技场中获得的经验值和战利品。

perks.name: Burning Maul
perks.description:
Summon a flaming maul and crush targets with the force of an earthquake.

[Light Attack]  : Spin the maul in a circle around you, damaging nearby targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam the maul to the ground and create a cyclone of flames that seeks targets, dealing damage and scorching them.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一支燃烧的大锤，用地震的力量碾碎目标。

[轻攻击]  ：在自身周围旋转大锤，对附近目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：朝地面猛击大锤并制造出一股追踪目标的火焰旋风，造成伤害并灼烧他们。

perks.name: Hammer of Sol
perks.description:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一把燃烧的战锤对你的敌人造成毁灭打击。

[轻攻击]  ：向敌人投掷战锤。

击中时，战锤会碎裂成爆炸熔合碎片。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description: High damage, high recoil.
perks.descriptionZh: 高伤害，高后坐力。

perks.name: Supreme Nightmare Crusher
perks.description: Grants additional damage to your melee and grenade abilities against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的近战和手雷技能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Enhanced Nightmare Crusher
perks.description: Grants additional damage to your melee and grenade abilities against Nightmare Hunt bosses. This benefit does not stack with other mods that provide the same or greater benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在对抗梦魇狩猎首领时，你的近战和手雷技能可造成额外伤害。此增益无法与其他提供同样或更高效果的模组叠加。

perks.name: Overload Bow
perks.description: Damage by fully drawn arrows disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 拉满弓所射出的箭会扰乱战斗人员并将其眩晕，延缓技能能量回复并降低输出。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Reaper Synth
perks.description: Armor Set—Reaper +3
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲套装——收割者+3

perks.name: Soul Devourer
perks.description: Absorbing a Remnant strengthens Mark of the Devourer and partially refills the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 吸收遗灵会强化吞噬者印记，并将装填部分弹匣。

perks.name: Ionic Sentry
perks.description:
Defeat targets with Kinetic or Arc weapons or Arc abilities to charge up an Arc turret that periodically chains lightning between nearby targets, granting a stack of Bolt Charge with each hit.

[Grenade]  : Deploy the Ionic Sentry, blinding nearby targets on initial impact.

Ionic Sentry damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用动能或电弧武器或电弧技能击败目标来为电弧炮台充能，该炮台会将连锁闪电周期性地传递到附近目标身上，每次命中都会施加一层电光充能。

[手雷]  ：部署离子哨兵，初次命中可致盲附近目标。

离子哨兵的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成精准击杀可以提高填装速度并使目标爆炸，对附近的敌人造成烈日伤害。

perks.name: Ember of Wonder
perks.description: Rapidly defeating multiple targets with Solar ignitions generates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过烈日点燃快速消灭多个目标会生成能量球。

perks.name: -5 Melee ▼
perks.description: -5 Melee ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -5 近战 ▼

perks.name: Umbral Sharpening
perks.description: While you have several stacks of Pervading Darkness, you deal increased weapon damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 在数个弥漫暗影效果叠加时，可造成更多武器伤害。

perks.name: Stat Bonus
perks.description: +20 Strength
perks.descriptionZh: +20力量

perks.name: Resurgence Directive
perks.description: Attacks grant Sword energy. Final blows and rapid hits spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites.
perks.descriptionZh: 攻击提供刀剑能量。最后一击和快速命中会生成追踪瞬变纳米蜂群。

perks.name: Prosperity
perks.description: Achieving victory in ritual activities grants a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
perks.descriptionZh: 在仪式活动中取胜有几率掉落一件额外的传说装备。

perks.name: Perpetual Loophole
perks.description: Deal additional melee damage while protected by an overshield. Defeating targets with melee final blows while the overshield is active will refresh it.
perks.descriptionZh: 当受到覆盖护盾保护时，可造成额外的近战伤害。当覆盖护盾激活时，使用近战最后一击击败目标会刷新护盾。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手炮的收举速度。

perks.name: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼
perks.description: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲ / -5 手雷 ▼

perks.name: Disease Vector
perks.description: Increases nanite damage. Enemies that die with nanites attached to them generate additional nanites.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高纳米蜂群伤害。因被纳米蜂群附着而死亡的敌人会生成更多的纳米蜂群。

perks.name: -10 Melee ▼
perks.description: -10 Melee ▼

perks.name: Increases resistance to damage when Matterspark is active.
perks.nameZh: 物质火花生效时提升伤害抗性。
perks.description: Increases resistance to damage when Matterspark is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 物质火花生效时提升伤害抗性。

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺后滑行期间可获得额外伤害和充能速度加成，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Invisible Hand
perks.description: Repeatedly missing targets increases this weapon's stability for a short time. This buff lasts for a longer duration after a target is hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 重复偏离目标可在短时间内提高此武器的稳定性。此增益效果在命中目标后会持续较长时间。

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
perks.descriptionZh: 未射击下瞄准一小段时间可提高在射击或退出瞄准后重置的射程和精准伤害。

perks.name: [Shoot] : Stun nearby combatants with Arc energy; also affects some objects.
perks.nameZh: [射击] ：使用电弧能量眩晕附近的战斗人员；同时影响部分物体。
perks.description: [Shoot] : Stun nearby combatants with Arc energy; also affects some objects.
perks.descriptionZh: [射击] ：使用电弧能量眩晕附近的战斗人员；同时影响部分物体。

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高射弹速度，大幅提升填装速度。

perks.name: Happy Dawning
perks.description: Boosting while riding Dawning Cheer will occasionally spawn a Glimmer present until the boost ends. This perk is available only during the Dawning.
perks.descriptionZh: 乘坐曙光喜悦时加速，会偶尔在加速结束时生成一个微光礼物。此特性仅可在曙光节期间使用。

perks.name: Prosperity (Crucible)
perks.description: Crucible wins have a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场取胜有几率掉落一件额外的传说装备。

perks.name: Supercharged Matrix
perks.description: While amplified, this weapon gains greatly increased reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于增幅状态时，此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度会大幅提升。

perks.name: Lethal Current
perks.description: After dodging, each Arc Staff hit creates a damaging lightning aftershock.
perks.descriptionZh: 进行闪身后，电弧法杖每次命中都能产生可造成伤害的闪电余震。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Cormorant Combo
perks.description: After three rapid light melee attacks, quickly [Heavy Attack]  to execute a heavy melee combo.
perks.descriptionZh: 在三次快速近战轻攻击后，迅速使用 [重攻击]  施展一次近战重攻击连击。

perks.name: The Rock
perks.description: For several seconds after a final blow, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to consume part of your ammo reserves, converting your next thrown grenade into a fragmentation grenade.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后的几秒钟内，[替换武器动作]来消耗部分备弹，将你下一颗投掷的手雷转化为碎片手雷。

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败一个目标会产生虚空爆发；用此爆发击中其他目标会使其不稳定，并为你提供不稳定弹药，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Glaive Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chances of finding ammo while you have a Glaive equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备偃月后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Facet of Blessing
perks.description: Melee final blows start health regeneration. While transcendent, melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击会带来生命值回复效果。处于超凡状态时，近战最后一击会为你和你附近的盟友带来生命值回复效果。

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器达成最后一击将在短时间内提高此武器的伤害和性能。

perks.name: Speed Demon
perks.description: Your vehicles take less time to summon and reload your weapons while you ride.
perks.descriptionZh: 缩短载具召唤时间，骑乘的同时填装武器。

perks.name: Circle of Life
perks.description: Rapidly healing allies grants this weapon a period of increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速治疗盟友可提升此武器在一段时间内的伤害。

perks.name: Chrysallis Entrance
perks.description: Adds a cocoon appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个茧外观。

perks.name: Pyramid Entrance
perks.description: Adds a pyramid appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金字塔外观。

perks.name: Spark of Haste
perks.description: While sprinting, you have greatly increased health stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 在冲刺时，生命值属性大幅提升。

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标后填装此武器，会使下次命中发射一枚引爆造成更持久迷失效果的动能射弹。

perks.name: Smoldering Glyphkeeper
perks.description: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Hand Cannons, Shotguns, Grenade Launchers, and Rocket Launchers to deal additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的手炮、霰弹枪、榴弹发射器和火箭发射器造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Enhanced Hand Cannon Targeting
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善手炮的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

perks.name: Big Frigid Glaive
perks.description: Fires a projectile that freezes. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一枚可冻结的射弹。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Titan Cache Detector
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 在土卫六上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Enhanced Fusion Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型融合步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高融合步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Polished Sockets
perks.description: Increases this armor's mobility, allowing you to move faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高这件护甲的敏捷度，以提高移动速度。

perks.name: Super Forged
perks.description: +3 Super
perks.descriptionZh: +3 超能

perks.name: Auto Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have an Auto Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备自动步枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.description: Defeating targets will award a Dawning gift at a faster rate. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标会更快地奖励一个曙光节礼物。击败强力目标算作多次击败。

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用这款武器瞄准可提高有效射程和变焦倍率。提高使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、弓箭瞄准时的射弹速度。

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon has more improved accuracy and handling as your health gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的生命值越低，此武器的精度和操控性提升越大。

perks.name: Enhanced Linear Fusion Rifle Dexterity
perks.nameZh: 强化型线性融合步枪灵巧
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高线性融合步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Perpetual Motion Enhanced
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可在持用者保持移动时获得短时间的稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成。

perks.name: Ionic Return
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield—or the shield of a Guardian using a Super—with the matched damage type refills the magazine from reserves and grants bonus damage rounds. Breaking a combatant's shield with a matched damage type Ionic Return round refreshes the perk.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用匹配的伤害类型击碎战斗人员的护盾 ，或击碎超能状态下的守护者护盾，则可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣，并提供额外伤害弹药。使用匹配伤害类型的离子回归弹药击碎战斗人员的护盾，可刷新特性。

perks.name: Supercharged Battery
perks.description: Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集一颗能量球会在一段时间内给予最大能量，并进行自动填装。在此模式中持续开火可压制目标。

perks.name: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
perks.description: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Melee ▼

perks.name: Celerity
perks.description:
Substantially increases weapon handling and reload speed. Gain the following effects while you are the last living member of your fireteam:
• Increased target acquisition
• Increased handling and reload speed
• Reduced flinch from incoming fire
perks.descriptionZh:
大幅提高武器操控性和装填速度。当你作为火力战队最后一名存活的成员时获得以下效果：
• 提高目标捕获能力
• 提高操控性和填装速度
• 减少受到伤害时的抖动

perks.name: Dragon's Vengeance
perks.description: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills and it gains improved range, charge rate, and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得更多额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

perks.name: Cadmus Ridge Signal
perks.description: The inert radiolaria courses through you with a strange resonance. Follow where it leads.
perks.descriptionZh: 惰性放射体液在你体内流动，产生奇怪的共鸣。跟随它的引导行动吧。

perks.name: Enhanced Draw Time
perks.description: +10 Draw Time
perks.descriptionZh: +10 拔枪速度

perks.name: Energy Reflex Brackets
perks.description: Improves weapon handling for equipped Energy weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善已装备能量武器的操控性。

perks.name: Ember of Blistering
perks.description: Defeating targets with Solar ignitions grants grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日点燃消灭目标可获得手雷能量。

perks.name: Ashes to Assets
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on grenade kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: +3 Class ▲
perks.description: +3 Class ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +3 职业 ▲

perks.name: +5 Class ▲
perks.description: +5 Class ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 职业 ▲

perks.name: Reaver Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Reaver archetype, which has Class as its primary stat and Melee as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落掠夺者框架：职业为主要属性，近战为次要属性。

perks.name: Well of Ordnance
perks.description: Picking up a Solar elemental well grants you additional grenade energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取一个烈日元素井会赋予你额外手雷能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

perks.name: Bountiful Wells
perks.description: Elemental well mods that cause you to spawn elemental wells can now stack, spawning additional wells for each additional copy of the mod you have equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 使你生成元素井的元素井模组现在可以叠加效果了。每多装备一块同款模组，生成的元素井也会多一个。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Trace Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊弹药时追踪步枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Broadside
perks.description: Each successive shot has more damage and more spread.
perks.descriptionZh: 连续的每次射击的伤害和扩散范围都有所增加。

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.description: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射时伤害目标会提升瞄准时的操控性、填装速度和移动速度。

perks.name: Snowy Entrance
perks.description: Adds a snowman to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个雪人效果。

perks.name: Sweet Entrance
perks.description: Adds a gingerbread house with a peppermint swirl to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个薄荷漩涡姜饼屋效果。

perks.name: Adaptive Frame
perks.description:
Well-rounded.
[Heavy Attack]  : Uppercut.
perks.descriptionZh:
全能型。
[重攻击] ：上挑。

perks.name: Embraced Largesse
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, activating a Void Super recharges your grenade.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，激活虚空超能可充能手雷。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 移动时瞄准会提高移动速度和目标获取速度。

perks.name: +20 Class ▲
perks.description: +20 Class ▲

perks.name: Aurora
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.
perks.descriptionZh: 在进行一次成功的近战打击后，在一小段时间内——或直到发射完三枚子弹前——提高武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: To Excess
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant an improved bonus to Melee and Grenade stats for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供更多近战和手雷属性加成。

perks.name: Hammer of the Warmind
perks.description:
The detonations from Warmind Cells you destroy cause disruption, stunning combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions  and [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你摧毁的战争思维电池所引发的爆炸会造成干扰，眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士和势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Aerodynamics
perks.description: Greatly increases blast radius and projectile speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升爆炸范围和射弹速度。

perks.name: Infinite Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has balanced defenses and maximized endurance.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡拥有平衡的防御以及最大化的持久。

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.description: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装前精准最后一击的次数会影响射程和伤害增加的子弹总数。激活宏伟之嚎时，精准最后一击会延长额外子弹效果。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description: High damage, high recoil.
perks.descriptionZh: 高伤害，高后坐力。

perks.name: Mercy
