perks.description: Forgives one loss per run. Forgives a second loss if you have not yet been flawless this week.
perks.descriptionZh: 每轮尝试允许有一场失利。如果本周尚未完成无瑕可允许有第二场失利。

perks.name: Glaive Scavenger
perks.description: Glaives get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Glaive.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该偃月所用弹药时，偃月获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Whisper of Durance
perks.description: Slow that you apply to targets lasts longer. For those abilities that linger, their duration will also increase.
perks.descriptionZh: 你对目标施加的减速效果持续时间更长。所有持续技能的持续时间也会加长。

perks.name: Rabbit Effects
perks.description: Adds the Jade Rabbit crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个玉兔纹章。

perks.name: Winged Eclipse
perks.description: Loyal moths damage targets and aid your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 忠诚飞蛾会对目标造成伤害并治疗你的盟友。

perks.name: Proximity Ward
perks.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher.
perks.descriptionZh: 在使用终结技时获得一个强大的力场护盾。

perks.name: Weavewalk
perks.description:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge while airborne to consume your melee energy and enter the weave, gaining damage resistance from combatants and players. Reactivate your air dodge or cast your Rift to exit the weave, generating Woven Mail for you and nearby allies.

While in the weave, your melee energy is drained and you generate perched Threadlings over time. Threadling hits generate ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
[空中闪身]  ：在空中时闪身将消耗你的近战能量并进入编织状态，获得来自战斗人员和玩家的伤害抗性。重新激活空中闪身或投掷裂痕来退出编织，为你和附近盟友生成织造铠甲。

在编织状态中，你的近战能量会耗尽并会慢慢产生息停线虫。线虫命中会产生技能能量。

perks.name: Self-Repairing Nanofibers
perks.description: Increases this armor's recovery, allowing you to recover health faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高这件护甲的恢复值，以提高你的生命值恢复速度。

perks.name: Juggernaut
perks.description:
With full class ability energy and after sprinting for a short time, you gain a frontal shield that blocks incoming damage. When the frontal shield breaks, your class ability energy is depleted. When the frontal shield takes damage, you gain a stack of Bolt Charge.

While amplified, the shield blocks significantly more damage before breaking.
perks.descriptionZh:
在职业技能能量已满并短时间冲刺后，你会得到一面抵挡来袭伤害的正面护盾。在护盾被打破后，你会耗尽所有职业技能能量。当正面护盾受到伤害时，你会获得一层电光充能。

在增幅状态下，护盾可抵挡的伤害显著增加。

perks.name: Sustained Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating combatants with Auto Rifles, Trace Rifles, or Machine Guns. Additional copies of this mod increase the time allowed between combatants that are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用自动步枪、追踪步枪或机枪快速消灭战斗人员来充斥光能。此模组的额外副本可增加消灭战斗人员之间的时间间隔。

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage greatly increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可大幅提升操控性与瞄准辅助，直到武器被收起。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器破坏战斗人员的护盾，使他们对动能伤害的承受力更低，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Asterion Abyss Signal
perks.description: The inert radiolaria courses through you with a strange resonance. Follow where it leads.
perks.descriptionZh: 惰性放射体液在你体内流动，产生奇怪的共鸣。跟随它的引导行动吧。

perks.name: Ruinscribe's Beacon
perks.description: While a Ruinscribe Turret is deployed, this weapon can paint targets with its laser projectiles. The turret prioritizes painted targets and fires more powerful munitions at them. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap between normal fire and laser fire modes.
perks.descriptionZh: 毁灭铭刻炮台部署时，此武器可使用其激光射弹标记目标。炮台会优先攻击被标记的目标，向其发射更强力的弹药。按下[替换武器动作] 切换普通射击或激光射击模式。

perks.name: Kinetic Weapon Targeting
perks.description: Slightly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 略微改善动能武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Siphoning Touch
perks.description: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器或偃月造成近战命中获得虹吸之触层数。切换武器会消耗所有层数来治疗你自己。

perks.name: Resonant Plating
perks.description: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到强力战斗人员的近战伤害后立即开始回复生命值。

perks.name: Shared Wisdom
perks.description: Increased experience gains provided by a fireteam member.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加了火力战队成员提供的经验值。

perks.name: Flight
perks.description: Grants slightly increased persistence and projectile speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅提升坚韧和射弹速度。

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.
perks.descriptionZh: 每隔一次的赋能刀剑击杀都可提供刀剑弹药。

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的拉弓速度快得难以置信。提高填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Automatic Prize
perks.description:
Defeating combatants or opponents with Auto Rifles or Submachine Guns grants a small amount of Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用 自动步枪 或 微型冲锋枪 击败战斗人员或对手可获得少量微光。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Transcendent Blessing
perks.description: While in the Dreaming City, you deal more damage to all targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 身处幽梦之城时，对所有目标造成的伤害提高。

perks.name: Will Given Form
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Drain Super energy, overflowing the magazine and empowering the beam with bonus damage and the ability to slow and freeze targets until the magazine or Super energy runs out, or the weapon is stowed. Can only be activated when Super energy is full.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作] ：消耗超能能量，使弹匣满溢并赋予光束额外伤害，并在超能能量或弹匣耗光或收起武器之前赋予减缓和冰冻敌人的能力。只能在超能能量全满时启动。

perks.name: Shot in the Dark
perks.description: Increases damage and weakens while invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 隐形时提升伤害和虚弱效果。

perks.name: Dawning Dare
perks.description: Landing a trick while riding Dawning Cheer will spawn multiple Glimmer presents. This perk is available only during the Dawning.
perks.descriptionZh: 在乘坐曙光喜悦时耍个把戏可生成多个微光礼物。此特性仅可在曙光节期间使用。

perks.name: Crook and Flail
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药盒会治疗你。

perks.name: Gift of Sight
perks.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升你雷达的分辨率。

perks.name: Traveler's Diffraction
perks.description: Defeating combatants with Void damage has a chance to create Void seekers that track nearby targets and suppress them.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空伤害击败战斗人员有一定几率生成虚空追踪弹，它能追踪并压制附近的目标。

perks.name: +10 Class ▲
perks.description: +10 Class ▲

perks.name: Lancer's Vigil
perks.description: Improves Diamond Lances.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升钻石长矛。

perks.name: Overflowing Corruption
perks.description:
Increases the drop rate of Sigil Stones by 10% for each equipped piece of armor (maximum 4 pieces).

Combining with other Episodic bonuses cannot exceed 100%.

Current Bonus: {var:1796953370}%
perks.descriptionZh:
增加印记石的掉落率，每装备一件护甲增加10%（最多4件）。

与其他篇章奖励叠加时不会超过100%。

当前奖励：{var:1796953370}%

perks.name: Unflinching Scout Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用斥候步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Momentum Siphon
perks.description: Recharge your melee ability whenever you or a member of your fireteam staggers a Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 你或你的火力战队成员眩晕敌方勇士时可为你充能近战技能。

perks.name: Abundant Ammo
perks.description: Grants increased ammo generation.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Void Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Monte Carlo Method
perks.description: Weapon damage reduces melee ability cooldown.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器伤害可缩短近战技能冷却时间。

perks.name: Elemental Charge
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle has an escalating chance to give you Armor Charge.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集元素拾取物或摧毁缠结有递增的几率提供护甲充能。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a longer duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 击杀可为所有武器提供更高的操控性，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.description: Damaging a combatant with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights by an improved amount. Bows receive improved draw speed, and Swords receive improved charge rate while this perk is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器对战斗人员造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提升更多瞄准时的移动速度。当此特性生效时，弓箭获得更多拉弓速度，刀剑获得更多充能速度。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sidearm
perks.description: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Suppressing Glaive
perks.description: Damaging combatants with your Glaive suppresses them, preventing them from using abilities for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用偃月对战斗人员造成伤害可压制他们，使其在短时间内无法使用技能。

perks.name: Heart Piercer
perks.description: Rounds from this weapon shatter into submunitions on impact. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器发射的子弹在命中时会碎裂成子弹药。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Double Bonus Focus
perks.description: The first Bonus Focus awarded per day drops a second time.
perks.descriptionZh: 每天获得的第一个加成专注会再次掉落。

perks.name: Deal increased Matterspark damage.
perks.nameZh: 造成更高的物质火花伤害。
perks.description: Deal increased Matterspark damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成更高的物质火花伤害。

perks.name: Vex Striker
perks.description: Defeating a Vex with a precision hit has a chance to spawn an Orb of Power. Multiple copies of this mod increase the Super energy granted when those Orbs are picked up.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用精准命中消灭Vex有机会刷出能量球。多个此模组可以增加拾起能量球时的超能能量。

perks.name: Precise Oracle Disruptor
perks.description: Your equipped Bows, Hand Cannons, Linear Fusion Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sniper Rifles deal additional damage to Oracles in the Vault of Glass.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的弓箭、手炮、线性融合步枪、斥候步枪和狙击步枪会对玻璃拱顶中的神谕造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Superstructure Defender
perks.description: While you are standing on a sync plate or are near a conflux, weapon attacks that hit powerful Vex combatants have a high chance to weaken those combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你站在同步板上或汇流附近时，击中强力Vex战斗人员的武器攻击有高几率削弱战斗人员。

perks.name: Whispered Breathing
perks.description: Aiming this weapon without firing for a brief moment grants bonus range and precision damage while it remains zoomed.
perks.descriptionZh: 未射击下瞄准一小段时间可使瞄准状态下射程和精准伤害提高。

perks.name: Pack Hunter
perks.description: Gain increased handling and reload speed when standing near allies. Firing this weapon also grants Wolfpack Rounds to nearby allies wielding non-Exotic Rocket Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 站在友军附近时，提高操控性和填装速度。使用此武器也能让附近使用非异域火箭发射器的友军获得狼群弹药。

perks.name: Together Forever
perks.description: Adaptive. Final blows with this weapon reload and overflow Sturm.
perks.descriptionZh: 适配。使用此武器造成最后一击会填装并溢装狂飙。

perks.name: Bomber
perks.description: Reduces grenade cooldown when using your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用职业技能时缩短手雷的冷却时间。

perks.name: Mobile Titan Armor
perks.description: Improved mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 更高的敏捷度。

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标后填装此武器，会使下次命中发射一枚引爆造成迷失效果的动能射弹。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Top Tier Mastery
perks.description: While this weapon is at high stacks of Master, new rounds are continually loaded into the magazine, and the benefits from Bullseye Bolster last longer.
perks.descriptionZh: 当这件武器处于高层数大师状态时，新弹药将持续装入弹匣，且靶心加固的效果持续时间更长。

perks.name: Machine Gun Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Machine Guns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的机枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Bottomless Bounty I
perks.description: Improves the effect of the Right Hook and Runneth Over weapon Origin perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化“右勾拳”和“火力满溢”武器原有特性的效果。

perks.name: Bleeding Edge
perks.description: Gain Super energy on Sword final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑最后一击获得超能能量。

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.description: Reloading after defeating targets grants an increased amount of energy to your lowest charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标后填装，会提供更多能量给当前充能最低的技能。

perks.name: Health regeneration begins immediately upon activating Matterspark.
perks.nameZh: 启动物质火花后立即开始生命值回复。
perks.description: Health regeneration begins immediately upon activating Matterspark.
perks.descriptionZh: 启动物质火花后立即开始生命值回复。

perks.name: Freehand Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy and ready speed while firing from the hip.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高腰际射击时的命中率和准备速度。

perks.name: Gift of the Traveler
perks.description: Each stack of Gathering Light improves this weapon's reload, handling, and target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 每层“光能聚集”均可提升此武器的填装、操控性和目标获取能力。

perks.name: Better Already
perks.description: Your health begins to regenerate immediately after picking up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后立即开始恢复生命值。

perks.name: Io Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 在木卫一上获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Imperial Allegiance
perks.description: Being near allies grants increased cooling or charge rate, and increased damage while at high heat or low guard energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 靠近盟友时，提升冷却或充能速度；高热量或低格挡能量时，提升伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: SUROS Ascendance
perks.description: Increased chance for kills to regen health.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高击杀即可恢复生命值的几率。

perks.name: Energy Stabilization Mod
perks.description: Reduces recoil for the equipped Energy weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低已装备能量武器的后坐力。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高狙击步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Ghost Green
perks.description: Adds a green Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色机灵环。

perks.name: Repurposed Charge
perks.description:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
perks.descriptionZh:
获得、失去或消耗护甲充能时，在短时间内获得治疗和伤害减免。

此效果根据获得、失去和消耗的护甲充能数量而调整。

perks.name: Emergency Electromagnet
perks.description: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被击破时，自动收集附近所有的能量球与弹药盒。

perks.name: Hunter's Trance
perks.description: Increased magazine size. Grants increased handling, reload speed, and weapon range based on the number of stacks of Paracausal Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣容量提高。根据“超因果充能”层数提高操控性、填装速度和武器射程。

perks.name: Hammer of the Warmind
perks.description:
The detonations from Warmind Cells you destroy cause disruption, stunning combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions  and [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你摧毁的战争思维电池所引发的爆炸会造成干扰，眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士和势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Afterburners
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Nessus Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯上探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Ghost White
perks.description: Adds a white Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个白色机灵环。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Assault Barricade
perks.description: You and your allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade.
perks.descriptionZh: 你和你的盟友可以穿过你的巍峨屏障进行射击。

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when lightly wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 轻伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Shotgun Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定霰弹枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用霰弹枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Stealth Running
perks.description: Enemies are less aggressive toward you while you are riding this Sparrow.
perks.descriptionZh: 敌人对你在使用快雀时的攻击减少。

perks.name: Prosperity (Gambit)
perks.description: Gambit wins have a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中取胜有几率掉落一件额外的传说装备。

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 缩短被战斗人员包围时的充能时间或蓄力时间。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Rocket Launcher ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的火箭发射器弹药数量。

perks.name: Of Hawks and Pigeons
perks.description: Raid rotator challenges grant Spoils of Conquest. Trials wins grant additional Trials reputation.
perks.descriptionZh: 突袭轮转挑战可奖励征服战利品。试炼胜场可奖励额外的试炼声望。

perks.name: Weighted Edge
perks.description: This weapon's melee attacks deal increased damage and slow targets when loaded with ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的近战攻击在武器装填有弹药的情况下可造成更高的伤害并让目标减速。

perks.name: Enhanced Machine Gun Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高机枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Disorienting Grenades
perks.description: Detonation has a brief disorienting effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 引爆后拥有短暂的迷失效果。

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊或重型弹药可自动填装武器至超出正常弹药储存量。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Scout Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Scout Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的斥候步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Revitalizing Blast
perks.description: Causing damage with a Solar ability weakens Champions and bosses for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日技能造成伤害会在短时间内削弱勇士和首领。

perks.name: Pillar of Ice
perks.description: Defeating a frozen target spawns Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败被冻结目标会生成冰影水晶。

perks.name: Unravelling Orbs
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会使缚丝武器获得瓦解弹药。

perks.name: Dragon's Bite
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with a Strand or Stasis weapon has a chance to suspend or freeze that combatant.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝或冰影武器打破战斗人员的护盾有几率悬停或冻结该战斗人员。

perks.name: Anti-Champion Nosecone
perks.description: Rocket Launchers deal increased damage to Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器对勇士造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Slug Rifle
perks.description: Lobs explosive slugs.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射爆炸弹头。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization I
perks.description:
Improves the benefits provided by the Sundering, Nano-Munitions, and Nanotech Tracer Rockets Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
perks.descriptionZh:
提升分离、纳米弹药和纳米技术追踪火箭原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

perks.name: From Whence You Came
perks.description: Increases ability damage to Taken and Scorn combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对傀儡军团和嗤魅战斗人员的技能伤害。

perks.name: Flame, Fiber, and Freeze
perks.description: Combines the Solar/Strand and Solar/Stasis Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将烈日/缚丝和烈日/冰影虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Kindling Trigger
perks.description: Radiant causes Solar weapons to apply scorch to unscorched combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 焕光会使烈日武器获得灼烧未被灼烧的战斗人员的能力。

perks.name: Blast Radius
perks.description: Rapid final blows with Rocket Launchers and Grenade Launchers grant Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器和榴弹发射器快速最后一击会提供护甲充能。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Bomber
perks.description: Even faster grenade cooldown when using your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用职业技能时大幅缩短手雷的冷却时间。

perks.name: Spark of Momentum
perks.description: Sliding over ammo bricks reloads your equipped weapon and grants you a small amount of Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行经过弹药盒会填装你当前装备的武器，并为你提供少量电光充能。

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的手雷技能会填装一部分弹匣，并更改此武器的伤害类型，使其匹配你手雷的属性，直到你收起此武器。

perks.name: Wrecker
perks.description: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh: 你对战斗人员护盾、覆盖护盾、载具和构造体造成的动能伤害显著提升。构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Concussive Rounds
perks.description: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用动能伤害击败强力战斗人员或破坏战斗人员护盾会释放具有迷失效果的动能冲击波。

perks.name: Threaded Specter
perks.description:
Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

After taking significant damage or when combatants approach, the decoy detonates, dealing damage and releasing Threadlings that seek out and attack nearby foes.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能将留下一个由缚丝物质编织的诱饵，吸引附近战斗人员的注意。

在受到高额伤害或战斗人员接近时，诱饵会自动引爆，造成伤害并释放出能追寻并攻击附近敌人的线虫。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Anticipation
perks.description:
[Shoot]  : Hold to charge; release to fire.
Charged projectiles have a delayed Solar payload.
perks.descriptionZh:
[射击]  ：长按充能；松开时射击。
充能射弹具有延迟的烈日载荷。

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.description: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified; increased reload speed and handling have a longer duration. This effect is significantly improved when you are amplified.
perks.descriptionZh: 在冲刺后或处于增幅状态时暂时提高填装速度和操控性；填装速度和操控性的提升将持续更长时间。此效果在你处于增幅状态时会得到显著提升。

perks.name: Daybreak
perks.description: Weave Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the skies.
perks.descriptionZh: 将烈日之光化作利刃，从空中轰击敌人。

perks.name: Ascendant Supply
perks.description: The first Vanguard Armory quest completed each week grants an Ascendant Shard.
perks.descriptionZh: 每周完成的第一个先锋军械库任务会奖励一个上维碎片。

perks.name: Distorted Glyphkeeper
perks.description: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Auto Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sniper Rifles to deal additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的自动步枪、线性融合步枪、斥候步枪和狙击步枪造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Vortex Frame
perks.description:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重旋转攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升瞄准辅助、瞄准速度和空中效率。附近没有盟友时这些效果将提升。

perks.name: Cellular Suppression
perks.description: Damaging a Warmind Cell creates a burst of suppressing Void energy. Additionally, you deal less damage to Warmind Cells.
perks.descriptionZh: 对战争思维电池造成伤害会引爆一股压制性虚空能量。另外，你对战争思维电池造成的伤害减少。

perks.name: Core Harvest
perks.description: Earn bonus Enhancement Cores when completing ritual activities.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成仪式活动时获得额外的强化核心。

perks.name: Prism Harvest
perks.description: Earn bonus Enhancement Prisms when completing ritual activities.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成仪式活动时获得额外的增强棱镜。

perks.name: Discipline Armorer
perks.description: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Discipline, and are more likely to drop with higher Discipline.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点纪律，且很可能掉落时带有更多的纪律。

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 引爆火箭时会释放出集束炸弹。扩大爆炸范围。

perks.name: High-Impact Longbow
perks.description: High-power draw with over-penetrating arrows.
perks.descriptionZh: 高能量拉弓可射出贯穿箭矢。

perks.name: Tangled Shore Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 纷争海岸缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Banshee's Wail
perks.description: Rev to empower; bypasses shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 旋转以赋能；无视护盾。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Well of Ions
perks.description: Picking up an Arc elemental well causes your next melee to deal increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取电弧元素井可使你的下一次近战造成更高的伤害。

perks.name: Offensive Bulwark
perks.description:
While you have an Overshield or are inside Ward of Dawn, final blows grant grenade and melee energy, you have increased melee range and damage, and melee final blows restore a small portion of your Overshield and extend its duration.

You gain an additional Shield Throw while in Sentinel Shield.
perks.descriptionZh:
拥有覆盖护盾或位于黎明护罩内时，进行最后一击提供手雷与近战能量，你的近战距离和伤害获得提升，近战最后一击可恢复小部分覆盖护盾并延长其持续时间。

在哨兵圣盾中时可进行一次额外的圣盾投掷。

perks.name: Dreaded Visage
perks.description: Gain ability energy when you are damaged. While you have a Void Super equipped, final blows grant Devour.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到伤害时获得技能能量。装备虚空超能时，最后一击会提供吞食。

perks.name: Transfusion Matrix
perks.description: Arc melee kills grant health and melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧近战击杀补充生命值和近战能量。

perks.name: Purple Class Sigil
perks.description: Adds a purple class sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个紫色职业印记。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Fusion Rifles get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Fusion Rifle.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该融合步枪所用弹药时，融合步枪获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Death at First Glance
perks.description: Bonus damage when aiming down sights on the opening shot of an attack. This bonus is preserved if the shot deals precision damage or strikes an elemental shield.
perks.descriptionZh: 举枪瞄准时的第一发子弹造成额外伤害。如果射击造成精准伤害或击中元素护盾，此加成保持不变。

perks.name: Martian Publicity
perks.description: Grants a chance for Heroic public events on Mars to reward an additional Mars token.
perks.descriptionZh: 有几率在火星上进行英雄公共事件时获得一枚额外的火星代币。

perks.name: Celerity
perks.description:
Increases weapon handling and reload speed. Gain the following effects while you are the last living member of your fireteam:
• Increased target acquisition
• Increased handling and reload speed
• Reduced flinch from incoming fire
perks.descriptionZh:
提高武器操控性和装填速度。当你作为你的火力战队最后一名存活的队员时获得以下效果：
·增强目标锁定
·增强操控性和装填速度
·减少收到伤害时的屏幕抖动

perks.name: Unstoppable Pulse Rifle
perks.description:
Aiming down Pulse Rifle sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
举枪瞄准脉冲步枪会装载一梭强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Machine Gun Aim
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用机枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可获得射程加成，直至你的护盾被摧毁。在你的护盾重新充满能量后，该加成将重新生效。

perks.name: Paraversal Singularity
perks.description: Adds a singularity appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个奇点外观。

perks.name: Cellular Division
perks.description: Adds a cellular appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个多孔外观。

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会提升精准伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Adept Range
perks.description: +10 Range
perks.descriptionZh: +10射程

perks.name: Radiant Largesse
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, activating a Solar Super recharges your grenade.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，激活烈日超能可充能手雷。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可在短时间内增加腰射的武器射程、稳定性和精度。

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭一个目标会向附近目标蔓延持续时间更长的灼烧效果。
更强大的战斗人员和敌方守护者会在更大的范围内造成灼烧效果。

perks.name: Prime Engram Boost
perks.description: Increases chance of receiving Prime Engrams from Ops activities.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高从行动活动中获得至高记忆水晶的几率。

perks.name: Frozen Striker
perks.description: Defeating a target with a Stasis melee spawns a Stasis shard.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用冰影近战击败目标会生成一块冰影碎片。

perks.name: COMBAT CONTROLS
perks.description:
Primary Weapon: [Vehicle Primary Fire]

Secondary Weapon: [Vehicle Secondary Fire]
Secondary Weapons inherit the damage type of the driver's equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh:
主武器：[载具主要攻击]

副武器：[载具次要攻击]
副武器继承驾驶者所装备超能的伤害类型。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Class ▼
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Class ▼

perks.name: Wave Frame
perks.description: One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher. Projectiles release a wave of energy when they contact the ground.
perks.descriptionZh: 单发手持榴弹发射器。弹药将在接触到地面时释放一股能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Compression Chamber
perks.description: Hip-fire pellets, aim to fire slugs.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射时发射霰弹，瞄准射击时发射铅弹。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Rocket Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高火箭发射器的收举速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Pulse Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型脉冲步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善脉冲步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Touch of Thunder
perks.description:
Your Flashbang, Pulse, Lightning, and Storm Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Flashbang Grenade: Emits an additional blinding detonation on bounce.

Pulse Grenade: Creates Ionic Traces periodically as it damages targets and increases in damage over time.

Lightning Grenade: Grants an additional grenade charge, jolts targets hit by the initial blast, and grants Bolt Charge when it causes damage.

Storm Grenade: After detonating, creates a roaming thundercloud that tracks nearby targets and fires bolts of lightning at foes beneath it.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的闪光、脉冲、闪电以及风暴手雷有更强的效果。

闪光手雷：反弹时额外发射一次致盲爆炸。

脉冲手雷：对目标造成伤害时周期性产生离子轨迹并逐渐提高伤害。

闪电手雷：赋予一枚额外的手雷并震颤初次爆破命中的目标，并且在造成伤害时提供电光充能。

风暴手雷：在爆炸后，制造一团会追踪附近目标并朝下方敌人释放闪电的移动雷云。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的动能弹药更容易令战斗人员眩晕，对低生命值目标的目标捕获能力和伤害更高。

perks.name: +10 Melee ▲
perks.description: +10 Melee ▲

perks.name: Umbral Recharge
perks.description: While you have several stacks of Pervading Darkness, your class ability recharges quicker.
perks.descriptionZh: 在数个弥漫暗影效果叠加时，职业技能的充能速度更快。

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击将生成更多手雷能量。使用手雷技能将用储存弹药填装此武器。

perks.name: Kinetic Ammo Generation
perks.description: Increases the ammo generation of Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升动能武器的弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Strand Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高缚丝武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.description: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 在高热量状态下，此武器造成更高伤害，并使目标在被击败时爆炸。

perks.name: Deconstruction
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage after using a Transmutation sphere to damage powerful combatants or deal final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 在使用蜕变圆球对强力战斗人员造成伤害或造成最后一击后，此武器会获得伤害提升。

perks.name: Taken Barrier
perks.description: Receiving Taken damage gives a 20% reduction in damage for 10 seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到傀儡军团的伤害可获得20%的伤害减免，持续10秒。

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器收回枪套一小段时间后会自动填装弹药，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Heat Sink
perks.description: Overheat damage is reduced while not aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 非举枪瞄准时的过热伤害降低。

perks.name: Sneak Bow
perks.description: Increases hold time and reload speed, and prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升充能时间和填装速度，同时防止蹲伏射击时产生雷达信号。

perks.name: Yellow Spotlight
perks.description: Adds a yellow spotlight to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束黄色聚光灯。

perks.name: Persistent Resonance
perks.description: Create orbs when depositing Resonance.
perks.descriptionZh: 存放共振时产生能量球。

perks.name: Dreaming City Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 在幽梦之城中探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Icarus Grip
perks.description: Greatly increases airborne effectiveness.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升空中效率。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.nameZh: 线性融合步枪弹药搜寻者
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding ammo while you have a Linear Fusion Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备线性融合步枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Nano-entanglement
perks.description: This weapon's damage type becomes Strand. Final blows with grenades from this weapon create Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的伤害类型变为缚丝。使用此武器的榴弹造成最后一击会生成缠结。

perks.name: Precision Weapon Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles, Trace Rifles, Bows, Linear Fusion, Snipers, and Slug Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善手炮、斥候步枪、追踪步枪、弓箭、线性融合步枪、狙击步枪和重弹霰弹枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: +20 Melee ▲
perks.description: +20 Melee ▲

perks.name: +5 Health ▲
perks.description: +5 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲

perks.name: Evasive Maneuvers
perks.description: With the Suppressor Augment, you take decreased damage from powerful foes.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有抑制增益时，你受到的来自高阶敌人的伤害降低。

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.
perks.descriptionZh: 引爆火箭时会释放出集束炸弹。

perks.name: Dark-Forged Trigger
perks.description: Removes hipfire accuracy penalties while increasing rate of fire. At maximum stacks of Cranial Spike, hipfiring deals increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 移除腰射精度惩罚并提高射速。颅骨之刺叠加数达到最大时，腰射可造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: [Shoot] After picking up the Relocator Launcher, aim at an Exit Pad and fire to activate the nearby Relocator Pad.
perks.nameZh: [射击]拾取重定位发射器后，瞄准出口板并发射以激活附近的重定位器板。
perks.description: [Shoot] After picking up the Relocator Launcher, aim at an Exit Pad and fire to activate the nearby Relocator Pad.
perks.descriptionZh: [射击]拾取重定位发射器后，瞄准出口板并发射以激活附近的重定位器板。

perks.name: Sweaty Confetti
perks.description:
Causes a festive celebration on each precision final blow.

This cosmetic mod is consumed when inserted into a weapon.
perks.descriptionZh:
每次精准最后一击都会带来节日庆祝。

此装饰模组会在插入武器时被消耗掉。

perks.name: Friendly Competition
perks.description: Generate Laurels by defeating enemies with abilities during the Guardian Games.
perks.descriptionZh: 在守护者游戏中使用技能消灭敌人以生成桂冠。

perks.name: Disrupting Blade
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits with any Sword you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用刀剑连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能恢复速度并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Collector +2
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Collector +1
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Collector +3
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Bray Legacy
perks.description: Damage with this weapon generates a small amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成伤害，会为最接近完全充能的技能生成少量技能能量。

perks.name: Impact Induction
perks.description: Causing damage with a powered melee attack reduces your grenade cooldown.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用充能近战攻击造成伤害可缩短手雷的冷却时间。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Machine Gun Targeting
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善机枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Overload Rounds
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits on enemy targets disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
对敌方目标的连续攻击扰乱战斗人员并将其眩晕，延缓技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Power Overwhelming
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, defeating challenging enemies with a Power weapon boosts Power weapon damage by 15% for a short time.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你在利维坦上使用威能武器消灭高阶敌人时，短时间内威能武器的伤害将提高15%。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Collective Purpose
perks.description: Gain improved bonus range and handling when near allies. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate. The effect scales with the number of nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 在盟友附近时获得更多额外射程和操控性。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度会加快。此效果与附近的盟友数量成正比。

perks.name: Strand Ammo Generation
perks.description: Increases the ammo generation of Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升缚丝武器的弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Scatter Projectile Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Auto Rifles, Machine Guns, SMGs, Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, and Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高自动步枪，自动步枪、机枪、微型冲锋枪、脉冲步枪、手枪和融合步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Mobile Warlock Armor
perks.description: Improved mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 更高的敏捷度。

perks.name: MIDA Synergy
perks.description: This weapon grants speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 当同时装备米达多功能时，移动速度提高。

perks.name: Radiant Orbs
perks.description: While you have a Solar or Prismatic subclass equipped, picking up an Orb of Power makes you radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你装备烈日或棱镜分支职业时，拾取能量球可获得焕光效果。

perks.name: Galvanic Armor
perks.description: While you have an Arc or Prismatic subclass equipped, incoming damage from combatants is reduced while amplified.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你装备电弧或棱镜分支职业时，在增幅状态下受到来自战斗人员的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Solar Fulmination
perks.description: Your ignitions do increased damage in an increased radius.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的点燃会在更大的半径范围内造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Targeting Autoloader
perks.description:
While you have an Auto Rifle equipped, defeating combatants reloads your equipped weapon and temporarily increases weapon damage. 

Awards bonus progress when dealing final blows while surrounded.
perks.descriptionZh:
装备自动步枪时，击败战斗人员将重新填装你装备的武器，并暂时提高武器伤害。

被包围时造成最后一击可提供额外进度。

perks.name: Counter Energy
perks.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，你充能最少的技能将获得能量。

perks.name: Blade Stamina
perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with a Sword refunds some ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 用刀剑快速击败战斗人员会返还一些弹药。

perks.name: Void Hegemony
perks.description: While you have a Void or Prismatic subclass equipped, defeating weakened targets provides a small Void Overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你装备了虚空或棱镜分支职业时，击败被削弱的目标会提供一个小型虚空覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Stay in the Fight
perks.description: When your shields are broken, this weapon gains an improved period of increased stability and ammo generation.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾破裂时，此武器会暂时获得更高的稳定性和弹药生成提升。

perks.name: A Wish for Protection
perks.description: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 短时间内受到大量伤害会生成一层庇护之愿，让战斗人员更难命中你，并提供填装速度和抖动抗性加成。

perks.name: A Wish Fulfilled
perks.description:
When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.
perks.descriptionZh:
庇护之愿失效时获得治愈。

快速最后一击会提前结束庇护之愿。

perks.name: Grenade Chaser
perks.description: Landing multiple Missile Tracers loads a grenade. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to switch into Grenade Launcher mode.
perks.descriptionZh: 用导弹追踪弹击中数次可以装载一枚手雷。[替换武器动作] 可切换为榴弹发射器模式。

perks.name: Recuperation
perks.description: Replenishes health each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次拾取能量球都将恢复生命值。

perks.name: Melee Mod
perks.description: Increases the Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升近战属性。

perks.name: Surge Eater
perks.description: Recharge your grenade ability whenever you or a member of your fireteam disrupts a Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 你或你的火力战队成员眩晕敌方勇士时可为你充能手雷技能。

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器破坏敌人的护盾，使他们在一小段时间内对动能伤害的承受力更低。

perks.name: Remote Connection
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on Sniper Rifle kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 狙击步枪击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Unflinching Auto Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用自动步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速元素最后一击和对受元素减益影响的目标造成最后一击，会定期准备一枚制导微型导弹，在此武器下次造成最后一击后从目标位置发射。可准备更多枚导弹。

perks.name: EDZ Combo Detector
perks.nameZh: 欧洲无人区综合探测器
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区中探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Perpetuation
perks.description: Reduces class ability cooldown when using your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用职业技能时缩短职业技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Excavation
perks.description: Grenades spawn cluster bombs.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷生成集束炸弹。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Peregrine Strike
perks.description: Bonus damage on airborne shoulder charge
perks.descriptionZh: 空中肩部冲撞将造成额外伤害

perks.name: +10 Super ▲
perks.description: +10 Super ▲

perks.name: Well of Radiance
perks.description: Thrust your Daybreak Sword into the ground. The Sword continuously projects a powerful aura that heals and empowers nearby allies, increasing their weapon damage and protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
perks.descriptionZh: 将你的黎明刀剑刺入地面。刀剑会持续发出强大的光环，治疗附近盟友并为其赋能，增加其武器伤害并使其免受冰影的影响。

perks.name: Will of Light (Arc)
perks.description: Your equipped weapons that deal Arc damage deal increased damage to Taken combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的电弧伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Sniper Rifles get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Sniper Rifle.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该狙击步枪所用弹药时，狙击步枪获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Defeating combatants with a Pulse Rifle grants a chance to drop Special ammo for your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用脉冲步枪消灭战斗人员可有几率为你的同伴掉落特殊弹药

perks.name: Indomitability
perks.description: Final blows grant improved grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or improved melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 玩光能分支职业时，最后一击可提供更多的手雷能量。玩暗影分支职业时，最后一击可提供更多的近战能量。

perks.name: Unflinching Pulse Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用脉冲步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Boss Resist
perks.description: Gain extra damage resistance against bosses and vehicles.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得对抗来自首领和载具的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Beyond Sight
perks.description: Adds a beyond sight appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个超越视界外观。

perks.name: Threat Remover
perks.description: Dealing damage with nearly all pellets in a spread increases reload speed, handling, and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 散射几乎所有弹丸造成伤害时会提升填装速度、操控性和稳定性。

perks.name: Dual Loader
perks.description: Reloads two additional shots at a time.
perks.descriptionZh: 一次填装两发额外子弹。

perks.name: Jumpshot
perks.description:
Drawing this weapon while in midair triggers increased damage, faster draw time, improved target acquisition, and dramatically faster movement speed for a short time or until you touch the ground.

This effect is activated once per jump and becomes available again after a moment on the ground.
perks.descriptionZh:
在空中时拉弓会触发更高伤害、更快的拉弓时间、改进的目标捕获能力，以及大幅增加的移动速度，在一小段时间后或你触地时失效。

每次跳跃触发该效果一次，落地片刻后可再次触发。

perks.name: Tungsten Bowstring
perks.description:
Deals increased damage, at the cost of draw time and handling. Releases an elemental explosion matching this weapon when fully drawn.

Kinetic weapons release a burst matching your equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh:
造成更高伤害，但会牺牲拉弓时间和操控性。拉满弓会释放与该武器匹配的元素爆炸。

动能武器会释放与你装备的超能匹配的爆炸。

perks.name: Shattershafts
perks.description: Arrows and bolts split into several projectiles after a short distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 箭矢和弩弹在飞行一小段距离后会分裂成几个射弹。

perks.name: Dreaming City Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional resources in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在幽梦之城中获得额外的资源。

perks.name: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
perks.description: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼

perks.name: Forked Lightning
perks.description: Lightning Rod now triggers from any Arc damage final blow.
perks.descriptionZh: 避雷针现在可被一切电弧伤害最后一击所触发。

perks.name: Resilience Armorer
perks.description: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Resilience, and are more likely to drop with higher Resilience.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点韧性，且很可能掉落时带有更多的韧性。

perks.name: Noble Deeds
perks.description: Gain charges by assisting your allies with revives, healing, overshields, and subclass buffs. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon is granted improved bonus handling, reload speed, and Sword charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过使用复活、治疗、覆盖护盾和分支职业增益协助盟友来获得充能。击败战斗人员会消耗充能。充能时，此武器可获得更多的操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度加成。

perks.name: Solar Empowerment
perks.description:
While Solar empowered:
- Solar Supers have extended durations.
- You radiate damaging Solar energy.
- Damage resistance increases.
- You heal passively.

On PRISM Day, Solar empowerment is applied while using a Solar subclass.
perks.descriptionZh:
在烈日赋能期间：
-延长烈日超能的持续时间。
-你会散发出具有伤害性的烈日能量。
-提高伤害抗性。
-你会被动治疗。

在棱镜日，使用烈日分支职业时会应用烈日赋能。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高脉冲步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Redirection
perks.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.
perks.descriptionZh: 对普通敌人造成伤害会提升对高阶敌人的伤害。

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中三个不同目标可提高武器操控性、稳定性、填装和射程，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Unsated Hunger
perks.description:
Increased handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain increased guard resistance and charge rate instead.
perks.descriptionZh:
在没有技能处于完全充能状态时提高操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

而刀剑则可提高防御抗性和充能速度。

perks.name: Lucent Tithes
perks.description: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员执行终结技会获得治疗并生成忠于你的虚空飞蛾。

perks.name: Lucent Transmutation
perks.description: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 对战斗人员执行终结技，或造成连续充能近战最后一击，会根据你的光能分支职业生成一个元素拾取物。

perks.name: Danger Close
perks.description: Proximity evaluation systems enable handling and stability when enemies are close.
perks.descriptionZh: 在敌人接近时提供操控性和稳定性的近接评估系统。

perks.name: Solar Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Solar weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善烈日武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Wish-Dragon Teeth
perks.description: Enhanced Tripmines.
perks.descriptionZh: 技能伤害可强化感应手雷。

perks.name: Spring-Loaded Mounting
perks.description: Boosts Sidearms, especially when you're wounded.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅增强手枪伤害，尤其在身受重伤时。

perks.name: Lightning Surge
perks.description: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 在滑铲时，启动你的已充能近战技能来向前瞬移，在重新物质化的同时降下闪电打击震颤目标。此技能还能让你获得增幅状态，并提供电光充能。

perks.name: Bottomless Appetite
perks.description: Dealing continuous damage extends the duration of Ravenous Beast.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会延长贪食野兽的持续时间。

perks.name: Split Decision
perks.description: Fires Stasis and Solar pellets quickly. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速发射冰影和烈日弹片。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.description: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣中最后的几发弹药可造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中三个不同目标可在一定时间内提高伤害。

perks.name: Weapons Font
perks.description: You gain a bonus to your weapons stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外武器属性。你的护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: Compound. Optimized for damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 复合弓。优化伤害。

perks.name: For the Empire
perks.description: This weapon is Full Auto, does extra damage to Cabal, and penetrates Phalanx shields.
perks.descriptionZh: 全自动武器，可对卡巴尔造成额外伤害，可穿透方阵士兵护盾。

perks.name: Shotgun Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Shotgun ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的霰弹枪弹药储量。

perks.name: Dynamic Duo
perks.description: Consuming your Arc grenade grants an Arc Soul and amplifies you.
perks.descriptionZh: 消耗你的电弧手雷可提供电弧之魂并使你进入增幅状态。

perks.name: Land Tank
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased health and additional damage resistance from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供更高的生命值以及对战斗人员的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Force Multiplier
perks.description: Shotgun and melee final blows start health regeneration and extend defensive buffs.
perks.descriptionZh: 霰弹枪和近战最后一击会开启生命值回复并延长防御性增益。

perks.name: Touch of Flame
perks.description:
Your Healing, Solar, Firebolt, and Fusion Grenades have enhanced functionality.

Healing Grenade: Improves the strength of cure and restoration effects applied. Consuming a Healing Grenade with Heat Rises also applies restoration to nearby allies.

Solar Grenade: Increases linger duration. Periodically emits blobs of lava around its perimeter.

Firebolt Grenade: Increases target search radius and maximum target count.

Fusion Grenade: Explodes twice.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的治愈、烈日、烈焰和融合手雷功能增强。

治愈手雷：提高所施加的治愈和恢复效果的强度。 炙热升腾时消耗治愈手雷还会对附近的盟友提供恢复效果。

烈日手雷：提升持续时间。在其周围周期性地发射熔岩团块。

烈焰手雷：提升目标搜寻范围和最大目标数。

融合手雷：可爆炸两次。

perks.name: Clenched Fist
perks.description: Bonuses to guarding with Swords.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡加成。

perks.name: Nova Bomb: Vortex
perks.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
perks.descriptionZh:
向目标抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹可产生一个奇点，将目标拉入其中，并对困在其中的敌人造成持续性伤害。

perks.name: Nova Warp
perks.description:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
perks.descriptionZh:
穿梭于位面之间以颠覆物理定律。

[超能附技能]  ：传送一小段距离并放出削弱追踪弹。

[超能主技能]  ：释放一次致命虚空爆发。完全充能的攻击可对目标施加不稳定效果。

perks.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
perks.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh:
向目标抛出虚空光能爆炸光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

新星炸弹会缓慢移动并追踪目标。发生爆炸时会碎裂成较小的追踪性射弹。

perks.name: Edge of Action
perks.description: Charge weapon to enable special projectile attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能武器来启用特殊射弹攻击。

perks.name: Dealer's Choice
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of Super energy. Equipping multiple weapons from the Pale Heart increases this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可恢复少量超能能量。装备苍白之心的多件武器会增加这一效果。

perks.name: Crucible Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables in the Crucible.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在熔炉竞技场中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Chaos Reach
perks.description:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy. Sustained damage on a single target creates a jolting lightning strike at their position.

 [Super]  while active to deactivate your Super early, saving Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
释放一道由浓缩电弧能量组成的远距离引导光束。对单体目标造成持续伤害可在其位置生成一道震颤闪电打击。激活时

 [超能] 可以提前终止超能，保留部分超能能量。

perks.name: Stormtrance
perks.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
从你的手中释放电弧闪电，用极具破坏力且随着时间增强的电弧光能流来电击目标。施放雷霆万钧会在你脚下产成一道震颤冲击波。

[冲刺]  ：向前传送，消耗少量超能能量。

perks.name: Together Forever
perks.description: Kills with this weapon reload Sturm. Consecutive kills overflow Sturm's magazine with bonus damage rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器击杀可填装狂飙。连续击杀可向狂飙弹匣中多加入具有额外伤害的弹药。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Sniper Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的狙击步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Twintails
perks.description: Double tracking rockets, Void and Solar. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 双发追踪火箭，虚空和烈日。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Echo of Starvation
perks.description: Picking up a Void Breach or an Orb of Power grants Devour.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口或能量球会赋予吞食。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Featherweight
perks.description: Final blows with weapons that have the Featherweight Origin Trait grant further increased movement speed while equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备时，使用有羽量原始特性的武器造成最后一击会进一步提升移动速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves. Shortens delay between activations.
perks.descriptionZh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。减少启动延迟。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高榴弹发射器的收举速度。

perks.name: Reciprocity
perks.description: When healing projectiles from this weapon strike allies, you also receive a small amount of healing.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的治疗射弹击中盟友时，你也会获得少量治疗。

perks.name: Valiant Charge
perks.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 防御时受到伤害会暂时增加刀剑前冲距离。

perks.name: Health Mod
perks.description: Increases the Health stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升生命值属性。

perks.name: Mercy
perks.description: Final loss has been forgiven.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一场失利已被宽恕。

perks.name: Tilting at Windmills
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed for an improved duration while you are shielding.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在更长时间内提高举盾时的移动速度。

perks.name: Faster Cooldown
perks.description: This vehicle has a shorter cooldown between summonings.
perks.descriptionZh: 使两次召唤载具的间隔时间减少。

perks.name: Solar Ammo Generation
perks.description: Increases the ammo generation of Solar weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升烈日武器的弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Harmonic Laser
perks.description: Power levels fluctuate over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 功率级会逐渐波动。

perks.name: MIDA Multi-Tool
perks.description: Boosts movement speed. Radar stays active while aiming.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升移动速度。瞄准时将始终显示雷达。

perks.name: Vex Gate Arrival
perks.description: Adds a circular Vex Gate to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex传送门形态。

perks.name: Up in Smoke
perks.description: Adds fire and smoke to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个烟火余烬形态。

perks.name: Cabal Shield Breaker
perks.description: Adds a Cabal shield to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个卡巴尔护盾形态。

perks.name: Box of Tricks
perks.description: Adds the illusion of a steamer trunk to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蒸汽车行李箱形态。

perks.name: Mercury Scout Reports
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a scout report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Mercury for all members of the fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在水星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Inspiring Presence
perks.description: Increased Vanguard token drops for you and your fireteam in this strike.
perks.descriptionZh: 在此次打击中增加你和你所在火力战队的先锋代币掉落几率。

perks.name: Gambit Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while in Gambit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Energized
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, defeating normal enemies with an Energy weapon boosts Energy weapon damage by 15% for a short time.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你在利维坦上使用能量武器消灭普通敌人时，短时间内能量武器的伤害将提高15%。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Opening Salvo
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range and deals more flinch at the start of combat for an improved duration. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 战斗开始时，此武器会暂时获得射程加成并造成更多的抖动，效果持续时间延长。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: True Sight
perks.description: Opens your mind to the secrets of the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 向幽梦之城的秘密敞开心扉吧。

perks.name: Trickle Charge
perks.description: Receiving or discharging Bolt Charge partially loads an improved quantity of the magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 接收或释放电光充能会从备弹中填装弹匣的一部分，填装量更多。

perks.name: Rites of Ember
perks.description: Improves Scorch, Ignitions, and Daybreak projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 增强灼烧、点燃和黎明射弹。

perks.name: Utility Finisher
perks.description:
Finishers restore class abilities. 

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting additional energy for each charge consumed.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技会恢复职业技能。

消耗3层或更多护甲充能。每消耗一层会提供额外能量。

perks.name: Meager Glimmer Booster
perks.description: Increases Glimmer gains by 5%.
perks.descriptionZh: 微光获取量提高5%。

perks.name: Standard Glimmer Booster
perks.description: Increases Glimmer gains by 10%.
perks.descriptionZh: 微光获取量提高10%。

perks.name: Considerable Glimmer Booster
perks.description: Increases Glimmer gains by 20%.
perks.descriptionZh: 微光获取量提高20%。

perks.name: Prodigious Glimmer Booster
perks.description: Increases Glimmer gains by 35%.
perks.descriptionZh: 微光获取量提高35%。

perks.name: Supercharged Glimmer Booster
perks.description: Increases Glimmer gains by 50%.
perks.descriptionZh: 微光获取量提高50%。

perks.name: Ultimate Glimmer Booster
perks.description: Increases Glimmer gains by 65%.
perks.descriptionZh: 微光获取量提高65%。

perks.name: Special Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对特殊弹药量表的所有计入效果。

perks.name: Adept Mag
perks.description: Greatly increases magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高弹匣容量。

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对一个目标造成元素减益会在较短时间内提升此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度。

perks.name: Victorious Entrance
perks.description: Adds a swirl of team color to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一抹团队色彩。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善斥候步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: To Excess
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon while your Super is full grant a bonus to melee and grenade stat for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能能量全满时使用此武器造成最后一击可在一定时间内提供近战和手雷属性加成。

perks.name: Dark Descent
perks.description: The further a Void orb falls, the more powerful its detonation becomes.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空能量球下落的距离越长，它的爆炸威力就越强大。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Power Grenade Launchers over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的威能榴弹发射器装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Air Assault
perks.description: Final blows grant an improved stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可为空中效率提供更多叠加加成。在空中时最后一击可提供更多层数。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Access Matterspark shortcuts across Kepler.
perks.nameZh: 可使用开普勒各处的物质火花捷径。
perks.description: Access Matterspark shortcuts across Kepler.
perks.descriptionZh: 可使用开普勒各处的物质火花捷径。

perks.name: Cold Efficiency
perks.description: Shattering a frozen target refills this weapon's magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 击碎被冻住的目标会使此武器从备弹中补充弹匣。

perks.name: Ghost Blue
perks.description: Adds a blue Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓝色机灵环。

perks.name: Dragon's Vengeance
perks.description: When an ally dies or you reach critical health, this weapon's magazine refills, and it gains bonus range, charge rate, and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友死亡或你生命危急时，此武器的弹匣会重新填充，并获得额外的射程、充能速度和操控性。

perks.name: Fallen Arrival
perks.description: Adds a Fallen Servitor appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个堕落魔眼外观。

perks.name: Improved Mercury Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版水星缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 第一发弹药的精度和射程提高。

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成近战能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Spark of Strength
perks.description: Spark of Strength
perks.descriptionZh: 力量火花

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药会装填一枚可粘附于各种表面的高爆弹药，命中后不久引爆并施加疲惫。

perks.name: Enhanced Sword Scavenger
perks.description: Swords get larger bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时刀剑获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Rasputin's Arsenal
perks.description: Breaking a target's shield partially reloads this weapon's magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 击破目标的护盾会部分填装此武器的弹匣。

perks.name: High Octane
perks.description: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.
perks.descriptionZh: 点燃附近的目标可部分补充燃料。该武器在获得最大燃料后会从储备中重新填充。

perks.name: Kinetic Siphon
perks.description: Rapid Kinetic weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速动能武器最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Bleak Watcher
perks.description: [Grenade]  : Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：长按将你的手雷转换成一个冰影炮台，向附近的目标发射减速射弹。

perks.name: Spark of Brilliance
perks.description: Defeating a blinded target with precision damage creates a blinding explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 用精准伤害击败一个被致盲的目标会造成一个致盲爆炸。

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.
perks.descriptionZh: 对目标造成持续的动能伤害会发射出一道冲击波，对任何附近的目标造成伤害。特性启动速度更快。

perks.name: Serious Business
perks.description: When this weapon is fully spun up, the flinch from incoming damage is greatly reduced.
perks.descriptionZh: 当枪管完全旋转起来时，来袭伤害产生的抖动大幅减少。

perks.name: Titan Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on the moon of Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 在土卫六上的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Edge of Concurrence
perks.description: Charge weapon to enable special projectile attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能武器来启用特殊射弹攻击。

perks.name: Fail-deadly
perks.description: Dealing damage grants an improved stacking bonus to magazine size, target acquisition, and range until your next final blow with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会为弹匣容量、目标捕获能力和射程提供更多可叠加的加成，直至你下一次使用此武器造成最后一击。

perks.name: Thunderer
perks.description: Significantly increased rate of fire. Defeating targets auto loads from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 显著提高射速。击败目标会从弹药储备中自动填装。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高狙击步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Void Effects
perks.description: Adds Void elements to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加虚空元素。

perks.name: Materialism (Gambit)
perks.description: Gambit wins have a chance to award destination materials.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中取胜有几率奖励目的地材料。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Fusion Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的融合步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Cold Steel
perks.description: Powered Sword hits slow targets. Improves ammo capacity.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能刀剑命中可让目标减速，提高弹药容量。

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 在此武器准备就绪前，使用其他两件武器造成伤害可从弹药储备中填装弹药。

perks.name: Heavy Handed
perks.description: Your powered melee final blows create Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的充能近战最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Transcendent Steel
perks.description: Dealing damage with a Transcendent grenade grants Ergo Sum ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用超凡手雷造成伤害可获得故我在弹药。

perks.name: Light Shift
perks.description: Shift instead of dodge.
perks.descriptionZh: 用位移替换闪身。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Rounds
perks.description: Shield-piercing rounds designed to bypass combatant defenses. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 用于击穿敌方战斗人员防具的护盾穿透子弹。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Torch
perks.description: While radiant, deal increased weapon damage to combatants affected by Strand and Stasis debuffs.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于焕光状态时，对受缚丝和冰影减益影响的战斗人员造成更多武器伤害。

perks.name: Heart of the Flame
perks.description: Casting your Solar Super grants nearby allies radiant and increases the damage of your Super for each nearby ally.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放烈日超能会使附近盟友进入焕光状态，而且附近的盟友越多，超能的伤害就越高。

perks.name: Flint Striker
perks.description: Rapid Solar weapon precision hits and rapid Solar weapon final blows grant Radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速烈日武器精准命中和快速烈日武器最后一击会提供焕光效果。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization II
perks.description:
Improves the benefits provided by the Noble Deeds, Unsated Hunger, Head Rush, and Dragon's Vengeance Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
perks.descriptionZh:
提升高尚事迹、未足之饥、热血上头和龙之复仇原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

perks.name: Wished into Being
perks.description: While your Super is nearly fully-charged, ability final blows spawn Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的超能几乎完全充满时，技能最后一击会生成能量球。

perks.name: Temporal Alignment Refit
perks.description: Overcharging both Arc and Stasis modes grants a period of increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 同时过充电弧与冰影模式可在一段时间内提升伤害。

perks.name: Outreach
perks.description: Reduces melee cooldown when using your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用职业技能时缩短近战技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Adaptive Ordnance
perks.description: Defeating 4 or more combatants in a single volley increases the damage of the next volley and refunds ammunition.
perks.descriptionZh: 一次连射击败4个或以上战斗人员会提升下一次连射的伤害并退返弹药。

perks.name: Moon Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 在月球上获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Echo of Cessation
perks.description:
Finisher final blows create a burst of Void damage that causes nearby combatants to become volatile.

Defeating volatile targets creates a Void Breach.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技最后一击会制造一次虚空伤害爆发，使附近战斗人员获得不稳定效果。

击败不稳定目标会制造一个虚空裂口。

perks.name: Confetti Entrance
perks.description: Adds a cheerful appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个欢快外观。

perks.name: Witchfire Entrance
perks.description: Adds a phantasmagorical appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个幻影外观。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Ranger
perks.description: Grants weapon shield-piercing, bypassing combatant defenses. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 赐予武器 护盾穿透特性，击穿敌人的防御。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Light Conductor
perks.description: Gain Super energy on Linear Fusion Rifle final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 线性融合步枪最后一击获得超能能量。

perks.name: Whisper of Bonds
perks.description: Defeating frozen targets generates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败冻结的目标会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: The Dance
perks.description: Improved Primary weapon performance; final blows refund dodges.
perks.descriptionZh: 改良主武器性能；最后一击返还闪身。

perks.name: Makeshift Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Destabilized Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 20-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测20米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Enhanced Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 50-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测50米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Stable Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 40-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测40米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Perfected Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 75-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测75米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高弹头速度，提升填装速度。

perks.name: Targeting Adjuster
perks.description: This weapon gains better target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器具有更好的目标获取能力。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Elemental Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by picking up an elemental well. If the elemental well's element type matches your subclass element, you gain 2 stacks of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取元素井也会使你充斥光能。如果元素井的元素类型与你的分支职业元素相同，你会获得2层光之充能。

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.
perks.descriptionZh: 在最后一击后填装会获得一段时间的伤害提升。填装前额外造成最后一击会进一步延长伤害提升持续时间。

perks.name: Emperor's Shock
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, your Arc abilities deal 25% more damage.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，你的电弧技能可造成25%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Burst Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has high resistance, but low endurance.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡拥有高抗性和低持久。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 线性融合步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善线性融合步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
perks.description: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Class ▼
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Class ▼

perks.name: Boss Spec
perks.description: Increases damage against bosses and vehicles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高对首领和载具的伤害。

perks.name: High-Impact Frame
perks.description: Long range, slow firing, and high damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 高射程，低射速，高伤害。

perks.name: Arc Scavenger
perks.description: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该电弧武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Adaptive Burst
perks.description: Fires a three-round burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 可进行三发连射。

perks.name: Contending Cascade
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus handling and reload speed based on your longest chain of rapid final blows from any source. After achieving an impressive record, final blows with this weapon create an elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会根据你通过任意来源达成的快速最后一击最高多杀数，获得额外操控性和填装速度。达成高多杀记录后，此武器的最后一击会造成元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Arc/Strand Siphon Combo
perks.description: Combines the Arc and Strand Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将电弧和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Void/Strand Siphon Combo
perks.description: Combines the Void and Strand Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将虚空和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Solar/Strand Siphon Combo
perks.description: Combines the Solar and Strand Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将烈日和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Diviner's Discount
perks.description: All Scavenger mods are discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 所有回收器模组均享有折扣。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization I
perks.description: Greatly improves the benefits provided by the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性提供的增益。

perks.name: Gold Contender's Boon
perks.description:
This buff commemorates a Gold Tier score in the Guardian Games Rushdown activity on Expert mode.

Weapons and abilities empower each other. Defeating combatants with abilities grants increased weapon damage. Defeating combatants with weapons grants increased ability recharge speed.

Empowerment stacks 5 times.

While at maximum empowerment, defeat combatants to gain a boost to mobility, accuracy, handling, and reload.

Active only in Guardian Games Rushdown activities. This buff will expire on weekly reset.
perks.descriptionZh:
此增益用于纪念在专家模式的守护者游戏急速强攻活动的黄金阶得分。

武器与技能可互相赋能。使用技能击败战斗人员可增加武器伤害。使用武器击败战斗人员可提高技能充能速度。

赋能可叠加5次。

当达到最大赋能次数时，击败战斗人员可获得敏捷、精度、操控性和填装的提升。

仅在守护者游戏急速强攻活动中有效。此增益将在周重置时过期。

perks.name: Glaive Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Glaive ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的偃月弹药数量。

perks.name: Target Acquired
perks.description: When Personal Assistant is active, this weapon has better target acquisition and deals significantly more precision damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 当启用私人助手时，此武器拥有更好的目标捕获能力，显著造成更高的精准伤害。

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it more effectively refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
perks.descriptionZh: 射空此武器的弹匣时，会根据命中次数更有效地从储存弹药中填装。

perks.name: Breach Refractor
