perks.description: Grants grenade energy on final blows with shield-piercing weapons or when a member of your fireteam shuts down a Barrier Champion's ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用 护盾穿透 武器打出最后一击或你的火力战队成员终结屏障勇士的技能时获得手雷能量。

perks.name: Winter's Wrath
perks.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一根冰影法杖。当超能激活时：

[超能主技能] ：施放由冰影碎片组成的弹幕，冻结敌人。

[超能附技能] ：施放一个震荡波，粉碎所有被冻结的敌人。

perks.name: Heavy Warlock Armor
perks.description: Improved resilience.
perks.descriptionZh: 更强的韧性。

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器对敌人造成最后一击可提供额外伤害，持续时间延长。此增益生效期间，相同伤害类型的手雷或近战最后一击会大幅提高其伤害输出，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Stat Penalty
perks.description: -10 Intellect
perks.descriptionZh: -10 智慧

perks.name: Darkblade Effects
perks.description: Adds Hive Knight miasma to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加邪魔族骑士瘴气。

perks.name: Eldritch Effects
perks.description: Adds eldritch energy to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加怪异能量。

perks.name: Minotaur Effects
perks.description: Adds Vex Minotaur data to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加Vex米诺陶数据。

perks.name: Loot Chest Effects
perks.description: Adds the illusion of a treasure chest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加宝箱的幻象。

perks.name: Tiger Effects
perks.description: Adds the illusion of a tiger to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加老虎的幻象。

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射精准命中会提供大量拉弓速度加成，效果持续时间延长。更多精准命中可延长持续时间。

perks.name: Thread of Evolution
perks.description: Threadlings travel farther and deal additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 线虫可移动得更远并造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Well-Rested
perks.description:
XP gains increased by 2x for your first {var:429946734} Rewards Pass ranks this week.

XP is primarily earned from completing Orders, finishing Ops, and defeating combatants.
perks.descriptionZh:
你在本周的前{var:429946734}个奖励通票等级所获得的经验值会是常规情况下的2倍。

经验值主要通过完成命令、参与行动及击败战斗人员获取。

perks.name: Returner's Boon
perks.description:
You will earn increased XP while Returner's Boon is active.

Fireteam members who do not have the Boon will be granted the Returner's Blessing buff.
perks.descriptionZh:
回归者恩惠生效时，你获得的经验值将增加。

未持有恩惠的火力战队成员将获得回归者祝福增益。

perks.name: Modularity
perks.description: Achieving victory in ritual activities grants a chance to award an Upgrade Module.
perks.descriptionZh: 在仪式活动中取胜有几率获得一个升级模块。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Trace Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的追踪步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Ember of Searing
perks.description: Defeating scorched targets grants melee energy and creates a Firesprite.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败灼烧的目标可获得近战能量并生成一个焰灵。

perks.name: Skirmisher Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Skirmisher archetype, which has Melee as its primary stat and Weapons as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落突击手框架：近战为主要属性，武器为次要属性。

perks.name: Call to Arms
perks.description: XP gains have increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 经验值获取已提升。

perks.name: Tear
perks.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会使附近目标变得割裂。

perks.name: Weapons Mod
perks.description: Increases the Weapons stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升武器属性。

perks.name: Increased Mobility
perks.description: +20 Mobility
perks.descriptionZh: +20 敏捷

perks.name: Vermin
perks.description: Reloading immediately after a kill grants a brief period of invisibility.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀后立即填装可在短时间内隐身。

perks.name: Treasure Hunter
perks.description: Detects caches within a 50-meter range and increases Glimmer gain.
perks.descriptionZh: 可探测50米范围内的缓存箱并提高微光获取量。

perks.name: Semi-Auto Striker
perks.description: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

perks.name: Refreshing Pickups
perks.description: Picking up a Tangle or Elemental Orb grants energy to your least-powered ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取缠结或元素能量球会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

perks.name: Communal Pickups
perks.description: When an ally destroys or picks up your Tangle or Elemental Orb, the Tangle cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and you gain bonus damage with weapons matching your subclass for 10 seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友摧毁或拾取你的缠结或元素能量球时，缠结冷却减少5秒，你使用与分支职业相匹配的武器会获得额外伤害，持续10秒。

perks.name: Elemental Fury
perks.description: While stunned, Champions take bonus damage from your abilities and Elemental Orb damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于眩晕状态时，勇士会受到来自你技能和元素能量球的额外伤害。

perks.name: Overload Machine Guns
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Machine Gun stuns unshielded combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的机枪不间断开火可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Enhanced Sniper Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型狙击步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善狙击步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Stylostixis
perks.description: Arcane Needle causes suspending detonations.
perks.descriptionZh: 神秘织针会造成悬停爆炸。

perks.name: Finest Matterweave
perks.description:
Defeated bosses have a chance of dropping an Enhancement Core.

Effect lasts until an Enhancement Core is found. Only one Finest Matterweave can be active at a time.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败首领有几率掉落一个强化核心。

效果持续至找到强化核心。同一时间只能激活一个精良物织。

perks.name: Benevolent Overflow
perks.description: While Engulfed in Light, dying or having the Chalice of Light taken from you creates a burst of healing around you. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase the radius and potency of healing.
perks.descriptionZh: 被光能包围时，死亡或被夺走光能圣杯会使你周围爆发出治疗效果。此模组可叠加，以提升治疗的范围和效力。

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 捡取重型弹药会为此武器提供弹药。

perks.name: Fistfuls of Bullets
perks.description: Melee kills overload the magazine to double its capacity.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战击杀多为弹匣添加一倍的弹药。

perks.name: Facet of Command
perks.description:
Freezing or suppressing a target reloads your equipped weapons and increases weapon stability, aim assist, and airborne effectiveness.

Defeating frozen or suppressed targets creates a Stasis Shard or Void Breach.
perks.descriptionZh:
冻结或压制目标会填装你已装备的武器并提升武器稳定性、瞄准辅助和空中效率。

击败被冻结或压制的目标会生成一个冰影碎片或虚空裂口。

perks.name: Rasputin's Arsenal
perks.description: Breaking a target's shield partially reloads this weapon's magazine an improved amount.
perks.descriptionZh: 击破目标的护盾会部分填装此武器的弹匣，填装量提升。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会根据武器伤害类型的分类赋予属性加成。光能元素赋予稳定性和操控性。暗影元素赋予射程和瞄准辅助。处于超凡状态时，这件武器同时获得两类加成。

perks.name: Precision Slug
perks.description: Single-slug precision round.
perks.descriptionZh: 单发精准弹药。

perks.name: Piercing Bowstring
perks.description:
Bows gain shield-piercing arrows, which bypass combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
弓箭射出护盾穿透箭矢，击穿战斗人员的防御。

克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Wealth
perks.description: Increased reputation from match wins on a ticket.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升通过入场券比赛胜场获得的声望。

perks.name: Prize Pursuant
perks.description: Detects caches within a 30-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Loot Seeker
perks.description: Detects caches within a 20-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测20米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Treasure Hunter
perks.description: Detects caches within a 50-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测50米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Cache Finder
perks.description: Detects caches within a 40-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Expert Tracker
perks.description: Detects caches within a 75-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测75米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Full Court
perks.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着射弹在爆炸前飞得越远，造成的爆炸伤害就越高。

perks.name: Spirit of the Necrotic
perks.description: Melee hits inflict potent corruption.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战命中会施加强效腐化。

perks.name: Spirit of Osmiomancy
perks.description: Improves grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升手雷。

perks.name: Spirit of Harmony
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会提供超能能量。

perks.name: Spirit of the Filaments
perks.description: Empowering Rifts grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 强能裂痕会赋予你吞食效果。吞食生效时击败目标会提供职业技能能量。

perks.name: Spirit of the Stag
perks.description: Rifts provides damage reduction.
perks.descriptionZh: 裂痕会提供伤害减免。

perks.name: Spirit of Starfire
perks.description: Empowered weapon damage recharges grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 赋能武器伤害为手雷充能。

perks.name: Spirit of Apotheosis
perks.description: Gain melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能结束后获得近战和手雷回复。

perks.name: Spirit of Vesper
perks.description: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves.
perks.descriptionZh: 裂痕定期释放电弧冲击波。

perks.name: Spirit of the Swarm
perks.description: Tangles spawn Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh: 缠结会生成线虫。

perks.name: Spirit of the Claw
perks.description: Gain an additional melee charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得额外一次近战充能。

perks.name: Harsh Refraction
perks.description: Trace Rifles do more damage to targets afflicted by elemental debuffs matching their element type.
perks.descriptionZh: 追踪步枪对受到与其元素类型相匹配的元素减益影响的目标造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Gold from Lead
perks.description: Picking up Special ammo has the chance to grant Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊弹药有机会获得重型弹药。

perks.name: Horde Shuttle
perks.description: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a Threadling. Threadlings sever targets that they damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。线虫会对其伤害到的目标施加割裂。

perks.name: No Bell
perks.description: Rapid Glaive melee final blows grant Special ammo Glaives additional ammo. Blocking damage with Glaives increases their melee damage to targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速偃月近战最后一击会为特殊弹药偃月提供额外弹药。用偃月阻挡伤害会增加它们对目标的近战伤害。

perks.name: Maligned Harvest
perks.description: Rapidly applying Volatile causes your next instance of [Void]Void weapon damage to create a weakening burst. Applying Weaken provides a small Void Overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速施加不稳定会使你的下一次虚空武器伤害产生削弱爆发。施加削弱会提供少量虚空覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Flashover
perks.description: When you gain maximum Bolt Charge, you also become amplified. Lightning bolts deal more damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得最大电光充能时，你也会获得增幅。闪电造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Dreadful Finisher
perks.description: Defeating powerful combatants with your finisher spawns Special ammo for you and your allies; defeated Subjugators, Tormentors, or Champions spawn more ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技击败强力战斗人员会为你和你的盟友生成特殊弹药；击败镇压者、折磨者或勇士会生成更多弹药。

perks.name: Thermal Overload
perks.description:
Solar and Stasis grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日和冰影手雷会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: LN2 Burst
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap fire mode.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]：切换开火模式。

perks.name: Filled Determination
perks.description: Fully charged shots over-penetrate weaker combatants and cause a delayed Solar detonation with a brief scorching field.
perks.descriptionZh: 完全充能的射击可穿透较弱的战斗人员，并造成延迟烈日引爆，产生一个短暂的灼烧场。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Seeker of Brilliance
perks.description: In addition to their normal rewards, encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" can award Bright Engrams.
perks.descriptionZh: 除一般奖励外，“利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战还将奖励光明记忆水晶。

perks.name: Facet of Ruin
perks.description: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你击碎一个冰影水晶或被冻结的目标时，提升爆发的规模和伤害，并扩大烈日点燃的效果范围。

perks.name: Overload Submachine Gun
perks.description: Landing consecutive hits with any Submachine Gun you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Submachine Guns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用任意微型冲锋枪连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间微型冲锋枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Pulse Rifle
perks.description: Aiming down the sights of a Pulse Rifle for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 脉冲步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Scout Rifle
perks.description: Scout Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你使用的斥候步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Melee
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your melee are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响近战所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Grenades
perks.description: The armor energy costs of all armor mods affecting your grenades are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 影响手雷的所有护甲模组的护甲能量花费均享有大量折扣。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Shotgun
perks.description: Shotguns you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Shotguns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你使用的霰弹枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间霰弹枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Breechloaded Grenade Launcher
perks.nameZh: 过载后膛填装榴弹发射器
perks.description: Damaging a combatant with Primary or Special ammo Grenade Launchers disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Primary and Special ammo Grenade Launchers are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主武器或特殊弹药榴弹发射器对战斗人员造成伤害可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间主武器和特殊弹药榴弹发射器将始终过充。

perks.name: Paracausal Fluid
perks.description: Gain improved bonus handling and mobility when damaging targets with this weapon. Swords gain increased charge rate while this perk is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器对目标造成伤害会额外提升操控性和敏捷。此特性生效时刀剑可获得更高充能速度。

perks.name: Flutterby Entrance
perks.description: Adds a fluttering appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个飞舞外观。

perks.name: Excalibur Entrance
perks.description: Adds a bladed appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个刀锋外观。

perks.name: Bad Dreams
perks.description: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 对受到分支职业减益影响的目标造成最后一击有递增的几率生成能量球。

perks.name: Dream-Devourer
perks.description: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员施展终结技可提供吞食。拥有吞食时，获得对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Winterized Gear
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，此武器的稳定性、填装速度和操控性获得提升。这些加成会在你重新进入战斗后逐渐衰减。

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a very short period of time reduces flinch.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器进行极短时间的瞄准可减少抖动。

perks.name: Echo of Undermining
perks.description: Your Void grenades weaken targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的虚空手雷会削弱目标。

perks.name: Missile Tracers
perks.description: Land multiple hits to fire homing micro-missiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成多次命中来发射制导微型导弹。

perks.name: Refined Soul
perks.description: Grants bonus range and stability. Dealing a final blow or absorbing a Remnant grants additional increased weapon range, as well as increased mobility and handling for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 提供额外射程和稳定性。造成最后一击或吸收残余会提供额外的武器射程，并在短时间内提升敏捷和操控性。

perks.name: Into the Light
perks.description: Your grenades recharge quicker and deal more damage when you are not under the effects of Pervading Darkness.
perks.descriptionZh: 不在弥漫暗影效果下时，手雷的充能速度更快并且造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Balanced Tuning
perks.description: Slightly increases the three lowest stats on this armor at no cost.
perks.descriptionZh: 免费对此护甲的三个最低属性进行小幅提升。

perks.name: Actual Grandeur
perks.description: Casting Nova Bomb grants a free cast of a Nova Bomb: Lance.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放新星炸弹时获得一次免费施放新星炸弹：长矛的机会。

perks.name: Conduction Tines
perks.description: Arc ability or Jolt final blows restore ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧技能或震颤最后一击可恢复技能能量。

perks.name: Cerebral Uplink
perks.description: Marks priority targets and buffs ability regen.
perks.descriptionZh: 标记首要目标，加快技能充能速度。

perks.name: Abyssal Extractors
perks.description: Void kills increase ability regen.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空击杀提高技能充能速度。

perks.name: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
perks.description: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Melee ▼

perks.name: Stacks on Stacks
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants you 1 additional stack of Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取一个能量球会赋予1层额外的护甲充能。

perks.name: Charge Shot
perks.description: Hold down the trigger to charge up a tracking shot that explodes and burns on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 按住扳机充能成为一次追踪射击，可在击中目标时爆炸并燃烧。

perks.name: Vex Arrival
perks.description: Adds a Vex storm appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex风暴外观。

perks.name: Suspending Blast
perks.description: Detonating a large number of rounds embedded in a single target suspends them.
perks.descriptionZh: 引爆单个目标体内大量嵌入的弹药会施加悬停。

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的每次最后一击都会造成一次更强的元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Vitreous Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Vex Glass appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex玻璃外观。

perks.name: Harpy Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Harpy appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个机甲女妖外观。

perks.name: Shock Blast
perks.description: Fires high-damage Arc blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射高伤害电弧冲击。

perks.name: Dornröschen
perks.description: Laser overpenetrates and refracts.
perks.descriptionZh: 激光可穿射敌人并在击中坚硬表面时折射。

perks.name: Silver Beam
perks.description: Adds a silver beam to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束银色光束。

perks.name: Melee Wellmaker
perks.description: Powered melee combatant final blows spawn elemental wells matching your subclass energy type.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战造成的战斗人员最后一击会生成与你的分支职业能量类型匹配的元素井。

perks.name: Overload Pulse Rifle
perks.description: Sustained fire from Pulse Rifles disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 脉冲步枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Auto Rifle
perks.description: Sustained fire from Auto Rifles disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 自动步枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sidearms
perks.description: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Bow
perks.description: Holding a Bow fully drawn for a short time loads powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Bows are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 完全开弓一小段时间可装填强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间弓箭将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perks.description: Your equipped Hand Cannons fire staggering rounds and stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手炮可发射眩晕子弹并眩晕势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

perks.name: Panoptic Tessellation
perks.description: Deploying a Guidance Ring or striking a target with a seeking projectile improves draw time, hip-fire accuracy, and reload speed for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 部署指引光环或用追踪射弹击中目标会在一定时间内强化拉弓时间、腰射精度和填装速度。

perks.name: Focusing Strike
perks.description: Grants class ability energy when you cause damage with a powered melee attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用充能近战攻击造成伤害时获得职业技能能量。

perks.name: Webcatcher
perks.description: Threaded Spike detonates Tangles and pulls them toward you.
perks.descriptionZh: 线织尖刺会引爆缠结并将其拉向你。

perks.name: Intellect Armorer
perks.description: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Intellect, and are more likely to drop with higher Intellect.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点智慧，且很可能掉落时带有更多的智慧。

perks.name: Timelost Magazine
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus Super energy. When your Super expires, this weapon's magazine size is doubled for a long duration and reloads from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会获得额外的超能能量。你的超能结束时，此武器的弹匣容量在较长持续时间内翻倍，并从弹药储备中填装。

perks.name: Strand Soldier
perks.description: Your Strand weapons gain Unraveling Rounds whenever you gain Woven Mail while your Strand or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备缚丝或棱镜分支职业时，每当你获得织造铠甲时你的缚丝武器都可获得瓦解弹药。

perks.name: Protective Breach
perks.description: Picking up a Void Breach gives you an overshield or refreshes your existing overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你获得一个覆盖护盾或刷新你现有的覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Origin Hones
perks.description: Weapons with the Unsated Hunger, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Harmonic Resonance, and Noble Deeds traits are always overcharged weapons for you when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 带有未足之饥、纳米技术追踪火箭、和谐回声和高尚事迹特性的武器在该修改器激活时将始终过充。

perks.name: Amplified Shielding
perks.description: Gain damage resistance while amplified.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于增幅时获得伤害抗性。

perks.name: Counter Charge
perks.description: Gain a stack of Armor Charge when you stun a Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你眩晕一名勇士时，可获得一层护甲充能。

perks.name: Cryoclasm
perks.description: Shattering a frozen target spawns seekers that track and freeze other nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 击碎一个被冻结的目标会生成追踪弹，追踪并冻结附近的其他目标。

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器摧毁冰影水晶或击败被冻结的目标可获得更多的冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Destabilizers
perks.description: [Brake]  : Use while airborne to release roll stabilizers, and move [Movement] to roll.
perks.descriptionZh: [刹车]  ：在空中使用以松开翻滚稳定装置，使用[移动]进行翻滚。

perks.name: Quick Access Sling
perks.description: Increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高此武器的准备和收起速度。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Grenade Launcher ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的榴弹发射器弹药数量。

perks.name: Spark of Recovery
perks.description: Spark of Recovery
perks.descriptionZh: 恢复火花

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Void
perks.description: While using a Void subclass, Void weapon final blows have a chance to spawn a Void Elemental Orb. Void Orbs can be thrown to create a Void explosion that makes enemies it damages volatile.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空分支职业时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空元素能量球。虚空能量球可被投掷出去造成一次虚空爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加不稳定效果。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization II
perks.description: Weapons with the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 在该修改器生效时，带有热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性的武器将始终过充。

perks.name: Thanatotic Tangles
perks.description: Strand weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Tangle.
perks.descriptionZh: 缚丝武器最后一击有几率生成一个缠结。

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Solar
perks.description: While using a Solar subclass, Solar weapon final blows have a chance to spawn a Solar Elemental Orb. Solar Orbs can be thrown to create a Solar explosion that scorches targets it damages.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日分支职业时，烈日武器最后一击有几率生成一个烈日元素能量球。烈日能量球可被投掷出去造成一次烈日爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加灼烧效果。

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
perks.description: While using an Arc subclass, Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用电弧分支职业时，电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.description: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕一名勇士可装填弹匣，触发生命值回复并在短时间内提高恢复效果。

perks.name: Move to Survive
perks.description: Grants airborne movement and improves Blink.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得空中移动并强化瞬移。

perks.name: Unflinching Kinetic Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Kinetic weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低用动能武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.description: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续按住扳机可提升命中率和稳定性。

perks.name: +10 Melee ▲
perks.description: +10 Melee ▲

perks.name: Large Arms Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of ammo you can carry for Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, Machine Guns, and Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高你可以携带的火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、机枪和霰弹枪的弹药数量。

perks.name: Shotgun Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding ammo while you have a Shotgun equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备霰弹枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Improved timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.
perks.descriptionZh: 多次同时造成最后一击会积累可叠加的伤害增益。持续时间更长的计时器在下次武器射击时开始；造成最后一击会延长此计时器。

perks.name: Knockout
perks.description:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
perks.descriptionZh:
重伤目标或打破其护盾可在短时间内给你的近战攻击赋予电弧能量，增加你对战斗人员的近战范围和对战斗人员及守护者的近战伤害。

用近战攻击打败目标会使你进入增幅状态，并恢复一部分生命值。击败强力战斗人员会恢复更多生命值。

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准可提升身体射击伤害，减少目标捕获能力。

perks.name: Controlled Demolition
perks.description: Hitting a target with a Void ability or Volatile explosion makes them volatile. Further damage to a volatile target causes them to explode. Grants you and nearby allies health when volatile targets explode near you.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空技能或不稳定爆炸击中目标会使其不稳定。对不稳定的目标造成进一步的伤害会使其爆炸。不稳定的目标在你附近爆炸时向你和附近的盟友提供生命值。

perks.name: Auto Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高自动步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Elemental Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by picking up an elemental well. If the elemental well's element type matches your subclass element, you gain 2 stacks of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取元素井也会使你充斥光能。如果元素井的元素类型与你的分支职业元素相同，你会获得2层光之充能。

perks.name: Rat Pack
perks.description: Fires full auto. Nearby Rat Kings increase strength.
perks.descriptionZh: 全自动射击。提高附近鼠王的力量。

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid final blow with this weapon progressively increases reload speed substantially for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的每个快速最后一击将在短时间内累积大幅增加填装速度。

perks.name: Arc Weapon Analyzer
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Arc weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在电弧武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Psionic Forging I
perks.description: Increases the duration of the Psychohack Origin Trait and the effect of the Suros Synergy Origin Trait.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加“心灵骇入”原始特性的持续时间，并强化“Suros协同”原始特性的效果。

perks.name: Psionic Forging II
perks.description: Increases the duration of the Land Tank Origin Trait and the effect of the Häkke Breach Armaments Origin Trait.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加“陆地坦克”原始特性的持续时间，并强化“Häkke突入武装”原始特性的效果。

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会提供可叠加的额外伤害。从高处攻击目标可立即获得最大层数。

perks.name: Valiant Charge
perks.description: Receiving damage while guarding temporarily increases Sword lunge distance for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 前冲距离时受到伤害会暂时增加刀剑前冲距离，持续时间更长。

perks.name: Sniper Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming damage from combatants that are at long range.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自远距离敌人的伤害。

perks.name: XP Boost
perks.description: Increases experience gains for your Subclass, Weapons, and Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高分支职业、武器和护甲的经验值获取。

perks.name: Facet of Awakening
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets with Light or Darkness damage or Super final blows generates an Elemental pickup of the matching damage type.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用光能或暗影伤害或超能最后一击快速击败目标，会生成一个匹配该伤害类型的元素拾取物。

perks.name: Vanguard Scanner
perks.description: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables in Vanguard Ops.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在先锋行动中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Frostpulse
perks.description:
Casting your Rift generates a shockwave that freezes nearby targets, granting you Frost Armor when it does so.

Freezing combatants generates class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
施放裂痕会产生震荡波，冻结附近的目标，如冻结目标则为你提供冰霜护甲。

冻结战斗人员会生成职业技能能量。

perks.name: Surprise Attack
perks.description: While Charged with Light, reloading or readying a Sidearm will consume all stacks of Charged with Light and convert them into stacks of a major damage buff, which are depleted as you damage combatants with that Sidearm.
perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，填装或就绪手枪将消耗全部光之充能层数并将其转换为高额伤害加成，此加成将随着你使用该手枪对战斗人员造成伤害而衰减。

perks.name: Tear
perks.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed. Cooldown between activations reduced.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会使附近目标变得割裂。减少启动冷却时间。

perks.name: Void Flux
perks.description:
Defeating weakened targets with a [Void] Void weapon applies Volatile to nearby targets.
Powerful targets increase the radius of the explosion.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空武器击败被削弱的目标会对附近目标施加不稳定。
强力目标增加爆炸半径。

perks.name: Defibrillating Blast
perks.description: Stunning a Champion grants maximum stacks of Bolt Charge. Damaging targets with Bolt Charge bolts jolts them and heals you.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士会提供最大层数的电光充能。用电光充能的弩弹对目标造成伤害会震颤他们并治疗你自己。

perks.name: To Shreds
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage to severed targets unravels them. Defeating a severed target creates a hotspot of Strand energy, granting Woven Mail to nearby allies for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对被割裂的目标造成持续伤害会瓦解它们。击败被割裂的目标会生成一个缚丝能量热点，为附近的盟友在短时间内提供织造铠甲。

perks.name: Limit Break
perks.description: Casting a Super while you are critically wounded or have a elemental buff matching your Super element grants a period of increased Super damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 重伤或拥有与超能元素相匹配的元素增益时施放超能，会在一段时间内提升超能伤害。

perks.name: Particle Reconstruction
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage with Fusion Rifles or Linear Fusion Rifles partially refills the magazine from reserves and grants them bonus damage for a short duration against that target.
perks.descriptionZh: 用融合步枪或线性融合步枪造成持续伤害会从弹药储备中部分填充弹匣，并在短时间内对该目标造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Heavy Ordnance Regeneration
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage to targets with a Heavy Machine Gun or Rocket Launcher grants damage resistance and increases grenade and melee regeneration for a short duration. While active, defeating powerful combatants disorients nearby rank-and-file combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用重型机枪或火箭发射器对目标造成持续伤害会获得伤害抗性，并在短时间内增加手雷和近战回复。生效期间击败强力战斗人员会使附近的普通战斗人员迷失方向。

perks.name: Elemental Supercharger
perks.description:
Defeating exhausted or severed targets with weapons that match your Super element grants Super energy.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用与超能元素匹配的武器击败疲惫或割裂的目标会获得超能能量。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Recombination
perks.description: Elemental final blows increase the damage of this weapon's next shot.
perks.descriptionZh: 元素最后一击会提升此武器的下一击伤害。

perks.name: Bow Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Bow ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的弓箭弹药数量。

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.description: Reloading grants this weapon improved bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装可在短时间内为此武器提供更高的操控性并减少受到伤害时的抖动。

perks.name: Bow Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弓箭的收举速度。

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants Sword ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: [轻攻击]  ：短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供刀剑的弹药，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Sentry +2
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Sentry +1
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Sentry +3
perks.description: Equip multiple pieces from this set to unlock Gambit Prime set perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备多件此套装中的护甲以解锁全盛智谋套装特性。

perks.name: Kinetic Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善动能武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Dimensional Shift
perks.description: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a Void Overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集虚空裂口会使最后一击提供虚空覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Energy Transfer
perks.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy at an improved rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 在受到伤害时进行防御可生成职业技能能量，生成速度提高。

perks.name: Strange Signal
perks.description: The Vex were responding to a strange signal coming from Nexus…
perks.descriptionZh: Vex在对一个来自枢纽的奇怪信号作出回应……

perks.name: Bow Reloader
perks.description: Increases the nocking speed of arrows.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弓箭的搭弦速度。

perks.name: Accelerator: Better with Friends
perks.description: Playing Ops activities in a fireteam increases your damage; playing with a clanmate further increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 火力战队玩行动活动可以增加你的伤害；与公会成员一起可以进一步提升此效果。

perks.name: High-Energy Fire
perks.description: While Charged with Light, gain a bonus to weapon damage. Each defeated combatant consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 当充斥光能的时候，获得额外武器伤害。每个被击败的战斗人员消耗一层光之充能。

perks.name: Empowered Finish
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by finishing a combatant, consuming one-tenth of your Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 消耗十分之一的超能能量，终结敌方战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Shield Break Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by breaking a combatant shield with the matching energy type.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过以对应属性击破战斗人员的护盾来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Taking Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by picking up Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球以变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Drengr's Lash
perks.description:
Activate Thruster to create an unstable knot of [Strand] Strand matter that detonates after a short delay, suspending and damaging targets.

Final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs grant Thruster energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
启动推进器来生成一个不稳定的缚丝物质绳结，可在短暂延迟后引爆，悬停目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到元素减益影响的目标造成最后一击会提供悬停能量。

perks.name: Veteran's Wisdom
perks.description: Rapid or precision final blows release a larger Kinetic shockwave that exhausts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速或精准最后一击会释放范围更大的动能冲击波，使目标疲惫。

perks.name: Cold Steel
perks.description: Powered Sword hits slow targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能刀剑命中可让目标减速。

perks.name: Transcendent Duelist
perks.description:
This weapon collects less ammo. Final blows with this weapon accelerate Light and Darkness mastery.
Deals increased damage while Transcendent; defeating targets lengthens Transcendence.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器收集的弹药较少。使用此武器造成最后一击可加速光能与暗影的掌控。
超凡状态下造成的伤害增加；击败目标可延长超凡状态。

perks.name: Air Control
perks.description: This vehicle gains increased agility while airborne.
perks.descriptionZh: 使载具在空中时灵活性增强。

perks.name: Piled High
perks.description: Adds a gift pile appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个礼物堆外观。

perks.name: Noble Rounds
perks.description: Absorbing Remnants allows you to fire ally-seeking Noble Rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 吸收遗灵允许你发射寻找盟友的高尚弹药。

perks.name: Crow's Wings
perks.description: [Heavy Attack]  : Fire a projectile.
perks.descriptionZh: [重攻击]  ：发射一枚射弹。

perks.name: Soulsknot
perks.description: Adds a ribbon of spectral energy to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个鬼灵能量色带。

perks.name: Arachnophile
perks.description: Adds a nest of spiders to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送特效添加一个蛛网效果。

perks.name: Bolt Thrower
perks.description: High power explosive bolts.
perks.descriptionZh: 高威力爆炸光弹。

perks.name: Evolution
perks.description:
Transmutation spheres you create can be picked up and wielded as weapons by you or your allies.
• [Light Attack]  : Light attack
• [Heavy Attack]  : Suppressing heavy attack
• [Block]  : Guard/drain nearby targets
perks.descriptionZh:
你制造的蜕变圆球可以被你和你的盟友拾取并作为武器使用。
• [轻攻击]  ：轻攻击
• [重攻击]  ：压制重攻击
• [格挡]  ：防御/吸取附近的目标

perks.name: Iron Grip
perks.description: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of a reduced amount of reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 以牺牲较少量填装速度为代价，大幅提升武器的稳定性。

perks.name: Feed the Void
perks.description:
Defeat a target with a Void ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空技能击败目标来启动吞食。

你的吞食效果获得改善，恢复额外生命值和手雷能量。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射精准的远程能量光束。

perks.name: -5 Weapon ▼
perks.description: -5 Weapon ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -5 武器 ▼

perks.name: Subjugation
perks.description:
Weapon adapts to targets. When dealing damage:

• To weak targets: shots create an improved explosion
• To strong targets: targets become exhausted
• To Guardians: the weapon's flinch resistance increases for an improved duration

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
武器可自适应目标。造成伤害时：

• 较弱目标：子弹产生强化爆炸
• 较强目标：使目标变得疲惫
• 守护者：武器的抖动抗性在更长时间内提升

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Crucible Effects
perks.description: Adds a Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个熔炉纹章。

perks.name: Strength of Rasputin
perks.description: Collecting a Warmind Cell grants you melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集战争思维电池会为你提供近战能量。

perks.name: Modular Lightning
perks.description: Collecting a Warmind Cell creates a burst of chaining Arc energy around you.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集战争思维电池会在你周围制造一股连锁电弧能量。

perks.name: Chosen of the Warmind
perks.description: Collecting or destroying a Warmind Cell creates a concussive blast that pushes enemies away.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集或摧毁一个战争思维电池会制造一场击退敌人的震荡冲击波。

perks.name: Sheltering Energy
perks.description: Collecting a Warmind Cell grants you an overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集战争思维电池会为你提供覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Heretical Behavior
perks.description: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants. Gain this bonus immediately for a longer duration when you are revived.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力目标造成持续武器伤害或最后一击会为此武器提供额外的填装、操控性以及对战斗人员的伤害。当你被复活时，立即获得此增益，且持续时间更长。

perks.name: Concentrated Mattergem
perks.description:
Bosses have a chance to drop an Upgrade Module when defeated.

Effect lasts until an Upgrade Module is found. Only one Concentrated Mattergem can be active at a time.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败首领有几率掉落一个升级模块。

效果持续至一个升级模块掉落。浓缩物质精粹一次只能激活一个。

perks.name: Bandolier
perks.description: Grants slightly increased ammo generation and magazine size.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅提升弹药生成速度和弹匣容量。

perks.name: The Whispers
perks.description: Gain an additional melee charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得额外一次近战攻击。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高微型冲锋枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Close Enough
perks.description: Extended and more frequent Chaos Reach .
perks.descriptionZh: 延长和增加混沌之触的频率。

perks.name: Inspiring Presence
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has a high Nightfall score in this strike, which grants increased Vanguard token drops for the entire fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队中的一名成员在此次打击中获得了非常高的日落分数，使全部火力战队成员的先锋代币掉落几率增加。

perks.name: Invader Synth
perks.description: Armor Set—Invader +3
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲套装——入侵者+3

perks.name: Fists of Havoc
perks.description:
Supercharge your fists and slam the ground with the force of a maelstrom. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Quickly dash forward, dealing damage to any impacted targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your fists to the ground, blinding targets and dealing damage in an area around you, leaving aftershocks in your wake. Performing a slam from the air or after a dash deals additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
对双拳进行超级充能，使用漩涡之力猛击地面。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：快速向前冲刺，对任何被撞到的目标造成伤害。

[重攻击]  ：用双拳猛砸地面，致盲目标，对你周围造成伤害并产生余震。从空中砸向地面或冲刺后可造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Thundercrash
perks.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中并撞进目标群中，造成流星伤害。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Bow Aim
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低弓瞄时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Crucible Blue
perks.description: Adds a blue Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓝色熔炉纹章。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Kintsugi
perks.description: Revives grant overshields.
perks.descriptionZh: 复活会生成覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.description: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器对敌人造成伤害有较小几率填装弹匣并提高瞄准时的移速。此特性生效时弓箭可获得更快的拉弓速度，而刀剑可获得更快的充能速度。

perks.name: Barrel Constrictor
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会在短时间内降低其弹道分布。

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

perks.name: Perpetual Destruction
perks.description: Rapid final blows with non-Exotic Rocket Launchers refund ammo and increase reload speed for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用非异域火箭发射器造成快速最后一击，会返还弹药并在短时间内提升填装速度。

perks.name: Elemental Siphon
perks.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super. Elemental pickups grant matching Super energy when they are collected.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。收集元素拾取物时会获得匹配的超能能量。

perks.name: Photonic Flare
perks.description:
Defeating an exhausted or severed target with [Arc]Arc damage releases a blinding burst.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧伤害击败疲惫或割裂的目标会释放致盲爆发。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Disruptor Spike
perks.description:
Improves the effects of Exhaust and Sever, lowering a target's damage output even further.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
提升疲惫和割裂的效果，进一步降低目标的伤害输出。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: King's Vestige
perks.description:
Defeating powerful Taken loads your weapon with Taken energy. The next time you fire, launch 3 Taken seeker rounds that [Disruption] disrupt and exhaust targets.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败强力傀儡军团会为你的武器注入傀儡能量。下次开火时，发射3发可对目标施加扰乱和疲惫的傀儡追踪弹。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Dielectric
perks.description:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

perks.name: Hold the Line
perks.description: While surrounded, Machine Guns and Glaives gain increased reload speed and stability; final blows heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 被包围时，机枪和偃月获得更高的填装速度和稳定性；最后一击会治疗你。

perks.name: Lucent Shrieker Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Lucent Hive Shrieker to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个光明邪魔族死灵。

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成击杀会产生技能能量。此能量会平分至你未充能完毕的技能。

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击或使用此武器快速击败目标，会在目标的位置生成一个线虫。有几率生成更多线虫。

perks.name: Adept Blast Radius
perks.description: +10 Blast Radius
perks.descriptionZh: +10爆炸范围

perks.name: Strike Paragon
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Fireteam Medallion, granting all members of the fireteam increased XP gains and loot from strike completion.
perks.descriptionZh: 火力战队的一名成员使用了火力战队大勋章，将增加小组所有成员在打击中获得的经验值和战利品。

perks.name: Splicer Surge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after dealing damage grants the weapon a stacking reload speed and handling bonus until stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害后填装此武器，可为其叠加填装速度并提供操控性加成，直到收起武器。

perks.name: Shooting Star
perks.description: Celebrate your achievements with style and alacrity!
perks.descriptionZh: 时尚而轻快地庆祝你的成就吧！

perks.name: Daybreak
perks.description:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.
perks.descriptionZh:
将烈日之光化作利刃，从空中轰击敌人。

你的黎明射弹在命中时会灼烧目标。

perks.name: Well of Radiance
perks.description: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
perks.descriptionZh: 将你的刀剑刺入地面，对附近目标造成伤害和灼烧效果。刀剑会发出持续的光环，为附近盟友提供焕光和恢复效果，使其免受冰影效果的影响。

perks.name: Song of Flame
perks.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
释放你的内心炽焰，让你装备的武器进入焕光状态并强化你的技能。

[近战]  ：释放一记发射额外射弹的超级充能近战攻击。

[手雷]  ：创造一股灵性的烈焰火苗，自动追踪目标并造成一次灼烧爆炸，然后追踪附近的其他目标。

在烈焰之歌生效时，你和附近的盟友技能回复更快，且对伤害的抗性增加。你的烈日和动能武器会灼烧目标。

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次精准射击命中后蓄力时间缩短。

perks.name: Glacial Quake
perks.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一个冰影臂铠。当超能激活时：

[重攻击] ：用臂铠猛击地面，制造一次震荡波，冻结目标并射出冰影水晶来冻结其他敌人。

[轻攻击] ：对你的战栗打击进行超级充能以获得伤害加成。冲刺穿过冰影水晶或被冻结的目标会立即将其粉碎。

perks.name: Anomalous Archaeologist
perks.description: Grants a chance to receive additional Etheric and Baryon resources when collecting them in the Reef.
perks.descriptionZh: 当在暗礁中收集乙太和重子资源时，有机会获得更多。

perks.name: Arc Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Auto Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Auto Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时自动步枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Embers of Light
perks.description: Create combination Healing/Empowering Rifts.
perks.descriptionZh: 创造出治愈/强能裂痕的组合。

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 对目标造成持续的动能伤害会发射出一道冲击波，对任何附近的目标造成伤害。

perks.name: Heavy Metal
perks.description: While holding down the trigger, every fourth bullet becomes a heavy projectile that makes targets volatile on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 按住扳机时，每四发子弹中有一发会变成重型射弹，命中时对目标施加不稳定效果。

perks.name: Overcharged Armory
perks.description: Weapons with the Dealer's Choice, Radiolaria Transposer, Collective Purpose, and Sundering Origin traits are always Overcharged weapons for you when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 带有庄家之选、活性放射体液转换器、集体使命和分离原始特性的武器在该修改器生效时将始终过充。

perks.name: Authorized Mod: Elemental Charge
perks.description: The energy cost of Elemental Charge mods are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 元素充能模组的能量花费大幅减少。

perks.name: Logic Reductor
perks.description: Weapons with the Radiolaria Transposer origin perk deal increased damage to Vex. Extends the duration of the radiolaria pools created by Radiolaria Transposer.
perks.descriptionZh: 带有活性放射体液转换器原始特性的武器会对Vex造成更高伤害。延长由活性放射体液转换器生成的活性放射体液池的持续时间。

perks.name: Authorized Mods: Scavenger
perks.description: The energy cost of Scavenger mods are significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 回收器模组的能量花费大幅减少。

perks.name: Authorized Mod: Charged Up
perks.description: The energy cost of the Charged Up mod is significantly discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 完全充能模组的能量花费大幅减少。

perks.name: Saint's Inspiration
perks.description: Rounds loaded by the Cast No Shadows origin perk can overflow the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 由光照无影原始特性填装的弹药会溢出弹匣。

perks.name: Winning Hand
perks.description:
While using weapons with the Dealer's Choice origin trait, combatant precision final blows or rapidly defeating combatants cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby combatants.

Having several equipped weapons with the Dealer's Choice origin trait increases the effect of the explosion.
perks.descriptionZh:
在使用带有庄家之选原始特性的武器时，战斗人员精准最后一击或快速击败战斗人员会让目标爆炸，对附近战斗人员造成烈日伤害。

装备多件带有庄家之选原始特性的武器可提升爆炸效果。

perks.name: Heating Up
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高精度和稳定性，同时改善垂直后坐力。

perks.name: Replenishing Guard
perks.description: Greatly increases the charge rate for your equipped Swords.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升你装备的刀剑的充能速度。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Demolitionist Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Demolitionist archetype, which has Grenade as its primary stat and Class as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落爆破专家框架：手雷为主要属性，职业为次要属性。

perks.name: Harmonic Siphon
perks.description: Rapid weapon final blows with damage matching your subclass type create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用伤害匹配你的分支职业类型的武器达成快速最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: The Corruption Spreads
perks.description: This weapon creates SIVA nanite swarms on rapid hits and precision kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器会在快速命中和精准击杀时产生湿婆纳米蜂群。

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准击杀可产生元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Unflinching Light Arms Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sidearms, Hand Cannons, Bows, and Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用手枪、手炮、弓箭和微型冲锋枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: On Black Wings
perks.description: Landing the majority of the pellets in a spread or pellet final blows, grants stacking precision damage and a reload speed buff. Precision hits with slugs extend the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 用弹片造成最后一击可获得可叠加的精准伤害和填装速度加成。用弹丸造成精准命中可延长持续时间。

perks.name: Minor Grenade Mod
perks.description: Increases the Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升手雷属性。

perks.name: Unflinching Arc Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming an Arc weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低用电弧武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Moon Cache Detector
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 在月球上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: +3 Super ▲
perks.description: +3 Super ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +3 超能 ▲

perks.name: +5 Super ▲
perks.description: +5 Super ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 超能 ▲

perks.name: Stasis Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Stasis weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高冰影武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Daito Capsule Entrance
perks.description: Adds a high-tech capsule to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个高科技胶囊效果。

perks.name: Champion Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Champion wreath to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个勇士花环。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.description: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.
perks.descriptionZh: 蹲伏射击时可提高精度、稳定性和操控性。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Pulse Rifle
perks.description:
Pulse Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Pulse Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的脉冲步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

脉冲步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Unstoppable Bow
perks.description: Crossbows, and Bows that have been fully drawn for a short time, fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 十字弓和弓箭完全开弓一小段时间后会发射一枚高爆载荷，可眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Disruptor Spike
perks.description: Improves the effects of disruption, lowering combatants' damage output even further.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高 混乱 的效果，进一步降低敌方战斗人员的伤害输出。

perks.name: Hunter's Trace
perks.description: Precision hits grant heavy rounds. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中可提供重型弹药。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Overflowing Light
perks.description: Use one ability to briefly improve your other abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用某个技能可暂时强化其他技能。

perks.name: Nadir Focus
perks.description: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续射击会提升精度和射程。提升刀剑的前冲距离，以及发射器的射弹速度。

perks.name: Anti-Flinch
perks.description: Greatly decreases incoming flinch for this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅减少此武器受到的抖动。

perks.name: Ember of Mercy
perks.description:
When you revive an ally, you and other nearby allies gain restoration.

Picking up a Firesprite grants restoration.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你复活盟友时，你和其他附近盟友将获得恢复效果。

拾取焰灵可赋予恢复效果。

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.description: Hitting a target with nearly every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 一发弹药的几乎所有弹片均命中同一目标可在短时间内提高近战伤害。

perks.name: Restorative Finisher
perks.description:
When you use a finisher, you gain a portion of energy for your least-recharged ability. 

Consumes 2 stacks of Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
在你打出终结技时，当前能量值最低的技能会获得一部分能量。

消耗2层护甲充能。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Materialism (Vanguard)
perks.description: Vanguard playlist strikes and Nightfall completions have a chance to award extra destination materials.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成先锋游戏列表打击和日落有几率奖励额外的目的地材料。

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对一个目标造成元素减益可提升此武器的填装速度、瞄准辅助和瞄准时的移动速度，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Praxic Lift
perks.description: Gain a tactical air move.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得战术空中移动能力。

perks.name: Solar Analyzer
perks.description: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on Solar weapon final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 在烈日武器最后一击时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.description:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器会对载具和构造体造成额外伤害。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Solar Impact Accelerator
perks.description:
Solar melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
提高烈日近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 偃月射弹最后一击会增加偃月近战伤害。偃月射弹或近战伤害会延长效果持续时间。

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.
perks.descriptionZh: 初次扣动扳机时可在短时间内提高稳定性和精度。

perks.name: Berserk Rush
perks.description: Weapon enrages faster while amplified. Final blows with this weapon make you amplified.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器在增幅状态下发怒更快。用此武器造成最后一击可获得增幅。

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器摧毁冰影水晶或击败被冻结的目标可获得冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 参加战斗一定时间后会增加空中效率并减少后仰，效果持续到你离开战斗。

perks.name: UNLOCKED BY QUEST
perks.description:
ASPECT OF INTERFERENCE
Purchase this Stasis Aspect from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
perks.descriptionZh:
干扰之星相
在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影星相。

perks.name: Elemental Munitions
perks.description: Combatant final blows with Tangles or Elemental Orbs have a chance to drop Special or Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缠结或元素能量球对战斗人员造成最后一击有几率掉落特殊或重型弹药。

perks.name: Frenzied Stacks
perks.description: Your Armor Charges grant bonus damage to your thrown Tangles or Elemental Orbs. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲充能会为你投掷出的缠结或元素能量球提供额外伤害。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Monochromatic Maestro
perks.description: Dealing elemental ability damage increases matching weapon damage, and elemental weapon damage increases matching ability damage. Bonus granted is 10% for 5 seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成元素技能伤害会提升相匹配武器的伤害，元素武器伤害会提升相匹配技能的伤害。伤害加成为10%，持续5秒。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Ranger
perks.description: Rapid precision hits made from long range weaken the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 长距离快速精准命中会削弱目标。

perks.name: Elemental Embrace
perks.description: Subclass elemental buffs grant you bonus recovery and damage resistance against combatant attacks of the matching element type.
perks.descriptionZh: 分支职业元素增益可提供对相匹配元素类型战斗人员攻击的额外恢复和伤害抗性。

perks.name: Well of Life
perks.description: Picking up a Solar elemental well grants increased regeneration for a short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取烈日元素井可在短期内提高恢复速度。

perks.name: While Ye May
perks.description:
Defeating Fallen Captains grants destination materials.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭 堕落者队长 可获得目的地材料。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location. Cooldown between activations reduced.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成最后一击，将有几率在目标位置产生实验性子弹药。减少启动冷却时间。

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速最后一击会在目标附近生成一块冰影水晶。

perks.name: Stopping Power
perks.description: This weapon's Kinetic ordinance can more easily stagger combatants, and grant increased target acquisition and damage against low-health targets within an improved range.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的动能弹药更容易令战斗人员眩晕，对更大范围内的低生命值目标的目标捕获能力和伤害更高。

perks.name: Taken Repurposing
perks.description: Destroying a Taken shield refreshes your grenade ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 摧毁傀儡护盾可重新充满手雷技能。

perks.name: Dealer's Choice
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant an improved amount of Super energy. Equipping multiple weapons from the Pale Heart increases this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可恢复更多的超能能量。装备苍白之心的多件武器会增加这一效果。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chances of finding ammo while you have a Fusion Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备融合步枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Empowering Largesse
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, activating an Arc Super recharges your grenade.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，激活电弧超能可充能手雷。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Extrovert
perks.description: Final blows while near multiple combatants or near Nightmares restores an improved amount of health.
perks.descriptionZh: 在多个战斗人员或梦魇附近完成最后一击可恢复更多生命值。

perks.name: Void Impact Accelerator
perks.description:
Void melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
提高虚空近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Overcharge Capacitor
perks.description: Sprinting, sliding, and firing build a charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺、滑行并射击可积攒充能。

perks.name: Fervid Coldsnap
perks.description: Your Coldsnap grenades have an additional charge and recharge faster on hits. Seekers travel farther.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的急冻手雷有一发额外充能且命中时充能更快。追踪弹移动得更远。

perks.name: Aggressive Frame
perks.description:
Powerful, heavy swings.
[Heavy Attack]  : Slam.
perks.descriptionZh:
强力挥击。
[重攻击] ：猛击。

perks.name: Foebreaker Chant
perks.description: Stunning a Champion or landing rapid precision hits on a powerful combatant will mark them. Your allies deal increased damage to marked combatants. When a combatant is first marked, nearby Aeon Cult allies who do not have the Sect of Force role equipped gain grenade and melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕一名勇士或对强力战斗人员连续精准命中会标记他们。你的盟友会对被标记的敌人造成更多伤害。战斗人员首次被标记时，其附近未装备力量学派角色的永劫邪教盟友会获得手雷和近战能量。

perks.name: Aeon's Wrath
perks.description: Rapid precision hits with a weapon temporarily increase your reload speed and weapon swap speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器快速精准命中会暂时提高你的填装速度和武器切换速度。

perks.name: Between Poles
perks.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 光能武器最后一击提供赋予手雷属性的光能极性层数。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供赋予近战属性的暗影极性层数。

perks.name: So Very Thin
perks.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 光能武器最后一击提供额外手雷能量。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供额外近战能量。光能与暗影交替的快速最后一击在短时间内提供伤害抗性。

perks.name: Special Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对特殊弹药量表的所有计入效果。

perks.name: Caster Frame
perks.description:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重弹道攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

perks.name: Guardian Effects
perks.description: Adds a Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个守护者纹章。

perks.name: Aura of Night
perks.description: Applies a purple crown aura.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加一个紫色头冠光环。

perks.name: From the Depths
perks.description: Grants bonus Void Super damage if cast while critically wounded. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.
perks.descriptionZh: 在重伤状态下施放可让守护者获得虚空超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

perks.name: Hellion
perks.description:
Activate your class ability to summon a [Solar] Solar mortar that lobs flaming projectiles at distant targets. Targets damaged by the mortar are scorched.

Hellion damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
启动你的职业技能来召唤一个可向远处目标发射火焰射弹的烈日迫击炮。被迫击炮伤害的目标会被灼烧。

地狱火的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perks.name: Arms Production
perks.description: Increase the progress rate toward Seraph weapon frames. Increases further when in a fireteam with clanmates.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升炽天使武器模型的进度速度。当你与公会成员同处一个火力战队时，进一步提升进度。

perks.name: Enhanced Auto Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高自动步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Vex Slayer
perks.description: Improves rewards from eliminating Vex enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭Vex敌人可获得更好的奖励。

perks.name: Thread of Wisdom
perks.description: Defeating suspended targets creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败悬停的目标会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Stagnant Glyphkeeper
perks.description: Damaging a Glyphkeeper with a grenade causes your equipped Bows, Fusion Rifles, Swords, and Trace Rifles to deal additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷对雕文守护者造成伤害，可使你装备的弓箭、融合步枪、刀剑和追踪步枪造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Roving Assassin
perks.description: Vanish after Spectral Blades kills for more Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成鬼灵利刃击杀后消失可获得更多超能能量。

perks.name: Double Dodge
perks.description: Gain a second dodge charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得一次额外的闪身充能。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭目标后填装可在短时间内大幅改善目标捕获能力和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Lucent Swarm
perks.description: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集能量球会延长典礼持续时间。典礼生效时，技能最后一击有几率生成友方电弧飞蛾。

perks.name: The Ceremony
perks.description: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结战斗人员或复活盟友会开始光明邪魔族仪式。仪式生效期间，提升超能属性。

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.description: Greatly increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are further increased but target acquisition is decreased.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅增加弹药生成。在空中时，精度与填装速度进一步提升，但目标捕获能力降低。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.description: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants improved stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成伤害或击败目标可逐渐提升稳定性、操控性、填装速度和充能速度。此效果会随时间逐渐减弱，但在靠近盟友时会更快获得。

perks.name: Disruption Weapon [Shield-Piercing]
perks.description: Fires a single heavy-hitting round. Disintegrates targets on impact. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一发高伤害弹药，命中时暴力分解目标。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼
perks.description: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼

perks.name: Molten Overload
perks.description:
Solar grenades cause [Disruption] disruption, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日手雷会造成 混乱 效果，延缓敌人的技能能量恢复并降低其伤害输出。

擅长对抗超载勇士。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Echo of Dilation
perks.description: While crouched, you sneak faster and gain enhanced radar resolution.
perks.descriptionZh: 蹲下时，你的潜行速度更快并获得增强雷达分辨率。

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击或使用此武器快速击败目标，会在目标的位置生成一个线虫。

perks.name: Mugunghwa Legion
perks.description: You are in a supported Internet Game Room! While you are here, you may speak to Yuna to receive Exotic equipment.
perks.descriptionZh: 您位于受支持的网络游戏室！您在这里可以与柳娜交谈，获得异域装备。

perks.name: -20 Health ▼
perks.description: -20 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -20 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Strand Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Strand weapons over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 逐渐填装你已收起的缚丝武器。

perks.name: Permeability
perks.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的职业技能会将此武器的伤害类型更改为匹配你已装备超能的属性，直到你收起此武器。

perks.name: Acrobat's Focus
perks.description: Gain Woven Mail when activating Grapple. Increased flinch resistance and health while Woven Mail is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 启用抓钩时获得织造铠甲。织造铠甲生效时会获得更高的抖动抗性和生命值。

perks.name: Union of Speed
perks.description: Increased mobility when you're in a fireteam with clanmates.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，敏捷度提高。

perks.name: The Extra Mile
perks.description: Completing a clan vendor challenge awards an additional 5 Legendary shards.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成公会商人挑战将奖励额外5个传说碎片。

perks.name: Omega Strike
perks.description: Land hits with the Slug Launcher to load micro-missiles[Alternate Weapon Action]  and then fire to launch several micro-missiles in a volley.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用重弹发射器命中目标可装载微型导弹[替换武器动作] ，然后射击即可一次性发射几枚微型导弹。

perks.name: Blunt Execution Rounds
perks.description: Damaging nearby combatants with melee abilities dramatically increases handling and damage. Expires after an improved short duration or the next shot.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战技能对附近战斗人员造成伤害可大幅提高操控性和伤害。持续短暂时间后或下次射击后过期，持续时间延长。

perks.name: The Dance
perks.description: Improved Primary weapon performance; final blows refund dodges.
perks.descriptionZh: 改良主武器性能；最后一击返还闪身。

perks.name: The Perfect Fifth
perks.description: Precision hits load a scorching explosive round.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中将填装一枚有灼烧效果的高爆弹药。

perks.name: Enhanced Reload
perks.description: +10 Reload
perks.descriptionZh: +10 填装

perks.name: Taken Resolution
perks.description: Hitting three different targets generates a large amount of blight. Blighted Seekers bore through targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 击中三个不同目标会生成大量凋零阴影。凋零追踪弹可穿透目标。

perks.name: Iron Reach
perks.description: Massively improves weapon range at the cost of a reduced amount of weapon stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 以牺牲较少武器稳定性为代价，大幅提升武器的射程。

perks.name: Built Bitter
perks.description: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到伤害会提升你已装备武器的填装速度，直到收起该武器。受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

perks.name: Bittersweet
perks.description: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你收起武器时，根据失去的苦涩锻造层数恢复生命值。

perks.name: Remote Shield
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a protective shield on impact. Passing through the protective shield provides a Void Overshield and improves weapon damage, reload speed, and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在命中后部署一个防御护盾。穿过它会提供一个虚空覆盖护盾，提升武器伤害、填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Elemental Armaments
perks.description: Combatant weapon final blows with a damage type that matches your subclass element have an escalating chance to spawn an elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 用符合你的分支职业元素类型的伤害类型取得战斗人员武器最后一击有更高几率生成元素井。

perks.name: Physic
perks.description: Rapidly healing allies grants the intrinsic elemental benefit to you.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速治疗盟友可为你提供固有特性元素增益。

perks.name: Gun and Run
perks.description: Defeating targets grants stacks of Gun and Run for a longer duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this improves draw speed for longer.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标可在更长时间内获得边打边跑层数。短暂冲刺消耗一层效果并从储备弹药中部分填装此武器的弹匣。如为弓箭，则在更长时间内提升拉弓速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 每个完全充能的技能都会提升操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

perks.name: Icarus Dash
perks.description: Activate while midair to dodge twice.
perks.descriptionZh: 可在空中激活进行 两次闪避 。

perks.name: Heavy Bolts
perks.description:
Bolts deal increased damage, but are slower and more affected by gravity.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
perks.descriptionZh:
弩弹造成更高伤害，但速度变慢且更易受重力影响。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

perks.name: Gunpowder Gamble
perks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败目标可充能临时烈日爆炸。

[手雷]  ：投掷出可在半空被击中，造成点燃的烈日爆炸。

perks.name: Autoloader
perks.description: This vehicle reloads weapons while you ride.
perks.descriptionZh: 在骑乘载具时填装武器。

perks.name: Barri-nade
perks.description: Using your class ability grants a Barricade grenade.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的职业技能可获得一枚屏障手雷。

perks.name: Aura of Grandeur
perks.description: Applies an orange crown aura.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加一个橙色头冠光环。

perks.name: Nessus Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯上获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Strand Siphon
perks.description: Rapid Strand weapon final blows create Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速缚丝武器最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Modularity (Vanguard)
perks.description: Vanguard playlist strikes and Nightfall completions have a chance to award an Upgrade Module.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成先锋游戏列表打击和日落有几率奖励一个升级模块。

perks.name: Explosive Shadow
perks.description: Combusts combatants with explosive slugs. Strong against  [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 用爆炸弹头点燃战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Winterized Gear
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, this weapon gains a greater amount of stability, reload speed, and handling. These benefits decay over time after reentering combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，此武器的稳定性、填装速度和操控性获得更多提升。这些加成会在你重新进入战斗后逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次最后一击都能提高充能/拉弓速度。

perks.name: Restorative Warlock Armor
perks.description: Improved recovery.
perks.descriptionZh: 更强的恢复力。

perks.name: -10 Health ▼
perks.description: -10 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -10 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Doppler Effect
perks.description: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对目标施加的悬停、瓦解和割裂效果，以及对自身施加的焕光和恢复效果拥有更长的持续时间。

perks.name: Accretion
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药盒会提供可叠加的武器切换和收起速度加成，直到你死亡。

perks.name: Adaptive Frame
perks.description: Well-rounded, reliable, and sturdy.
perks.descriptionZh: 全面，可靠，耐用。

perks.name: Memento Mori
perks.description: Grants radar while aiming down sights. Bonus damage after kill-reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时启动雷达。击杀后填装提供额外伤害。

perks.name: Spark of Discipline
