perks.description: Spark of Discipline
perks.descriptionZh: 纪律火花

perks.name: Ferocity
perks.description: Your third match win grants a bonus win.
perks.descriptionZh: 取得的第三场比赛胜利会奖励一个额外胜场。

perks.name: Aurochs
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Spark of Discharge
perks.description:
Arc weapon final blows have a chance to create an Ionic Trace.

Collecting an Ionic Trace grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个离子轨迹。

收集一个离子轨迹会为你提供一层电光充能。

perks.name: Emperor's Balance
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, your Void abilities deal 25% more damage.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，你的虚空技能可造成25%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Substantially increases blast radius and increases damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭会在碰撞时粘附，延迟一定时间后引爆。爆炸范围大幅扩大且伤害提高。

perks.name: Pack Tactics
perks.description: Dealing damage with Threadlings increases Threadling damage. At maximum stacks, Threadlings stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用线虫造成伤害可提升线虫伤害。叠满层数时，线虫可眩晕势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Semi-Auto Striker
perks.description: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

perks.name: Reciprocal Draw
perks.description: Rapid non-Sidearm final blows grant Sidearms a period of increased damage for a short time upon next draw.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用非手枪武器快速造成最后一击会使手枪下次拔出时获得短时间的伤害提升。

perks.name: Refresh Threads
perks.description: Picking up an Elemental pickup matching your subclass element or picking up a Tangle while you have a [Strand]Strand Super equipped grants energy to your least charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备缚丝超能时，拾取与你分支职业元素相匹配的元素拾取物或拾取缠结会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

perks.name: Elemental Benevolence
perks.description: Granting allies an elemental buff gives class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 为盟友提供元素增益会获得职业技能能量。

perks.name: Frost Renewal
perks.description: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Fever and Chill
perks.description: Rapid precision hits with [Solar]Solar weapons grant Radiant. Rapid precision hits with [Stasis]Stasis weapons grant Frost Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日武器快速精准命中目标可获得焕光。使用冰影武器快速精准命中目标可获得冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Io Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 在木卫一的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Adept Stability
perks.description: +10 Stability
perks.descriptionZh: +10稳定性

perks.name: Resistant Tether
perks.description: Gain damage resistance while part of a tether chain. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 被吸附时获得伤害抗性。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Sword Scavenger
perks.description: Swords get bonus reserves when picking up Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取重型弹药时，刀剑获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Burning Cells
perks.description: Destroying a Warmind Cell creates a burst of Solar energy that causes enemies to burn for several seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 摧毁战争思维电池会引爆一股烈日能量，点燃敌人数秒。

perks.name: Wrath of Rasputin
perks.description: Solar splash damage final blows have a chance to create Warmind Cells.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日溅射伤害最后一击有一定几率生成战争思维电池。

perks.name: Fireteam Medic
perks.description: Destroying a Warmind Cell creates a burst of healing for you and allies near you.
perks.descriptionZh: 摧毁战争思维电池会在你和附近的盟友身上制造一股治疗波。

perks.name: Rage of the Warmind
perks.description: Adds additional Solar damage to the explosions of Warmind Cells you destroy.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你摧毁的战争思维电池的爆炸效果增加额外的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Incinerating Light
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple enemies with the explosion of a Warmind Cell.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用战争思维电池的爆炸快速击杀多名敌人以变得充斥光能 。

perks.name: Banned Weapon
perks.description: Fires a three-round burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 可进行三发连射。

perks.name: Guidance Ring
perks.description: Charges and deploys a guidance system.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能并部署制导系统。

perks.name: Titan Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while on the moon Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 在土卫六获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Color Bearer
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.description: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加弹药生成。在空中时，精度与填装速度提升，但目标捕获能力降低。

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器射程和稳定性。

perks.name: Solar Weapon Analyzer
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Solar weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在烈日武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Hydraulic Boosters
perks.description: Buffs slide and jumping.
perks.descriptionZh: 加强滑行和跳跃的能力。

perks.name: Illegally Modded Holster
perks.description: Hand Cannons ready faster and gain increased accuracy and bonus damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使手炮举枪速度更快，并获得额外精准度和伤害。

perks.name: Uncanny Arrows
perks.description: Grants Deadfall and Moebius Quiver energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 提供狩猎陷阱和莫比乌斯箭袋能量。

perks.name: Baroque Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Solstice appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个至日英雄外观。

perks.name: Cursed Thrall
perks.description: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击击败目标后，在更长时间内使用此武器造成最后一击可使目标爆炸。

perks.name: Phase Magazine
perks.description:
Increases damage while lowering rate of fire.
  •  Decreases magazine size
perks.descriptionZh:
低射速时造成伤害会增加。
  •  缩小弹匣容量

perks.name: Titan Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables on the moon Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在土卫六上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Insectoid Robot Grenades
perks.description: Fires insectoid robot grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射类虫机器人榴弹。

perks.name: Delicate Tuning
perks.description: While at low heat, this weapon has slightly more improved range, handling, and accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 在低热量状态下，此武器的射程、操控性与精度提升得略微更高。

perks.name: Advanced Reflexes
perks.description: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到来自目标的伤害后，使用此武器快速防卫或瞄准目标，可在短时间内获得额外伤害、操控性和充能速度。

perks.name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver
perks.nameZh: 暗影箭矢：莫比乌斯箭袋
perks.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.
perks.descriptionZh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和盟友大幅削弱和压制他们。

发射两组三发虚空箭矢，搜寻附近目标。暗影箭矢会使敌人变得不稳定，对已被束缚的目标造成更高伤害。击败被束缚的目标会生成能量球。

在超能启用期间，造成伤害会提升你的虚空箭矢和弓箭武器伤害。

perks.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
perks.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
perks.descriptionZh:
将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，为你和友军大幅削弱和压制他们。

暗影箭矢所发射的虚空之锚会将敌人拉向命中位置，随后变成陷阱静候猎物的到来。虚空之锚射程与持续时间均增加。

perks.name: Spectral Blades
perks.description:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一对致命的虚空利刃，然后在暗影笼罩之下潜入战场。

 [轻攻击] ：进行一次快速的近战攻击。

 [重攻击] ：进行一次可削弱目标的重攻击，并再次从敌人的视野中消失。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
perks.description: Deep ammo reserves. Fast reload when empty.
perks.descriptionZh: 更多弹药储备。打空时可提高填装速度。

perks.name: Eyes Up, Guardian
perks.description: Collecting Orbs of Power strengthens this weapon's next several ricochet shots, providing more damage and more bounces between targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集能量球会强化此武器接下来的几发跳弹，造成更高的伤害并在目标间产生更多弹射。

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼

perks.name: Crucible Gold
perks.description: Adds a gold Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金色熔炉纹章。

perks.name: Voltaic Mote Collector
perks.description: Gain an overshield after you collect 10 Motes. This mod's effect does not stack with other copies of this mod.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集10个萤光后可获得力场护盾。此模组的效果无法与其他副本叠加。

perks.name: Elemental Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by picking up an elemental well. If the elemental well's element type matches your subclass element, you gain 2 stacks of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取元素井也会使你充斥光能。如果元素井的元素类型与你的分支职业元素相同，你会获得2层光之充能。

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces slightly more heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会降低略多的热量。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Touch of Venom
perks.description: Spread weakening effects with smoke.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烟雾扩散削弱效果。

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可恢复少量生命值。

perks.name: Vanishing Step
perks.description: Dodging makes you vanish from sight for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身使你从视野中消失一小段时间。

perks.name: Refined Sights
perks.description: The weekly clan challenge also grants an Enhancement Core.
perks.descriptionZh: 周常公会挑战还会提供一个强化核心作为奖励。

perks.name: Unfaltering Focus
perks.description: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 弓箭、霰弹枪或刀剑最后一击会暂时减少受到的伤害。使用这些武器对目标造成伤害可延长效果。

perks.name: Iaido
perks.description: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 用刚刚拔出或填装的武器造成最后一击会治疗你。

perks.name: Arc Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: And Its Name Was Death
perks.description: Adds an additional round to the magazine and increases reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 为弹匣添加一发额外的子弹且提高填装速度。

perks.name: Suppressive Darkness
perks.description: Whenever you suppress a combatant, you also weaken them, causing them to take additional damage for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你压制一名战斗人员时，你也会将其削弱，使该战斗人员在短时间内受到额外伤害。

perks.name: Echo of Harvest
perks.description: Defeating weakened targets creates an Orb of Power and a Void Breach.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败虚弱的目标会生成一个能量球以及一个虚空裂口。

perks.name: Enhanced Cheer
perks.description: An ally is using Enhanced Cheer, granting all members of your fireteam the chance to gain additional Dawning Essence upon activity completion.
perks.descriptionZh: 一个队友正在使用强化欢呼，使你所在的火力战队全部成员在活动结束时有几率获得额外的曙光精华。

perks.name: Shotgun Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Shotguns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的霰弹枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: +10 Weapon ▲
perks.description: +10 Weapon ▲

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target. Triggers faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会在目标周围引发爆炸。触发速度更快。

perks.name: Grasp of the Warmind
perks.description: You can pick up, carry, and throw Warmind Cells. Once thrown, a Warmind Cell cannot be picked up again.
perks.descriptionZh: 你可以拾取、携带和投掷战争思维电池。投掷后，战争思维电池将无法再被拾取。

perks.name: Warmind's Light
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by collecting a Warmind Cell.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过收集战争思维电池以变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Light of the Fire
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets with the detonation of a Warmind Cell generates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过引爆战争思维电池快速消灭目标会生成能量球。

perks.name: Blessing of Rasputin
perks.description: Collecting a Warmind Cell increases the chances that your next final blow with a Seraph weapon will create a Warmind Cell.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集战争思维电池会提升你下一次使用炽天使武器造成最后一击可制造战争思维电池的几率。

perks.name: Global Reach
perks.description: Warmind Cells you create affect and damage targets at a greater distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所制造的战争思维电池可以影响和伤害更远距离的目标。

perks.name: Nano-Munitions
perks.description: Being near allies slowly builds up an improved partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累更多的部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着此武器准星在目标上停留的时间增加伤害。

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage and an improved amount of reload speed and handling until the wielder's death.
perks.descriptionZh: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予武器伤害，以及更多的填装速度和操控性，直到使用者死亡。

perks.name: Renewal Entrance
perks.description: Adds the Traveler's renewal to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加旅行者的复兴。

perks.name: Orrery Entrance
perks.description: Adds a planetary appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个行星外观。

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for an improved short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换至此武器后短时间内充能时间缩短，操控速度提高，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.description: This weapon adapts its damage output to be more effective against energy shields that don't match its damage type. Improves damage increase.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可调整其伤害输出以更有效地对抗与其伤害类型不匹配的能量护盾。伤害提升量提高。

perks.name: Icarus Grip
perks.description: Moderately increases airborne effectiveness.
perks.descriptionZh: 中幅提高空中效率。

perks.name: Glimmershard
perks.description:
Defeated bosses have a chance to create a shower of Glimmer.

Effect lasts for 4 hours.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败首领有几率产生一阵微光之雨。

效果持续4小时。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Radiant Shrapnel
perks.description: Dealing sustained weapon damage while Radiant or defeating a scorched combatant with a weapon causes the target to release Solar projectiles that deal damage and scorch on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 在焕光状态下造成持续武器伤害或用武器击败一个灼烧状态的战斗人员，会使目标释放烈日射弹，命中时造成伤害并灼烧。

perks.name: Shieldcrush
perks.description:
While you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or a Void overshield, your melee recharges faster and deals increased damage.

While you are Amplified or Radiant, your grenade recharges faster and deals increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，你的近战充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

当你处于增幅或焕光状态时，你的手雷充能会更快，造成的伤害也会增加。

perks.name: Elemental Overdrive
perks.description: Picking up an Elemental pickup or Tangle grants increased damage to weapons of the same element.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取元素拾取物或缠结会在短时间内提升同元素武器的伤害。

perks.name: Tangled Web
perks.description: Creating a Tangle by defeating a [Strand]Strand debuffed target suspends nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过击败被缚丝减益的目标产生缠结会悬停附近的战斗人员。

perks.name: Frigid Glare
perks.description: While Frost Armor is active, [Stasis]Stasis precision final blows cause combatants to release a freezing burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰霜护甲生效时，冰影精准最后一击会使战斗人员释放冻结爆发。

perks.name: Iron Lord's Vigor
perks.description: While wielding a Sword, you take decreased damage; rapid final blows grant ammo to the wielder.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑时，你受到的伤害降低；快速最后一击可获得弹药。

perks.name: Argent Quiver
perks.description: Reloading a Bow consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed for your next 3 shots or until you stow your Bow.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装弓箭会消耗一层护甲充能，使接下来直至收起弓箭前的3次射击伤害和填装速度获得提升。

perks.name: EDZ Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区中获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Stolen Light
perks.description: Adds stolen Light to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一道被偷走的光能。

perks.name: Focused Light
perks.description: When you have Field of Light, gain increased weapon damage and resilience.
perks.descriptionZh: 在你拥有光之领域时，获得武器伤害和韧性提升。

perks.name: Focused Darkness
perks.description: When you have Flux of Darkness, gain increased ability damage and mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 在你拥有暗影能流时，获得技能伤害和敏捷提升。

perks.name: Release Recover
perks.description: When you lose Flux of Darkness or Field of Light, begin recovering health.
perks.descriptionZh: 在你失去暗影能流或光之领域时，开始恢复生命值。

perks.name: Cabal Extinguisher
perks.description: When an ally gains Flux of Darkness or Field of Light, deal increased weapon damage to Cabal combatants for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在盟友获得暗影能流或光之领域时，短时间内提升对卡巴尔战斗人员造成的武器伤害。

perks.name: Spring-Auger Bolts
perks.description:
Bolts release an impulse shortly after impact that deals a small amount of damage and has a high chance to cause flinch.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
perks.descriptionZh:
弩弹在命中后不久释放冲击波，造成少量伤害并有高几率造成抖动。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

perks.name: Cursed Thrall
perks.description: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击击败目标后，在短时间内使用此武器造成最后一击可使目标爆炸。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Overloaded Auto/SMG
perks.nameZh: 过载自动步枪/微型冲锋枪
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles and Submachine Guns grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的自动步枪和微型冲锋枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Improve Side Boost
perks.description: This vehicle has improved dodging from side to side.
perks.descriptionZh: 使载具的横向闪避能力增强。

perks.name: Auto Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Auto Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的自动步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Power Surge
perks.description: Rapid hits charge your next shot into an explosive round that deals additional damage and accelerates power buildup on hit. While empowered, every shot is explosive.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速命中会将你的下一发子弹充能成高爆弹药，造成额外伤害并加速能量积累。强化后，每一发子弹都具有爆炸效果。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Special ammo while you have a Trace Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备追踪步枪后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

perks.name: Collective Purpose
perks.description: Gain bonus range and handling when near allies. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate. The effect scales with the number of nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 在盟友附近时获得额外射程和操控性。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度会加快。此效果与附近的盟友数量成正比。

perks.name: Focused Optics
perks.description: Increased zoom and effective range when aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时会提高放大倍率和有效射程。

perks.name: Well of Potency
perks.description: Picking up a matching elemental well grants you Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取匹配的元素井可获得超能能量。

perks.name: Materialism (Crucible)
perks.description: Crucible wins have a chance to award destination materials.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场取胜有几率奖励目的地材料。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Reserves
perks.nameZh: 线性融合步枪弹药储量
perks.description: Increases the amount of Linear Fusion Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的线性融合步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Flourishing Blade
perks.description:
Defeating combatants or opponents with Swords has a chance to grant a large amount of Glimmer.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用 刀剑 击败战斗人员或对手有几率获得大量微光。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中目标会向弹匣里填装一枚弹药。

perks.name: Manifested Power
perks.description: Adds a powerful appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个强力外观。

perks.name: Reign Havoc
perks.description: Final blows generate lightning strikes and grant a stack of Bolt Charge. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可产生闪电打击并提供一层电光充能。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Search Party
perks.description: This weapon is granted faster aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.
perks.descriptionZh: 在附近没有盟友的情况下瞄准时，此武器的瞄准速度和移动速度都会更快。

perks.name: Ember of Solace
perks.description: Radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 施加在自身的焕光和恢复效果拥有更长的持续时间。

perks.name: Solar Plexus
perks.description: Increases damage of all Solar melee abilities. Gain Super energy from performing finishers with a Solar subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 增强所有烈日近战技能的伤害。在装备烈日分支职业时利用终结技最后一击获得超能能量。

perks.name: Heavy Burst
perks.description: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射威力巨大的两发点射。降低瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面抖动。

perks.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons
perks.description: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Banner of War grants melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得一次额外的狂暴利刃充能。战争旗帜可提供近战能量。

perks.name: Sidearm Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 火箭发射器弹药回收器
perks.description: Rocket Launchers get bonus reserves when picking up Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取重型弹药时，火箭发射器获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Tri-Planar Mass Driver
perks.description: Fires a spread of Void energy projectiles. Aiming down sights narrows the spread.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射扇形的虚空能量射弹。瞄准时会缩小散布范围。

perks.name: Sidearm Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Sidearms over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的手枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Disaster Plan
perks.description:
Picking up ammunition increases this weapon's flinch resistance and range, which lasts until it is fired again.

Swords gain a large increase to charge rate instead.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取弹药可提高此武器的抖动抗性和射程，并可持续至再次射击。

而刀剑则可大幅提高充能速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Grenade Launcher Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定榴弹发射器瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用榴弹发射器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Minor Resist
perks.description: Gain extra damage resistance against rank-and-file combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得对抗来自普通敌人的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Vanishing Shadow
perks.description: Improved invisibility.
perks.descriptionZh: 隐身效果延长。

perks.name: Persistence
perks.description: Reaching seven wins rewards the weekly Adept weapon. When you are not in a full fireteam, losses following a win remove the win from the card.
perks.descriptionZh: 赢得七场胜利会奖励每周专家武器。若你处于未满员的火力战队，则获胜后的负场会从卡片上移除该胜场。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Scout and Pulse
perks.nameZh: 反屏障斥候和脉冲步枪
perks.description: Your equipped Scout Rifles and Pulse Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的斥候步枪和脉冲步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Daily Ops Focus
perks.description: Gain an additional bonus engram on a Daily Focus activity in Ops.
perks.descriptionZh: 在行动的日常专注活动中获得额外的记忆水晶。

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成最后一击会产生更多近战能量。
造成近战伤害会在短时间内提升这把武器的操控性。

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器打破正在使用超能的战斗人员或守护者的护盾将获得覆盖护盾，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Thread of Finality
perks.description: Finisher final blows create Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击会生成线虫。

perks.name: Blade Barrage
perks.description: Vault into the air and unleash a volley of Solar-charged explosive knives.
perks.descriptionZh: 跃向空中并释放一连串烈日能量的爆炸飞刀。

perks.name: Redemption
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon cure you and increase reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会治愈你，并提升填装速度。

perks.name: Aeon Energy
perks.description: Throwing grenades grants energy to nearby Aeon Cultists.
perks.descriptionZh: 投掷手雷可使附近永劫教派盟友获得能量。

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.description:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine. 

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh:
处于增幅状态时，弹药会逐渐从备弹转移到弹匣中。

拥有速度加成时，弹药回复更快并会过量填充弹匣。

perks.name: Bulwark Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Bulwark archetype, which has Health as its primary stat and Class as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落堡垒框架：生命值为主要属性，职业为次要属性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Strategist
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate improved class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会产生更多的职业技能能量。使用你的职业技能会在短时间内提升此武器的稳定性。

perks.name: Adamantine Brace
perks.description: Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely for increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 弓箭可以不限时地完美拉弓，以提升伤害。

perks.name: Sharp Edges
perks.description: Get Super energy for Blade Barrage hits and kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成利刃弹幕命中和击杀时获得超能能量。

perks.name: Flight
perks.description: Grants increased persistence and projectile speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升坚韧和射弹速度。

perks.name: Adept Projectile Speed
perks.description: +10 Projectile Speed
perks.descriptionZh: +10弹速

perks.name: Hand Cannon Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善手炮的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Flame Harvesting
perks.description: Solar Exotic final blows create Solar elemental wells.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日异域最后一击可制造烈日元素井。

perks.name: Solar Fulmination
perks.description: Your ignitions do increased damage in an increased radius.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的点燃会在更大的半径范围内造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Classy Restoration
perks.description: Activating your Solar class abilities grants you restoration.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活烈日职业技能可获得恢复。

perks.name: Radiant Orbs
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power makes you radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球可获得焕光效果。

perks.name: Rays of Precision
perks.description: While radiant, Solar precision final blows cause combatants to ignite.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有焕光效果时，烈日精准最后一击可点燃战斗人员。

perks.name: Circle of Life
perks.description: Rapidly healing allies grants this weapon an improved period of increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速治疗盟友可提升此武器在一段时间内的伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Lucky Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 在精准最后一击后填装，会使后续的精准命中从备弹中补充一发子弹。

perks.name: Ravenous Beast
perks.description: Damage and final blows charge the weapon. Unleashing this charge increases damage and rate of fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 伤害和最后一击会为武器充能。释放此充能会提升伤害和射速。

perks.name: House of Light Entrance
perks.description: Adds a House of Light appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个光能氏族外观。

perks.name: Machine Gun Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Machine Guns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的机枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Focusing Lens
perks.description: Your Light abilities do bonus damage to combatants affected by Stasis.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的光能技能对受到冰影影响的战斗人员造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Auto Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高自动步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Bountiful Harvest
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional Glimmer when harvesting.
perks.descriptionZh: 在收割时有几率获得额外微光。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高榴弹发射器的收举速度。

perks.name: Glowing Embers
perks.description: Glowing Embers
perks.descriptionZh: 光辉余烬

perks.name: Shining Embers
perks.description: Shining Embers
perks.descriptionZh: 闪光余烬

perks.name: Arc Synergy
perks.description: This armor piece adds +2 to your overall Power and +20% damage with Arc weapons against combatant shields when you have an Arc subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 此护甲提供总能量+2以及装备电弧分支职业时电弧武器对战斗人员护盾伤害+20%。

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速消灭目标可触发更多的生命值回复。守护者和强力战斗人员视为不止一个目标。

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可暂时性地提高武器伤害力。可叠加3次。

perks.name: Conserve Momentum
perks.description: Hits decrease charge time.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中缩短充能时间。

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后进行填装时可以为收起的武器也进行填装

perks.name: Arc Synergy
perks.description: This armor piece adds +1 to your overall Power and +10% damage with Arc weapons against combatant shields when you have an Arc subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 此护甲提供总能量+1以及装备电弧分支职业时电弧武器对战斗人员护盾伤害+10%。

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants an improved stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.
perks.descriptionZh:
投掷手雷或使用充能近战击中目标可提供更多的武器稳定性、操控性和射程叠加加成。

使用超能可提供最大叠加次数。

perks.name: Enhanced Scout Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型斥候步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善斥候步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会缓慢填装子弹，直至两倍弹匣容量。

perks.name: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Class ▼
perks.description: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Class ▼

perks.name: Facet of Hope
perks.description: While you have an elemental buff, your class ability regenerates more quickly.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有元素增益时，你的职业技能回复速度更快。

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves. Improves handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击或使用充能近战造成伤害会从储存弹药中填装此武器的弹匣。提升操控性。

perks.name: Spark of Magnitude
perks.description: Your lingering Arc grenades (Lightning Grenade, Pulse Grenade, and Storm Grenade) have extended duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的持久电弧手雷（闪电手雷、脉冲手雷、风暴手雷）的持续时间加长。

perks.name: +15 Super ▲
perks.description: +15 Super ▲

perks.name: Melee Font
perks.description: You gain a bonus to your melee stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外近战属性。你的护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Balanced Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡拥有平均的综合防御。

perks.name: Kinetic Weapon Surge
perks.description: Your Kinetic weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的动能武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Screaming Swarm
perks.description: Fires a stream of sentient projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一连串感知射弹。

perks.name: Cast No Shadows
perks.description: Dealing melee damage increases this weapon's handling significantly and loads a small amount of ammo from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成近战伤害会显著提升此武器的操控性，并从备弹中填装少量弹药。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Rocket Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高火箭发射器的填装速度。

perks.name: Frame of Reference
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会临时赋予更高的伤害、填装速度和射程。收起武器时暂停此效果的计时。

perks.name: Swooping Talons
perks.description: Dealing damage while airborne increases this weapon's damage output.
perks.descriptionZh: 在空中时造成伤害会提升此武器的伤害输出。

perks.name: Powerful Friends
perks.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集能量球时，会使附近所有至少拥有一层护甲充能的盟友获得额外一层。

perks.name: Rega's Refrain
perks.description: Stasis final blows transfer ammo to this weapon's magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰影最后一击会用储存弹药填充此武器的弹匣。

perks.name: Silence and Squall
perks.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤两把冰影镰刃：“沉默”与“狂啸”，并接连掷出。

沉默：制造一场急速冰冻爆炸，冰冻并伤害目标。

狂啸：制造一场冰影风暴以减速和伤害被包裹的目标。

perks.name: Amethyst Rabbit
perks.description: Adds a purple rabbit crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个紫色兔子纹章。

perks.name: Storm's Keep
perks.description:
Cast your class ability to grant a moderate amount of Bolt Charge stacks to you and nearby allies.

While behind your Barricade, you and allies gain stacks of Bolt Charge over time and your weapons can discharge max stacks of Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
施放你的职业技能，为你和附近的盟友提供适量的电光充能层数。

当你位于屏障后面时，你和盟友会随着时间推移获得电光充能层数，并且你的武器可以释放最大层数的电光充能。

perks.name: The Gift of Certainty
perks.description: Improves Ascension and Tempest Strike.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升飞升与裂空打击。

perks.name: Explosive Pact
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability and reload speed when activating a grenade ability. Healing grenades and grenade final blows grant additional stacks of the bonus.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器在激活手雷技能时可获得稳定性和填装速度加成。治愈手雷和手雷最后一击可提供额外叠加层数。

perks.name: Whisper of Shards
perks.description: Shattering a [Stasis] Stasis crystal temporarily boosts your grenade recharge rate. Shattering additional [Stasis] Stasis crystals increases the duration of this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 破碎 冰影结晶会在短时间内使你的手雷充能速度加快。破碎额外的 冰影结晶可增加此增益的持续时间。

perks.name: Chill Out
perks.description: Defeating a combatant with a Stasis weapon spawns a Stasis crystal. Must have a Stasis subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用冰影武器击败一名战斗人员会生成一个冰影水晶。必须装备冰影分支职业。

perks.name: Ignoble Deeds
perks.description: Gain charges by inflicting subclass debuffs on targets. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon gains handling, reload speed, and Sword charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过对目标施加分支职业减益来获得充能。击败战斗人员来消耗充能。充能时，此武器获得操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度。

perks.name: Improved Titan Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版土卫六缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Titan.
perks.descriptionZh: 在土卫六上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Needlestorm
perks.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
perks.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤一阵致命织针风暴。

这些织针融入环境后，会重新编织成大量线虫。

如果你生成的这些线虫无法找到任何附近目标，它们会返回你的位置并息停。使用你的武器或近战对目标造成伤害会派出息停的线虫发动攻击。

perks.name: Void Scavenger
perks.description: Void weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该虚空武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Trials of Osiris
perks.description: Reach seven wins to claim Passage rewards. Each win contributes to the total Crucible Performance Multiplier.
perks.descriptionZh: 达到七场胜利以领取入场券奖励。每次胜利都会提升熔炉竞技场表现系数总值。

perks.name: +15 Melee ▲
perks.description: +15 Melee ▲

perks.name: Hand Cannon Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手炮的收举速度。

perks.name: Reactive Booster
perks.description: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次激活力量转化器可生效一次，生命危急、被悬停或受冰影效果减速时冲刺，会立即获得短暂的速度加成。

perks.name: Force Converter
perks.description: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，冲刺一小段时间来获得速度加成。

perks.name: Violent Reanimation
perks.description: Multiple final blows with this weapon grant Devour to the wielder.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器多次造成最后一击可为使用者提供吞食效果。

perks.name: Io Scout Reports
perks.description: Highlights nearby loot caches on Io for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你和你的火力战队在木卫一上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Sundering
perks.description:
Destroying vehicles and constructs or breaking target shields grants this weapon bonus reload speed and charge rate.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
摧毁载具和构造体或击碎目标护盾可以增加此武器的填装速度和充能速度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.description: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 接近满弹匣时赋予更快的填装速度。

perks.name: Unstoppable Sniper Rifle
perks.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Sniper Rifle for a short time loads a powerful payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
用狙击步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: UNLOCKED BY QUEST
perks.description: Purchase this Stasis Fragment from the Exo Stranger on Europa after completing the Beyond Light campaign.
perks.descriptionZh: 在完成凌光之刻战役后，从木卫二上的Exo陌客处购买此冰影碎片。

perks.name: Union of Recovery
perks.description: Increased recovery when you're in a fireteam with clanmates.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，恢复力提高。

perks.name: Blast Off
perks.description: Gain Super energy on Rocket Launcher final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器最后一击获得超能能量。

perks.name: Facet of Bravery
perks.description: Defeating targets with grenade final blows grants Volatile Rounds to your [Void] Void weapons. Defeating targets with powered melee final blows grants Unraveling Rounds to your [Strand] Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷最后一击击败目标会提供不稳定弹药给你的虚空武器。使用充能近战最后一击击败目标会提供瓦解弹药给你的缚丝武器。

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在击败目标后，此武器的射速、充能速度、换持速度都会减慢，但是会在短时间内造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Striking Light
perks.description: While Charged with Light, defeating combatants with melee damage and Swords spawns 1 Orb of Power for your allies and consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 当充斥光能的时候，通过近战伤害和刀剑消灭战斗人员将为你的同伴产生1个能量球并消耗1层光之充能。

perks.name: Quick Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple combatants with Fusion Rifles or Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用融合步枪或霰弹枪快速击败多名战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Powerful Friends
perks.description: When you become Charged with Light, nearby allies also become Charged with Light, if they are not already.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你充斥光能的时候，附近的同伴若还未充斥光能，则同样将充斥光能。

perks.name: Heavy Handed
perks.description: While Charged with Light, regain half of your melee energy when you use a charged melee ability, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 当充斥光能的时候， 当你使用充能近战技能时重新获得一半的近战能量， 消耗一层 光之充能。

perks.name: Shepherd's Presence
perks.description: When active, the aura grants a Bright Engram once a week when you are completing a Leviathan raid as a Guide.
perks.descriptionZh: 光环被激活后，每周作为指导者完成一次利维坦突袭后都将获得一个光明记忆水晶。

perks.name: Meaning-Making
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon create a Threadling nest that periodically spawns Threadlings. Final blows with this weapon near an existing Threadling nest create a Threadling instead.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器的最后一击会生成一个线虫巢，周期性地产生线虫。在已有的线虫巢附近用此武器造成最后一击时，会改为生成一个线虫。

perks.name: Enduring Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡拥有高持久和低抗性。

perks.name: Overload Auto Rifle
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的自动步枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可获得射程加成，直至你的护盾被摧毁。在你的护盾重新充满能量后，该加成将更快地重新生效。

perks.name: Timelost Magazine
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant improved bonus Super energy. When your Super expires, this weapon's magazine size is doubled for an improved long duration and reloads from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会获得更多额外的超能能量。你的超能结束时，此武器的弹匣容量在更长持续时间内翻倍，并从弹药储备中填装。

perks.name: Fail-deadly
perks.description: Dealing damage grants a stacking bonus to magazine size, target acquisition, and range until your next final blow with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会为弹匣容量、目标捕获能力和射程提供可叠加的加成，直至你下一次使用此武器造成最后一击。

perks.name: Poison Arrows
perks.description: Fires poison arrows on perfect draw. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 完美拉弓可射出毒化箭矢。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.description: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 超能 ▲ /-5 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Flare-Up
perks.description: Immediately regain your melee charge when you or an ally stuns an [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你或盟友眩晕势不可挡勇士时，立即充能你的近战技能。

perks.name: Stat Penalty
perks.description: -10 to the stat that governs your class ability recharge rate
perks.descriptionZh: 决定你的职业技能充能速度的属性-10

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器破坏敌人的护盾，使他们在一小段时间内对动能伤害的承受力更低。

perks.name: Untold Greed
perks.description: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药、能量球、元素拾取物，或摧毁缚丝缠结时获得无尽贪婪层数，略微降低所受伤害，并为已装备武器提供填装速度加成。当你的护盾被击破时，会失去部分层数。

perks.name: Overflowing Coffers
perks.description: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有无尽贪婪层数时，能量球和元素拾取物会提供更多对应能量，并且提升缚丝缠结造成的伤害。当你的护盾被击破时，所有层数会转化为一股能量球的泉涌。

perks.name: Stalwart Sigil
perks.description: Adds a stalwart appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个尽忠竭力外观。

perks.name: Proud Sigil
perks.description: Adds a proud appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个骄傲外观。

perks.name: Kill Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow loads a high-powered round, causing the next hit to cause improved additional splash damage. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后填装，会加载高威力弹药，使下一次命中造成更高的额外溅射伤害。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION
perks.description: Quicksilver nanites grant more health the greater your stacks of Nano-Assault are. Taking damage while Nano-Assault is active has the chance to generate nanites nearby.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞬变纳米蜂群会根据你的纳米突袭层数提供更多生命值。纳米突袭生效时受到伤害有几率在附近生成纳米蜂群。

perks.name: Mercury Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Crucible Green
perks.description: Adds a green Crucible crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色熔炉纹章。

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.description: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在防御后立刻格挡攻击将会在短时间内增加伤害。

perks.name: Nadir Focus
perks.description: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range by an improved amount. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers is improved amount.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续射击会进一步提升精度和射程。进一步提升刀剑的前冲距离，以及发射器的射弹速度。

perks.name: Heavy Slug Thrower
perks.description: [Aim Down Sights]  : Spin up.
perks.descriptionZh: [瞄准]  ：旋转。

perks.name: Taegeuk Form
perks.description: Adds a Taegeuk to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个太极形态。

perks.name: Ketch Flight Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Fallen Ketch appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个堕落双桅船外观。

perks.name: Stasis Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Stasis appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个冰影外观。

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里填装一枚弹药。

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
perks.description: Higher base damage, increased damage versus powerful combatants. High heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
perks.descriptionZh: 高基础伤害，提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

perks.name: Strength in Numbers
perks.description: Increases chance of receiving an engram when completing playlist activities with a clan member.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高与公会成员共同完成列表活动时获得记忆水晶的几率。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Pulse Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的脉冲步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.
perks.descriptionZh: 在短时间内使用所有已装备的武器造成伤害可为此武器提供伤害加成。

perks.name: Temporal Tracker
perks.description: Gain bonus aim assistance or projectile tracking for an improved duration after picking up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后，获得一段时间的瞄准辅助或射弹追踪加成，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Solar Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用烈日分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Overload Shotgun
perks.description:
Your equipped Shotguns fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你装备的霰弹枪会发射扰乱子弹，使目标眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Grenade Forged
perks.description: +3 Grenade
perks.descriptionZh: +3 手雷

perks.name: Improved EDZ Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版欧洲无人区缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区中探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Blast Radius
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple combatants with Grenade Launchers or Rocket Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用榴弹发射器或火箭发射器快速击败多名战斗人员来变得充斥光能。

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.
perks.descriptionZh: 在最后一击或进入增幅状态后填装，会获得更长时间的伤害提升。最多叠加5层。

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.description: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装可在短时间内为此武器提供额外的操控性并减少受到伤害时的抖动。

perks.name: Io Cache Detector
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 在木卫一上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Stasis Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Stasis weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善冰影武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.description: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.
perks.descriptionZh: 在冲刺后或处于增幅状态时暂时提高填装速度和操控性。此效果在你处于增幅状态时会得到提升。

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器对敌人造成最后一击可提供额外伤害。此增益生效期间，相同伤害类型的手雷或近战击杀会大幅提高其伤害输出并延长持续时间。

perks.name: Sugar Crash
perks.description:
Picking up a piece of Candy generates a weakening pulse.

Only one mask upgrade can be active at a time. Activating this mask upgrade will deactivate the others.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取糖果会生成削弱脉冲。

一次只能激活一个面具升级。激活此面具升级将停用其他面具升级。

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会在目标周围引发爆炸。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Property: Unavoidable
perks.description: Targets near the blast of Property: Irreducible are [afflicted|burdened|cursed] with an elemental effect matching your equipped grenade's damage type.
perks.descriptionZh: 靠近“属性：不可约简”爆炸范围的目标会受到与你装备的手雷伤害类型相匹配的元素效果的[影响|负累|诅咒]。

perks.name: Moon Scanner
perks.description: Gain a chance to obtain additional resources on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在月球上获得额外的资源。

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.
perks.descriptionZh: 在此武器准备就绪前，使用其他两件武器造成伤害可从弹药储备中填装弹药。提升弹药生成。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Firewalker
perks.description: Roaring Flames improves weapon and ignition damage. You are harder to suspend, slow, and freeze.
perks.descriptionZh: 咆哮烈焰会提升武器和点燃伤害。你更难被悬停、减速和冻结。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Ammo Finder
perks.nameZh: 榴弹发射器弹药搜寻者
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding ammo while you have a Grenade Launcher equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备榴弹发射器后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加弹药储备量。蹲伏时填装、收举和准备速度提高。

perks.name: Effect lasts for 30 minutes.
perks.description: Effect lasts for 30 minutes.
perks.descriptionZh: 效果将持续30分钟。

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 根据填装之前完成的最后一击数可过量填充弹匣, 提高填装速度。

perks.name: Illegal Trigger
perks.description: Every shell fired increases rate of fire for a short time. Magazine size and reserves are increased beyond their normal limits.
perks.descriptionZh: 每发射一发子弹都会暂时提升射速。弹匣容量和弹药储备超出正常限制。

perks.name: Aftershock
perks.description: Final blows create a wave of deadly energy behind the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会在目标后方产生致命能量波。

perks.name: Fragmentation Rounds
perks.description: Precision final blows create multiple explosive submunitions.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会产生多个爆炸子弹药。

perks.name: Cowboy Grip
perks.description: Supremely improved hip fire weapon performance.
perks.descriptionZh: 极度地提升腰射武器性能。

perks.name: Chaotic Munitions
perks.description: Precision final blows produce randomized effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会产生随机效果。

perks.name: Unstable Shells
perks.description: Landing precision hits or most of a pellet spread will attach a delayed explosive to the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成精准命中或散射时大多数弹片命中会附着延迟爆炸物到目标上。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
perks.description: Deep ammo reserves. Fast reload when empty.
perks.descriptionZh: 更多弹药储备。打空时可提高填装速度。

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会填装子弹直至两倍弹匣容量，此填装的速度有所提升。

perks.name: Spark of Ions
perks.description: Defeating a jolted target or defeating a target with Bolt Charge creates an Ionic Trace.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败被震颤的目标或带有电光充能的目标会生成一个离子轨迹。

perks.name: Inferno Whip
perks.description:
Solar melee abilities stun unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日近战技能会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 略微提升瞄准辅助、瞄准速度和空中效率。附近没有盟友时这些效果将提升。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Skittering Stinger
perks.description: Weighted Knife bounces twice and deals bonus damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 权衡飞刀弹跳两次并造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高其射速。

perks.name: Gambit Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in Gambit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.description: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.
perks.descriptionZh: 多次同时造成最后一击会积累可叠加的伤害增益。计时器在下次武器射击时开始；造成最后一击会延长此计时器。

perks.name: Riven's Curse
perks.description: While in the Dreaming City, you deal more damage, but also take more damage from all sources.
perks.descriptionZh: 身处幽梦之城时，对所有目标造成的伤害提高，但受到来自任何来源的伤害也会提高。

perks.name: Modularity (Gambit)
perks.description: Gambit wins have a chance to award an Upgrade Module.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中取胜有几率奖励一个升级模块。

perks.name: Devouring Rift
perks.description: Empowering Rift grants Devour. Damage from inside it [Disruption] disrupts combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 强能裂痕会提供吞食效果。来自内部的伤害会扰乱战斗人员。

perks.name: Counterattack
perks.description: Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在防御后立刻格挡攻击可增加伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高狙击步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会在短时间内增加所有来源的弹药量表进度。

perks.name: Void Leech
perks.description: Leech Void debuffs.
perks.descriptionZh: 榨取虚空减益。

perks.name: Defiant Vexsplosion
perks.description: Adds a Vexsplosion to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex爆炸效果。

perks.name: Matterspark timer removed
perks.nameZh: 已移除物质火花计时器
perks.description: Matterspark timer removed
perks.descriptionZh: 已移除物质火花计时器

perks.name: Harmonic Resonance
perks.description: Equipping multiple weapons from this set grants this weapon improved reload speed and handling. It also deals increased damage versus targets wielding Light and Darkness.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备此套装中的多件武器可为此武器提供更多填装速度和操控性，并增加对操控光能与暗影之力目标的伤害。

perks.name: Whirlwind Guard
perks.description: [Block]  : Use while wielding your Arc Staff to deflect incoming projectiles. Deflecting projectiles triples Arc Staff damage for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: [格挡]  ：挥舞你的电弧法杖时使用以反射向你射来的弹道。反射弹道可使电弧法杖的伤害在短时间内变成三倍。

perks.name: Enhanced Projectile Speed
perks.description: +10 Projectile Speed
perks.descriptionZh: +10 射弹速度

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭一个目标会向附近目标蔓延灼烧效果。
更强大的战斗人员和敌方守护者会在更大的范围内造成灼烧效果。

perks.name: Ember of Char
perks.description: Your Solar ignitions spread scorch to affected targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的烈日点燃可将灼烧效果蔓延至受影响的目标。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.
perks.descriptionZh: 可提升弹药和备弹，但会减少伤害。爆炸范围和填装速度将轻微降低。

perks.name: Blind Clutch
perks.description: Adds a mysterious appearance to O Bearer Mine's transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为“我的宿主”传送效果添加一个神秘外观。

perks.name: Harpy's Cry
perks.description: Adds a Vex Harpy appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex机甲女妖外观。

perks.name: Shattered Shrieker
perks.description: Adds a Hive Shrieker appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个邪魔族死灵外观。

perks.name: Blackheart Growth
perks.description: Adds a nightmarish appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个噩梦外观。

perks.name: Supreme Shardmaker
perks.description: Casting your Super spawns three Stasis shards near you.
perks.descriptionZh: 释放你的超能会在你周围生成三块冰影碎片。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Sniper Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化狙击步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高狙击步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Planetary Torrent
perks.description: Rift periodically releases an Arc shockwave.
perks.descriptionZh: 裂痕定期释放一个电弧冲击波。

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。近战和手雷最后一击会造成更多额外伤害，而且可叠加。

perks.name: Unflinching Shotgun Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用霰弹枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Unstoppable Force
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可在短时间内提高射弹伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Taken Predator
perks.description: Bonus damage against Taken enemies and Gambit invaders.
perks.descriptionZh: 对傀儡敌人和智谋入侵者造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Line 'Em Up
perks.description: Enables precision damage with Golden Gun. Precision hits with Golden Gun generate Orbs of Power, increase its damage, and extend its duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 黄金枪可以造成精准伤害。使用黄金枪精准命中可生成能量球，提高其伤害并延长其持续时间。

perks.name: Volatile Flow
perks.description: Picking up a Void elemental well grants your Void weapons Volatile rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾起一个虚空元素井会给你的虚空武器装上不稳定弹药。

perks.name: Lead From Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power causes your next final blow with this weapon to grant bonus Special ammo meter progress. Increases the stack count limit.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后，此武器造成的下一次最后一击将提供额外特殊弹药量表进度。提升可叠加次数上限。

perks.name: Wayfinder's Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Wayfinder's Compass appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个寻迹者罗盘外观。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Rifle Aim
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming any Rifle-class weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用任意步枪类武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Solar Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用烈日分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Hand Cannon
perks.description: Your equipped Hand Cannons fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手炮会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Augmented Servos
perks.description: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用充能近战击败目标时额外释放一道迷失脉冲。

perks.name: God-like Judgment
perks.description: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被战斗人员击破，或你使用超能时，发射大量追踪热源的微型导弹。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Scout Rifle Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定斥候步枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用斥候步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Facet of Devotion
perks.description: Defeating targets afflicted with [Stasis] Stasis or [Strand] Strand debuffs grants bonus Light Transcendence energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败受到冰影或缚丝减益效果影响的目标会提供额外光能超凡能量。

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成伤害可逐渐减少后坐力和抖动。

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次最后一击都能提高充能/拉弓速度，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Ashes to Assets
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on grenade kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Sugar Rush
perks.description: Adds a sugar rush appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个摄糖兴奋外观。

perks.name: Tangled Shore Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional resources in the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在纷争海岸上获得额外的资源。

perks.name: Precise Jolts
perks.description: Rapid precision hits with Arc weapons jolt the target. Must have an Arc subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用电弧武器快速精准命中可震颤目标。必须装备电弧分支职业。

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中三个不同目标可提高伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼
perks.description: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼

perks.name: Cobra Totemic
perks.description: Improved weapon ready speed, reload, and melee range.
perks.descriptionZh: 更快的武器准备和填装速度，更大的近战范围。

perks.name: Medieval Champion
perks.description: Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Glaives are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的偃月可发射一枚高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间偃月将始终过充。

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.description: Grants greatly increased reload speed when close to full magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 接近满弹匣时赋予大幅提高的填装速度。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼

perks.name: Anti-Praetorian
perks.description: Defeating a Praetorian grants you Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭禁卫军可获得超能能量。

perks.name: Anti-Oracle
perks.description: Defeating an Oracle grants you Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭神谕可获得超能能量。

perks.name: All at Once
perks.description: Hold fire to load; release for a burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 按住射击进行填装；松开发射所有填装弹药。

perks.name: The Fundamentals
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Changes this weapon's damage type.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ：改变武器的伤害类型。

perks.name: Bandolier
perks.description: Grants increased ammo generation and magazine size.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升弹药生成速度和弹匣容量。

perks.name: Enhanced Accuracy
perks.description: +10 Accuracy
perks.descriptionZh: +10 精度

perks.name: Sharp Harvest
perks.description: Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供特殊弹药。

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine an improved amount. Bows receive improved draw time and Swords receive improved charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 在盟友附近填装会过量填充更多弹药进入弹匣。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度更快。

perks.name: Infernal
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭目标后填装可大幅改善目标捕获能力和瞄准速度，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.description: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 投身战斗一小段时间会提升操控性和稳定性。

perks.name: Well Prepared
perks.description: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药提供护甲充能。每层护甲充能都会提供生命值属性加成。

perks.name: Down the Line
perks.description: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
perks.descriptionZh: 对初级首领、勇士和首领造成持续伤害会提升对基础和强力战斗人员造成的武器伤害。每次造成武器最后一击时消耗一层。

perks.name: Heavy Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡拥有较高综合防御，但拥有较低充能效率。

perks.name: Snowstorm
perks.description: Defeat combatants to generate snowballs.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败战斗人员来生成雪球。

perks.name: Spark of Mobility
perks.description: Spark of Mobility
perks.descriptionZh: 敏捷火花

perks.name: Submachine Gun Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Submachine Gun ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的微型冲锋枪弹药储量。

perks.name: Scatter Charge
perks.description: Enhanced Scatter Grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化散射手雷

perks.name: Kinetic Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高动能武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Big Boom
perks.description: Defeating an enemy with Explosive Shadow causes a final explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 用爆炸暗影击败敌人会引起一次最终爆炸。

perks.name: Gunpowder Gamble
perks.description:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised [Solar] Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a [Solar] Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败目标可充能临时烈日爆炸。

[手雷]：投掷出可在半空被击中，造成点燃的烈日爆炸。

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在此武器收起时使用武器或技能完成最后一击可提高其操控性、稳定性和填装速度，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Sharp Shooting
perks.description: Greatly increases the duration and effectiveness of the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and the Veist Stinger Origin Trait.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高“特克斯平衡枪托”和“Veist尖刺”原始特性的持续时间和效果。

perks.name: Resilient Retrofit
perks.description: Increases resilience by +5.
perks.descriptionZh: 韧性+5。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善手炮的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高脉冲步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Energy Diffusion Substrate
perks.description: Gain a small amount of resistance to all damage dealt to you by combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅减少战斗人员对你造成的伤害。

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣内的部分弹药造成精准伤害后可赋予此武器一段更长时间的额外伤害。在填装或是收起武器时重置命中数量。

perks.name: Helping Hand
perks.description: Final blows charge this weapon. When the weapon is charged, the next final blow creates a healing burst at your location and leaves a remnant behind that provides restoration to allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会给此武器充能。当武器充满时，下次最后一击会在你的位置生成治疗波，并留下能恢复盟友的残余。

perks.name: Bow Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弓箭的收举速度。

perks.name: Queen's Wrath
perks.description: When aiming down sights and fully drawn, gain Truesight. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 满弓瞄准时获得真视效果。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: -20 Grenade ▼
perks.description: -20 Grenade ▼

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Pulse Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的脉冲步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Stasis Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Stasis weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高冰影武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Unstoppable Pulse Rifle
perks.description:
Aiming down Pulse Rifle sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
举枪瞄准脉冲步枪会装载一梭强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: Recoil pattern is more vertical.
perks.descriptionZh: 后坐轨迹更偏向垂直方向

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.description: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 在高热量状态下，此武器造成更高伤害，并使目标在被击败时爆炸。

perks.name: -10 Grenade ▼
perks.description: -10 Grenade ▼

perks.name: Nightmare Fuel
perks.description: Melee and finisher final blows reload and enhance holstered weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战和终结技最后一击会填装并强化枪套中的武器。

perks.name: Area Denial Frame
perks.description: Burst fire Grenade Launcher. Each projectile creates a lingering pool on impact that deals damage over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 具有点射功能的榴弹发射器。每个射弹命中时都会留下一个造成持续伤害的区域。

perks.name: Soul Siphon
perks.description:
Ready this aspect by striking a foe with your powered melee ability.

Once readied, press your melee ability to begin siphoning energy from all combatants in front of you, dealing damage and gathering Overshield and class ability energy from each target.

Soul Siphon's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用充能近战技能打击敌人来准备此星相。

就绪后，按下近战技能，开始从你面前所有战斗人员身上汲取能量，造成伤害并从每个目标身上获取覆盖护盾和职业技能能量。

灵魂虹吸的伤害会根据近战属性强化收益而调整。

perks.name: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
perks.description: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲ /-5 武器 ▼

perks.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perks.description:
Aiming down sights with any Hand Cannon you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意手炮举枪瞄准会装载一个高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Paragon Mod
perks.description: Increases class ability regeneration speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高职业技能的恢复速度。

perks.name: Repair Data
perks.description: Adds a digitized hypercube appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加数字化超立方体外观。

perks.name: Eternal Summer
perks.description: Adds bouncing beach balls to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加弹跳沙滩球。

perks.name: Enhanced Bow Targeting
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善弓箭的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: +10 Weapon ▲
perks.description: +10 Weapon ▲

perks.name: Harbinger's Pulse
perks.description: Multikills with Void damage immediately reload this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空伤害造成多杀会立即从储备弹药中填装此武器。

perks.name: Siphoned Glyphkeeper
perks.description: Killing a Glyphkeeper grants some grenade, class, and Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭一个雕文守护者可获得一些手雷、职业和超能能量。

perks.name: Causality Arrows
perks.description:
•  Arrows fired while aiming down sights cause Sacred Flames to instantly detonate.

 •  Precision hits with perfectly drawn arrows increase the power of this detonation.
perks.descriptionZh:
•  举弓瞄准后发射的箭矢会立即引爆神圣之焰。

 •  完美拉弓并精准命中可提升此引爆的威力。

perks.name: Overload Scout Rifle
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits on combatants with any Scout Rifle you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

After any member of your fireteam disrupts a Champion, your Scout Rifles gain a temporary bonus to damage against Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意斥候步枪对战斗人员的连续命中可扰乱敌人并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

任意火力战队成员扰乱勇士后，你的斥候步枪获得对勇士的临时伤害加成。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Linear Fusion Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的线性融合步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Void Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Void weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善虚空武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: +20 Weapon ▲
perks.description: +20 Weapon ▲

perks.name: Electrostatic Mind
perks.description:
Defeating targets with Arc abilities or defeating jolted or blinded targets creates an Ionic Trace.

Collecting an Ionic Trace makes you amplified.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧技能击败目标，或者击败被震颤或致盲的目标会产生一个离子轨迹。

收集离子轨迹会使你进入增幅状态。

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves to an improved degree.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装此武器将随机从储存弹药中填装更多弹药。

perks.name: Enhanced Submachine Gun Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型微型冲锋枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善微型冲锋枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Targeting Adjuster
perks.description: Greatly increases targeting acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升目标获取能力。

perks.name: Burning Maul
perks.description: Summon a flaming maul and crush enemies with the force of an earthquake.
perks.descriptionZh: 召唤一支燃烧的大锤，用地震的力量碾碎敌人。

perks.name: Solar Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Solar weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高烈日武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Stormbringer
perks.description: Rapid precision hits create a lightning storm at the point of impact and grant a stack of Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中会在命中位置制造一场闪电风暴，并提供一层电光充能。

perks.name: Amplified Candy
perks.description: Collect Candy to become amplified.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集糖果以进入增幅状态。

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高腰际射击时的命中率、稳定性和精准命中能力。

perks.name: Honed Edge
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Consume the magazine and load a more powerful round.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ： 消耗弹匣以填充一枚更强大的弹药。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Fusion Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的融合步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Shrapnel Launcher
perks.description: Powerful short-range Solar burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 强大的近距离烈日冲击。

perks.name: Well of Restoration
perks.description: Picking up a Stasis elemental well grants you additional energy for your ability that has the lowest energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取一个冰影元素井会赋予当前能量最少的技能能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

perks.name: Elemental Time Dilation
perks.description: Elemental well mods that grant you time-limited benefits can now stack, increasing the duration of the effect for each copy of the mod you have equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 赋予你限时加成的元素井模组现在可以叠加效果了。效果的持续时间会随着同款模组的装备数量而增加。

perks.name: Supreme Wellmaker
perks.description: Casting your Super spawns three Stasis elemental wells near you. Does not apply to Crucible, Trials, or Iron Banner.
perks.descriptionZh: 释放你的超能会在你周围生成三个冰影元素井。在熔炉竞技场、试炼或铁旗中无效。

perks.name: Elemental Shards
perks.description: Stasis shards count as Stasis elemental wells for you. Does not apply to Crucible, Trials, or Iron Banner.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰影碎片现在对你等同于冰影元素井。在熔炉竞技场、试炼或铁旗中无效。

perks.name: Lethal Current
perks.description:
After dodging, your next melee attack has increased lunge range, jolts the target, and creates a damaging aftershock.

Damaging any jolted target with melee attacks also blinds them.
perks.descriptionZh:
在闪身之后，下一记近战攻击会增加前冲距离，使目标震颤，并产生破坏性的余震。

使用近战攻击对任何震颤的目标造成伤害，也会使其致盲。

perks.name: Gathering Light
perks.description: Stowing weapon restores ability energy based on final blows.
