perks.descriptionZh: 收起武器会根据最后一击恢复技能能量。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Heavy Ammo Scout
perks.description: When you fill your Heavy ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Heavy ammo for your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你填满重型弹药量表时，也会为盟友生成较小的重型弹药盒。

perks.name: Stormbringer
perks.description: Rapid final blows create a lightning storm.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速最后一击会生成一场闪电风暴。

perks.name: EDZ Glimmer Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 欧洲无人区微光回收利用
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Unstoppable Fusion Rifles
perks.description:
Aiming down sights for a brief period with any Fusion Rifle you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Fusion Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意融合步枪举枪瞄准一段时间会装载一个强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Piercing Sidearms
perks.description: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Machine Guns
perks.description:
Shots from Machine Guns you are wielding disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Machine Guns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的机枪射出的子弹可扰乱战斗人员，使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复，并使其疲惫。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间机枪将始终过充。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Unstoppable Glaive
perks.description: Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Glaives are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的偃月可发射一枚强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间偃月将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle
perks.description:
Sniper Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Sniper Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的狙击步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间狙击步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Rocket Launcher
perks.description:
Shortly after you ready or reload a Rocket Launcher, damage from that weapon stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Additionally, Rocket Launchers are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
在你准备或填装火箭发射器之后不久，该武器造成的伤害会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间火箭发射器将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Trace Rifles
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Trace Rifle causes the beam to stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的追踪步枪不间断开火可以使光束眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并使其疲惫。

克制过载勇士。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Improved Tangled Shore Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版纷争海岸缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Auto Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高自动步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Gladitorial Entrance
perks.description: Adds a chain-breaking appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个锁链断裂外观。

perks.name: Paint the Target
perks.description: With the scanner augment, powerful targets are marked by precision shots and take increased damage for a short period.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有扫描增益时，遭到精准命中的强大目标会被标记，短时间内受到的伤害提高。

perks.name: Ghost Gold
perks.description: Adds a gold Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金色机灵环。

perks.name: Spark of Frequency
perks.description:
Melee hits increase your equipped weapon's reload speed and stability for a short duration.

While amplified, the effects are increased and you gain increased stacks of Bolt Charge from all sources.
perks.descriptionZh:
近战命中会在短时间内提升你已装备武器的填装速度和稳定性。

处于增幅状态时，效果获得提升，并且你会从所有来源获得更多电光充能层数。

perks.name: Power Loader
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会提供特殊弹药进度。

perks.name: Terminal Velocity
perks.description: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升主弹药武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Ember of Empyrean
perks.description: Solar weapon or ability final blows extend the duration of restoration and radiant effects applied to you.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日武器或技能最后一击可延长施加在自身的恢复和焕光效果的持续时间。

perks.name: Weapons Forged
perks.description: +3 Weapons
perks.descriptionZh: +3 武器

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准此武器一小段时间而不射击，你将能够削弱下一个目标。计时器在射击或停止瞄准后重置。

perks.name: Resonance Siphon
perks.description: Gain [Stasis] Stasis ability energy whenever you or a member of your fireteam stuns a Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 每当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，获得冰影技能能量。

perks.name: Tome of Dawn
perks.description: Aiming in midair holds you in place while you have a Solar super equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备烈日超能时，在空中瞄准可保持稳定姿态。

perks.name: Fusion Harness
perks.description: Extra Fusion Grenade. Grenade kills charge Rift.
perks.descriptionZh: 额外融合手雷。手雷击杀充能裂痕。

perks.name: Silkstrike
perks.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
perks.descriptionZh:
编织出一根毒辣的绳镖，刺穿你的目标。

[轻攻击]  ：向前方投掷绳镖以造成伤害。绳镖尖会造成额外伤害，用镖尖击败目标会使其爆炸。

[重攻击]  ：以圆周运动挥动绳镖，对周围一切造成重创。

[手雷]  ：使用抓钩来迅速向前移动。

perks.name: Ballistics
perks.description: Grants increased range and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高射程和稳定性。

perks.name: Air Assault
perks.description: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可为空中效率提供叠加加成。在空中时最后一击可提供更多层数。

perks.name: Wolfpack Rounds
perks.description: Creates tracking micro-missiles on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中时生成追踪微型导弹。

perks.name: Division Computed
perks.description:
Adds a division computed appearance to your transmat effects.

This effect will change to reflect your current Competitive Division in Crucible.
perks.descriptionZh:
为你的传送效果添加一个级别结算外观。

此效果会发生变化，以反映你当前的熔炉竞技场多人竞技级别。

perks.name: En Garde
perks.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this Sword do additional damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换至这把刀剑之后立即进行快速攻击可造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Quick Access Sling
perks.description: Greatly increases this weapon's ready and stow speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升此武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 线性融合步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善线性融合步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Timed Payload
perks.description: Projectiles attached to targets explode after a short delay. Increases stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 射弹可粘附在目标上，并在短暂延迟后爆炸。提高稳定性。

perks.name: Enhanced Grenade Launcher Dexterity
perks.nameZh: 强化型榴弹发射器灵巧
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高榴弹发射器的收举速度。

perks.name: Seriously, Watch Out
perks.description: Improves Juggernaut. Allies who follow closely gain speed boost.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升无畏护甲。紧随其后的盟友可获得速度加成。

perks.name: +15 Health ▲
perks.description: +15 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +15 生命值 ▲

perks.name: Guiding Light
perks.description: All XP gains increased by 10%.
perks.descriptionZh: 所有获得的经验值增加10%。

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会根据目标身上被施加的每个元素减益效果造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Enhanced Pulse Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型脉冲步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高脉冲步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Truth to Power
perks.description: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害或最后一击时获得递增的伤害抗性。终结技提供更快的进度。层数叠满时，你的技能充能速度也将获得提升。

perks.name: Queensfoil Rush
perks.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技时获得一个强大的覆盖护盾。终结目标时，在你周围释放一次减速爆发。

perks.name: Search Party
perks.description: This weapon is granted an improved amount of aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.
perks.descriptionZh: 在附近没有盟友的情况下瞄准时，此武器提供更多的瞄准速度和移动速度加成。

perks.name: Spheromatik Trigger
perks.description: Powered melee kills and finishers unleash explosions.
perks.descriptionZh: 强大近战击杀和终结技将释放爆炸。

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Significantly increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 若附近无目标，大幅提升填装、射程和精度。

perks.name: Echo of Reprisal
perks.description: Final blows when surrounded by combatants grant Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 被战斗人员包围时的最后一击将赋予超能能量。

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies. Handling is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 在两个或更多盟友身边时，武器造成的精准伤害增加。提高操控性。

perks.name: Shotgun Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善霰弹枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Encore
perks.description:
Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
Effect duration is improved.
perks.descriptionZh:
最后一击可为此武器提供稳定性、射程及精度的叠加加成。精准最后一击可提供更多层数。
效果持续时间延长。

perks.name: Double Down
perks.description: Improves Threaded Specter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升线织幽灵。

perks.name: Edge of Intent
perks.description: Charge weapon to enable special projectile attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能武器来启用特殊射弹攻击。

perks.name: Tithing Harvest
perks.description: While Creeping Attrition is active, destroying Stasis crystals or landing precision final blows creates a Stasis shard. The Stasis shard returns to you, and collecting Stasis shards refills the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 在蔓延羸弱生效时，摧毁冰影水晶或造成精准最后一击会生成冰影碎片。冰影碎片可返回给你，收集冰影碎片可填装弹匣。

perks.name: Nano-Munitions
perks.description: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.description: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 电池充满时，你的下一次点射获得提升，造成额外伤害并使目标在被击败时爆炸。

perks.name: Heavy Lifting
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy from Power weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 威能武器击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Ardent Adoration
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

perks.name: tier1_mod1
perks.description: tier1_mod1
perks.descriptionZh: tier1_mod1

perks.name: tier1_mod2
perks.description: tier1_mod2
perks.descriptionZh: tier1_mod2

perks.name: tier1_mod3
perks.description: tier1_mod3
perks.descriptionZh: tier1_mod3

perks.name: tier1_mod4
perks.description: tier1_mod4
perks.descriptionZh: tier1_mod4

perks.name: Unstoppable Fusion
perks.description:
Aiming down sights for a brief period with any Fusion Rifle you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Fusion Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意融合步枪举枪瞄准一段时间会装载一个强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon increases reload speed and Sword charge rate and slightly increases damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成持续伤害会提升填装速度和刀剑充能速度，并略微提升伤害。

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description:
The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
Base blast radius is also improved.
perks.descriptionZh:
当被战斗人员包围时，此武器的爆炸范围会增大。启用时，此武器对持有者造成的伤害会大幅降低。
基础爆炸范围增大。

perks.name: Amped Up
perks.description: Stay amplified longer while your Arc or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或棱镜分支职业时增幅状态保持得更久。

perks.name: Thunderous Retort
perks.description: Grants bonus Arc Super damage if cast while critically wounded or while amplified. Lasts until the end of the Super activation.
perks.descriptionZh: 在重伤或增幅状态下施放可获得电弧超能伤害加成。持续至超能激活结束。

perks.name: Improved Unraveling
perks.description: Increases the amount of damage dealt by unraveling a target.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高瓦解目标造成的伤害。

perks.name: Deeper Origins
perks.description: Greatly improves the benefits provided by the Unsated Hunger, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Harmonic Resonance, and Noble Deeds traits.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升未足之饥、纳米技术追踪火箭、和谐回声和高尚事迹特性提供的增益。

perks.name: Unto the Breach
perks.description: Defeating a Void debuffed target creates a Void Breach while your Void or Prismatic subclass is equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备虚空或棱镜分支职业时击败受虚空减益效果影响的目标可生成一个虚空裂口。

perks.name: Chaotic Motion
perks.description:
Provides a non-stacking benefit to blast radius and decreases self-damage. Damaging yourself launches you further than usual.

Rapid final blows with this weapon are guaranteed to drop an enhanced Heavy ammo brick.
perks.descriptionZh:
提供对爆炸范围的不可叠加增益，并降低自我伤害。对自己造成伤害时，你被推行的距离比平常更远。

使用此武器打出快速最后一击时，必定掉落一个强化的重型弹药盒。

perks.name: Overflowing Holster
perks.description:
This weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time while holstered.

This effect completely ignores magazine size.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器在收回枪套一小段时间后会自动填装弹药。

此效果完全无视弹匣容量。

perks.name: Fikrul's Friends
perks.description: This weapon summons allied mini Screebs on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器在命中时会召唤友方迷你变异体。

perks.name: Kismet
perks.description: Allows shields to slowly recharge into an overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 护盾会缓慢充能形成覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高榴弹发射器的填装速度。

perks.name: Noble Deeds
perks.description: Gain charges by assisting your allies with revives, healing, overshields, and subclass buffs. Consume charges by defeating combatants. While charged, this weapon is granted bonus handling, reload speed, and sword charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过使用复活、治疗、覆盖护盾和分支职业增益协助盟友来获得充能。击败战斗人员会消耗充能。充能时，此武器可获得更高的操控性、填装速度和刀剑充能速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Will of Light (Void)
perks.description: Your equipped weapons that deal Void damage deal increased damage to Taken combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的虚空伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Charged Up
perks.description: Increases the maximum number of stacks of Armor Charge you can carry by 1.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加1层你可携带的最大护甲充能层数。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 在赫拉斯盆地中获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Hand Cannon Aim
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用手炮瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Mercy
perks.description: First loss has been forgiven.
perks.descriptionZh: 首场失利已被宽恕。

perks.name: Enhanced Bow Loader
perks.description: Greatly increases nock speed of Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高弓箭的搭弦速度。

perks.name: Guardian Green
perks.description: Adds a green Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色守护者纹章。

perks.name: Unplanned Reprieve
perks.description: Heavy attacks emit delayed detonating projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 重攻击会发射延时引爆射弹。

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.description: Greatly increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.
perks.descriptionZh: 蹲伏射击时可大幅提高精度、稳定性和操控性。

perks.name: Union of Strength
perks.description: Increased resilience when you're in a fireteam with clanmates.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你与公会队友同处一个火力战队时，韧性提高。

perks.name: Hailstorm
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage and begin to steadily reload the magazine from reserves until you stop firing.
perks.descriptionZh: 击杀会提高武器伤害，同时在停止射击前会持续将弹药从储存弹药中转移至弹匣。

perks.name: Golden Gun: Marksman
perks.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一把精准烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

你的黄金枪可造成大幅增加的精准伤害，穿透目标，并在精准命中时生成能量球。

可从焕光状态中获益。

perks.name: Golden Gun: Deadshot
perks.description:
Summon a rapid-fire flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Final blows with this weapon refund a Golden Gun round and extend your super duration.

Benefits from being radiant.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一把速射烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光灼烧并裂解目标。

使用此武器造成最后一击将返还一枚黄金枪弹药，并延长你的超能持续时间。

可从焕光状态中获益。

perks.name: Blade Barrage
perks.description: Vault into the air and unleash a volley of Solar-charged knives that explode and scorch targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 跃向空中并释放一连串会爆炸并灼烧目标的烈日能量飞刀。

perks.name: Mobile Retrofit
perks.description: Increases mobility by +5.
perks.descriptionZh: 敏捷+5。

perks.name: Bow Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弓箭的收举速度。

perks.name: In-Flight Compensator
perks.description: Increases the airborne effectiveness of all equipped weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加所有已装备武器的空中效率。

perks.name: Legacy Ambush
perks.description: Increases the duration and effectiveness of the Ambush Origin Trait and the Bray Inheritance Origin Trait.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化“伏击”和“布瑞遗产”原始特性的持续时间和效果。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Grenade Launchers over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的榴弹发射器装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 装填此武器将随机从备弹中多填装弹药。

perks.name: Beacon Rounds
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed for an improved duration. Dealing further damage extends the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可为射弹提供追踪能力并增加填装速度，效果持续时间延长。造成更多伤害可延长持续时间。

perks.name: Scissor Fingers
perks.description: Grants two knives per charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次充能提供两枚飞刀。

perks.name: Shield Break Charge
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with the matching damage type grants you Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 用匹配的伤害类型击破战斗人员的护盾可获得护甲充能。

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Arc
perks.description: While using an Arc subclass, Arc weapon final blows have a chance to spawn an Arc Elemental Orb. Arc Orbs can be thrown to create an Arc explosion that jolts targets it damages.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用电弧分支职业时，电弧武器最后一击有几率生成一个电弧元素能量球。电弧能量球可被投掷出去造成一次电弧爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加震颤效果。

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Solar
perks.description: While using a Solar subclass, Solar weapon final blows have a chance to spawn a Solar Elemental Orb. Solar Orbs can be thrown to create a Solar explosion that scorches targets it damages.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日分支职业时，烈日武器最后一击有几率生成一个烈日元素能量球。烈日能量球可被投掷出去造成一次烈日爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加灼烧效果。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization II
perks.description: Weapons with the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 在该修改器生效时，带有热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性的武器将始终过充。

perks.name: Elemental Orbs: Void
perks.description: While using a Void subclass, Void weapon final blows have a chance to spawn a Void Elemental Orb. Void Orbs can be thrown to create a Void explosion that makes enemies it damages volatile.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空分支职业时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空元素能量球。虚空能量球可被投掷出去造成一次虚空爆炸，对造成伤害的目标施加不稳定效果。

perks.name: Thanatotic Tangles
perks.description: Strand weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Tangle.
perks.descriptionZh: 缚丝武器最后一击有几率生成一个缠结。

perks.name: Super Font
perks.description: You gain a bonus to your Super stat while you have any Armor Charge. Armor Charges decay over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外超能属性。护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sidearm
perks.description:
Grants weapon shield-piercing, bypassing combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
赐予武器 护盾穿透特性，击穿敌人的防御。

克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Iron Lord's Pride
perks.description: Grants a chance to receive an Enhancement Prism as a reward at the end of Iron Banner matches.
perks.descriptionZh: 使你在铁旗比赛结束时有机会获得增强棱镜奖励。

perks.name: Pick Your Poison
perks.description:
Hipfiring: Projectiles will track marked targets, dealing increased body shot damage on impact.

Aiming: Projectiles have greatly increased velocity and cause extra damage when dealing precision final blows to marked targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
腰射时：射弹追击已标记的目标，命中时造成更高的身体射击伤害。

瞄准时：射弹拥有大幅提升的速度，并且对已标记的目标进行精准最后一击时造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Helping Hands
perks.description: Final blows with bonus damage rounds build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow Sturm and Together Forever weapons at a massively increased rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用额外伤害弹药造成最后一击会积累和存储充能，极大地提升你切换和收起狂飙和永不分离武器的速度。

perks.name: Class Sigil Effects
perks.description: Adds a class sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个职业印记。

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害会灼烧目标。对被灼烧的目标造成伤害会施加灼烧效果。

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay.
perks.descriptionZh: 箭矢在短暂延迟后爆炸。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Dead Weight
perks.description: Increases how quickly Dark Descent reaches its full potential.
perks.descriptionZh: 加快黑暗后裔达到其全部潜能的速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Magnificent Duty
perks.description: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你陷入生命危急或治疗生命危急的盟友时，自动步枪、斥候步枪和手枪会暂时获得射程、稳定性和填装速度提升。

perks.name: Pleas Heard
perks.description: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成最后一击后填装自动步枪、斥候步枪或手枪可缓慢恢复生命值，直至你重新进入战斗。

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会产生元素伤害爆炸，该爆炸会根据先前造成的快速精准命中次数造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at an additionally improved rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会储存多股能量，使你切换和收举此武器的速度大幅增加。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Sidearm Aim
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用手枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: You're Welcome
perks.description: Detects caches and resources within a 75-meter range on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上探测75米范围内的缓存箱和资源。

perks.name: Sharp Harvest
perks.description: Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 时间窗口延长的短时间内进行三次轻攻击可提供特殊弹药。

perks.name: Swordmaster's Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has low overall defenses, but increases charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑格挡拥有较低综合防御，但充能效率增加。

perks.name: Aeon Energy
perks.description: Melee grants energy to nearby Aeon Cultists.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战可让附近永劫教派盟友获得能量。

perks.name: Reflex Brackets Mod
perks.description: Improves weapon handling for equipped Power weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善已装备威能武器的操控性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Insectoid Robot Grenades
perks.description: Final blows deploy homing robot grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击将会部署引导机器人榴弹。

perks.name: Drengr's Lash
perks.description:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活屏障技能来在现实世界中生成一道沿着地面向前传播的涟漪，悬停击中的目标并对其造成伤害。

对受到悬停、瓦解或断舍影响的目标造成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Lesser Core Harvest (Crucible)
perks.nameZh: 次级核心收割（熔炉竞技场）
perks.description: Precision final blows in Crucible have a chance to award an Enhancement Core.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场取得精准最后一击有几率奖励一个强化核心。

perks.name: Greater Core Harvest (Crucible)
perks.nameZh: 高级核心收割（熔炉竞技场）
perks.description: Precision final blows in Crucible have a chance to award an Enhancement Prism.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场取得精准最后一击有几率奖励一个强化棱镜。

perks.name: Shieldcrash Wellmaker
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with a matching weapon type creates an elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用对应的武器类型打破战斗人员护盾可以产生一个元素井。

perks.name: Stylish Executioner
perks.description:
Defeating a weakened, suppressed, or volatile target grants Invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败虚弱的、被压制的、或不稳定的目标可获得隐身和真视。

在完成一次潇洒处刑后，你下一次的隐身近战攻击会使目标虚弱。

perks.name: Unflinching Scout Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用斥候步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Surrounded Spec
perks.description: Increases the damage granted by Surrounded. Bonus damage lingers for a brief time when no longer surrounded by three or more enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高腹背受敌造成的伤害。当周围的敌人小于三人时，额外伤害将会持续一小段时间。

perks.name: Special Ammo Scavenger
perks.description: Gain bonus reserves when you pick up Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊弹药时获得额外弹药。

perks.name: Unflinching Kinetic Aim
perks.description: Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming your Kinetic weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用动能武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.description: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的前半弹匣弹药拥有更高的填装速度和稳定性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Void Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Void weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高虚空武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Thermoclastic Strike
perks.description:
Solar and Stasis melees disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Refresh your melee ability whenever you or a member of your fireteam stuns an Overload Champion.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日和冰影近战会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。每当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕过载勇士时，刷新你的近战技能。

perks.name: Flutter By
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会在短时间内提升爆炸的范围。

perks.name: Facet of Grace
perks.description: Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器击败目标会为你提供额外超凡能量。使用超能击败目标会为你和附近盟友提供额外超凡能量。

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的每个快速击杀将在短时间内累积增加装填速度。

perks.name: Harmonic Resonance
perks.description: Equipping multiple weapons from this set grants this weapon increased reload speed and handling. It also deals increased damage versus targets wielding Light and Darkness.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备此套装中的多件武器可增加此武器的填装速度和操控性，并增加对操控光能与暗影之力目标的伤害。

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器命中身体部位可在短时间内提高精准伤害和瞄准辅助。特性激活时命中身体射击可刷新时长。

perks.name: Lightweight Frame
perks.description:
Fast movement.
[Heavy Attack]  : Dash attack.
perks.descriptionZh:
快速移动。
[重攻击] ：前冲攻击。

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里返还两枚弹药。增加精准命中之间的时间间隔。

perks.name: Specialist Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Specialist archetype, which has Class as its primary stat and Weapons as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落专家框架：职业为主要属性，武器为次要属性。

perks.name: Forgotten Treasures
perks.description: When you redeem a Salvage Key or a Deep Dive Key, you have a chance to earn an additional Deep Engram.
perks.descriptionZh: 兑换回收密钥或深渊潜水密钥时，你有一定几率获得额外的深渊记忆水晶。

perks.name: Thermoclastic Blooming
perks.description: Defeating a combatant with a Solar or Stasis melee creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日或冰影近战攻击消灭战斗人员会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision final blows greatly decrease reload time for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击可大幅缩短填装时间，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Head Rush
perks.description: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of improved bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 下蹲一段时间后起身或者滑行会使此武器在短时间内提升更多操控性和填装速度，以及对邪魔族战斗人员的伤害。

perks.name: Primary Survivor
perks.description: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
perks.descriptionZh: 当一名盟友被击败时，提高主弹药武器的操控性、填装速度、目标捕获能力并减轻抖动。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成提升。

perks.name: Primary Phantom
perks.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击将使你暂时从雷达中消失。举起非主弹药武器将立即中断此效果。

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.description: This weapon has improved reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的前半弹匣弹药拥有进一步提升的填装速度和稳定性。

perks.name: Häkke Light Burst Fire
perks.description: Fires a stable burst of four lightweight rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 稳定地连续发射四发轻型子弹。

perks.name: Deeper Pockets
perks.description: Increased ammo reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加弹药储备量。

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs for an improved duration and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
造成持续伤害可提供对载具和构造体的额外伤害，效果持续时间延长，并从备弹中填充弹药。主弹药伤害或对构造体的伤害可提供额外进度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Strand Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Strand damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自敌方战斗人员的缚丝伤害。

perks.name: Randomized Perks
perks.description: This item comes with randomized perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 此物品自带随机特性。

perks.name: Sundering Glare
perks.description: Rapid precision hits against distant combatants weaken them for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对远距离战斗人员的精准命中会在短时间内削弱他们。

perks.name: Shotgun Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高霰弹枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Land Tank
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased health and improved damage resistance from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供更高的生命值以及更多对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Wave Sword Frame
perks.description:
Heavy attack deploys a shockwave uppercut and launches the user into the air.
An immediate follow-up swing after the uppercut deploys a homing strike that aggressively seeks a target.
perks.descriptionZh:
重攻击会激发一股上行震荡波，将使用者抛到空中。
在上行震荡波发生后立即进行后续攻击，会发射一次主动搜寻目标的制导打击。

perks.name: Color Variants
perks.description: This transmat effect may be awarded in gold, green, pink, or purple color variants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此传送效果可能出现金色、绿色、粉色或紫色变幻。

perks.name: Enhanced Sidearm Targeting
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善手枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Ager's Call
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon slow nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可使周围目标减速。

perks.name: Prismatic Inferno
perks.description: Fires a beam that generates a heat field.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射出一道能产生热力场的光束。

perks.name: Spark of Shock
perks.description: Your Arc grenades jolt targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的电弧手雷会震颤目标。

perks.name: Spotlight Effects
perks.description: Adds spotlights to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束聚光灯。

perks.name: Understand basic words and concepts in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
perks.nameZh: 理解艾昂人的基本词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。
perks.description: Understand basic words and concepts in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
perks.descriptionZh: 理解艾昂人的基本词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。

perks.name: Understand most words and sentence structures in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
perks.nameZh: 理解艾昂人的大多数词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。
perks.description: Understand most words and sentence structures in Aionian, allowing for a greater range of linguistic interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
perks.descriptionZh: 理解艾昂人的大多数词汇和概念，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行更广泛的语言交互。

perks.name: Understand advanced and technical concepts in the Aionian language, allowing full depth of translation.
perks.nameZh: 理解艾昂人语言中的高级和技术概念，实现完全的深度翻译。
perks.description: Understand advanced and technical concepts in the Aionian language, allowing full depth of translation.
perks.descriptionZh: 理解艾昂人语言中的高级和技术概念，实现完全的深度翻译。

perks.name: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼
perks.description: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼

perks.name: Supercharged Magazine
perks.description:
While amplified, ammo is gradually transferred from reserves to the magazine.

While in Speed Booster, ammo regenerates faster and overflows the magazine. Improves magazine size.
perks.descriptionZh:
处于增幅状态时，弹药会逐渐从备弹转移到弹匣中。

拥有速度加成时，弹药回复更快并会过量填充弹匣。提升弹匣容量。

perks.name: Knock 'Em Down
perks.description:
Your Solar Supers are enhanced. Deadshot Golden Gun has damage resistance, Marksman Golden Gun has increased duration, and Blade Barrage launches more projectiles.

While radiant, final blows with your equipped Throwing Knife fully refund your melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的烈日超能已得到强化。死亡射击黄金枪获得伤害抗性，神枪手黄金枪持续时间延长，利刃弹幕可发射更多射弹。

拥有焕光效果时，使用已装备的投掷飞刀造成最后一击可完全补偿近战能量。

perks.name: Enhanced Machine Gun Loader
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高机枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Anti-Champion Nosecone
perks.description: Rocket Launchers deal increased damage to Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 火箭发射器对勇士造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Dragon's Bite
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with a Strand or Stasis weapon has a chance to suspend or freeze that combatant.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝或冰影武器打破战斗人员的护盾有几率悬停或冻结该战斗人员。

perks.name: Pillar of Ice
perks.description: Defeating a frozen target spawns Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败被冻结目标会生成冰影水晶。

perks.name: Unravelling Orbs
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会使缚丝武器获得瓦解弹药。

perks.name: Friendly Competition
perks.description: Enables advanced functionality during the Guardian Games.
perks.descriptionZh: 启用守护者游戏中的高级功能。

perks.name: Matterspark timer extended
perks.nameZh: 已延长物质火花计时器
perks.description: Matterspark timer extended
perks.descriptionZh: 已延长物质火花计时器

perks.name: Stop, Stunnertime
perks.description: With no augment, grenades temporarily stun your targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 没有增益时，手雷会暂时眩晕你的目标。

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.description: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害可提升填装速度与操控性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Traveler Entrance
perks.description: Adds the Traveler to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加旅行者特效。

perks.name: Healthy Finisher
perks.description:
Finishers heal you.

Consumes 1 stack of Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技会治疗你。

消耗1层护甲充能。

perks.name: Strength of the Void
perks.description: Increases damage of all Void melee abilities. Gain Super energy from performing finishers with a Void subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高所有虚空近战技能的伤害。装备虚空副职业时施展终结技可获得超能能量。

perks.name: Light Touch
perks.description: This weapon gains increased reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你拥有增幅、焕光，或吞食效果时，此武器获得更多的填装速度、操控性与瞄准速度。

perks.name: Stasis Siphon
perks.description: Rapid Stasis weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速冰影武器最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Contending Cascade
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus handling and reload speed based on your longest chain of rapid final blows from any source. After achieving a less impressive record, final blows with this weapon create an elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会根据你通过任意来源达成的快速最后一击最高多杀数，获得额外操控性和填装速度。达成少量多杀记录后，此武器的最后一击会造成元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Riis-Reborn Key Codes
perks.description: These codes are only activated for a limited time. Find the terminal in the Riis-Reborn Approach.
perks.descriptionZh: 此代码的可激活次数有限。在重生的里斯入口找到终端。

perks.name: Oppressive Darkness
perks.description: Causing damage with a Void grenade adds a weaken effect to combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 用虚空手雷造成伤害会对战斗人员附加削弱效果。

perks.name: Inspiring Presence
perks.description: Increased Vanguard token drops for you and your fireteam in this strike.
perks.descriptionZh: 在此次打击中增加你和你所在火力战队的先锋代币掉落几率。

perks.name: Compressed Wave Frame
perks.description: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹药将在接触到地面时释放一股压缩能量。

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣的大多数弹药直接命中可造成减速附近目标的爆炸。

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.description: Arrows explode after a short delay. Increases accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 箭矢在短暂延迟后爆炸。提高精度。

perks.name: Ensnaring Slam
perks.description:
Activate your air move to consume your class ability energy and dive to the ground, suspending all nearby targets on impact.

Suspending combatants with this ability grants you Woven Mail.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活空中移动来消耗你的职业技能能量并朝地面俯冲，悬停附近所有的目标。

使用此技能悬停战斗人员可为你提供织造铠甲。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Powerful Attraction
perks.description: Automatically collects nearby Orbs of Power when you activate your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活职业技能时自动收集附近的能量球。

perks.name: Iron Gaze
perks.description: Massively improves weapon target acquisition at the cost of a reduced amount of weapon range.
perks.descriptionZh: 以牺牲较少量武器射程为代价，大幅提升武器的目标捕获能力。

perks.name: Accomplice
perks.description: Final blows fill the magazine of Energy weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会填装能量武器的弹匣。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
perks.description: Deep ammo reserves. Fast reload when empty.
perks.descriptionZh: 更多弹药储备。打空时可提高填装速度。

perks.name: Headstone
perks.description: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会在目标附近生成一块冰影水晶。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Void Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可提高其射速，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高融合步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Arc Compounding
perks.description: [Arc] Arc sources deal increased damage to Blind targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧来源对被致盲目标造成的伤害增加。

perks.name: Old God's Rite
perks.description: After picking up a [Void] Void Breach, dealing damage with a Void weapon creates a rain of seeking projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口后，使用虚空武器造成伤害会生成追踪射弹雨。

perks.name: Served Cold
perks.description:
Picking up a [Stasis] Stasis Shard grants you class ability energy. 

Picking up a [Void] Void Breach grants you melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会赋予你职业技能能量。

拾取虚空裂口会赋予你近战能量。

perks.name: Kinetic Impacts
perks.description:
Sustained damage with a Grenade Launcher increases the reload speed of Grenade Launchers and triggers a damaging Kinetic shockwave.

This shockwave can stun [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用榴弹发射器造成持续伤害会提升榴弹发射器的填装速度，并触发造成伤害的动能冲击波。

此冲击波可以眩晕势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Supernova
perks.description: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你的下一次虚空伤害来源生成一次大型的削弱脉冲。

perks.name: Conductive Cosmic Crystal
perks.description: Your [Arc] Arc and [Void] Void abilities deal bonus damage to targets that are affected by a [Stasis] Stasis debuff.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的电弧和虚空技能对受到冰影减益影响的目标造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Brain Freeze
perks.description: Frozen combatants become surrounded by chilling fog, which slows combatants that aren't already.
perks.descriptionZh: 被冻结的战斗人员受到寒冷雾气包围，减速尚未被减速的战斗人员。

perks.name: Permeability
perks.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon. Improves handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的职业技能会将此武器的伤害类型更改为匹配你已装备超能的属性，直到你收起此武器。提升操控性。

perks.name: Serrated Bolts
perks.description:
Recovering a bolt from a living target deals damage.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
perks.descriptionZh:
从存活的目标身上回收弩弹会造成伤害。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

perks.name: Crucible Cash
perks.description: Gain bonus Glimmer when completing Crucible matches.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成熔炉竞技场比赛可获得额外微光。

perks.name: Percussive Flames
perks.description: Burning Maul and Consecration create flame cyclones.
perks.descriptionZh: 燃烧锻锤和神圣献祭会生成火焰旋风。

perks.name: Sidearm Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Strand Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高缚丝武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Problem Solver
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed for a longer duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
对勇士、初级首领或首领战斗人员造成持续伤害会使他们疲惫，并在更长的时间内赋予此武器操控性和填装速度。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Glaive Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition and accuracy for Glaives.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升偃月的目标捕获能力和精度。

perks.name: Vex Incursion Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Vex incursion appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个Vex入侵外观。

perks.name: Swirling Leaf Entrance
perks.description: Adds a green petal appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色花瓣外观。

perks.name: Lightweight Frame
perks.description:
Fast movement.
[Heavy Attack]  : Dash attack.
perks.descriptionZh:
快速移动。
[重攻击] ：前冲攻击。

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.description: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.
perks.descriptionZh: 生命值低下时，使用此武器造成最后一击可提供强化雷达，将你从敌方守护者雷达上移除，并减少战斗人员对你的攻击性。

perks.name: Networked Targeting
perks.description: While Personal Assistant is active, hits grant this weapon and nearby allies' non-Exotic Sniper Rifles increased overall weapon performance and precision damage. Granting maximum stacks of the effect to an ally grants this weapon bonus damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 私人助手生效时，命中目标会提升此武器及附近盟友的非异域狙击步枪的整体武器性能和精准伤害。为盟友提供最大层数效果可为此武器提供额外伤害加成。

perks.name: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Class ▼
perks.description: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Class ▼

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后短时间内填装，可为自身和附近盟友提供治愈。

perks.name: Adept Impact
perks.description: +10 Impact
perks.descriptionZh: +10冲击力

perks.name: And Another Thing
perks.description: Gain an additional grenade charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得额外一枚手雷。

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗时提供更快的填装速度和操控性。刀剑可获得更快的移动速度。

perks.name: Arrow Scavenger
perks.description: Bows that use Heavy ammo get bonus reserves when picking up Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取重型弹药时，使用重型弹药的弓箭获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Sniper Rifles get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Sniper Rifle.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该狙击步枪所用弹药时，狙击步枪获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.description: Grants further increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain even faster movement speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗时提供比之前更快的填装速度和操控性。刀剑可获得比之前更快的移动速度。

perks.name: Exhaustive Research
perks.description: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a homing micro-missile.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准目标一小段时间会填装一枚制导微型导弹。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Auto Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Auto Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的自动步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Scout Rifle
perks.description: Aiming down the sights of a Scout Rifle for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 斥候步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Piercing Bowstring
perks.description:
Bows gain shield-piercing arrows, which bypass combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Bows are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
弓箭射出护盾穿透箭矢，击穿战斗人员的防御。

克制屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，弓箭将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Fusion
perks.description:
Aiming down sights for a brief period with any Fusion Rifle you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Fusion Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意融合步枪举枪瞄准一段时间会装载一个强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间，融合步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Hand Cannon
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits with any Hand Cannon you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用手炮连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能恢复速度并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Bow
perks.description: Your equipped Bows fire shield-piercing broadheads and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的弓箭会发射护盾穿透箭头并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: The Fundamentals
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Change this weapon's damage type.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ：改变武器的伤害类型

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
最后一击会提供电光充能。
处于增幅状态时，最后一击会提供额外的电光充能。

perks.name: Spirit of Caliban
perks.description: Powered melee final blows trigger an ignition.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战最后一击会触发一次点燃。

perks.name: Spirit of the Foetracer
perks.description: Abilities grant bonus weapon damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 技能会提供武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Spirit of Galanor
perks.description: Super hits return Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能命中会返还超能能量。

perks.name: Spirit of the Dragon
perks.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Class ability increases this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的武器准备得更快且更稳定。职业技能会提升此加成。

perks.name: Spirit of the Liar
perks.description: Counterpunch deals extra damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战反击会造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Spirit of the Gyrfalcon
perks.description: Gain volatile rounds after being invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 离开隐身状态后会获得不稳定弹药。

perks.name: Spirit of the Cyrtarachne
perks.description: Grenades grant Woven Mail.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷会提供织造铠甲。

perks.name: Spirit of Renewal
perks.description: Improves Duskfield grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善暮域手雷。

perks.name: Spirit of the Coyote
perks.description: Gain an additional class ability charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得额外一次职业技能充能。

perks.name: Spirit of the Wormhusk
perks.description: Dodging heals you.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身会治疗你。

perks.name: Unflinching Sniper Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用狙击步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Light Touch
perks.description: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你拥有增幅、焕光，或吞食效果时，此武器获得填装速度、操控性与瞄准速度。

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves. Increases range.
perks.descriptionZh: 射击能量球会立即将其拾起。射击弹药盒会立即将其拾取，并自动从储存弹药中填充所有已装备武器的弹药。提高射程。

perks.name: Featherweight
perks.description: Final blows with weapons that have the Featherweight Origin Trait grant increased movement speed while equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备时，使用有羽量原始特性的武器造成最后一击会提升移动速度。

perks.name: Overload Grenades
perks.description: Void grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空手雷会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Hawkeye Hack
perks.description: Golden Gun fires one high-damage shot.
perks.descriptionZh: 黄金枪发射单发高伤害子弹。

perks.name: Upgraded Sensor Pack
perks.description: Provides radar while you're aiming and marks targets, increasing damage to low-health marked targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时可显示雷达并标记目标，提高对低生命值已标记目标的伤害。

perks.name: Energy Vampirism
perks.description: Gain energy for your least-charged ability when you suppress a target.
perks.descriptionZh: 压制目标时可为充能最少的技能补充能量。

perks.name: Slideways
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行可填装武器的一部分弹匣，并暂时性地大幅提高武器操控性和稳定性。

perks.name: Advanced Reflexes
perks.description: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到来自目标的伤害后，使用此武器快速防卫或瞄准目标，可在较长时间内获得额外伤害、操控性和充能速度。

perks.name: Welcoming Party
perks.description: A member of your fireteam is playing the Destiny 2 Trial. Everyone in the fireteam receives bonus XP.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员正在进行《命运2》试玩版。火力战队中的所有成员都将获得额外经验值。

perks.name: Explosive Pact
perks.description: This weapon gains an improved amount of stability and reload speed when activating a grenade ability. Healing grenades and grenade final blows grant additional stacks of the bonus.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器在激活手雷技能时可获得更多的稳定性和填装速度加成。治愈手雷和手雷最后一击可提供额外叠加层数。

perks.name: Revving Up
perks.description: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速移动积累充能，逐渐提升你的生命值回复速度。全速轰鸣时，冲刺会提供速度加成。

perks.name: Dielectric Drift
perks.description: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.
perks.descriptionZh: 速度加成生效时，滑行将震颤你前方的战斗人员。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 微型冲锋枪弹药回收器
perks.description: Submachine Guns get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时微型冲锋枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速元素最后一击和对受元素减益影响的目标造成最后一击，会定期准备一枚制导微型导弹，在此武器下次造成最后一击后从目标位置发射。可准备多枚导弹。

perks.name: Omni-Telemetry
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在任意元素武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Bulwark Finisher
perks.description:
Finisher final blows generate an overshield.

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting a longer duration to the overshield for each charge consumed.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技最后一击会生成一个覆盖护盾。

消耗3层或更多护甲充能。每消耗一层，会延长覆盖护盾的持续时间。

perks.name: Melee Momentum
perks.description: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it additional bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成近战最后一击可为其进一步提供额外能量，并在格挡时提供更高的移动速度。

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹药在命中时爆炸，产生范围效果。

perks.name: Melee Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming damage from combatants that are at point-blank range.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自近距离敌人的伤害。

perks.name: Shoot rotatable relays to change their alignment, altering the path of Relocator Launcher shots
perks.nameZh: 射击可旋转中继器来调整方向，改变重定位发射器的射击轨迹
perks.description: Shoot rotatable relays to change their alignment, altering the path of Relocator Launcher shots
perks.descriptionZh: 射击可旋转中继器来调整方向，改变重定位发射器的射击轨迹

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Legion's Bulwark
perks.description: Increases the Arc shield's durability and partially reloads the magazine if it is destroyed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升电弧护盾的耐久度，护盾被摧毁后可以部分填装弹匣。

perks.name: Crystalized Auto Loader
perks.description: BOOST: Shattering frozen targets and [Stasis] Stasis crystals deals increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化：碎裂被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更高的伤害。

perks.name: Powerhouse Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Powerhouse archetype, which has Weapons as its primary stat and Super as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落高能者框架：武器为主要属性，超能为次要属性。

perks.name: Glacial Harvest
perks.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。

拥有冰霜护甲时，用冰影或动能武器击败战斗人员可能会使其碎裂，对附近其他敌人造成伤害。碎裂几率根据你的冰霜护甲层数而增加。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成手雷能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Snapload Finisher
perks.description:
Finishers reload all your weapons. 

Consumes 1 stack of Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技会填装你所有的武器。

消耗1层护甲充能。

perks.name: Looks Can Kill
perks.description: This weapon fires shield-piercing ammunition and comes with a scope. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可发射护盾穿透弹药。配有瞄准具。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Danger Close
perks.description: Precision weapon hits load micro-missiles. Activating a class ability fires them.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准武器命中可装填微型导弹。激活职业技能将其发射。

perks.name: Super Mod
perks.description: Increases the Super stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升超能属性。

perks.name: Tangled Up
perks.description: Defeating a combatant with a Strand weapon spawns a Tangle. Must have a Strand subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝武器击败一名战斗人员会生成一个缠结。必须装备缚丝分支职业。

perks.name: Tension
perks.description: Grants increased draw time and accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升拔枪速度和精度。

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.
perks.descriptionZh: 对首领、载具和激活超能的守护者造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Fan Fire
perks.description: This weapon fires full auto and is more effective in hip-fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 这把武器全自动开火，并且腰射更加有效。

perks.name: Linear Fusion Rifle Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 线性融合步枪弹药回收器
perks.description: Linear Fusion Rifles get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Linear Fusion Rifle.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该线性融合步枪所用弹药时，线性融合步枪获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Catalyst Seeker
perks.description: Increases the drop rate of Crucible and strike catalysts when playing with clanmates.
perks.descriptionZh: 与公会队友一同游戏时，提高熔炉竞技场和打击催化的掉落几率。

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，稳定性和精度随之提高。

perks.name: Arc Traps
perks.description: Grenades stick to surfaces and chain Arc bolts.
perks.descriptionZh: 榴弹粘附在表面并形成电光效果。

perks.name: Unraveling Blast
perks.description: This weapon's explosions unravel nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的爆炸可对附近目标造成瓦解效果。

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.
perks.descriptionZh: 在进行一次成功的近战打击后，在一小段时间内——或直到发射完三枚子弹前——提高武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: Aggressive Burst
perks.description: Hard-hitting four-burst fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 四发强力冲击射击。

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Damage increases by an improved amount the longer this weapon remains on a target.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着此武器准星在目标上停留的时间增加更多伤害。

perks.name: Green Spotlight
perks.description: Adds a green spotlight to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束绿色聚光灯。

perks.name: Hands-On
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on melee kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Desperado
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成精准最后一击或快速击败目标后进行填装可提升你的射速。

perks.name: Looming Moon
perks.description: Adds a moonlit appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个月光外观。

perks.name: Murder of Crows
perks.description: Adds an avian appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个鸟类外观。

perks.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perks.description: Aiming down the sights of a Hand Cannon for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 手炮举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Scout Rifle
perks.description: Landing consecutive hits on combatants with any Scout Rifle you are wielding causes disruption, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering their damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用任意斥候步枪连续命中战斗人员可造成混乱效果，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Auto Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Auto Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的自动步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Trace Rifles
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Trace Rifle causes the beam to stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的追踪步枪不间断开火可以使光束眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并使其疲惫。

克制过载勇士。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Unstoppable Glaive
perks.description: Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Glaives are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的偃月可发射一枚强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间偃月将始终过充。

perks.name: Unflinching Strand Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Strand weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低用缚丝武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Solar Scavenger
perks.description: Solar weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该烈日武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Puppeteer's Control
perks.description: Improved Drengr's Lash. Gain Woven Mail when suspending targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 改良版勇士之鞭。悬停目标时获得织造铠甲。

perks.name: Guardian Gold
perks.description: Adds a gold Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金色守护者纹章。

perks.name: Primary Ammo Scavenger
perks.description: Gain bonus reserves when you pick up Primary ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取主要弹药时获得额外弹药。

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads slightly more ammo from reserves, or removes more heat, and increases damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成持续伤害会从备弹中填装略多弹药或移除更多热量，并提升伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: -5 Grenade ▼
perks.description: -5 Grenade ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -5 手雷 ▼

perks.name: Soulburn
perks.description: This weapon's melee grants Soulfire Charges that inflict potent corruption.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的近战会提供施加强效腐化的魂火充能。

perks.name: Lighthouse
perks.description: Reach seven wins to access the Lighthouse. Lighthouse chest rewards increase with longer win streaks. Your active win streak contributes to your total Crucible Performance Multiplier.
perks.descriptionZh: 达到七场胜利以进入灯塔。灯塔宝箱奖励会随连胜场数增加而增加。当前连胜会提升熔炉竞技场表现系数总值。

perks.name: Trick or Treat
perks.description: Defeated combatants have a chance to drop Candy.
perks.descriptionZh: 被击败的战斗人员有几率掉落糖果。

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 近战 ▲ /-5 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Gold Beam
perks.description: Adds a gold beam to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束金色光束。

perks.name: Primary Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the drop chance of Primary ammo on kill.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高完成击杀时主武器弹药的掉落几率。

perks.name: Hive Arrival
perks.description: Adds a Hive spawn appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个邪魔族出生外观。

perks.name: Enhanced Relay Defender
perks.description: Gain a powerful increase to weapon damage while within 5 meters of an active Vex Relay.
perks.descriptionZh: 在激活的Vex继电器周围5米范围内，武器伤害获得大幅提升。

perks.name: Aura of Will
perks.description: Applies a blue crown aura.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加一个蓝色头冠光环。

perks.name: The Right Choice
perks.description: Every seventh shot bounces.
perks.descriptionZh: 每第七发子弹会发生弹射。

perks.name: Spread Shot
perks.description: Fires a short range spread of pellets.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射短射程的散弹。

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲ / -5 Grenade ▼

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
perks.description: Full auto. Faster reload on empty.
perks.descriptionZh: 全自动。打空时可提高填装速度。

perks.name: Arc Glow Pack
perks.description: Armor glow packages rotate daily. This package is available only on Arc days.
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲炫彩包裹每日轮换。此包裹仅可在电弧日使用。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Scout Rifle
perks.description:
Scout Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Scout Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的斥候步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

斥候步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Spread Shot Package
perks.description: Aiming this weapon reduces the spread of its projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准可降低弹药的散射。

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀后填装可提高武器伤害力。

perks.name: Melee Wellmaker
perks.description: Powered melee combatant final blows spawn elemental wells matching your subclass energy type.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战造成的战斗人员最后一击会生成与你的分支职业能量类型匹配的元素井。

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.description: Reloading this weapon automatically gathers nearby ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装此武器会自动收集附近的弹药。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier SMG
perks.description:
Grants weapon shield-piercing, bypassing combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
赐予武器 护盾穿透特性，击穿敌人的防御。

克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Threat Remover
perks.description: Dealing damage with all pellets in a spread increases reload speed, handling, and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 散射所有弹丸造成伤害时会提升填装速度、操控性和稳定性。

perks.name: Energy Weapon Targeting
perks.description: Slightly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Energy weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善能量武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可暂时性地提高武器伤害力。可叠加3次。

perks.name: Shock and Clear
perks.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
perks.descriptionZh: 以震颤造成最后一击，或对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击时，会生成离子轨迹。

perks.name: Ionic Overclock
perks.description: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
perks.descriptionZh: 当处于增幅状态时，你的融合步枪、线性融合步枪以及热量武器可获得更高的操控性、填装和排气速度。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Trace Rifles over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的追踪步枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Crossing Over
perks.description: This weapon has significantly increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal significantly increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器显著增加了前半弹匣的射程和操控性，而后半弹匣的弹药能造成显著提升的伤害。

perks.name: Adept Charge Time
perks.description: +10 Charge Time
perks.descriptionZh: +10充能速度

perks.name: Bright Paragon
perks.description: Increased XP gains and loot for you and members of your fireteam or match from strikes, public events, and the Crucible. This effect does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加你和火力战队成员在打击、公共事件和熔炉竞技场中获得的经验值和战利品。此效果不可叠加。

perks.name: Charged with Blight
perks.description: Precision hits increase stability and reload speed and drain combatants' life force to charge a ball of Darkness. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to restore health and fire the charged projectile, shrouding combatants in Darkness to temporarily blind them and inflict corruption.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中会提升稳定性和填装速度，并吸收战斗人员的生命力来给暗影球充能。[替换武器动作]  恢复生命值并发射充能射弹，将战斗人员笼罩在暗影中，暂时致盲目标并施加腐化。

perks.name: Void Glow Pack
perks.description: Armor glow packages rotate daily. This package is available only on Void days.
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲炫彩包裹每日轮换。此包裹仅可在虚空日使用。

perks.name: Shatterdive
perks.description: Activate while midair to quickly descend and shatter nearby targets on impact. Shattering targets grants you Frost Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 在半空中激活可快速下落并在撞击地面时碎裂附近的目标。碎裂目标可为你提供冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Piercing Sidearms
perks.description:
Sidearms gain shield-piercing rounds, which bypass combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
手枪获得护盾穿透弹药，可击穿战斗人员的防御。

克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Unstoppable Scout Rifle
perks.description:
Aiming down sights for a short time causes Scout Rifles you wield to fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
举枪瞄准一小段时间可让你的斥候步枪发射出一枚高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Full Stop
perks.description: Deals massively increased precision damage to unshielded targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 对没有护盾的目标造成大幅提高的精准伤害。

perks.name: Facet of Honor
perks.description: Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants Transcendence energy of the same type.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会提供相同类型的超凡能量。

perks.name: Giving Hand
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, melee kills have a chance to make enemies drop Heavy ammo.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，取得近战击杀将有机会使敌人掉落重型弹药。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Egregore Entrance
perks.description: Adds a spore cloud to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个孢子云。

perks.name: Candy Devourer
perks.description:
Picking up a piece of Candy grants Devour.

Only one mask upgrade can be active at a time. Activating this mask upgrade will deactivate the others.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取糖果会获得吞食效果。

一次只能激活一个面具升级。激活此面具升级将停用其他面具升级。

perks.name: Hammer of the Gods
perks.description: Gain melee energy and create lightning strikes with Thunderclap.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用雷霆一击获得近战能量并产生闪电打击。

perks.name: 4 Hours
perks.description: Effect lasts for 4 hours.
perks.descriptionZh: 效果将持续4小时。

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，射程、精度和操控性随之提高。

perks.name: Enhanced Heat Generated
perks.description: -10 Heat Generated
perks.descriptionZh: -10发热量

perks.name: Cranial Spike
perks.description: Precision hits grant bonus target acquisition and range.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准命中可提供额外目标捕获能力和射程。

perks.name: Auto-reload all weapons shortly after entering Matterspark.
perks.nameZh: 进入物质火花状态不久后自动填装所有武器。
perks.description: Auto-reload all weapons shortly after entering Matterspark.
perks.descriptionZh: 进入物质火花状态不久后自动填装所有武器。

perks.name: Burning Cells
perks.description: Destroying a Warmind Cell creates a burst of Solar energy that causes enemies to burn for several seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 摧毁战争思维电池会引爆一股烈日能量，点燃敌人数秒。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Improved Solar Analyzer
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Solar weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在烈日武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑最后一击可大幅提高移动速度和伤害。

perks.name: Traveler's Transference
perks.description: Sprinting for a short time causes you to become amplified. While you are amplified, melee damage creates lightning bolts which damage nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺一小段时间即可进入增幅状态。处于增幅状态时，近战伤害会生成闪电，对附近战斗人员造成伤害。

perks.name: Will of Light (Solar)
perks.description: Your equipped weapons that deal Solar damage deal increased damage to Taken combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的烈日伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Revolution
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Swap firing modes.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ： 切换开火模式。

perks.name: Frame of Reference
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, and an increased amount of reload speed and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会临时赋予更高的伤害，以及更多的填装速度和射程。收起武器时暂停此效果的计时。

perks.name: Winter's Shroud
perks.description:
Dodging slows nearby targets.

Slowing targets briefly increases your class ability regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh:
闪身会减速附近的目标。

减速目标会短暂增加你的职业技能回复。

perks.name: Breakthrough
perks.description: This weapon fires [Stagger] staggering projectiles. Strong against Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器发射眩晕射弹。适合对付势不可挡的勇士。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Echoes of Glory
perks.description: Grants additional Failsafe vendor reputation from all sources. For each piece of armor equipped with this perk, this bonus increases.
perks.descriptionZh: 可从所有来源获得额外智能失效保险商人声望。具有此特性的护甲装备得越多，此加成越高。

perks.name: Superstructure Striker
perks.description: While you are standing on a sync plate or are near a conflux, weapon attacks that hit powerful Vex combatants have a high chance to stun those combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你站在同步板上或汇流附近时，击中强力Vex战斗人员的武器攻击有高几率使战斗人员眩晕。

perks.name: Vex Breaker
perks.description: Defeating a Vex with a melee attack has a chance to spawn an Orb of Power. Multiple copies of this mod increase the Super energy granted when those Orbs are picked up.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击消灭Vex有机会刷出能量球。多个此模组可以增加拾起产生的能量球时获得的超能能量。

perks.name: Rapid Oracle Disruptor
perks.description: Your equipped Pulse Rifles, Shotguns, Sidearms, SMGs, and Swords deal additional damage to Oracles.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的脉冲步枪、霰弹枪、手枪、冲锋枪和刀剑会对神谕造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: [Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
perks.descriptionZh: [射击] ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击，可在短时间内提升此武器的瞄准速度、精度和空中效率。失调协议效果激活时，最后一击会返还弹药。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Bladefury
perks.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：生成两把编织利刃掠过战场。激活时：

[轻攻击]  ：对附近的目标进行跃动砍击，击中时割裂他们并对悬停的目标造成额外伤害。每次成功击中可短暂提升你的攻击速度并为你的重攻击提供能量。

[重攻击]  ：发动一次上行重砍击，生成两枚可搜寻目标的悬停射弹。

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.
perks.descriptionZh: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予武器伤害、填装速度和操控性，直到使用者死亡。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善狙击步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Spirit of Hoarfrost
perks.description: Replace Barricade with a wall of Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh: 用冰影水晶墙替换屏障。

perks.name: Spirit of Severance
perks.description: Powered melee final blows and finishers unleash explosions.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战最后一击和终结技会释放爆炸。

perks.name: Spirit of the Abeyant
perks.description: Improves Drengr's Lash.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升勇士之鞭。

perks.name: Spirit of the Eternal Warrior
perks.description: Gain bonus weapon damage when your Super ends.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能结束时获得武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Spirit of Contact
perks.description: Powered melee damage causes lightning strikes.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战伤害会造成闪电打击。

perks.name: Spirit of the Bear
perks.description: Improves Unbreakable.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升坚不可摧。

perks.name: Spirit of the Horn
perks.description: Class abilities unleash a Solar blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 职业技能会释放烈日爆炸。

perks.name: Spirit of Scars
perks.description: Weapon final blows heal allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会治疗盟友。

perks.name: Spirit of the Armamentarium
perks.description: Gain an additional grenade charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得额外一次手雷充能。

perks.name: Spirit of Alpha Lupi
perks.description: Casting your class ability heals you and nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 释放你的职业技能可治疗你和附近盟友。

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification, and improves handling. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器瞄准可提高有效射程和变焦倍率，并改善操控性。提高使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、弓箭瞄准时的射弹速度。

perks.name: Reflex Brackets Mod
perks.description: Improves weapon handling for equipped Power weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善已装备威能武器的操控性。
