perks.name: Pump Action
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on Shotgun kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 霰弹枪击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Volatile Light
perks.description: Overpenetrating ricocheting rounds. Bonus damage on bounce.
perks.descriptionZh: 具备贯穿性并可反弹的弹药。反弹后可造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Adaptive Glaive
perks.description: [Aim Down Sights]  : Raise shield
perks.descriptionZh: [瞄准]  ：举起护盾

perks.name: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_status_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_summon_vehicle_button###] : Activate Matterspark anywhere on Kepler.
perks.nameZh: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_status_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_summon_vehicle_button###] ：可在开普勒上的任意地点启动物质火花。
perks.description: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_status_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_summon_vehicle_button###] : Activate Matterspark anywhere on Kepler.
perks.descriptionZh: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_status_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_summon_vehicle_button###] ：可在开普勒上的任意地点启动物质火花。

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器击杀战斗人员会产生少量超能能量。

perks.name: Disorganized Attachment
perks.description: Nests now mature over time. Fully mature nests can be harvested with [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###] [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] to grant yourself a held Tangle.
perks.descriptionZh: 线虫巢现在会随时间成熟。完全成熟的线虫巢可通过[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###] [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]进行采集，为你提供一个握持的缠结。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.description: Gain even more increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus further increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
perks.descriptionZh: 当一名盟友被击败时，获得更高的填装、稳定性、瞄准辅助和射程。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成进一步提升。

perks.name: Temporal Armaments
perks.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage versus Cabal and Vex targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可对卡巴尔和Vex目标造成更多额外伤害。

perks.name: Yellow Dawning Lantern
perks.description: Adds a yellow Dawning lantern to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个黄色曙光灯笼。

perks.name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
perks.description: Higher base damage, increased damage versus powerful combatants. High heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.
perks.descriptionZh: 高基础伤害，提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，高热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。武器在射击间隙冷却得更快。

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.
perks.descriptionZh: 在进行一次成功的近战打击后，在一小段时间内——或直到发射完三枚子弹前——武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度会提高。

perks.name: Reactive Shock
perks.description: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
perks.descriptionZh: 力量吸收生效时，受到近战伤害将触发一次迷失爆发。

perks.name: Force Absorption
perks.description: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，暂时减少受到的范围效果伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Warmind's Decree
perks.description: Void splash damage final blows have a chance to create Warmind Cells.
perks.descriptionZh: 虚空溅射伤害最后一击有一定几率生成战争思维电池。

perks.name: Alchemical Etchings
perks.description: Rifts increase weapon reload speed. Empowering Rift increases range.
perks.descriptionZh: 裂痕加快武器填装速度。强能裂痕提高射程。

perks.name: Strange Protractor
perks.description: Buffs sprint. Sprinting reloads current weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺加快。冲刺填装当前武器。

perks.name: Tectonic Harvest
perks.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby combatants. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。

拥有冰霜护甲时，用冰影或动能武器击败战斗人员可能会使其碎裂，对附近其他战斗人员造成伤害。碎裂几率根据你的冰霜护甲层数而增加。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成近战能量。

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.description: Dealing damage significantly improves reload speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害可大幅提升填装速度与操控性。

perks.name: Iron Reach
perks.description: Massively improves weapon range at the cost of weapon stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 以牺牲武器稳定性为代价，大幅提升武器的射程。

perks.name: Pinpoint Slug Frame
perks.description: Fires a single-slug round.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射独头弹。

perks.name: Enhanced Handling
perks.description: +10 Handling
perks.descriptionZh: +10 操控性

perks.name: Malevolent Grasp
perks.description: Improves suspend, causing damage over time. Using your Rift also suspends nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 改进悬停效果，造成持续伤害。使用裂痕也会悬停附近的目标。

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.description: Speeds up weapon charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高武器充能速度。

perks.name: Nessus Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Guardian Pink
perks.description: Adds a pink Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色守护者纹章。

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto. Improves reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式射击此武器。提高填装速度。

perks.name: Sword Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Sword ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的刀剑弹药储量。

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败一个目标会产生虚空爆发；用此爆发击中其他目标会使其不稳定，并在短时间内为你提供不稳定弹药。

perks.name: Thermoplastic Grenades
perks.description: Grenades fired from this weapon bounce further.
perks.descriptionZh: 可发射弹跳距离更远的榴弹。

perks.name: Volatile Volleys
perks.description: Defeating powerful combatants with a Void weapon gives your Void weapons Volatile Rounds. Must have a Void subclass equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空武器击败强力战斗人员会为你的虚空武器提供不稳定弹药。必须装备虚空分支职业。

perks.name: +10 Class ▲
perks.description: +10 Class ▲

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成更多手雷能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Starless Night
perks.description: Weapons of Light is improved; capable of extending Ward of Dawn's duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 光之武器获得强化；能够延长黎明护罩的持续时间。

perks.name: Heat of the Moment
perks.description: While Ignition Trigger is active, final blows with this weapon cure you and sustained fire scorches your target.
perks.descriptionZh: 引燃扳机生效时，使用此武器造成最后一击会治愈你，而持续火力会灼烧你的目标。

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会增加下一枚射弹的爆炸范围和伤害。提升层数限制。

perks.name: Sidearm Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高手枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Enhanced Persistence
perks.description: +10 Persistence
perks.descriptionZh: +10 坚韧

perks.name: Survivalist Hunter Armor
perks.description: Improved recovery.
perks.descriptionZh: 更强的恢复力。

perks.name: Improved Hellas Basin Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版赫拉斯盆地缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Trials of Osiris
perks.description: Passage rewards have been claimed this week. Each win contributes to the total Crucible Performance Multiplier.
perks.descriptionZh: 本周已领取入场券奖励。每次胜利都会提升熔炉竞技场表现系数总值。

perks.name: Three of Coins
perks.description: Increased chance to receive Exotic engrams from sources in the world.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高在世界资源中获得异域记忆水晶的几率。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chances of finding Special ammo while you have a Hand Cannon that uses Special ammo equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备使用特殊弹药的手炮后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

perks.name: Feed the Void
perks.description:
Defeat a target with any ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意技能击败目标来启动吞食。

你的吞食效果获得改善，恢复额外生命值和手雷能量。

perks.name: Both [Aim Down Sights] dash and [Super] blast apply jolt to combatants.
perks.nameZh: [瞄准]冲刺和[超能]爆破均可对战斗人员施加震颤。
perks.description: Both [Aim Down Sights] dash and [Super] blast apply jolt to combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: [瞄准]冲刺和[超能]爆破均可对战斗人员施加震颤。

perks.name: Glaive Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Glaives over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的偃月装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Foundry Sponsorship: Suros
perks.description: Suros weapons deal overcharged damage in Ops activities.
perks.descriptionZh: SUROS武器在行动活动中造成过充伤害。

perks.name: White Nail
perks.description: Higher base precision damage. Rapidly landing three precision hits will refill the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 更高的基础精准伤害。快速完成三次精准命中可重新填装弹匣。

perks.name: Flawless Lighthouse Passage
perks.description:
Flawless Lighthouse Passage completed. Match wins will grant you a chance to earn Lighthouse chest rewards. Flawless and active win streaks contribute to your total Crucible Performance Multiplier.

Continuing to play on this Passage will match you versus other players with similar weekly performance.
perks.descriptionZh:
无瑕灯塔入场券已完成。比赛胜利将有机会获得灯塔宝箱奖励。无瑕和当前连胜会提升熔炉竞技场表现系数总值。

继续使用此入场券游戏将与其他周常表现相似的玩家匹配。

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 第一发弹药的精度和射程大幅提高。

perks.name: Shotgun Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高霰弹枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Arc Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Arc damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的电弧伤害。

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.description: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened. Cooldown between activations reduced.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会使附近目标变得虚弱。减少启动冷却时间。

perks.name: Stasis Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Stasis weapons over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 逐渐填装你已收起的冰影武器。

perks.name: Glaive of Dreams
perks.description: While you have a Glaive equipped, the Unstable Essence buff gained by picking up objects dropped by Nightmares has double its normal duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备偃月时，通过拾取梦魇掉落物品获得的不稳定精华增益的持续时间将是其正常持续时间的两倍。

perks.name: Revitalizing Blast
perks.description: Stunning a Champion causes it to ignite and clears your shield stun.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士使其燃烧并清除你的护盾眩晕。

perks.name: Overload Trace Rifles
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Trace Rifle causes the beam to stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and exhausting them.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的追踪步枪不间断开火可以使光束眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并使其疲惫。

克制过载勇士。
疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Strand Weapon Surge
perks.description: Your Strand weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的缚丝武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Empowered Finish
perks.description: Finisher final blows grant you 1 temporary Armor Charge when you have none.
perks.descriptionZh: 若你没有护甲充能，终结技最后一击会赋予1层临时的护甲充能。

perks.name: Overload Sword
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits with a Sword you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Swords are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用刀剑连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间刀剑将始终过充。

perks.name: Advanced Reflexes
perks.description: Upon taking damage from a target, quickly guard or aim down sights with this weapon to gain bonus damage, handling, and charge rate for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到来自目标的伤害后，使用此武器快速防卫或瞄准目标，可在短时间内获得额外伤害、操控性和充能速度。

perks.name: Elliptical Orbit
perks.description: After briefly sprinting, gain increased ammo generation. Alternatively, gain stability, reload speed, and flinch resistance when not sprinting for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 短暂冲刺后，获得提升的弹药生成。停止冲刺一小段时间后，改而获得稳定性、填装速度和抖动抗性。

perks.name: Stasis Ammo Generation
perks.description: Increases the ammo generation of Stasis weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升冰影武器的弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成独特的元素伤害会为此武器提供叠加的伤害加成。对于动能武器，此加成会提升。

perks.name: Blast from the Side
perks.description: Projectiles from the time portal shoot more frequently.
perks.descriptionZh: 时间传送门中的子弹更频繁。

perks.name: Seraph Reboot Entrance
perks.description: Adds a seraphic reboot appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个炽天使重启外观。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Special ammo while you have a Trace Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备追踪步枪后，提高你找到特殊武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Armor of the Colossus
perks.description: While at full health, spinning up this weapon protects you with an Arc shield.
perks.descriptionZh: 生命值全满时，旋转此武器会为你生成一个电弧护盾。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Trample
perks.description: Destroying enemies with Fists of Havoc extends its duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用浩劫之拳击杀敌人可延长其持续时间。

perks.name: Stun Ventilator
perks.description: Stunning a Champion vents a large amount of heat from this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士可为此武器散去大量热量。

perks.name: Into the Fray
perks.description:
Destroying a Tangle or casting your Super grants Woven Mail for nearby allies.

While you have Woven Mail, your melee regeneration rate is increased.
perks.descriptionZh:
摧毁缠结或施放超能会为附近盟友提供织造铠甲。

身穿织造铠甲时，你的近战恢复速率将提升。

perks.name: Static Buildup
perks.description: While amplified, this weapon gradually gains overcharge.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到增幅效果影响时，此武器会逐渐获得过充。

perks.name: Light from Darkness
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by rapidly defeating multiple enemies near a Warmind Cell using weapons or abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器或技能快速击杀在战争思维电池附近的多名敌人以变得充斥光能 。

perks.name: Warmind's Longevity
perks.description: Warmind Cells you create last longer.
perks.descriptionZh: 你制造的战争思维电池持续的时间更长。

perks.name: Warmind's Protection
perks.description: You take reduced damage from enemies that are near Warmind Cells.
perks.descriptionZh: 战争思维电池附近的敌人对你造成的伤害降低。

perks.name: Power of Rasputin
perks.description: You gain a bonus to weapon damage against enemies that are near Warmind Cells.
perks.descriptionZh: 你对战争思维电池附近的敌人获得武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Cellular Suppression
perks.description: Damaging a Warmind Cell creates a burst of suppressing Void energy. Additionally, you deal less damage to Warmind Cells.
perks.descriptionZh: 对战争思维电池造成伤害会引爆一股压制性虚空能量。另外，你对战争思维电池造成的伤害减少。

perks.name: Paracausal Fluid
perks.description: Gain bonus handling and mobility when damaging targets with this weapon. Swords gain increased charge rate while this perk is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器对目标造成伤害会获得额外的操控性和敏捷。此特性生效时刀剑可获得更高充能速度。

perks.name: Randomized Perks + 1
perks.description: This item comes with randomized perks, as well as an extra perk in the right trait column.
perks.descriptionZh: 此物品自带随机特性和右侧特性栏的一个额外特性。

perks.name: Shielding Hand
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, melee kills reduce incoming damage by 20%.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，取得近战击杀可降低你所受伤害20%。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Thread of Continuity
perks.description: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 向目标施加的悬停、瓦解和割裂效果拥有更久的持续时间。

perks.name: Unflinching Power Aim
perks.description: Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a Power weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用威能武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放你的职业技能会让此武器在短时间内命中时割裂目标，直至达到最大目标数量。效果持续时间延长。

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.description: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 能量相匹配的护盾爆炸可使附近战斗人员迷失方向。

perks.name: Elemental Ordnance
perks.description: Defeating a combatant with a grenade spawns an elemental well that matches your subclass energy type.
perks.descriptionZh: 用手雷击败战斗人员会生成一个符合你的分支职业能量类型的元素井。

perks.name: Chomping at the Stem
perks.description: After you have been Drained of Light, gain a bonus to mobility, weapon handling, and reload speed. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在你的光能耗尽时，敏捷、武器操控性、填装速度都会提升。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Weapon Ritualist
perks.description: Earn bonus crafted weapon XP from completing ritual playlist activities.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成仪式游戏列表活动可获得额外制作武器经验值。

perks.name: Osteo Striga Catalyst
perks.description: Final blows with corruption return ammo to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 腐化最后一击可将弹药返回弹匣。

perks.name: Bountiful Bounties
perks.description: The first clan bounty completed each week grants an Exotic engram.
perks.descriptionZh: 每周完成的首个公会悬赏可奖励一个异域记忆水晶。

perks.name: Lucky Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在精准最后一击后填装，会使后续的精准命中从备弹中补充一发子弹，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Micro-Missile Frame
perks.description: This weapon fires a high-speed micro-missile in a straight line and deals reduced self-damage. Move faster with this weapon equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会发射一个直线前进的高速微型导弹并造成较少的自我伤害。装备此武器时移动速度更快。

perks.name: Disrupting Blade
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits on enemy targets disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
对敌方目标的连续攻击扰乱战斗人员并将其眩晕，延缓技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Void Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Veteran's Wisdom
perks.description: Rapid or precision final blows release a Kinetic shockwave that exhausts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速或精准最后一击会释放动能冲击波，使目标疲惫。

perks.name: Stat Penalty
perks.description: -10 Discipline
perks.descriptionZh: -10 纪律

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 近战 ▲

perks.name: Facet of Defiance
perks.description: Finishers create a detonation that either jolts, scorches, slows, severs, or makes targets volatile based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技会基于你已装备超能的伤害类型，产生一次对目标造成震颤、灼烧、减速、割裂或不稳定的爆炸。

perks.name: Unflinching Auto Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用自动步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Eyes on All
perks.description: Tracks and fires at multiple targets simultaneously.
perks.descriptionZh: 追踪多个目标并同时向其开火。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高脉冲步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善融合步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Sacred Flame
perks.description: Heavy attacks mark targets; light attacks detonate them.
perks.descriptionZh: 重攻击会标记目标；轻攻击可将其引爆。

perks.name: Yellow Class Sigil
perks.description: Adds a yellow class sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个黄色职业印记。

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可在短时间内提升敏捷、武器射程和操控性。

perks.name: Paracausal Beam
perks.description: Beam deals Kinetic damage with bonus damage to shields.
perks.descriptionZh: 光束会造成动能伤害，对护盾造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Crackshot
perks.description:
Activate your class ability to fire up to three scorching shots at combatants you've marked. Aim at targets to mark them.

Landing all three shots cures you.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能来向你标记的战斗人员发射至多三发灼烧射击。瞄准目标来标记他们。

三发全中会治愈你。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Pure Matterglass Lens
perks.description: Precision kills have a chance to drop weapon telemetries.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准击杀有几率掉落武器遥测。

perks.name: Unflinching Sniper Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用狙击步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可提升操控性与瞄准辅助，直到武器被收起。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

perks.name: Knight Errant
perks.description:
Defeating Hive Knights grants Destination Materials.

Mod does not stack.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭邪魔族骑士可获得目的地材料。

模组无法叠加。

perks.name: Broadhead
perks.description: Piercing arrowhead that damages the target on entry and exit. One shot can overpenetrate multiple targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 穿透型箭头，在进入和穿出时均可对目标造成伤害。一发可射穿多个目标。

perks.name: One for Thrall
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage, range, handling, and aim assist for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中三个不同目标可在一定时间内提高伤害、射程、操控性和瞄准辅助。

perks.name: Strategist
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会产生职业技能能量。使用你的职业技能会在短时间内提升此武器的稳定性。

perks.name: M1R Distribution Matrix
perks.description: Guarding grants overshields to allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 防御可为盟友提供覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Assassin's Blade
perks.description: Sword final blows boost movement speed and damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑最后一击可大幅提高移动速度和伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Kinetic Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高动能武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Hadopelagic Tribute
perks.description: Collecting Stasis shards gradually overflows the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集冰影碎片会逐渐过量填充弹匣。

perks.name: Vengeance
perks.description: Highlight and defeat those that harm you for an overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 高亮并击败对你造成伤害的敌人以获得覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Hitting a morphable object with Mattermorph triggers Woven Mail.
perks.nameZh: 使用物质变形击中可变形物体会触发织造铠甲。
perks.description: Hitting a morphable object with Mattermorph triggers Woven Mail.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用物质变形击中可变形物体会触发织造铠甲。

perks.name: Mindspun Invocation
perks.description:
Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的抓取、束缚手雷、线虫手雷和切线手雷拥有强化性能。

你的抓取近战会生成三个线虫。

[手雷]  ：按住消耗你的束缚手雷并激活编织者之境。编织者之境激活时造成最后一击可生成一次悬停爆炸。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的线虫手雷，使其在命中地点编织一个不断生成线虫的线虫巢穴。

[手雷]  ：按住以充能你的切线手雷。该手雷最终爆炸时将发射子弹药并在其路径上留下一个缠结。

perks.name: Coronal Culmination
perks.description: This weapon can be charged with Solar energy to massively increase its damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 这件武器可以充入烈日能量，大幅增加其伤害。

perks.name: Shieldburst
perks.description:
Enhances your equipped barricade with [Solar] Solar capabilities.

Towering Barricade: Your barricade slides forward across the ground before stopping, allowing you to advance in safety.

Rally Barricade: Standing behind your barricade grants scorching rounds to your allies' Solar and Kinetic weapons.

While your barricade is deployed, activate your class ability again to remotely detonate it, scorching combatants caught in the detonation. Dealing damage increases the power of the blast.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
为你当前装备的屏障提供烈日能力强化。

巍峨屏障：你的屏障会在地面上向前滑行后再停下，让你能够安全推进。

集结屏障：站在你的屏障后时，为盟友的烈日和动能武器提供灼烧弹。

在你的屏障部署期间，再次激活职业技能会远程引爆它，灼烧爆炸范围内的战斗人员。造成伤害会提升爆炸威力。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Unflinching Grenade Launcher Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Grenade Launchers.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用榴弹发射器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Unstoppable Sidearm
perks.description:
Aiming down sights with any Sidearm you are wielding loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意手枪举枪瞄准会装载一个高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Shadowshot
perks.description: Tether foes to a Void Anchor, slowing, weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 将敌人束缚在虚空之锚上，使其行动缓慢且虚弱，为你和友军压制他们。

perks.name: Spark of Volts
perks.description: Finishers make you amplified and grant you a stack of Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技会使你进入增幅状态，并提供一层电光充能。

perks.name: Delicate Tuning
perks.description: While at low heat, this weapon has improved range, handling, and accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 在低热量状态下，此武器的射程、操控性与精度提升。

perks.name: Solar Effects
perks.description: Adds Solar elements to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加灼烧元素。

perks.name: Pyrotechnic Entrance
perks.description: Adds a ring of fire to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个火环效果。

perks.name: Celebratory Entrance
perks.description: Adds a golden filigree to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个金丝效果。

perks.name: Stack 'Em Up
perks.description: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
perks.descriptionZh: 超凡未生效时，以独特元素伤害击败目标会提供可叠加的超凡能量获取加成。

perks.name: Burn 'Em Down
perks.description: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 超凡生效时，使用手雷技能会消耗所有“叠加起来”层数来获得递增的手雷能量。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善脉冲步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Jump Driver
perks.description: Lorentz Driver gains an enhanced radar. Additionally, while this weapon has 3 telemetry patterns, EM Anomaly detonations no longer require a precision final blow.
perks.descriptionZh: 洛伦兹驱动器获得强化雷达。此外，在此武器收集到3次遥测规律后，电磁异常引爆将不再需要精准最后一击。

perks.name: Hands-On
perks.description: Gain bonus Super energy on melee kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战击杀可提供额外超能能量。

perks.name: Reactive Pulse
perks.description: While Charged with Light, when you take damage while surrounded by combatants, you emit a burst of damaging Arc energy, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，当你被战斗人员包围时受到伤害，会爆发出一股伤害性电弧能量，消耗一层充斥光能。

perks.name: Echo of Remnants
perks.description: Your lingering grenade effects (Vortex Grenade, Void Wall, Void Spike, and Axion Bolt) have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 来自你的手雷的残留效果（涡流手雷，虚空墙壁，虚空尖刺，量子光束）的持续时间延长。

perks.name: Insatiable
perks.description: Ability energy for you and allies on Super cast.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放超能时会提供技能能量给你和盟友。

perks.name: Absorption Cells
perks.description: Gain Super energy on elemental weapon takedowns.
perks.descriptionZh: 元素武器击杀可获得超能能量。

perks.name: Bricks from Beyond
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a Void weapon has a chance to generate Heavy ammo progress for you and your teammates.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空武器击败强力战斗人员有几率为你和队友生成重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Flare Up
perks.description: Firebolt Grenades apply more Scorch stacks. Damaging a combatant with a Firebolt Grenade spawns a Firesprite near them.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈焰手雷可施加更多的灼烧层数。使用烈焰手雷对战斗人员造成伤害可在其附近生成一个焰灵。

perks.name: Origin Hones
perks.description: Weapons with the Noble Deeds, Nanotracing Rockets, Tex Balanced Stock, and Ambush Origin Traits are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 在该修改器生效时，带有高尚事迹、纳米追踪火箭、特克斯平衡枪托和伏击原始特性的武器将始终过充。

perks.name: Allied Unraveling
perks.description: Rapid final blows with a Strand weapon grant your weapon Unraveling Rounds, with a longer duration near allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝武器造成最后一击会赋予你的武器瓦解弹药，在盟友附近时持续时间延长。

perks.name: Counterweave
perks.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns or defeats a Champion, you gain energy for your least-charged Strand ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕或击败勇士时，你充能最少的缚丝技能将获得能量。

perks.name: Enhanced Scatter Projectile Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型散射射弹瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Auto Rifles, Machine Guns, SMGs, Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, and Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善自动步枪、机枪、微型冲锋枪、脉冲步枪、手枪和融合步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Breach Resonator
perks.description: Grants melee and grenade energy on final blows with [Shield-Piercing] shield-piercing weapons or when a member of your fireteam stuns a Barrier Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 护盾穿刺武器最后一击或火力战队成员眩晕屏障勇士可获得近战和手雷能量。

perks.name: Mega Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.
perks.descriptionZh: 在最后一击后填装会获得更长时间的伤害提升。填装前额外造成最后一击会进一步延长伤害提升持续时间。

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准此武器一小段时间而不射击会使你的目标在你下一次造成最后一击时爆炸。计时器在停止瞄准后重置。

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.description: Gain lingering aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，在更长的时间内获得瞄准辅助、稳定性和抖动抗性。

perks.name: Purple Dawning Lantern
perks.description: Adds a purple Dawning lantern to your transmat effects
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个紫色曙光灯笼

perks.name: Ever Ready
perks.description: Greatly increases the ready speed of Fusion Rifles, Shotguns, Submachine Guns, and Swords.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高融合步枪、霰弹枪、微型冲锋枪和刀剑的准备速度。

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放你的职业技能会让此武器在短时间内命中时割裂目标，直至达到最大目标数量。

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成独特的元素伤害会为此武器提供叠加的伤害加成，效果持续时间延长。对于动能武器，此加成会提升。

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time and increased stability when surrounded by combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 缩短被战斗人员包围时的充能时间或拉弓时间。提高稳定性。

perks.name: +20 Super ▲
perks.description: +20 Super ▲

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Rifle Loader
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Rifle-class weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高步枪类武器的填装速度。

perks.name: EM Anomaly
perks.description: A precision final blow with this weapon creates an implosion that pulls in nearby targets and damages them with an additional detonation.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器达成的精准最后一击会生成一次拉拢附近目标的内爆，再用额外的爆炸对其造成伤害。

perks.name: Guardian Angel
perks.description: Grants a chance to generate healing orbs for you on Scout Rifle, Sniper Rifle, Bow, and Linear Fusion Rifle precision final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 斥候步枪、狙击步枪、弓箭和线性融合步枪精准最后一击有几率为你产生治疗光球。

perks.name: Facet of Protection
perks.description: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 在被战斗人员包围时，你对伤害的抗性增加。处于超凡状态时，效果提升。

perks.name: Dearly Departed
perks.description: Rift grants damage reduction. Grants Rift energy when critically wounded; creates healing rift on death.
perks.descriptionZh: 裂痕将为你提供伤害减免效果。重伤时获得裂痕能量；死亡时产生治疗裂痕。

perks.name: Returner's Blessing
perks.description:
While playing with a Returner, you receive the Returner's Blessing buff.

While you have the Returner's Blessing, you gain the following benefits:

• All XP earned is increased.
• Completing activities grants you an additional bonus Ops engram for a random activity.
• Completing activities has a chance to complete additional Common Orders.
perks.descriptionZh:
与回归者一起玩时，你会收到回归者祝福增益。

回归者祝福生效时提供以下福利：

• 所有获得的经验值增加。
• 完成活动时额外获得一个随机活动的加成行动记忆水晶。
• 完成活动时有几率完成额外普通命令。

perks.name: Breach and Clear
perks.description: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and causes the combatant to take increased damage for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并在短时间内使该战斗人员受到的伤害增加。

perks.name: Pyrotoxin Rounds
perks.description: Fires high-powered explosive ammunition.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射高爆弹药。

perks.name: Traveler's Fervor
perks.description: Sliding after sprinting for a short time sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺一小段时间后滑行会向前发射一道燃烧火焰，对路径上的目标造成伤害及灼烧效果。

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a shorter period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 在更短的时间内瞄准此武器而不射击，你将能够削弱下一个目标。计时器在射击或停止瞄准后重置。

perks.name: Worm's Hunger
perks.description: Fires exploding Hive worms.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射会爆炸的邪魔族蠕虫。

perks.name: Protective Weave
perks.description: Fire at your allies to grant Woven Mail.
perks.descriptionZh: 朝你的盟友射击会提供织造铠甲。

perks.name: Hand Cannon Scavenger
perks.description: Hand Cannons that use Special ammo get bonus reserves when picking up Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊弹药时，使用特殊弹药的手炮获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Scanner
perks.description: Grants a chance to obtain additional faction consumables in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在赫拉斯盆地中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: +10 Super ▲
perks.description: +10 Super ▲

perks.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对重型弹药量表的所有计入效果。

perks.name: Dream Work
perks.description: Once per reload, assists or assisted final blows partially refill the weapon from reserves for an improved amount and improve reload speed for a short duration. Bows receive improved draw time.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次重新填装时，助攻或协助最后一击可更多地从储存弹药中部分填装武器，并在短时间内进一步提升填装速度。弓箭的开弓速度进一步加快。

perks.name: Dual Loader
perks.description: Reloads an additional shot at a time.
perks.descriptionZh: 一次填装一发额外子弹。

perks.name: Subjugator Entrance
perks.description: Adds a resonant appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个共振外观。

perks.name: Ghost Purple
perks.description: Adds a purple Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个紫色机灵环。

perks.name: Command Frame
perks.description: Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射强化射程的大口径射弹。

perks.name: Methane Burst
perks.description: Adds a methane burst appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个甲烷爆发外观。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Auto Rifle
perks.description:
Auto Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Auto Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的自动步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

自动步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Dreaming City Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 幽梦之城缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 在幽梦之城中探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 受伤时自动填装弹匣并提升武器操控性，此武器收起时也有效。

perks.name: Ruinscribe's Forge
perks.description: Creates a Ruinscribe Turret.
perks.descriptionZh: 生成一个毁灭铭刻炮台。

perks.name: Mobility Armorer
perks.description: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Mobility, and are more likely to drop with higher Mobility.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点敏捷，且很可能掉落时带有更多的敏捷。

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可提供额外伤害，且持续时间延长。击败更强力的目标可提高此加成的强度和持续时间。

perks.name: Soul of the Praxic Fire
perks.description: Activating Solar class abilities grants an overshield and increases the cooldown of your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活烈日职业技能可获得力场护盾并增加你的职业技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Benevolent Finisher
perks.description:
Using a finisher on a combatant spawns Orbs of Power for your allies. 

Consumes 3 stacks of Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用终结技击杀战斗人员会为你的盟友生成能量球。

消耗3层护甲充能。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have a Pulse Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备脉冲步枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Moon Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 在月球上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Faster Summon
perks.description: This vehicle takes less time to summon.
perks.descriptionZh: 使召唤载具的用时减少。

perks.name: Sun Blast
perks.description: Targets defeated with Sunshot explode in Solar energy, scorching other nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 被烈日弹丸击败的目标会在烈日能量中爆炸，灼烧附近的目标。

perks.name: Sprint Grip
perks.description: Temporarily increases the weapon's ready speed and aim down sights speed after sprinting.
perks.descriptionZh: 在冲刺后短暂提高武器的准备速度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Hail Barrage
perks.description: Fires Stasis arrows.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射冰影箭矢。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Double Fire
perks.description: Hard-hitting twin-fire rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 强硬的双发弹头。

perks.name: Enhanced Shotgun Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型霰弹枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善霰弹枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant improved stability and handling. Dark elements grant improved range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会根据武器伤害类型的分类赋予属性加成。光能元素赋予更多的稳定性和操控性。暗影元素赋予更多的射程和瞄准辅助。处于超凡状态时，这件武器同时获得两类加成。

perks.name: Judgment
perks.description: Sustained damage with this weapon envelops the target in a field that weakens and stuns them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的持续伤害会将目标包围在一个可削弱并眩晕他们的区域。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Unflinching Hand Cannon Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用手炮瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Loss
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and aim assist whenever your shields are broken or when a friendly Guardian is defeated. Effect lasts until you are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被打破时，或一名友方守护者被击败时，此武器的稳定性、操控性和瞄准辅助获得提升。效果持续至你被击败。

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.description: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成伤害或击败目标可逐渐提供更高的稳定性、操控性、填装速度和充能速度。此效果会随时间逐渐减弱，但在靠近盟友时会更快获得。

perks.name: Reanimated Entrance
perks.description: Adds loose wrappings to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓬松包裹的效果。

perks.name: Ghost Effects
perks.description: Adds a Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个机灵环。

perks.name: Whirlwind Blade
perks.description: Rapid sword strikes increase this weapon's damage for a short duration. Guarding also ends the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速刀剑打击将在短时间内增加此武器的伤害。防御将中断此效果。

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的每次最后一击都会造成一次元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Sentinel Shield
perks.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.
perks.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤一面虚空之光圣盾。
哨兵圣盾激活时：
[轻攻击] ：攻击。
[格挡] ：进行防御。
[手雷] ：进行圣盾投掷。

perks.name: Ride Together, Die Together
perks.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球时，你会获得短暂且快速衰减的伤害减免效果。

perks.name: Too Old for This
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技击败强力战斗人员可获得特殊弹药进度，并恢复少量生命值。

perks.name: Dimensional Shift
perks.description: Collecting a Void Breach causes final blows to provide a higher value Void Overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集虚空裂口会使最后一击提供更高数值的虚空覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Dark Deliverance
perks.description:
Fires remotely detonated projectiles that drop Void orbs on combatants.
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
perks.descriptionZh:
发射可远程引爆的弹药，向战斗人员投射虚空能量球。
[射击]  ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

perks.name: Gun and Run
perks.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标可在短时间内积累边打边跑层数。短暂冲刺消耗一层效果并从储备弹药中部分填装此武器的弹匣。如为弓箭，则短暂提升拉弓速度。

perks.name: Heavy Titan Armor
perks.description: Improved resilience.
perks.descriptionZh: 更强的韧性。

perks.name: Howl of the Storm
perks.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Stasis] Stasis energy forward that freezes enemy combatants, slows enemy players, and creates [Stasis] Stasis crystals.

Grants an additional melee charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
滑行时激活你的充能近战技能会向前发射一道冰影能量波，冻结地方战斗人员，减速敌方玩家，并产生冰影水晶。

提供额外的近战充能。

perks.name: CQC Optics: Low
perks.description: Slightly reduces zoom magnification.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅降低变焦倍率。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Worm Byproduct
perks.description: Taking damage from your own worm projectile detonation empowers your weapons for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到自身的蠕虫射弹爆炸造成的伤害可在短时间内强化武器。

perks.name: Wire Rifle
perks.description: Swap between scopes to alter firing mode. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换瞄准镜来改变射击模式。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Relay Defender
perks.description: Gain an increase to weapon damage while within 5 meters of an active Vex Relay. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 在激活的Vex继电器周围5米范围内，武器伤害获得大幅提升。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Spark of Feedback
perks.description: Taking melee damage briefly increases your outgoing melee damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 承受近战伤害可在短时间内增加你造成的近战伤害。

perks.name: Bat Wing Entrance
perks.description: Adds the illusion of bat wings to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加蝙蝠翅膀的幻象。

perks.name: Temporal Anomaly
perks.description:
While overcharged, each mode expends a portion of overcharge for additional effects on final blows or precision hits:

Arc mode calls down lightning strikes. 
Stasis mode creates an explosion and a formation of Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh:
过充时，每种模式消耗部分过充，以在最后一击或精准命中时获得额外效果：

电弧模式召唤闪电打击。
冰影模式产生爆炸并生成一组冰影水晶。

perks.name: Silent Alarm
perks.description: Increases handling. Holstering this weapon automatically reloads it after a short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 操控性提高。武器收回枪套一小段时间后会自动填装弹药。

perks.name: Primary Chain
perks.description: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 主弹药武器最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，提升敏捷、主武器射程和操控性，直至你被击败。

perks.name: Sublime Transit
perks.description: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升敏捷并强化冲刺速度和滑行距离。

perks.name: Unstoppable Sidearm
perks.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Sidearm for a short time loads a powerful payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
用手枪举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Extrovert
perks.description: Final blows while near multiple combatants or near Nightmares restores health.
perks.descriptionZh: 在多个战斗人员或梦魇附近完成最后一击可恢复生命值。

perks.name: Power Handicap
perks.description: Your Power is reduced while in this activity.
perks.descriptionZh: 能量在此活动中削弱。

perks.name: Hearts of Ice
perks.description: Winter's Wrath gives targets increased Shatter damage and buffs allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 严冬之怒对目标造成更多碎裂伤害并为盟友提供增益。

perks.name: Echo of Provision
perks.description: Damaging targets with grenades grants melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷对目标造成伤害可回复近战能量。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Scout Reports
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot caches on Mars for all members of the fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在火星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: MIDA Synergy
perks.description: Precision spread. Final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准散射。最后一击会为米达多功能提供改造进度。

perks.name: Liquid Cooling
perks.description: Direct hits by a charged shot instantly freeze the target. Indirect hits freeze combatants and slow opposing Guardians.
perks.descriptionZh: 直接命中充能射击可立即冻结目标。间接命中可冻结战斗人员并让敌方守护者减速。

perks.name: Wind Chill
perks.description: Rapid [Stasis] Stasis weapon hits grant you a stack of Frost Armor; hits against slowed or frozen targets also create a Stasis Shard.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速冰影武器命中会提供一层冰霜护甲；命中被减速或被冻结的目标还会生成一个冰影碎片。

perks.name: Crystalline Converter
perks.description:
After activating your class ability, your next [Stasis] Stasis weapon final blow creates a Stasis Shard. 

Gather Stasis Shards to gain stacks of Crystalline Converter, which cause your next powered Stasis melee hit to create Stasis crystals equal to the number of stacks you have.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活职业技能后，你下一次冰影武器最后一击会生成一个冰影碎片。

收集冰影碎片来获得晶体转换器层数，使你下一次充能冰影近战命中生成冰影水晶，数量等同于你拥有的层数。

perks.name: Total Carnage
perks.description: After finishing a powerful combatant, gain temporary damage resistance and replenish health.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结一个强力战斗人员后，获得临时伤害抗性并回复生命值。

perks.name: Power from Pain
perks.description: Rapid final blows against weakened combatants grants you Devour and creates a Void Breach.
perks.descriptionZh: 对被削弱的战斗人员造成快速最后一击为你提供吞食效果并生成一个虚空裂口。

perks.name: Trace Evidence
perks.description:
Rapid precision hits or rapid final blows on targets affected by Jolt or Blind will generate Ionic Traces.

Picking up an Ionic Trace grants an Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
对受到震颤或致盲效果影响的目标造成快速精准命中或快速最后一击，会生成离子轨迹。

拾起离子轨迹会提供护甲充能。

perks.name: The Thick of It
perks.description: Rapid final blows while surrounded grant you Armor Charge. While you are surrounded, your weapons have increased handling; Swords gain increased charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 被包围时，快速最后一击会为你提供护甲充能。你被包围时，武器的操控性提升。刀剑的充能速度提升。

perks.name: Finders Keepers
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo grants a chance to receive an Armor Charge. Heavy ammo grants a greater chance.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取特殊或重型弹药有几率赋予护甲充能。重型弹药提供的几率更高。

perks.name: Overload Auto Rifle
perks.description: Sustained fire from Auto Rifles disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 自动步枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Pulse Rifle
perks.description: Sustained fire from Pulse Rifles disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 脉冲步枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Piercing Sidearms
perks.description: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perks.description: Aiming down the sights of a Hand Cannon for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 手炮举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Bow
perks.description: Holding a Bow fully drawn for a short time loads powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Bows are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 完全开弓一小段时间可装填强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间弓箭将始终过充。

perks.name: Aberrant Combustion
perks.description: Precision final blows with Amalgamation Rounds cause the target to detonate into a weakening blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用合并弹药造成精准最后一击会引爆目标，产生削弱爆破。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Berserker
perks.description: When your Super ends, you gain a temporary bonus to weapon damage. The duration and strength of this bonus increases based on the number of combatants you defeated with your Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的超能技能结束时获得短时间的武器伤害加成。此加成的持续时间和强度取决于你使用超能消灭的战斗人员数量。

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Substantially increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 每个完全充能的技能都会大幅提升操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

perks.name: Overdrive
perks.description: [Boost]  : Greater speed at risk of exploding.
perks.descriptionZh: [加速]  ：获得更高速度，但会有爆炸的危险。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Auto Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善自动步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Rapid Precision Rifling
perks.description: Rapid precision hits or final blows with Scout Rifles grants them increased reload and reduced incoming flinch.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用斥候步枪快速精准命中或造成最后一击，可提升填装速度并减少受到伤害时的抖动。

perks.name: Tightly Woven
perks.description: While Woven Mail is active, gain increased class ability and Grenade stats.
perks.descriptionZh: 在织造铠甲启用时，获得提升的职业技能和手雷属性。

perks.name: Threadling Proliferation
perks.description: Dealing [Strand] Strand weapon damage has the chance to spawn a Threadling. Defeating a Strand-debuffed target increases this chance.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成 缚丝武器伤害有几率生成一个线虫。击败被缚丝减益的目标会提升此几率。

perks.name: Light-Forged Lead
perks.description: Kinetic weapons gain increased ammo generation. Collecting an Orb of Power increases this benefit for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 动能武器获得弹药生成速度提升。手机能量球可在短时间内提升此增益。

perks.name: Flame, Fiber, and Freeze
perks.description: Combines the Solar/Strand and Solar/Stasis Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将烈日/缚丝和烈日/冰影虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: One with Frost
perks.description: While Frost Armor is active, [Stasis] Stasis weapons gain increased reload speed and stability. Stasis Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰霜护甲启用时，冰影武器的填装速度和稳定性提升。冰影刀剑的防御抗性提升。

perks.name: Diviner's Discount
perks.description: All Scavenger mods are discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 所有回收器模组均享有折扣。

perks.name: The Survivor
perks.description: Three rapid precision kills while the Roadborn is active will return two rounds to the chamber.
perks.descriptionZh: 当天生在途激活时，三次快速精准击杀会向弹匣返还两枚弹药。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Conversionist
perks.description: With no augment, collecting Orbs of Power causes you to periodically spawn Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 没有增益时，收集能量球会为你周期性生成重型弹药。

perks.name: Banner Shield
perks.description: Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall. Allies who shoot through the wall have increased weapon damage, and Guarding allies makes the shield last longer.
perks.descriptionZh: 与哨兵圣盾一同制造一堵巨型防护墙。射穿防护墙的盟友的武器伤害会提高，保护盟友可延长圣盾时间。

perks.name: Tenderizer
perks.description: Staggering Unstoppable Champions temporarily boosts weapon damage for allied players.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕 势不可挡勇士会短时间内强化队友的武器伤害。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Enhanced Scout Rifle Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型斥候步枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高斥候步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Soaring Fang
perks.description: Ground damage charges; airborne damage extends.
perks.descriptionZh: 地面伤害充能；空中伤害延时。

perks.name: Striking Hand
perks.description:
While you're on the Leviathan, melee kills increase all damage by 20%.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在利维坦上时，取得近战击杀可让所有攻击造成20%额外伤害。

这个模组的能力无法重复叠加。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Business Time
perks.description: Sustained fire boosts range and rate of fire.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续开火可提升射程和射速。

perks.name: Overloaded Auto/SMG
perks.nameZh: 过载自动步枪/微型冲锋枪
perks.description: Sustained fire from Auto Rifles and Submachine Guns disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions. Additionally, Auto Rifles and Submachine Guns are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 自动步枪和微型冲锋枪的持续射击会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪和微型冲锋枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Scout Rifle
perks.description: Aiming down the sights of a Scout Rifle for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 斥候步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Bow
perks.description: Damage by fully drawn arrows from your equipped Bows causes disruption,  stunning the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. Additionally, Bows are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 拉满弓射出的箭会造成混乱效果，从而眩晕目标，延缓其技能能量回复并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间弓箭将始终过充。

perks.name: Piercing Sidearms
perks.description: Your equipped Sidearms fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的手枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Pulse Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的脉冲步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Stunloader
perks.description: Stunning a Champion substantially refills this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士可从备弹中大量填充此武器的弹匣。

perks.name: Echo of Instability
perks.description: Defeating targets with grenades grants Volatile Rounds to your Void weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷击败目标可给你的虚空武器装上不稳定弹药。

perks.name: Arc Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Hellas Basin Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 赫拉斯盆地缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Pulse Rifle Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定脉冲步枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用脉冲步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Sniper Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的狙击步枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: No Backpack
perks.description: Final blows create ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会生成弹药。

perks.name: Phosphor Ascent
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Bolt Scavenger
perks.description: Recovering a bolt increases reload speed and handling for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 回收弩弹会在更长的时间内提升填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: Bullwhacker
perks.description: Aim down sights for a period of time to overcharge the next bolt fired. Increases damage and area of effect for each charge level.
perks.descriptionZh: 按住瞄准一段时间可过充下一发射出的光弹。每一级充能都会提高伤害与效果范围。

perks.name: EDZ Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在欧洲无人区中获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Unflinching Energy Aim
perks.description: Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming your Energy weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用能量武器瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Wicked Kudu
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Child of the Old Gods
perks.description:
Cast your rift to create a Void Soul. When you damage a target with a weapon, your Void Soul flies to them and drains them, doing damage and weakening them. Combatants affected by the Soul are also briefly suppressed.

When a target is being drained, you are granted grenade and melee energy (if running Healing Rift) or health (if running Empowering Rift).

Defeating a target who is being drained by your Void Soul grants class ability energy.

The Void Soul's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
施放你的裂痕来制造一个虚空灵魂。使用武器对目标造成伤害时，你的虚空之魂会飞向他们并进行汲取，造成伤害并削弱他们。受灵魂影响的战斗人员还会被短暂压制。

目标被汲取时，你将获得手雷和近战能量（如果使用治愈裂痕）或生命值（如果使用强能裂痕）。

击败正被虚空灵魂汲取的目标可提供职业技能能量。

虚空灵魂的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perks.name: Regenerative Motion
perks.description: Sprinting gradually reloads this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺会逐渐填装此武器。

perks.name: Vigilant Watch
perks.description: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着你的生命值降低，你的武器获得稳定性和操控性提升。护盾耗尽时造成武器最后一击可获得治疗。

perks.name: Iron Conviction
perks.description: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的护盾破裂时，你在短时间内获得弹药生成速度、抖动抗性和对附近战斗人员伤害抗性提升。最后一击会延长此效果。

perks.name: Unstoppable Pulse Rifle
perks.description:
Aiming down Pulse Rifle sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
举枪瞄准脉冲步枪会装载一梭强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击和使用此武器消灭目标可提高此武器造成的伤害，持续时间更长。

perks.name: Martingale
perks.description: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友被击败或你复活盟友时，你的武器会获得暂时的操控性和瞄准速度提升。

perks.name: Paroli
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行后主弹药武器会获得抖动抗性加成。

perks.name: Sneak Bow
perks.description: Increases hold time and reload speed; prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched. Improves stability and reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升充能时间和填装速度；蹲伏时射击不产生雷达信号。提高稳定性和填装速度。

perks.name: Eyes Up
perks.description:
This weapon gains reload speed, range, and slightly increased damage against combatants for a short time when combat begins.

Final blows extend and enhance this bonus by an improved amount.
perks.descriptionZh:
战斗开始时，此武器在短时间内获得填装速度、射程，并略微提升对战斗人员的伤害。

最后一击会更多地延长和强化此加成。

perks.name: Mattermorph melee attacks deal [Strand] Strand damage and apply suspend and unravel.
perks.nameZh: 物质变形近战攻击造成  缚丝伤害并施加悬停和瓦解。
perks.description: Mattermorph melee attacks deal [Strand] Strand damage and apply suspend and unravel.
perks.descriptionZh: 物质变形近战攻击造成  缚丝伤害并施加悬停和瓦解。

perks.name: Six-Shooter
perks.description: Golden Gun can be fired quickly up to 6 times and refunds a bullet with each kill.
perks.descriptionZh: 黄金枪可最多快速射击6次，且每完成一次击杀都将补偿一枚子弹。

perks.name: Pyrogenesis
perks.description: Solar laser scorches targets hit and ignites them when defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 完全充能激光将从备弹中重新填满弹夹。

perks.name: Lantern Effects
perks.description: Adds a lantern to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个灯笼。

perks.name: Unstoppable Arrows
perks.description: Fully drawn arrows release a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 拉满弓箭将释放强力爆炸，可眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Cursebringer
perks.description: Precision final blows trigger an explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会触发一次爆炸。

perks.name: Concussion Grenades
perks.description: Grenades emit a blast that staggers enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 可发射冲击波榴弹，让敌人眩晕。

perks.name: Ward of Dawn
perks.description: When Super energy is full, create an indestructible dome to protect you and your allies. Passing through Ward of Dawn grants you and your allies a temporary increase to weapon damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能就绪时，制造一个 坚不可摧的圆顶护罩 保护自己和友军。穿过黎明护罩可暂时提高你和友军的 武器伤害 。

perks.name: Bronze Contender's Boon
perks.description:
This buff commemorates a Bronze Tier score in the Guardian Games Rushdown activity on Expert mode.

Weapons and abilities empower each other. Defeating combatants with abilities grants increased weapon damage. Defeating combatants with weapons grants increased ability recharge speed. 

Active only in Guardian Games Rushdown activities. This buff will expire on weekly reset.
perks.descriptionZh:
此增益用于纪念在专家模式的守护者游戏急速强攻活动中的青铜阶得分。

武器与技能可互相赋能。使用技能击败战斗人员可增加武器伤害。使用武器击败战斗人员可提高技能充能速度。

仅在守护者游戏急速强攻活动中有效。此增益将在周重置时过期。

perks.name: Marksman Optics: High
perks.description: Slightly increases zoom magnification.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅提高变焦倍率。

perks.name: Traveler's Multiplicity
perks.description: Finisher final blows convert your next thrown grenade into a bonus fragmentation grenade.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击会将你下一枚投掷的手雷转化为额外的碎片手雷。

perks.name: Traveler's Animus
perks.description: Defeating a combatant has a chance to create a random Elemental pickup or Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败战斗人员有一定几率生成一个随机元素拾取物或能量球。

perks.name: Traveler's Abundance
perks.description: Defeating combatants with your grenade has a chance to spawn Special ammo. Defeating combatants with your Super ability has a chance to spawn Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷击败战斗人员有一定几率生成特殊弹药。使用超能技能击败战斗人员有一定几率生成重型弹药。

perks.name: Voltaic Ammo Collector
perks.description: Increases the chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have the Voltaic Overflow buff. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高你在拥有溢出电流时找到重型弹药的几率。此模组的多个副本可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Vestigial Alchemy
perks.description:
This weapon gains energy when you pick up Vestiges and allows you to create ammo at the projectile impact point for you and your allies. Special ammo mode unlocks at 50% energy, while Heavy ammo mode unlocks at 100% energy. 

To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to activate Special ammo mode. [Alternate Weapon Action]  a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器在你拾取残余时获得能量，并让你能在射弹命中位置为你和你的盟友生成弹药。特殊弹药模式可在50%能量时解锁，重型弹药模式则需100%能量。

要将残余转化为特殊弹药，按下[替换武器动作]以激活特殊弹药模式。再按[替换武器动作]以激活重型弹药模式。

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成最后一击可提高武器伤害力，持续时间延长。可叠加3次。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Combo Detector
perks.nameZh: 赫拉斯盆地缓存箱综合探测器
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Overpressured Munitions
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage against Cabal targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可对卡巴尔目标造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Stay in the Fight
perks.description: When your shields are broken, this weapon gains a period of increased stability and ammo generation.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾破裂时，此武器会暂时获得稳定性和弹药生成提升。

perks.name: Kill Shot
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow loads a high-powered round, causing the next hit to cause additional splash damage. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后填装，会加载高威力弹药，使下一次命中造成额外溅射伤害。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Calm Amidst Chaos
perks.description: After not taking damage for a short duration, this weapon gains significantly increased aim down sight speed, handling and flinch resistance until the next shot is fired.
perks.descriptionZh: 短时间内未受伤害后，此武器会获得显著提升的瞄准速度、操控性与抖动抗性，效果持续至下一次射击。

perks.name: Opening Salvo
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range and deals more flinch at the start of combat for a duration. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 战斗开始时，此武器会暂时获得射程加成并造成更多的抖动。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Bray Inheritance
perks.description: Dealing damage regenerates a small amount of ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会恢复少量技能能量。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Frenzied Stacks
perks.description: Your Armor Charges grant bonus damage to your thrown Tangles or Elemental Orbs. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲充能会为你投掷出的缠结或元素能量球提供额外伤害。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Elemental Munitions
perks.description: Combatant final blows with Tangles or Elemental Orbs have a chance to drop Special or Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缠结或元素能量球对战斗人员造成最后一击有几率掉落特殊或重型弹药。

perks.name: Monochromatic Maestro
perks.description: Dealing elemental ability damage increases matching weapon damage, and elemental weapon damage increases matching ability damage. Bonus granted is 10% for 5 seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成元素技能伤害会提升相匹配武器的伤害，元素武器伤害会提升相匹配技能的伤害。伤害加成为10%，持续5秒。

perks.name: Elemental Embrace
perks.description: Subclass elemental buffs grant you bonus recovery and damage resistance against combatant attacks of the matching element type.
perks.descriptionZh: 分支职业元素增益可提供对相匹配元素类型战斗人员攻击的额外恢复和伤害抗性。

perks.name: Sundering Glare
perks.description: Rapid precision hits against distant combatants weaken them for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对远距离战斗人员的精准命中会在短时间内削弱他们。

perks.name: Phalanx Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Cabal Red Legion shield appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个卡巴尔猩红军团盾的外观。

perks.name: Wireframe Entrance
perks.description: Adds a luminous, sketched appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个发光素描风外观。

perks.name: Stag Lord
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被抑制。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Arc Analyzer
perks.description: Generate gunsmith telemetry data on Arc weapon final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 在电弧武器最后一击时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.description: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅增加操控性，大幅降低目标捕获能力。

perks.name: Infestation
perks.description: Improved aim assist and recoil direction. Refreshes health on Vermin invisibility trigger.
perks.descriptionZh: 对瞄准辅助性能和后坐方向进行优化。鼠害隐身触发时刷新生命值。

perks.name: Fire and Ice
perks.description: Defeating a Champion spawns multiple Solar and Stasis wells.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败勇士可以生成多个烈日和冰影元素井。

perks.name: Festive Entrance
perks.description: Adds a festive appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个节庆外观。

perks.name: Ambush
perks.description: Greatly improves range, handling, and damage against combatants during the opening moments of an engagement.
perks.descriptionZh: 在刚开始交火时，大幅提升对战斗人员的射程、操控性和伤害。

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成最后一击会产生近战能量。
造成近战伤害会在短时间内提升此武器的操控性。

perks.name: Weaver's Call
perks.description:
Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能来编织三条线虫并部署任何你已息停的线虫。

造成伤害和击败目标将产生息停线虫。

perks.name: Glacial Guard
perks.description: Stasis final blows and your class ability grant Frost Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰影最后一击和你的职业技能会提供冰霜护甲。

perks.name: +15 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +15 Grenade ▲

perks.name: Dream Work
perks.description: Once per reload, assists or assisted final blows partially refill the weapon from reserves and increase reload speed for a short duration. Bows receive faster draw time.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次重新填装时，助攻或协助最后一击可从储存弹药中部分填装武器，并在短时间内提高填装速度。弓箭的开弓速度更快。

perks.name: Machine Gun Scavenger
perks.description: Machine Guns get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时机枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 为火箭添加追踪能力。瞄准时锁定目标。

perks.name: Special Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对特殊弹药量表的所有计入效果。

perks.name: Golden Gun
perks.description: Summon a flaming pistol that disintegrates enemies with Solar Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 召唤一把烈焰手枪，产生烈日之光裂解敌人。

perks.name: Elemental Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by picking up an elemental well. If the elemental well's element type matches your subclass element, you gain 2 stacks of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取元素井也会使你充斥光能。如果元素井的元素类型与你的分支职业元素相同，你会获得2层光之充能。

perks.name: Multi-Threaded Snare
perks.description: Snareweaver traps can suspend more targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 织陷者的陷阱可悬停更多目标。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: High-Tier Elimination
perks.description: Gain bonus ability energy when defeating challenging combatants or higher.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败高阶或更具挑战性的战斗人员可获得额外技能能量。

perks.name: Double XP: Season Pass
perks.description: Season Pass progression is currently doubled for a limited time!
perks.descriptionZh: 限时内季票进度获取速度加倍！

perks.name: Unstoppable Grenade Launcher
perks.nameZh: 势不可挡的榴弹发射器
perks.description:
When you ready or reload a Grenade Launcher, for a short period, that weapon stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你准备或填装榴弹发射器时，短时间内，这把武器会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Advance Scout
perks.description: Champions you stun take additional damage from teammates.
perks.descriptionZh: 队友可对你眩晕的勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Counter Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light whenever you or a member of your fireteam stuns any Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，使你充斥光能。

perks.name: Low Entropy Superconductor
perks.description:
Stasis and Arc melee abilities stun unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
电弧和冰影近战技能会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Lord Kelvin's Basilisk
perks.description:
Void and Stasis grenades cause disruption, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
虚空和冰影手雷会造成混乱效果，延缓战斗人员的技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.description: Dragonfly deals more damage based on the number of precision hits dealt beforehand.
perks.descriptionZh: 蜻蜓会根据先前造成的精准射击次数造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Phosphene Stimulus
perks.description: Adds a phosphene appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个光幻视外观。

perks.name: Inflorescence
perks.description: Adds an inflorescence appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个花序外观。

perks.name: Harvester Spike
perks.description: Harvest the Vestiges of your foes.
perks.descriptionZh: 收割你敌人的残余。

perks.name: Will of Light (Stasis)
perks.description: Your equipped weapons that deal Stasis damage deal increased damage to Taken combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的冰影伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Unyielding Handle
perks.description: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain damage resistance from being in combat for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 传统防御被禁用，转而偏好进攻能力。处于战斗状态时，短时间内获得伤害抗性。

perks.name: Arc Staff
perks.description:
Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.

[Block] : Hold to deflect incoming projectiles with your Arc staff.

Deflecting a projectile grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.

Heavy attack combos and airborne heavy slams blind targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
生成一支充斥着纯粹电弧能量的法杖，华丽地击杀你的敌人。

[格挡]：按住来用你的电弧法杖抵挡来袭的射弹。

抵挡射弹会为你提供一层电光充能。

重攻击连击和空中猛击重攻击会致盲目标。

perks.name: Gathering Storm
perks.description:
Hurl your Arc Staff forward, embedding it into surfaces or large targets and jolting nearby targets.

After a short time, a devastating lightning bolt strikes the staff, overcharging it with Arc energy. While overcharged, your staff discharges lightning at nearby foes.
perks.descriptionZh:
将你的电弧法杖向前抛出，将其嵌在表面或大型目标上，震颤附近的目标。

短时间后，一道毁灭性的闪电将击中法杖，使其被电弧能量过充。在过充时，你的法杖会对附近的敌人放出闪电。

perks.name: Storm's Edge
perks.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一把透电匕首，朝瞄准的方向投出。

当匕首命中某个表面或目标时，你会瞬移至其位置并施展强力旋风打击，对任何附近目标造成伤害。打击后可重新激活施展额外投掷。

匕首在未命中任何对象的情况下飞行足够远的距离后会引爆，而你将会瞬移至引爆位置。

perks.name: Umbral Harbinger
perks.description: Adds a Taken appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个傀儡军团外观。

perks.name: Gold Plating
perks.description: Adds a digital gold appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个数字黄金外观。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Vanishing Execution
perks.description: Powered melee kills and finishers grant invisibility and healing.
perks.descriptionZh: 强大近战击杀和终结技将赋予隐身和治疗。

perks.name: Overload Hand Cannon
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits with any Hand Cannon you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用手炮连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能恢复速度并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Unsated Hunger
perks.description:
Improved handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain improved guard resistance and charge rate instead.
