perks.descriptionZh:
在没有技能处于完全充能状态时提高操控性、填装速度和稳定性。

刀剑则提高防御抗性和充能速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Arc Ammo Generation
perks.description: Increases the ammo generation of Arc weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升电弧武器的弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Cormorant Reversal
perks.description: While guarding, this Sword converts incoming projectiles into bolts that reflect to where you're aiming.
perks.descriptionZh: 进行格挡时，此刀剑会将来袭的射弹转化为光弹并弹向你瞄准的位置。

perks.name: Arc Conductor
perks.description: Taking Arc damage increases weapon power and Arc resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到电弧伤害可提高武器威力和电弧伤害抗性。

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.
perks.descriptionZh: 长时间处于战斗状态会使此武器获得额外伤害。更长时间的战斗状态会使此武器获得更大的额外伤害，并周期性治疗使用者。

perks.name: Whisper of Chill
perks.description: [Stasis] Stasis weapon final blows have a chance to create a Stasis Shard.
perks.descriptionZh: 冰影武器最后一击有几率生成一个冰影碎片。

perks.name: Unstoppable Shot
perks.description: Aiming down sights loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 举枪瞄准会装载一个高爆载荷，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Loss
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and aim assist whenever your shields are broken or when a friendly Guardian is defeated. Effect lasts until you are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被打破时，或一名友方守护者被击败时，此武器的稳定性、操控性和瞄准辅助获得提升。效果持续至你被击败。

perks.name: Grenade Mod
perks.description: Increases the Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升手雷属性。

perks.name: Temporal Unlimiter
perks.description:
Defeating targets builds stacks of Overcharge.

[Alternate Weapon Action]  : When fully Overcharged, swap firing modes. In this mode, hold the trigger to charge up and fire Linear Fusion Rifle shots that cause an ignition on precision final blows.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败目标可以积累过充层数。

[替换武器动作] ：完全过充时，切换射击模式。此模式下，长按扳机充能并发射线性融合步枪射击，在精准最后一击时引燃。

perks.name: Minor Super Mod
perks.description: Increases the Super stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升超能属性。

perks.name: Ember of Combustion
perks.description: Final blows with a Solar Super causes targets to ignite and creates a Firesprite.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日超能完成最后一击可对目标造成点燃效果并生成一个焰灵。

perks.name: Relocator teleportation applies a Void overshield.
perks.nameZh: 重定位器传送会施加虚空覆盖护盾。
perks.description: Relocator teleportation applies a Void overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 重定位器传送会施加虚空覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Color Variants
perks.description: This transmat effect may be awarded in silver, gold, green, or purple color variants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此传送效果可能出现银色、金色、绿色或紫色变幻。

perks.name: +3 Weapon ▲
perks.description: +3 Weapon ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +3 武器 ▲

perks.name: +5 Weapon ▲
perks.description: +5 Weapon ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 武器 ▲

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Use Relocator Launchers to reach previously restricted areas.
perks.nameZh: 使用重定位发射器到达之前受限的区域。
perks.description: Use Relocator Launchers to reach previously restricted areas.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用重定位发射器到达之前受限的区域。

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
perks.descriptionZh: 当被战斗人员包围时，此武器的爆炸范围会增大。启用时，此武器对持有者造成的伤害会大幅降低。

perks.name: Seeker of Brilliance
perks.description: In addition to their normal rewards, encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" can award Bright Engrams. This chance increases each time no Bright Engram drops.
perks.descriptionZh: 除一般奖励外，“利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战还将奖励光明记忆水晶。若未掉落光明记忆水晶，则该几率会不断提升。

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.description: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标会奖励一个曙光节礼物。击败强力目标算作多次击败。

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣中的弹药减少时，射程、精度和操控性随之进一步提高。

perks.name: Nova Warp
perks.description:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.
[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance.
[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption.
perks.descriptionZh:
在位面之间行进以颠覆物理定律。
[超能附技能] ：传送一小段距离。
[超能主技能]  ： 释放一次致命虚空爆发。

perks.name: Lead From Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power causes your next final blow with this weapon to grant bonus Special ammo meter progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后，此武器造成的下一次最后一击将提供额外特殊弹药量表进度。

perks.name: Amalgamation Rounds
perks.description:
Aiming down sights for a short period without firing compresses the spread into a single high-density projectile. Damaging a target with this shot marks them.

This weapon deals additional damage to marked targets. Defeating a marked target or landing a precision final blow with an Amalgamation Round grants invisibility and truesight.
perks.descriptionZh:
瞄准一小段时间而不射击可将扇形弹道压缩为高密度单发射弹。用这发射弹伤害目标会施加标记。

此武器对被标记的目标造成额外伤害。击败被标记的目标或使用合并弹药造成精准最后一击会获得隐身和真视。

perks.name: Misdirection
perks.description: Dodging disorients and removes enemy radars.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身迷惑敌人并关闭敌人雷达。

perks.name: Ascendant Bounty
perks.description: Defeating Taken combatants with your finisher grants a large amount of glimmer.
perks.descriptionZh: 用终结技消灭傀儡军团战斗人员有几率获得大量微光。

perks.name: Cryoclasm
perks.description: Your slide distance is greatly increased. Sliding releases a wave that shatters [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets on contact, along with any other frozen targets nearby.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅增加你的滑行距离。滑行时释放一道冲击波，接触时击碎  冰影水晶或被冻结的目标，以及附近其他被冻结的目标。

perks.name: Vanguard Operations Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while in Vanguard Ops.
perks.descriptionZh: 在先锋行动中获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Enhanced Linear Fusion Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型线性融合步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善线性融合步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Whisper of Reversal
perks.description: While you have Frost Armor, melee damage slows your target.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，近战伤害可减速你的目标。

perks.name: Void Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered Sword final blow, with a chance for additional ammo to be provided.
perks.descriptionZh: 每隔一次的赋能刀剑最后一击都可提供刀剑弹药，并有几率提供额外弹药。

perks.name: All-Star
perks.description:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取弹药会从备弹中填装此武器，并在一段时间内提升其伤害和填装速度。

拾取重型弹药提供的时间更长。

perks.name: Shotgun Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高霰弹枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Crucible Hoarder
perks.description: Chance to gain a second Crucible token whenever you receive one.
perks.descriptionZh: 有几率在获得熔炉竞技场代币时获得一枚额外的代币。

perks.name: Ballistics
perks.description: Greatly increases range and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升射程和稳定性。

perks.name: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Super ▼
perks.description: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Super ▼

perks.name: Shotgun Scavenger
perks.description: Shotguns get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Shotgun.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该霰弹枪所用弹药时，霰弹枪获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Superconductor
perks.description: When Arc Conductor is active, shots fired have the chance to become chain lightning and return ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧导体激活时，射击有几率形成连锁闪电并归还弹药。

perks.name: Mercury Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Enhanced Charge Time
perks.description: +10 Charge Time
perks.descriptionZh: +10 充能时间

perks.name: Tangled Shore Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while on the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸上获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Moon Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on the Moon.
perks.descriptionZh: 在月球上探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Elliptical Orbit
perks.description: After briefly sprinting, gain significantly increased ammo generation. Alternatively, gain significantly more stability, reload speed, and flinch resistance when not sprinting for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 短暂冲刺后，获得显著提升的弹药生成。停止冲刺一小段时间后，改而获得显著增加的稳定性、填装速度和抖动抗性。

perks.name: Ember of Torches
perks.description: Powered melee attacks against combatants make you and nearby allies radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 对战斗人员进行的充能近战攻击可赋予你和附近友军焕光效果。

perks.name: Armor of Eramis
perks.description: BOOST: Increase radius and strength of this freezing burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化：提升此冻结爆发的范围和强度。

perks.name: Public Service
perks.description: Increases public event rewards.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高公共事件的奖励。

perks.name: Polished Sockets
perks.description: Increases this armor's mobility, allowing you to move faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高这件护甲的敏捷度，以提高移动速度。

perks.name: Arc Effects
perks.description: Adds Arc elements to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加电弧元素。

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage for an improved duration. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 偃月射弹最后一击会增加偃月近战伤害，且持续时间更长。偃月射弹或近战伤害会延长效果持续时间。

perks.name: Unflinching Scout Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用斥候步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Hive Slayer
perks.description: Improves rewards from eliminating Hive enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭邪魔族敌人可获得更好的奖励。

perks.name: Decipher Aionian characters, allowing interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
perks.nameZh: 解密艾昂人的文字，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行交互。
perks.description: Decipher Aionian characters, allowing interfacing with Aionian devices and ciphers.
perks.descriptionZh: 解密艾昂人的文字，使你能够与艾昂人的设备和暗码进行交互。

perks.name: Ionic Conductor
perks.description: Improved ionic traces
perks.descriptionZh: 改良的离子轨迹

perks.name: Adept Icarus Grip
perks.description: Moderately increases airborne effectiveness. Slightly increases handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 中幅提高空中效率。略微提高操控性。

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.description: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 生命值低下时，使用此武器造成最后一击可提供强化雷达，将你从敌方守护者雷达上移除，并减少战斗人员对你的攻击性，效果持续时间更长。

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在连射中，每一次射击命中都会提高此武器的伤害并减少充能时间，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Hopeful Light
perks.description: Increase XP gains by 5%.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得的经验值增加5%。

perks.name: Burning Light
perks.description: Increase XP gains by 8%.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得的经验值增加8%。

perks.name: Flickering Light
perks.description: Increase XP gains by 2%.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得的经验值增加2%。

perks.name: Little Light
perks.description: Increase XP gains by 3%.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得的经验值增加3%。

perks.name: Guiding Light
perks.description: Increase XP gains by 10%.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得的经验值增加10%。

perks.name: Blinding Light
perks.description: Increase XP gains by 12%.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得的经验值增加12%。

perks.name: Accelerator: Heavy Surge
perks.description: Increases Heavy weapon damage and ammo drops.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升重型武器伤害和弹药掉落。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Concentrated Forward Firepower
perks.description: Sustained damage from Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Machine Guns grants those weapons bonus stability, range, and aim assist for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 来自融合步枪、线性融合步枪和机枪的持续伤害，会在短时间内为这些武器提供额外的稳定性、射程和瞄准辅助。

perks.name: Vanguard Surplus Discounts
perks.description: All Ammo Finder mods are discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 所有弹药搜寻者模组均享有折扣。

perks.name: Fastest Draw
perks.description: If the first shot shortly after reloading or readying your weapon is a precision hit, gain flinch resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 如果填装或举起武器后不久的第一次命中为精准命中，则获得抖动抗性。

perks.name: Elemental Siphon
perks.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。

perks.name: Gravitic-Voltaic Charge
perks.description: While you have an Arc or Void Super equipped, increase the maximum number of stacks of Armor Charge you can carry by 1.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备电弧或虚空超能时，增加1层你可携带的最大护甲充能层数。

perks.name: Expert Handling
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to stability which resets on weapon reload or stow. Swords gain Guard Resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会赋予可叠加的稳定性加成，填装或收起武器时重置。刀剑获得防御抗性。

perks.name: Impact, Shock, Gravity
perks.description:
Grants access to the Helmet mods: Kinetic/Void Siphon and Kinetic/Arc Siphon.

These mods combine two elemental siphons at a discounted cost.
perks.descriptionZh:
可使用头盔模组：动能/虚空虹吸和动能/电弧虹吸。

这些模组以折扣花费组合两种元素虹吸。

perks.name: -5 Health ▼
perks.description: -5 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -5 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Stylish Executioner
perks.description:
Defeating a target affected by any elemental debuff grants invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败受到任何元素减益效果影响的目标可获得隐身和真视。

在完成一次潇洒处刑后，你下一次的隐身近战攻击会使目标虚弱。

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne accuracy and reduces flinch until you are out of combat for an extended duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 参加战斗一定时间后会增加空中精度并减少后仰，效果持续到你离开战斗一段时间后。

perks.name: Blastwave Striders
perks.description: Blast your boots to spray your targets with shrapnel.
perks.descriptionZh: 爆破你的战靴来向你的目标喷射碎片。

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速最后一击会在目标附近生成一块更大的冰影水晶。

perks.name: Wolfpack Rounds
perks.description: Heavy attacks grant micro-missiles to Sword-wielders.
perks.descriptionZh: 重攻击会为刀剑使用者提供微型导弹。

perks.name: Timeless Mythoclast
perks.description: This weapon fires full auto.
perks.descriptionZh: 这把武器全自动开火。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
perks.description: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲ /-5 近战 ▼

perks.name: Accelerator: Special Surge
perks.description: Increase Special weapon damage and ammo drops.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升特殊武器伤害和弹药掉落。

perks.name: Heretical Behavior
perks.description: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants for an improved duration. Gain this bonus immediately for a significantly longer duration when you are revived.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力目标造成持续武器伤害或最后一击会为此武器提供额外的填装、操控性以及对战斗人员的伤害，持续时间延长。当你被复活时，立即获得此增益，且持续时间显著更长。

perks.name: Saint's Fists
perks.description: Charge to fire 3 spreads of Kinetic slugs. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能以发射三束动能弹药。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Solar Impact Accelerator
perks.description:
Solar melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
提高烈日近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Overclock and Load
perks.description: While you are amplified or have Bolt Charge, [Arc]Arc weapons gain increased handling and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有增幅或电光充能时，提高电弧武器的操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: Deep Alchemy
perks.description: Weapons with the Subjugation Origin Trait gain stability and reload speed for a short duration when hitting any target. These weapons are also overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 具有征服原始特性的武器在命中任意目标时会短时间内获得稳定性和填装速度。该修改器生效期间此类武器将始终过充。

perks.name: Volatile Marksman
perks.description: Rapid [Void]Void weapon precision hits and rapid Void weapon final blows grant Volatile Rounds. Volatile detonations grant class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速虚空武器精准命中和快速虚空武器最后一击会提供不稳定弹药。不稳定引爆会提供职业技能能量。

perks.name: Legend Incarnate
perks.description: Weapons with the Timelost Magazine Origin Trait gain bonus damage; these weapons are also overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 带有失时弹匣原始特性的武器会获得伤害加成。该修改器生效期间此类武器将始终过充。

perks.name: Unraveling Orbs
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power or a Tangle grants [Strand]Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球或缠结会使 缚丝武器获得瓦解弹药。

perks.name: Beam Medic
perks.description:
Rapid Trace Rifle final blows heal you and nearby allies.
Powerful combatants increase the amount.
perks.descriptionZh:
追踪步枪快速最后一击会治疗你和附近的盟友。
强力战斗人员的治疗量更多。

perks.name: Vile Weave
perks.description: Targets hit by your Tangles are severed. Reduce Tangle cooldown by picking one up.
perks.descriptionZh: 被你的缠结击中的目标会被割裂。拾取缠结会减少缠结冷却。

perks.name: Unflinching Large Arms
perks.description: Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, Machine Guns, and Shotguns.
perks.descriptionZh: 略微降低使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器、机枪和霰弹枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Enhanced Submachine Gun Dexterity
perks.nameZh: 强化型微型冲锋枪灵巧
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高微型冲锋枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Pyretic Embrace
perks.description: Casting a Solar Super restores you to full health and shields.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放烈日超能会为你回复全部生命和护盾值。

perks.name: Thread of Transmutation
perks.description: While you have Woven Mail, weapon final blows create a Tangle.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于织造铠甲状态时，武器最后一击会生成一个缠结。

perks.name: Swarmers
perks.description: Threadlings spawn from Tangles and unravel targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 通过缠结可生成线虫并瓦解目标。

perks.name: Thundercrash
perks.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into enemies to inflict meteoric damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 像导弹一样飞速穿过空中撞进敌人群中，造成流星伤害。

perks.name: Heavy Burst
perks.description: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射威力巨大的两发点射。降低瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面抖动。

perks.name: Signal Intercept
perks.description: Adds a modified Black Armory theme to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个修改过的黑色军械库主题。

perks.name: Capsule Gang Entrance
perks.description: Adds a neo-capsule appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个近地太空舱外观。

perks.name: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.description: +5 Weapons ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 武器 ▲ /-5 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Deeper Pockets
perks.description: Increased ammo reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加弹药储备量。

perks.name: Ember of Resolve
perks.description: Solar grenade final blows cure you.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日手雷最后一击可获得治愈效果。

perks.name: +3 Health ▲
perks.description: +3 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +3 生命值 ▲

perks.name: +5 Health ▲
perks.description: +5 Health ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲

perks.name: Electrified Conductor
perks.description: Receive a large amount of Special ammo when charging a conductor.
perks.descriptionZh: 为导体充能可获得大量特殊弹药。

perks.name: Public Defender
perks.description: Increased loot from public events on all destinations.
perks.descriptionZh: 在所有目的地的公共事件中获得更好的战利品。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Ward of Dawn
perks.description:
Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.
perks.descriptionZh:
为你和你的盟友制造一个防护圆顶护罩。

你和你的盟友处在黎明护罩中时，会获得虚空覆盖护盾并且提升武器伤害，护罩内的目标则会被削弱。

护罩的制造者在护罩中时还会获得近战伤害提升，并且可以拾取并投掷护罩核心，以此重新放置护罩，最多两次。

perks.name: Sentinel Shield
perks.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤一面虚空光能圣盾。
哨兵圣盾生效时：
[轻攻击]  ：攻击。
[格挡]  ：格挡。
[手雷]  ：进行圣盾投掷。

用哨兵圣盾防御来制造一堵可以吸引敌人火力的防护墙。处于护盾后方的盟友将获得更高的生存能力、武器伤害和被动填装。

为盟友防御和阻挡伤害会延长护盾持续时间并提升你的圣盾投掷伤害。

perks.name: Twilight Arsenal
perks.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
perks.descriptionZh:
[超能]  ：召唤三把虚空战斧并依次将其扔向敌人。命中时，战斧会拉近附近的目标，然后造成具有削弱效果的爆炸。爆炸后，战斧可以被你或盟友拾起，在短时间内作为武器使用。

携带一把虚空战斧时：
[轻攻击]  ：向前挥斩，造成伤害并削弱目标。
[重攻击]  ：投掷战斧，耗尽战斧的剩余弹药。

perks.name: War Beast Entrance
perks.description: Adds a beastly appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个兽性外观。

perks.name: Lucent Flutter Entrance
perks.description: Adds a lucent appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个光辉外观。

perks.name: Hawthorne's Heroes
perks.description: Grants a chance of receiving a Legendary engram when completing strikes with a clan member.
perks.descriptionZh: 与一名公会成员完成打击后有几率获得一个传说记忆水晶。

perks.name: Gunner Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Gunner archetype, which has Weapons as its primary stat and Grenade as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落枪手框架：武器为主要属性，手雷为次要属性。

perks.name: Markov Chain
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon. Melee kills grant ammo for this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战和此武器获得击杀，可提高此武器造成的伤害。近战击杀可为此武器恢复弹药。

perks.name: Gift Recipient
perks.description:
You will receive a gift from a generous Guardian if you complete this activity together.

Each type of gift can be awarded only up to 4 times per activity.
perks.descriptionZh:
如果你们共同完成此项活动，一位慷慨大方的守护者将赠予你一份礼物。

每种礼物在同一活动中最多可以获得4次。

perks.name: Blunt Execution Rounds
perks.description: Damaging nearby combatants with melee abilities dramatically increases handling and damage. Expires after a short duration or the next shot.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战技能对附近战斗人员造成伤害可大幅提高操控性和伤害。持续短暂时间后，或下次射击后过期。

perks.name: Kinetic Munition Mod
perks.description: Improves reload speed for equipped Kinetic weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高已装备动能武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Relentless Tracker
perks.description: Improves weapon damage after damaging a target with an ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用技能对目标造成伤害后提升武器伤害。

perks.name: Tension
perks.description: Greatly increases draw time and accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升拔枪速度和精度。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Resource Detector
perks.nameZh: 赫拉斯盆地资源探测器
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while in Hellas Basin.
perks.descriptionZh: 在赫拉斯盆地中探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Diamond Lance
perks.description:
Shatter or defeat targets with [Stasis] Stasis abilities or weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
perks.descriptionZh:
碎裂或使用冰影技能或武器击败目标以生成冰影长矛。

[射击]  ：投掷长矛以冻结被击中的目标。

[近战]  ：使用长矛猛击地面以冻结小范围内的目标。

perks.name: EDZ Scout Reports
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches in the EDZ for all members of the fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在欧洲无人区中标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.description: Dealing damage grants you an extended window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会在更长的时间内赋予你更高的移动速度和空中效率。造成最后一击会提升这些效果。

perks.name: Argent Ordnance
perks.description: While Charged with Light, readying or firing a Rocket Launcher grants it increased damage and reload speed. Damaging a combatant with a rocket consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，就绪或发射火箭发射器可提升它的伤害和填装速度。用火箭对战斗人员造成伤害消耗一层充斥光能。

perks.name: Roaring Flames
perks.description: Final blows with [Solar] Solar abilities or ignitions increase the damage of your Solar abilities. Stacks 3 times.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日技能或点燃完成最后一击可提高烈日技能的伤害。可叠加3层。

perks.name: Void Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Void weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高虚空武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Chaos Reach
perks.description:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy.
[Super]  : Use while active to deactivate Chaos Reach early and save Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
释放一道由浓缩电弧能量组成的远距离引导光束。
[超能] ：超能激活时使用以提前终止混沌之触，保留部分超能能量。

perks.name: Hallowed Geometry
perks.description: Adds a hallowed geometry appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个神圣几何外观。

perks.name: Headstone
perks.description: Precision final blows spawn a large Stasis crystal at a target's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会在目标附近生成一块大型冰影水晶。

perks.name: Dielectric
perks.description:
Defeating [Arc]Arc debuffed targets grants Bolt Charge.

Rapidly defeating Arc debuffed targets spawns an Orb of Power and heals a small portion of health.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败受到电弧减益的目标可获得电光充能。

快速击败受到电弧减益的目标会生成一个能量球并治疗一小部分生命值。

perks.name: Armorsmith
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield temporarily grants you damage resistance and increased melee damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾会暂时获得伤害抗性和近战伤害提升。

perks.name: Counter Energy
perks.description: When you or a member of your fireteam stuns a champion, you gain energy for your least-charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，你充能最少的技能将获得能量。

perks.name: Combination Argent Blade
perks.description: Briefly pause after executing a light attack, then follow it up with a light or heavy attack to empower your Sword for a short time, granting it bonus damage and charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 在一次轻攻击后稍作停顿，然后接续一次轻攻击或重攻击，可在短时间内强化你的刀剑，赋予其伤害加成和充能速度。

perks.name: Singularity Blade
perks.description: While you have a Void elemental buff, melee and Sword hits weaken targets, while melee and Sword final blows create a weakening burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你拥有虚空元素增益时，近战和刀剑命中会削弱目标；近战和刀剑最后一击会产生削弱爆发。

perks.name: Blinding Jolts
perks.description: Final blows on jolted combatants blind nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击会致盲附近的战斗人员。

perks.name: Precision Equity
perks.description: Precision final blows build progress towards a large Orb of Power that also grants bonus weapon damage on pickup. Higher ranked targets grant more progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会累积进度生成一个大型能量球，拾取后为武器提供额外伤害加成。高等级目标提供更多进度。

perks.name: Strand Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善缚丝武器的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Minor Melee Mod
perks.description: Increases the Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升近战属性。

perks.name: Randomized Perks + 1
perks.description: This item comes with randomized perks, as well as an extra perk in the left trait column.
perks.descriptionZh: 此物品自带随机特性和左侧特性栏的一个额外特性。

perks.name: Subatomic Distortion
perks.description:
Fires projectiles made of compressed quantum particles that decompress within targets after a short delay, lacerating them.

Over-pressurizing this weapon with Quantum Nova releases a detonation around you.
perks.descriptionZh:
发射由压缩量子粒子构成的射弹，它将在目标体内短暂延迟后解压，撕裂目标。

使用量子新星对该武器进行过度增压，会在你周围引爆。

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.description: Improved weapon performance and greatly increased recovery when its wielder is the last living member of a fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你是火力战队最后存活的成员时，武器性能提高，生命值恢复速度大幅提高。

perks.name: Solar Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Solar weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高烈日武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Rampage Spec
perks.description: Increases duration of Rampage.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高狂暴的持续时间。

perks.name: Superluminal Motion
perks.description: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用超能造成伤害后，你移动时会逐渐回复生命值和护盾。额外超能伤害可刷新此效果。

perks.name: Special Relativity
perks.description: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药会从备弹中填装收起的特殊武器。

perks.name: Improved Crucible Scanner
perks.nameZh: 改良熔炉竞技场探测器
perks.description: Increased chance to obtain additional faction consumables in the Crucible.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高在熔炉竞技场中获得额外阵营消耗品的几率。

perks.name: Spark of Resilience
perks.description: Spark of Resilience
perks.descriptionZh: 韧性火花

perks.name: Bolstering Detonation
perks.description: Grants class ability energy when you cause damage with a grenade.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷造成伤害时获得职业技能能量。

perks.name: Will of Light (Kinetic)
perks.description: Your equipped weapons that deal Kinetic damage deal increased damage to Taken combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的动能伤害武器会对傀儡军团战斗人员造成更多伤害。

perks.name: Old Gods' Boon
perks.description: Gain damage reduction while carrying the King's Fall relic.
perks.descriptionZh: 在运送“国王的陨落”圣物时获得伤害减免。

perks.name: Run for Your Life
perks.description: Gain increased mobility and resilience while you are Torn Between Dimensions.
perks.descriptionZh: 维度撕裂期间，提高敏捷和韧性。

perks.name: Mortal Medicine
perks.description: Gain increased recovery and weapon reload speed while you have a Brand or are in a pool of Reclaimed Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你持有烙印或在回收光能池中时，可提高恢复和武器填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Arcology Scout Reports
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Titan for all members of the fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在土卫六上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.
perks.descriptionZh: 难以置信武器的拔出速度有多快。

perks.name: Solar Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Trace Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的追踪步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Unquenchable Thirst
perks.description: Increases the buff effect of the To Excess Origin Trait and the healing effect of the Souldrinker Origin Trait.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加“过量”原始特征的增益效果，并强化“灵魂饮者”原始特征的效果。

perks.name: Impact Absorber
perks.description: Increases this armor's resilience, allowing you to absorb more damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高这件护甲的韧性，以提高你的伤害接受能力。

perks.name: Ensign Entrance
perks.description: Adds an ensign appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个旗帜外观。

perks.name: Blessing of the Sky
perks.description: Using a Noble Round on an ally heals them and grants both you and them a weapon damage bonus for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对一位盟友使用高尚弹药可对其进行治疗，并在短时间内给予你和该盟友武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.description: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed for an improved amount while aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射时伤害目标会进一步提升瞄准时的操控性、填装速度和移动速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Suros Harmony
perks.description: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装武器可在短时间内提升其操控性及减少受到的抖动。如果武器拥有SUROS协同原始特性，则改为提升射程。

perks.name: Fanfare
perks.description: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的武器弹匣剩余一半子弹时填装速度提升。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼
perks.description: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Weapons ▼

perks.name: Nessus Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在涅索斯上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: All-Star
perks.description:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for an improved duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取弹药会从备弹中填装此武器，并在更长时间内提升其伤害和填装速度。

拾取重型弹药提供的时间更长。

perks.name: Energy Reflex Brackets
perks.description: Improves weapon handling for equipped Energy weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善已装备能量武器的操控性。

perks.name: Special Ammo Scout
perks.description: When you fill your Special ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Special ammo for your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你填满特殊弹药量表时，也会为盟友生成较小的特殊弹药盒。

perks.name: Cruel Remedy
perks.description: Kills with this weapon heal the wielder. Precision kills also refill the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可治疗持枪者。完成精准击杀还可装填弹匣。

perks.name: Class Mod
perks.description: Increases the Class stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升职业属性。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Vital Intel
perks.description: Gain enhanced radar resolution and increased reload speed when combatants are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 当战斗人员接近时，获得强化的雷达分辨率和提升的填装速度。

perks.name: Mercury Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Arc Siphon
perks.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速电弧武器最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Snareweaver
perks.description: Create traps that suspend targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 生成可悬停目标的陷阱。

perks.name: Innervation
perks.description: Reduces grenade cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短手雷的冷却时间。

perks.name: Medieval Champion
perks.description: Landing consecutive hits with a Sword you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption]  Overload Champions. Additionally, Swords are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间刀剑将始终过充。

perks.name: Enhanced Impact
perks.description: +10 Impact
perks.descriptionZh: +10 冲击力

perks.name: Mad Scientist
perks.description: Shoots a long volley of rockets.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一长串火箭。

perks.name: Icing-Breaker
perks.description: Landing a hit on a slowed or frozen target has a chance to return the round to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 击中被减速或冻结的目标有几率将弹药返还到弹匣。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Scout Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时斥候步枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Lightning Surge
perks.description: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 在滑铲时，启动你的已充能近战技能来向前瞬移，在重新物质化的同时降下闪电打击震颤目标。此技能还能让你获得增幅状态，并提供电光充能。

perks.name: Prosperity (Vanguard)
perks.description: Vanguard playlist strikes and Nightfall completions have a chance to drop an additional piece of Legendary gear.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成先锋游戏列表打击和日落有几率额外掉落一件传说装备。

perks.name: Aeon Energy
perks.description: Dodging grants energy to nearby Aeon Cultists.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身可使附近永劫教派盟友获得能量。

perks.name: Arc Impact Accelerator
perks.description:
Arc melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
提高电弧近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭目标会使弹药从储存弹药中转移并填装部分弹匣。

perks.name: The Roadborn
perks.description: Precision final blows and rapid precision hits briefly grant bonus handling, range, rate of fire, and precision damage with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击和快速精准击杀会短暂提供武器额外的操控性、射程、射速和精准伤害。

perks.name: Thresh
perks.description: Defeating combatants with this weapon generates an improved small amount of Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器消灭战斗人员会产生少量超能能量，能量数量提高。

perks.name: Major Resist
perks.description: Gain extra damage resistance against powerful combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得对抗来自强大敌人的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Solo Operative
perks.description: While you are the only member of your fireteam, precision weapon final blows increase weapon damage until you are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你是火力战队的唯一成员时，精准武器最后一击会提升武器伤害，直至你被击败。

perks.name: Energy Accelerant
perks.description: Your Dragonfly, Chain Reaction, and Firefly explosions deal more damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高蜻蜓、连锁反应和萤火虫爆炸所造成的伤害。

perks.name: Weakened Clear
perks.description: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.
perks.descriptionZh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并削弱战斗人员。

perks.name: Monochromatic Maestro
perks.description: Dealing damage with elemental abilities grants increased damage to weapons of the same element for a short duration. Dealing damage with elemental weapons grants increased damage to abilities of the same element for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用元素技能造成伤害会在短时间内加强同元素武器的伤害。使用元素武器造成伤害会在短时间内加强同元素技能的伤害。

perks.name: Passive Aggressive Guard
perks.description: Receive less damage from combatants that are close to you while you are wielding a Glaive.
perks.descriptionZh: 挥舞偃月时，你附近的战斗人员对你造成的伤害降低。

perks.name: Reversal
perks.description: Dealing damage to Void debuffed targets increases this weapon's damage for a short time per each type of Void debuff affecting the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 对受到虚空减益的目标造成伤害，会按影响目标的虚空减益类型数量在短时间内提升此武器的伤害。

perks.name: Bountiful Munitions
perks.description: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 肾上腺素亢奋生效期间，最后一击提供特殊弹药进度。对强力战斗人员、守护者及傀儡军团造成的最后一击可提供额外进度。

perks.name: Adrenal Rush
perks.description: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
perks.descriptionZh: 短暂冲刺会在一段时间内提升填装速度和操控性。最后一击可延长持续时间。

perks.name: Ember of Singeing
perks.description: Your class ability recharges faster when you scorch targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 灼烧目标时你的职业技能充能速度将加快。

perks.name: Flash Counter
perks.description: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 举起防御阻挡伤害后会释放出一道使目标迷失方向的短程冲击波。

perks.name: Solar Siphon
perks.description: Rapid Solar weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速烈日武器最后一击可生成能量球。

perks.name: Vexadecimal
perks.description: Sustained fire weakens targets. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续火力可削弱目标。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Boon of Friendship
perks.description:
Grants a Dawning reward to your fireteam upon completion of an Ops activity, with additional rewards based on the number of teammates with Boons active.

Effect lasts until a reward is earned. Only one Boon of Friendship may be active per fireteam member.
perks.descriptionZh:
在完成行动活动时给予你的火力战队一个曙光节奖励，并根据当前受到恩惠的队友数量提供额外奖励。

效果会在获得一个奖励后消失。每名火力战队成员只能启用一个友谊恩惠。

perks.name: Vampire's Caress
perks.description: Melee kills restore health for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成近战击杀可在一小段时间内补充生命值。

perks.name: Helium Spirals
perks.description: Solar grenades burn longer. Melee kills restore them.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日手雷燃烧时间更长，可通过近战击杀充能。

perks.name: Warlord's Sigil
perks.description: Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战和终结技最后一击会提升近战伤害。

perks.name: Chaos Accelerant
perks.description:
[Grenade]  : Overcharge your grenade, making it deadlier and more effective.

Vortex Grenade: Increases the size, linger duration, and pull of the vortex.

Axion Bolt: Detonates twice and has enhanced seekers.

Scatter Grenade: Submunitions track to nearby targets.

Magnetic Grenade, Spike Grenade, Voidwall Grenade, and Suppressor Grenade: Releases a short-range Void blast. Cooldown is reduced.

Grants an additional grenade charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：对手雷进行过充，使其更加致命有效。

涡流手雷：提升漩涡的大小、持续时间和和拉力。

量子光束：引爆两次，拥有强化追踪弹。

散射手雷：子弹药可追踪附近目标。

磁性手雷、尖刺榴弹、虚空之墙手雷和抑制手雷：释放短程的虚空爆破。冷却时间减少。

提供额外手雷充能。

perks.name: Heat Rises
perks.description:
You can fire weapons, melee, and throw grenades while gliding.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your grenade, gaining Heat Rises and releasing a burst of healing energy that cures nearby allies. The strength of the burst is increased when a Healing Grenade is consumed.

Final blows while airborne increase the duration of Heat Rises and grant melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
滑行时可使用武器射击、发动近战和投掷手雷。

[手雷]  ：按住来消耗手雷，可获得炙热升腾并爆发治疗能量，来治愈 附近的盟友。消耗治愈手雷时，爆发强度将会提升。

在空中时造成最后一击可提升炙热升腾的持续时间并提供近战 能量。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成持续伤害会从备弹中填装少量弹药或移除热量，并略微提升伤害。

perks.name: Insulation
perks.description: Reduces class ability cooldown each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短职业技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Stalker's Entrance
perks.description: Adds a hunting crest appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个猎杀纹章外观。

perks.name: Weft Cutter
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage severs the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成持续伤害可割裂目标。

perks.name: Lucent Blades
perks.description: Increases the energy recharge rate of your equipped Swords. Your equipped Glaives gain more energy from dealing damage with their ranged attacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高装备中刀剑的充能速率。装备中的偃月会在使用远程攻击造成伤害时获得更多能量。

perks.name: Io Scout Reports
perks.description: A member of your fireteam has used a Scout Report, which highlights nearby loot catches on Io for all members of the fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所在火力战队的一名成员使用了侦察报告，为火力战队的所有成员在木卫一上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Adept Big Ones Spec
perks.description: Deals extra damage against powerful combatants, bosses, and vehicles.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强大的战斗人员、首领和载具造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Fragment Magnet
perks.description: Increased chance to find Solstice Key Fragments.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加找到至日密匙片段的几率。

perks.name: Nightmarish Resilience
perks.description: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有不稳定精华时，你的快速武器伤害或最后一击会提供治疗并开启生命值回复。

perks.name: Nightmarish Power
perks.description: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员或高阶目标造成最后一击可获得不稳定精华。拥有不稳定精华时，你会获得手雷和近战属性加成。

perks.name: Sidearm Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善手枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Elemental Fury
perks.description: While stunned, Champions take bonus damage from your abilities and Elemental Orb damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于眩晕状态时，勇士会受到来自你技能和元素能量球的额外伤害。

perks.name: Communal Pickups
perks.description: When an ally destroys or picks up your Tangle or Elemental Orb, the Tangle cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and you gain bonus damage with weapons matching your subclass for 10 seconds.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友摧毁或拾取你的缠结或元素能量球时，缠结冷却减少5秒，你使用与分支职业相匹配的武器会获得额外伤害，持续10秒。

perks.name: Overload Machine Guns
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Machine Guns grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的机枪不间断开火可以射出使战斗人员眩晕的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Refreshing Pickups
perks.description: Picking up a Tangle or Elemental Orb grants energy to your least-powered ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取缠结或元素能量球会为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

perks.name: Semi-Auto Striker
perks.description: If you have fewer than 2 stacks of Armor Charge, rapid precision shots with Bows, Snipers, and Scout Rifles generate an Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 如果你拥有的护甲充能少于2层，使用弓箭、狙击步枪和斥候步枪快速精准命中会生成一层护甲充能。

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 对首领、载具和激活超能的守护者造成更多伤害。提升稳定性。刀剑拥有更高的防御抗性。

perks.name: Ursine Guard
perks.description: Improves Sentinel Shield and Unbreakable.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升哨兵圣盾和坚不可摧。

perks.name: Ossified Entrance
perks.description: Adds a bone spiral appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个白骨螺旋外观。

perks.name: Heartbreaking Entrance
perks.description: Adds a heartbreaking appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个心碎外观。

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用前半弹匣弹药直接命中可造成减速附近目标的爆炸。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Elemental Shards
perks.description: Collecting a Stasis shard grants energy to your least-charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集冰影碎片可为你充能最少的技能提供能量。

perks.name: Underdog
perks.description: This weapon gains a boost to reload speed as your health gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的生命值越低，这款武器的填装速度就越快。

perks.name: Redirection
perks.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones. Powerful shots consume fewer stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 对普通战斗人员造成伤害会提升对高阶敌人的伤害。强力射击会消耗更少层数。

perks.name: String of Curses
perks.description: Kills refill the magazine, increase damage, and grant Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可填装弹匣，增加伤害，并给予超能能量。

perks.name: Nessus Cache Detector
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Beacons of Empowerment
perks.description: Improves Sol Invictus and Sunspots.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升无敌索尔与太阳黑子。

perks.name: Whisper of Hedrons
perks.description: Increases weapon handling and health after freezing a target with [Stasis] Stasis.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用冰影冻结目标后，提升武器操控性和生命值。

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高瞄准速度。

perks.name: Rapid Repair
perks.description: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的护盾开始回复时，你在短时间内获得抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

perks.name: Built from Scratch
perks.description: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的弹药储备较低时，使用武器对战斗人员造成最后一击，会根据武器弹药类型提供额外的弹药进度。主弹药武器可提升特殊弹药进度，特殊弹药武器可提升重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Dual Speed Receiver
perks.description: When aiming down sights, weapon rate of fire slows while weapon damage increases. Final blows while aiming down sights grant bonus Heavy ammo progress. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Spinning Up.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时武器射速会降低，但伤害会提高。瞄准时造成最后一击可提供额外重型弹药进度。[替换武器动作] 切换至旋转直上。

perks.name: Submachine Gun Ammo Finder
perks.nameZh: 微型冲锋枪弹药搜寻者
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have a Submachine Gun equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备微型冲锋枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Ranged Weapon
perks.description: Throw your Praxic Blade to hit multiple targets. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 投掷你的英勇利刃以命中多个目标。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Sacred Flame
perks.description: Hipfired shots track targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射弹药将追踪目标。

perks.name: Purple Beam
perks.description: Adds a purple beam to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束紫色光束。

perks.name: Remote Detonation
perks.description:
Grenades bounce.
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.
perks.descriptionZh:
可弹跳榴弹。
[射击] ： 发射，松开扳机引爆。

perks.name: Ember of Beams
perks.description: Your Solar Super projectiles have stronger target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的烈日超能弹道将拥有更强的捕获能力。

perks.name: Strangest Favor
perks.description: Grants extra Strange Coins when completing Vanguard Ops or Onslaught activities, or also for winning Crucible or Gambit matches. Rewards increase with additional stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成先锋行动或猛攻活动时，或者赢得熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛时，可获得额外的奇异硬币。额外层数越多，奖励会随之增加。

perks.name: Stranger Favor
perks.description: Grants extra Strange Coins when completing Vanguard Ops or Onslaught activities, or also for winning Crucible or Gambit matches. Rewards increase with additional stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成先锋行动或猛攻活动时，或者赢得熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛时，可获得额外的奇异硬币。额外层数越多，奖励会随之增加。

perks.name: Strange Favor
perks.description: Grants extra Strange Coins when completing Vanguard Ops or Onslaught activities, or also for winning Crucible or Gambit matches. Rewards increase with additional stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成先锋行动或猛攻活动时，或者赢得熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛时，可获得额外的奇异硬币。额外层数越多，奖励会随之增加。

perks.name: Exhaustive Research
perks.description: Aiming down sights at a target for a short time loads a homing micro-missile.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准目标一小段时间会填装一枚制导微型导弹。

perks.name: Void Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Spirit of Synthoceps
perks.description: Improves melee damage when you're surrounded.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你被包围时提升近战伤害。

perks.name: Spirit of Verity
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant grenade damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会提供手雷伤害加成。

perks.name: Spirit of the Assassin
perks.description: Finishers and powered melee final blows grant invisibility.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技和充能近战最后一击会赋予隐身。

perks.name: Spirit of Inmost Light
perks.description: Using an ability empowers the other two abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用技能会为其他两项技能赋能。

perks.name: Spirit of the Ophidian
perks.description: Weapons ready very quickly.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器的准备速度非常快。

perks.name: Spirit of the Star-Eater
perks.description: Orbs of Power overcharge your Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 能量球会过充超能。

perks.name: Touch of Malice
perks.description: Final round drains life force to deal extra damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一发子弹会吸收生命力以造成更大伤害。

perks.name: Ardent Adoration
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

perks.name: Facet of Dawn
perks.description: Powered melee hits against targets makes you radiant. Powered melee final blows make you and nearby allies radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战命中目标会赋予你焕光效果。充能近战最后一击会赋予你和附近盟友焕光效果。

perks.name: Overload Auto Rifle
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Additionally, Auto Rifles are always overcharged when this modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的自动步枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间自动步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle
perks.description:
Sniper Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Sniper Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的狙击步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间狙击步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-barrier Submachine Gun
perks.description:
Submachine Guns you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Additionally, Submachine Guns are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的微型冲锋枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间微型冲锋枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Overload Hand Cannon
perks.description:
Landing consecutive hits with any Hand Cannon you are wielding disrupts combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions. 

Additionally, Hand Cannons are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意手炮连续命中可扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复速度并降低战斗人员伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间手炮将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Scout Rifle
perks.description: Aiming down the sights of a Scout Rifle for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions. Additionally, Scout Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 斥候步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间斥候步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Unstoppable Sidearm
perks.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Sidearm for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Additionally, Sidearms are always overcharged when the modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh:
手枪举枪瞄准一小段时间可装填高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

此外，该修改器生效期间手枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Pulse Rifle
perks.description: Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. Additionally, Pulse Rifles are always overcharged when that modifier is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的脉冲步枪可发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。此外，该修改器生效期间脉冲步枪将始终过充。

perks.name: Second Shield
perks.description: Gain an additional Shield Throw charge while Sentinel Shield is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 哨兵圣盾激活时可进行一次额外的圣盾投掷。

perks.name: Amassed Fate
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  to consume Fate of all Fools and prime a single Fated Missile that deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  消耗愚者宿命，准备一枚宿命导弹，根据消耗层数造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Frozen Ordnance
perks.description: Defeating a target with a Stasis grenade spawns a Stasis shard.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用冰影手雷击败目标会生成一块冰影碎片。

perks.name: Penance
perks.description: Targets under the effects of Judgment long enough are struck with a burst of damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 受审判效果影响时间足够长的目标会受到爆发性伤害。

perks.name: Taken Invigoration
perks.description:
Defeating a challenging Taken combatant refreshes your class ability.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
消灭高阶傀儡军团战斗人员会刷新你的职业技能。

装备多个此模组无法使效果叠加。

perks.name: Purple Spotlight
perks.description: Adds a purple spotlight to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束紫色聚光灯。

perks.name: Venture Capital
perks.description: Increases the chance of receiving reputation tokens when completing Nightfalls, Raids, and Trials.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高完成日落、突袭和试炼时获得声望代币的几率。

perks.name: Pink Class Sigil
perks.description: Adds a pink class sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色职业印记。

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.description: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标后填装，会提供能量给当前充能最低的技能。

perks.name: Nova Bomb
perks.description: Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at the enemy, disintegrating those caught within its blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 向敌人抛出可发生爆炸的虚空光束，裂解爆炸范围内的敌人。

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.description: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds. Improves reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装前精准最后一击的次数会影响射程和伤害增加的子弹总数。激活宏伟之嚎时，精准最后一击会延长额外子弹效果。提升填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Silver Spotlight
perks.description: Adds a silver spotlight to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束银色聚光灯。

perks.name: Glacial Fortification
perks.description: Replaces Barricade with a wall of Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh: 用冰影水晶墙替换屏障。

perks.name: Bow Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Bow equipped that uses Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备使用重型弹药的弓箭后，提高你找到重型弹药的机会。

perks.name: Tenacious Handle
perks.description: Traditional guarding is disabled in favor of offensive capabilities. Gain greatly increased damage resistance from being in combat for an extended duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 传统防御被禁用，转而偏好进攻能力。处于战斗状态时，较长时间内获得大幅增加的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Mercury Glimmer Scavenger
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Thread of Generation
perks.description: Dealing damage generates grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会生成手雷能量。

perks.name: Shadow Legion Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Shadow Legion drop pod apperance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个暗影军团空降仓外观。

perks.name: Lattice Entrance
perks.description: Adds a data lattice appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个数据晶格外观。

perks.name: Thin the Herd
perks.description: Direct hits do increased damage to combatant shields and cause a volatile detonation. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 直接命中可对战斗人员的护盾造成更多伤害并引起不稳定爆炸。造成伤害会提高填装速度。对受到手雷伤害的战斗人员造成快速最后一击可填装弹匣。

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.description: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹匣内的部分弹药造成精准伤害后可赋予此武器额外伤害。在填装或是收起武器时重置命中数量。

perks.name: Flow State
perks.description:
Defeating a jolted target makes you amplified.

While you are amplified, your dodge recharges more quickly, you are more resilient while dodging, and your reload speed is greatly increased.
perks.descriptionZh:
击败一名震颤的目标会使你进入增幅状态。

在增幅状态下，你的闪身充能更快，闪身时韧性更高，填装速度大幅上升。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
perks.description: Fires full auto with deeper ammo reserves. Faster reload when weapon is empty.
perks.descriptionZh: 可进行全自动射击并具有更多的弹药储备。弹匣打空时可提高填装速度。

perks.name: Scavenger: Cabal
perks.description: Improves rewards from eliminating Cabal enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭卡巴尔敌人时可获得更高品质的奖励。

perks.name: Color Variants
perks.description: This transmat effect may be awarded in silver, gold, green, pink, or blue color variants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此传送效果可能出现银色、金色、绿色、粉色或蓝色变幻。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Sniper Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的狙击步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Blessing of Order
perks.description: Rifts create beneficial seeker projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 裂痕可以产生增益追踪射弹。

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 附近有目标时，填装速度、稳定性和操控性均会大幅提高。

perks.name: Arc Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Arc weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高电弧武器的填装速度

perks.name: Unflinching Glaive Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Glaives.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用偃月瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Head Rush
perks.description: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 下蹲一段时间后起身或者滑行会使此武器在短时间内提升操控性和填装速度，以及对邪魔族战斗人员的伤害。

perks.name: Lucent Blade
perks.description: While Charged with Light, dealing damage with a Sword gives you bonus Sword damage for 5 seconds, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，使用刀剑造成伤害可在5秒内获得额外的刀剑伤害加成，消耗一层光之充能。

perks.name: EDZ Resource Detector
perks.nameZh: 欧洲无人区资源探测器
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区中探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.description: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击或持续精准命中，会在短时间内增加此武器的射速。

perks.name: Glorious Charge
perks.description: Increases Thundercrash damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高雷霆冲击的伤害。

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成最后一击会周期性生成黑暗乙太充能。

通过武器射击或与其接触可提前引爆充能，并从弹药储备中为此武器填装弹药。

perks.name: Absolution
perks.description: Reduces all ability cooldowns each time you pick up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次拾取能量球都将缩短所有技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器收回枪套一小段时间后会自动填装弹药。

perks.name: Strand Scavenger
perks.description: Strand weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该缚丝武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Rapid Fire Slug
perks.description: Fast-firing slug rounds with deeper ammo reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 速射重弹，拥有提升的弹药储备。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Linear Fusion Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定线性融合步枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用线性融合步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.description: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会在短时间内赋予你更高的移动速度和空中效率。造成最后一击会提升这些效果。

perks.name: Explosive Bolts
perks.description:
Bolts explode shortly after hitting the environment or a target, but deal less damage on impact.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.
perks.descriptionZh:
弩弹击中环境或目标后不久爆炸，但命中时造成较少伤害。
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###]弩弹进行回收。

perks.name: Ascending Amplitude
perks.description: Enhanced Stormtrance and amplified abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化雷霆万钧和增幅技能。

perks.name: Unrepentant
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants a superburst.
perks.descriptionZh: 击杀后重新填装可提供超级爆发。

perks.name: Lightning Rod
perks.description: Precision kills grant the next shot chain-lightning capabilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准击杀提供下次射击连锁闪电的能力。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Violent Pour
perks.description: Weapon final blows against challenging combatants spawn an Orb of Power. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase the potency of the Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 对具有挑战性的战斗人员造成武器最后一击会产生一个能量球。此模组可叠加以提升能量球的效力。

perks.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
perks.description: Deep ammo reserves. Fast reload when empty.
perks.descriptionZh: 更多弹药储备。打空时可提高填装速度。

perks.name: Cold Fusion
perks.description: Shoots a cold fusion-powered laser.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射冰冷融合动力激光。

perks.name: Shield-Shattering Rounds
perks.description: Your Machine Guns fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的机枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Stunning Fusion
perks.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle for a short time loads a powerful payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
用融合步枪或线性融合步枪举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Counterbalance Stock
perks.description: Greatly improves recoil direction.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善后坐力方向。

perks.name: Unstoppable Fusion Rifles
perks.description: Aiming down Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 举枪瞄准融合步枪和线性融合步枪会装载一发强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Devouring Depths
perks.description: Casting your Void Super while you are critically wounded or benefitting from Devour increases your damage with that Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到重伤或获得吞食增益时施放虚空超能可增加该超能的伤害。

perks.name: Trinary Vision
perks.description: Releases three waves on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中后释放三次能量波。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Solar Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Sentry Synth
perks.description: Armor Set—Sentry +3
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲套装——哨兵+3

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Sword Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Sword equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备刀剑后，提高你找到重型武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Big Red Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Rasputin respawn to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个拉斯普廷重生效果。

perks.name: Thread of Mind
perks.description: Defeating suspended targets grants class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败悬停的目标可回复职业技能能量。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Hand Cannon
perks.description: Shield-piercing rounds designed to bypass combatant defenses. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 用于击穿敌方战斗人员防具的护盾穿透子弹。克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.
perks.descriptionZh: 当三名或三名以上敌人靠近时，武器可造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.description: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, has an improved detonation shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药会装填一枚可粘附于各种表面的高爆弹药，命中后不久引发更强力的爆炸并施加疲惫。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善斥候步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Mulligan
perks.description: Missing a shot has a chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 子弹未命中时有几率直接向弹匣返还弹药。

perks.name: Adaptive Burst
perks.description: Well-rounded, reliable, 3 round burst.
perks.descriptionZh: 全面，可靠，3发点射。

perks.name: Arc Battery
perks.description: Activating Arc class abilities grants an overshield. Increases cooldown of your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活电弧职业技能获得覆盖护盾。增加你的职业技能冷却时间。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 手雷 ▲

perks.name: Property: Irreducible
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action] : Consume your grenade to load a large [projectile|shape|language] that generates an elemental explosion on impact and deals increased damage while Transcendence is active.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作] ：消耗你的手雷，为你的武器装填一枚大型[射弹|形状|语言]。命中时它会造成一次元素爆炸，并在超凡生效的情况下造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Traitor's Vessel
perks.description: Hip shots fire widespread. Final blows generate Ionic Traces.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射的射击范围广。最后一击产生离子轨迹。

perks.name: Moebius Quiver
perks.description: Fire Shadowshot multiple times in rapid succession. Shadowshot deals massive damage against tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power and grants nearby allies the Heart of the Pack buff.
perks.descriptionZh: 连续多次快速发射暗影箭矢。暗影箭矢会对被束缚的目标造成高额伤害。消灭被束缚的目标会生成能量球并为附近的盟友提供“种群之心”增益。

perks.name: Minor Modifications
perks.description: Completing a weekly Hawthorne bounty awards mod components.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成周常霍桑悬赏将会获得模组组件。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.description: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of precision hits dealt beforehand.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会产生元素伤害爆炸，该爆炸会根据先前造成的精准命中次数造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Relocator Launcher final blows will spawn Void seekers.
perks.nameZh: 重定位发射器最后一击将生成虚空追踪弹。
perks.description: Relocator Launcher final blows will spawn Void seekers.
perks.descriptionZh: 重定位发射器最后一击将生成虚空追踪弹。

perks.name: Primary Honing
perks.description: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升主弹药武器的操控性和填装速度。根据你的武器属性，提升主弹药武器对非首领战斗人员造成的伤害。

perks.name: Supercyclical
perks.description: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能生效期间造成的最后一击将在超能结束后返还超能能量。

perks.name: Frozen Sphere
perks.description: Adds a frozen sphere to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个冰球。

perks.name: Split Electron
perks.description: Fires an arrow that splits when released.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一支释放后会分裂的箭矢。

perks.name: Green Class Sigil
perks.description: Adds a green class sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个绿色职业印记。

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器打破正在使用超能的战斗人员或守护者的护盾将获得覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Special Finisher
perks.description:
Finishers generate Special ammo for the whole fireteam. 

Consumes 3 stacks of Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技可为整个火力战队生成特殊弹药。

消耗3层护甲充能。

perks.name: Mark of the Devourer
perks.description: Rounds pierce targets and inflict corruption. Final blows with this weapon leave behind Remnants.
perks.descriptionZh: 子弹会穿透目标并施加腐化。最后一击会留下残余。

perks.name: Debilitating Wave
perks.description: BOOST: While you have an [Arc] Arc, [Void] Void, or [Stasis] Stasis Super equipped, the blast also applies Blind, Weaken, and Slow, respectively.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化：装备电弧、虚空或冰影超能时，爆炸还会相应施加致盲、削弱或减速效果。

perks.name: Conductive Cosmic Crystal
perks.description: BOOST: Increase bonus damage to combatants affected by a [Stasis] Stasis debuff.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化：对受冰影减益影响的战斗人员造成更高的额外伤害。

perks.name: Dichotomous Thinking
perks.description: Healing allies with this weapon spawns Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器治疗盟友会生成线虫。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Coat of Arms
perks.description: Adds a swords and shield appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个剑与盾的外观。

perks.name: Burning Determination
perks.description: Adds a fiery appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个炽热的外观。

perks.name: Radiolaria Transposer
perks.description: Rapid final blows cause targets to explode into a pool of radiolarian fluid.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速最后一击将使目标爆炸成一摊活性放射体液。

perks.name: Energy Acceleration
perks.description: Sustained damage with micro-missiles causes the combatant to emit a Kinetic shockwave that damages nearby combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用微型导弹对战斗人员造成持续伤害，将使其产生伤害周围战斗人员的动能冲击波。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: That Fresh Bullets Smell
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick gives your Kinetic weapons increased damage for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药盒会在短时间内提升你的动能武器伤害。

perks.name: Elemental Coalescence
perks.description: Defeating targets has the chance to create an Elemental pickup matching your equipped Super element.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标有几率产生与你装备的超能元素匹配的元素拾取物。

perks.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
perks.description: Dealing sustained precision damage against combatants while near two or more allies grants you damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 在两个或更多盟友附近对战斗人员造成持续精准伤害会获得伤害抗性。

perks.name: Elemental Daze
perks.description: Stunning a Champion with an elemental weapon creates an elementally aligned explosion, applying a matching elemental debuff to them and nearby targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 用元素武器眩晕一个勇士会产生一次元素对应的爆炸，对其和附近目标施加匹配的元素减益。

perks.name: Cauterized Darkness
perks.description: [Stasis]Stasis or [Strand] Strand debuffed non-boss combatants take increased [Solar]Solar damage from all sources.
perks.descriptionZh: 被冰影或缚丝减益的非首领战斗人员会受到更多来自任何来源的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Threaded Blast
perks.description: Destroying a Tangle with [Strand]Strand damage increases the radius of the explosion and its damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用缚丝伤害摧毁缠结会增加爆炸范围和伤害。

perks.name: Grim Harvest
perks.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取冰影碎片会获得冰霜护甲层数。

拥有冰霜护甲时，用冰影或动能武器击败战斗人员可能会使其碎裂，对附近敌人造成伤害。碎裂几率根据你的冰霜护甲层数而增加。

拥有冰霜护甲时受到伤害会生成职业技能能量。

perks.name: Facet of Purpose
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会基于你已装备超能的伤害类型，提供电光充能、恢复、冰霜护甲、织造铠甲或覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Shining Embers
perks.description: Shining Embers
perks.descriptionZh: 闪光余烬

perks.name: Glowing Embers
perks.description: Glowing Embers
perks.descriptionZh: 光辉余烬

perks.name: Bray Inheritance
perks.description: Dealing damage regenerates an increased amount of ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害会恢复更多的技能能量。

perks.name: The Scientific Method
perks.description: Damaging an opponent temporarily increases speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 对敌人造成伤害可暂时提高速度和操控性。

perks.name: Healing Initiative
perks.description: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有主动出击层数时，使用职业技能会生成一个位置固定的治疗光环。该光环的治疗量基于主动出击层数而提升。

perks.name: Taking Initiative
perks.description: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击或刀剑打击命中战斗人员可获得主动出击层数，从而提升操控性和填装。层数会随时间缓慢衰减。

perks.name: Bountiful Unity
perks.description: Earn bonus Trials reputation when winning Trials matches with clanmates.
perks.descriptionZh: 在与公会成员一起获得试炼比赛胜利时可获得额外试炼声望。

perks.name: Grenades and Horseshoes
perks.description: Projectiles will detonate when they are within close proximity of their targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 射弹靠近目标时会引爆。

perks.name: Ballistic Combo
perks.description: Grants melee energy on final blows with shield-piercing weapons or when a member of your fireteam shuts down a Barrier Champion's ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用 护盾穿透 武器或你的火力战队成员终结屏障勇士的技能时获得近战能量。

perks.name: Wish Granter's Presence
perks.description: When the aura is active and you complete the "Last Wish" raid as a Guide, once per week you will earn a Bright Engram.
perks.descriptionZh: 当激活光环并作为指导者完成“最后一愿”突袭时，你可以每周获得一个光明记忆水晶。

perks.name: Ascension
perks.description:
[Air Move]  While airborne, consume your class ability energy to summon your Arc Staff, propelling yourself upward and creating a burst of energy around you that amplifies allies and jolts targets.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
[空中移动]  在空中时，消耗你的职业技能能量来召唤电弧法杖，推动自身向上并在四周生成增幅盟友和震颤目标的能量爆发。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Tempest Cascade
perks.description: Ionic Traces load a jolting round.
perks.descriptionZh: 离子轨迹会填装一发震颤弹药。

perks.name: Kindling the Flame
perks.description: While Charged with Light, reviving a downed Guardian gives you a burst of healing, consuming one stack of Charged with Light.
