perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，复活倒地的守护者可对你进行一次爆发治疗，消耗一层光之充能。

perks.name: Classy Contender
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant improved class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可获得更多职业技能能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Tilting at Windmills
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed while shielding.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用护盾阻挡伤害可提高举盾时的移动速度。

perks.name: Thread of Ascent
perks.description: Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon and grants bonus airborne effectiveness and handling for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活你的手雷技能会填装你已装备的武器并在短时间内提供额外的空中效率和操控性。

perks.name: Spark of Resistance
perks.description: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 在被战斗人员包围时，你对伤害的抗性增加。

perks.name: Guardian White
perks.description: Adds a white Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个白色守护者纹章。

perks.name: Backup Mag
perks.description: Greatly increases magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升弹匣容量。

perks.name: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
perks.description: +5 Super ▲ / -5 Melee ▼

perks.name: Randomized Perks + 2
perks.description: This item comes with randomized perks, as well as extra perks in both trait columns.
perks.descriptionZh: 此物品自带随机特性和两侧特性栏的额外特性。

perks.name: Super Font
perks.description: Picking up an elemental well that matches your subclass energy type grants you a temporary significant increase in your Intellect, improving the recharge rate of your Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取符合你的分支职业能量类型的元素井会暂时显著提升你的智慧，提高你的超能充能速度。

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.description: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用任意武器完成击杀将在短时间内提高此武器的伤害。

perks.name: Recovery Armorer
perks.description: Armor pieces with random stats you acquire will have a guaranteed minimum of 10 Recovery, and are more likely to drop with higher Recovery.
perks.descriptionZh: 你所获得的带有随机属性的护甲保底有10点恢复，且很可能掉落时带有更多的恢复。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高脉冲步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Thread of Fury
perks.description: Damaging targets with a Tangle grants melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缠结对目标造成伤害可回复近战能量。

perks.name: Thunder Coil
perks.description: Grants bonus damage for all Arc melee abilities and refunds Super energy on finisher final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 所有电弧近战技能将获得伤害加成，且在造成终结技最后一击时返还超能能量。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Submachine Gun
perks.description:
Submachine Guns you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Submachine Guns deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的微型冲锋枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

微型冲锋枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Unstoppable Hand Cannon
perks.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Hand Cannon for a short time loads a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
用手炮举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Wished into Being
perks.description: While your Super is nearly fully-charged, ability final blows spawn Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的超能几乎完全充满时，技能最后一击会生成能量球。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization II
perks.description:
Improves the benefits provided by the Noble Deeds, Unsated Hunger, Head Rush, and Dragon's Vengeance Origin Traits.

Additionally, weapons with these traits are always overcharged.
perks.descriptionZh:
提升高尚事迹、未足之饥、热血上头和龙之复仇原始特性提供的增益。

此外，拥有这些特性的武器会始终过充。

perks.name: Heart of the Flame
perks.description: Casting your Solar Super grants nearby allies radiant and increases the damage of your Super for each nearby ally.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放烈日超能会使附近盟友进入焕光状态，而且附近的盟友越多，超能的伤害就越高。

perks.name: Torch
perks.description: While radiant, deal increased weapon damage to combatants affected by Strand and Stasis debuffs.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于焕光状态时，对受缚丝和冰影减益影响的战斗人员造成更多武器伤害。

perks.name: Flint Striker
perks.description: Rapid Solar weapon precision hits and rapid Solar weapon final blows grant Radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速烈日武器精准命中和快速烈日武器最后一击会提供焕光效果。

perks.name: Unflinching Linear Fusion Aim
perks.nameZh: 稳定线性融合步枪瞄准
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用线性融合步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: See Me, Feel Me
perks.description: After being invisible, your Void weapons gain Volatile Rounds. Finishers while invisible grant bonus damage for all weapons and a reserve overshield for allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 隐身结束后，你的虚空武器会获得不稳定弹药。隐身时施放终结技可为所有武器提供额外伤害，并为盟友提供后备覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Boost
perks.description: [Boost]  : Accelerate to a higher speed.
perks.descriptionZh: [加速]  ： 加速至更快速度。

perks.name: Mercurial Luck
perks.description: Chance to receive an additional Simulation Seed when one is collected on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上收集到一颗模拟种子时，有机会获得额外一颗。

perks.name: Cross Counter
perks.description: Cross Counter regenerates health and deals extra damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 交叉反击可恢复生命值并造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Thread of Propagation
perks.description: Powered melee final blows grant your [Strand] Strand weapons Unraveling Rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能近战最后一击会赋予你的缚丝武器瓦解弹药。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Boss Resist
perks.description: Gain extra damage resistance against bosses and vehicles.
perks.descriptionZh: 获得对抗来自首领和载具的额外伤害抗性。

perks.name: Arc Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Arc weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高电弧武器的收举速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Together Forever
perks.description: Fires micro-missiles. Final blows with this weapon reload and overflow Sturm.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射微型导弹。使用此武器造成最后一击会填装并溢装狂飙。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高斥候步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Bubble Trouble
perks.description: This visual effect is suppressed while in combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 此视觉效果在战斗中会被压制。

perks.name: Light Arms Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of ammo you can carry for Sidearms, Hand Cannons, Bows, and Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高你可以携带的手枪、手炮、弓箭和微型冲锋枪的弹药数量。

perks.name: +5 Weapon ▲
perks.description: +5 Weapon ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 武器 ▲

perks.name: Classy Contender
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器完成最后一击可获得职业技能能量。

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.description: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射精准命中会在短时间内给予极大的拉弓速度加成。

perks.name: Argent Ordnance
perks.description: While Charged with Light, readying or firing a Rocket Launcher grants it increased damage and reload speed. Damaging a combatant with a rocket consumes one stack of Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 充斥光能时，就绪或发射火箭发射器可提升它的伤害和填装速度。用火箭对战斗人员造成伤害消耗一层充斥光能。

perks.name: Temporal Loader
perks.description: This weapon loads ammo from reserves when dealing damage to targets that are slowed, frozen, or suspended.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器在对被减速、冻结或悬停的目标造成伤害时，会从备弹中填装弹匣。

perks.name: Temporal Tracker
perks.description: Gain bonus aim assistance or projectile tracking for a moderate duration after picking up an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后，获得一段时间的瞄准辅助或射弹追踪加成。

perks.name: Temporal Adapter
perks.description: Readying this weapon grants it bonus stability, handling, and reload speed for a moderate duration that is borrowed from an alternate timeline version of the weapon. Swords gain bonus charge rate and guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器准备就绪后一段时间内可获得稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成，取自武器在另一个时间线的版本。刀剑可获得充能速度和防御抗性加成。

perks.name: Temporal Armaments
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage versus Cabal and Vex targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可对卡巴尔和Vex目标造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Temporal Blast
perks.description: This weapon stores a portion of its damage dealt into charges. At 5 charges, the weapon's next shot creates an explosive blast on impact that damages nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会将造成伤害的一部分储存为能量。达到5次充能时，武器的下一发射击会在命中时产生爆炸冲击，对附近战斗人员造成伤害。

perks.name: Payday
perks.description: Large mag. Increased hip fire accuracy.
perks.descriptionZh: 大容量弹匣。提高腰际射击精度。

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行可装填武器的一部分弹药，并暂时性地大幅提高武器射程和稳定性。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 榴弹发射器弹药回收器
perks.description: Grenade Launchers get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Grenade Launcher.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该榴弹发射器所用弹药时，榴弹发射器获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Grenade Launcher Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 榴弹发射器弹药回收器
perks.description: Grenade Launchers get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Grenade Launcher.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该榴弹发射器所用弹药时，榴弹发射器获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Primeval's Torment
perks.description: Weapon impact causes blight.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器命中会造成凋零效果。

perks.name: Beacon Rounds
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed. Dealing further damage extends the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击可为射弹提供追踪能力并提升填装速度。造成更多伤害可延长持续时间。

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.description: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭虚空减益目标可提供覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Chaotic Exchanger
perks.description: Improved charging for Void grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高虚空手雷的充能速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: -5 Super ▼
perks.description: -5 Super ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -5 超能 ▼

perks.name: Taken Armaments
perks.description: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击会提供额外的重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Taken Barrier
perks.description: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击会在短时间内减少你受到的伤害。

perks.name: Genesis
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield. Also increases weapon handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器打破战斗护盾可从储备弹药中转移弹药至弹匣。若能量武器与战斗护盾伤害类型吻合，击中目标时可重生弹药。还可提升武器操控性。

perks.name: Revved Consumption
perks.description: Damaging a combatant heals the wielder.
perks.descriptionZh: 对战斗人员造成伤害可以治疗武器的使用者。

perks.name: Scout and Sniper Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 斥候步枪和狙击步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Improves targeting for Scout Rifles and Sniper Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升斥候步枪和狙击步枪的瞄准性能。

perks.name: Warmind Techno
perks.description: Adds a earthly appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个大地的外观。

perks.name: Cookie Crisis
perks.description: Adds an explosion of chocolate chip cookies appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个巧克力曲奇爆炸的外观。

perks.name: Balanced Heat Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage versus powerful combatants. Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对强力战斗人员造成的伤害，极低热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。在极高热量时手动排气将大幅提高排气速度。

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.description:
This weapon deals improved damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器会对载具和构造体造成更高的伤害。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的生命值越低，这款武器的精度和操控性就越好。

perks.name: Radiant Light
perks.description: Casting your Super causes nearby allies to become Charged with Light.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放你的超能会使附近的盟友充斥光能。

perks.name: Nail, Meet Hammer
perks.description: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants improved Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo , or improved Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾更有效。使用此武器摧毁护盾时，若使用的是主武器或重型弹药，则提供更多的特殊弹药进度；若使用的是特殊弹药，则提供更多的重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 火箭发射器弹药回收器
perks.description: Rocket Launchers get bonus reserves when picking up Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取重型弹药时，火箭发射器获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Arc Soul
perks.description: Your Rift now grants you or any ally that uses it an Arc Soul to aid in battle.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的裂痕使你或任何使用它的友军获得一个电弧之魂来协助战斗。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: Fires small auto-tracking rockets.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射自动追踪的小型火箭。

perks.name: Four-Headed Dog
perks.description: Shoots from all four barrels.
perks.descriptionZh: 全部四根枪管同时射击。

perks.name: Melee Kickstart
perks.description: When your melee energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain melee energy for each Armor Charge used.
perks.descriptionZh: 在近战能量完全耗尽时，你的护甲充能会被消耗，每一层被消耗的护甲充能都会赋予你额外的近战能量。

perks.name: Nightsworn Sight
perks.description: Defeating targets grants Truesight, ammo conservation, and Weaken. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标可提供真视、弹药节约和削弱效果。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.description: +5 Class ▲ / -5 Health ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 职业 ▲ / -5 生命值 ▼

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Resonant Virtue
perks.description: Gain two Remnants per final blow instead of one.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次最后一击获得两枚遗灵，而非原来的一枚。

perks.name: Pyromancer
perks.description: This weapon replenishes its fuel faster. Defeating targets with this weapon causes them to periodically drop Firesprites.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器补充燃料的速度更快。使用此武器击败目标会使其周期性地掉落焰灵。

perks.name: Improved Dreaming City Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版幽梦之城缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 在幽梦之城中探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Heavy Ammo Scavenger
perks.description: Gain bonus reserves when you pick up Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取重型弹药时获得额外弹药。

perks.name: Overload Submachine Gun
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped SMGs grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
不间断开火可以使子弹造成眩晕效果，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

擅长对抗过载勇士。

perks.name: Icarus Dash
perks.description:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge quickly while airborne.

While Heat Rises is active, you have an additional dodge.

While airborne, rapidly defeating targets with your Super or weapons cures you.
perks.descriptionZh:
[空中闪身]  ：在空中时快速闪身。

炙热升腾激活时，拥有额外闪身。

在空中时，用你的超能或武器快速击败目标可治愈你。

perks.name: Overload Bow
perks.description:
Damage by fully drawn arrows from your equipped Bows causes disruption, stunning combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
拉满弓射出的箭会造成混乱效果，从而眩晕战斗人员，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器的每次最后一击都会造成一次元素伤害爆炸。

perks.name: Herd Thinner
perks.description: Your weapons deal additional damage to non-powerful combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的武器对非高阶战斗人员造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Invisible Hand
perks.description: Repeatedly missing targets increases this weapon's stability for a short time. This buff lasts for a short duration after a target is hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 重复偏离目标可在短时间内提高此武器的稳定性。此增益效果在命中目标后会持续较短时间。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在更长时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
造成持续伤害可提供对载具和构造体的额外伤害，并从备弹中填充弹药。主弹药伤害或对构造体的伤害可提供额外进度。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Facet of Sacrifice
perks.description: While you have an Arc, Solar, or Void buff, ability final blows grant bonus Darkness Transcendence energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有电弧、烈日或虚空增益时，技能最后一击会提供额外暗影超凡能量。

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷或此武器获得最后一击可提高此武器的伤害和操控性。

perks.name: Tesseract
perks.description: [Heavy Attack]  : Use while sprinting with full energy to launch a repeatable heavy blink attack.
perks.descriptionZh: [重攻击]  ：在满能量冲刺时使用，以发出可重复的闪烁重击。

perks.name: Stacked
perks.description: Final blows have an increased chance of spawning Heavy ammo while in possession of Resonance.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有共振时最后一击生成重型弹药的几率增加。

perks.name: Banner of War
perks.description:
Defeat a target with a melee attack, finisher, or Sword to raise a Banner of War that pulses with energy, periodically healing nearby allies and increasing melee and Sword damage. 

Targets defeated by you and nearby allies charge the banner, increasing the speed of its pulses.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用近战攻击、终结技或刀剑击败目标来升起一面会发出能量脉冲的战旗，周期性治疗附近的盟友，并提升近战和刀剑伤害。

你和附近的盟友击败目标会给战旗充能，提高其脉冲的速度。

perks.name: Spark of Focus
perks.description: After sprinting for a short time, your class ability regeneration is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 进行冲刺后短时间内，你的职业技能回复会增加。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Micro-Missile
perks.description: This weapon fires in a straight line and has a massively increased projectile speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 进行直线射击，弹头速度大幅提高。

perks.name: Enhanced Scout Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Scout Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高斥候步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Taken Armaments
perks.description:
Defeating a Taken combatant with a grenade grants Heavy ammo.

This mod's abilities cannot stack across multiple copies.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用手雷消灭傀儡军团战斗人员时会给予重型弹药。

装备多个此模组无法使效果叠加。

perks.name: Longest Winter
perks.description: Periodically generates Ionic Traces while in its high-damage state.
perks.descriptionZh: 在高伤害状态下周期性地产生离子轨迹。

perks.name: Seeking Wells
perks.description: Elemental wells you create will move across the ground toward nearby players.
perks.descriptionZh: 你创造出的元素井会在地面上朝附近的玩家移动。

perks.name: Well of Striking
perks.description: Picking up an Arc elemental well grants you additional melee energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取一个电弧元素井会赋予你额外近战能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

perks.name: Flame Refraction
perks.description: Kills with this weapon return a fraction of the ammo used to the magazine from reserves, extending the beam's duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可从储存弹药中转移部分弹药至弹匣，延长光束持续时间。

perks.name: -5 Class ▼
perks.description: -5 Class ▼
perks.descriptionZh: -5 职业 ▼

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon further increases reload speed and Sword charge rate and increases damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成持续伤害会进一步提升填装速度和刀剑充能速度，并提升伤害。

perks.name: Overload Submachine Gun
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped SMGs grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
不间断开火可以使子弹造成眩晕效果，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

擅长对抗过载勇士。

perks.name: Void Impact Accelerator
perks.description:
Void melee abilities recharge faster.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
提高虚空近战技能充能速度。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Terminal Velocity
perks.description: Fists of Havoc's ground slam attack leaves a damage-dealing field in its wake and deals more damage the longer it's in the air.
perks.descriptionZh: 浩劫之拳的震地攻击会产生一片可造成伤害的区域。在空中的时间越长，造成的伤害就越高。

perks.name: Peach Spotlight Effects
perks.description: Adds a peach spotlight to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一束桃红聚光灯。

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会产生技能能量，能量数量提高。此能量会平分至你未充能完毕的技能。

perks.name: Stat Penalty
perks.description: -10 Strength
perks.descriptionZh: -10 力量

perks.name: Solar Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Solar weapons over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 逐渐填装你已收起的烈日武器。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败目标后填装此武器会短时间过充武器且持续时间延长，下次命中时震颤敌人。

perks.name: Echo of Vigilance
perks.description: Defeating a target while your shields are depleted grants you a temporary Void overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 护盾耗尽时击败一个目标，就会获得一个临时的虚空覆盖护盾。

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt at an increased rate. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用此武器造成重复伤害会以更快的速度施加震颤。

增幅状态下震颤施加速度更快。

perks.name: Solar Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用烈日分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Radar Tuner
perks.description: Radar immediately returns when you stop aiming down sights and slightly increases the range at which radar detects combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 当停止瞄准时雷达立即返回，且略微提升雷达能监测到战斗人员的范围。

perks.name: Echo of Obscurity
perks.description: Finisher final blows grant Invisibility.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结技最后一击将赋予隐身。

perks.name: Enhanced Bow Dexterity
perks.description: Greatly increases ready and stow speed for Bows.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高弓箭的收举速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Wombo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 50-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测50米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 40-meter range.
perks.descriptionZh: 探测40米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Volatile Flow
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants your Void weapons Volatile rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会赋予你的虚空武器不稳定弹药。

perks.name: Solar Surge
perks.description: Collecting a Firesprite gives you Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集一个焰灵可为你提供护甲充能。

perks.name: Shatter Orbs
perks.description: The first time you break a combatant's shield, you create an Orb of Power if you break the shield with the matching damage type.
perks.descriptionZh: 首次击破战斗人员护盾时，如果使用了匹配的伤害类型击破护盾，则可生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Untangler
perks.description: Destroying a Tangle with a Strand weapon suspends targets damaged by the explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝武器摧毁缠结可悬停受到爆炸伤害的目标。

perks.name: Defiant Armory
perks.description: Greatly improves the benefits provided by the Noble Deeds, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Tex Balanced Stock, and Ambush Origin Traits.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升高尚事迹、纳米技术追踪火箭、特克斯平衡枪托和伏击原始特性提供的增益。

perks.name: Overload Rounds
perks.description: Uninterrupted fire grants bullets that disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 不间断开火会扰乱战斗人员并将其眩晕，延缓技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Reflective Vents
perks.description: Sliding reflects projectiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行可反弹射弹。

perks.name: Disorienting Grenades
perks.description: Detonation has a brief disorienting effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 引爆后拥有短暂的迷失效果。

perks.name: Energy Stabilization Mod
perks.description: Reduces recoil for the equipped Energy weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低已装备能量武器的后坐力。

perks.name: Souldrinker
perks.description: Gain an improved amount of health based on the number of hits before reloading.
perks.descriptionZh: 根据填装之前完成的命中数更多地恢复生命值。

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升弹药生成。蹲伏时提升填装、收举和准备速度。

perks.name: Dreaming City Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 在幽梦之城中探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
perks.description: Landing multiple hits turns your next shot into a homing micro-missile. Cooldown between activations is reduced.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成多次命中会将你的下一发子弹变成一枚制导微型导弹。减少启动冷却时间。

perks.name: Arc Empowerment
perks.description:
While Arc empowered:
- Arc Supers have extended durations.
- Air and ground speed increases.
- Slide distance increases.
- Weapon handling and reload speed increases.
- Melee damage increases.
- Sword damage and lunge range increases.
- Sword ammo is granted every second while equipped.

On PRISM Day, Arc empowerment is applied while using an Arc subclass.
perks.descriptionZh:
在电弧赋能期间：
-延长电弧超能的持续时间。
-加快在空中和地面的速度。
-提高滑行距离。
-提升武器操控和填装速度。
-增加近战伤害。
-增大刀剑伤害和前冲范围。
-在配备刀剑时，每秒都会提供刀剑弹药。

在棱镜日，使用电弧分支职业时会应用电弧赋能。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Sniper Rifle
perks.description:
Sniper Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Sniper Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的狙击步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

狙击步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: +5 Class ▲
perks.description: +5 Class ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 职业 ▲

perks.name: Tyrant's Surge
perks.description: Dealing damage with Arc melee, Super, and grenade abilities spawns a Warmind Cell.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用电弧近战、超能和手雷技能造成伤害会生成一个战争思维电池。

perks.name: Glaive Scavenger
perks.description: Glaives get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that Glaive.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该偃月所用弹药时，偃月获得额外储存弹药。

perks.name: Overload Machine Guns
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Machine Guns grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的机枪不间断开火可以射出使战斗人员眩晕的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低其伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Snipers
perks.description:
Scout Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds, which bypass combatant defenses.

Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的斥候步枪会发射足以穿透战斗人员防御的护盾穿透子弹，

克制屏障勇士。

perks.name: Bad Amplitude
perks.description: Damaging a Champion with an Arc ability causes the Champion to become jolted.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用电弧技能伤害勇士会使其震颤。

perks.name: Surge Detonators
perks.description:
Arc grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them and delaying ability regeneration, and lower combatant damage output. 

Strong against Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
电弧手雷会扰乱战斗人员，使其眩晕并延缓其技能回复速度，降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Inferno Whip
perks.description:
Solar melee abilities stun unshielded combatants. 

Strong against Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
烈日近战技能会眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Modularity (Crucible)
perks.description: Crucible wins have a chance to award an Upgrade Module.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场取胜有几率奖励一个升级模块。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Unflinching Pulse Rifle Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用脉冲步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Edge
perks.description: Grants increased charge rate and guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高充能速度和防御抗性。

perks.name: Counter Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light whenever you or a member of your fireteam stuns a Champion.
perks.descriptionZh: 你或你的火力战队成员眩晕勇士时，使你充斥光能。

perks.name: Hot Swap
perks.description:
Switching to this weapon while you are damaged strongly increases its handling for an improved duration.

Swords gain increased recharge speed, guard resistance, and guard endurance instead.
perks.descriptionZh:
在受到伤害的情况下切换至此武器会在更长时间内大幅提升其操控性。

刀剑会获得更高的充能速度、防御抗性、防御持久。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Sharpshooter
perks.description: This weapon gains passive bonuses to target acquisition, aim down sight speed, and flinch resistance. The bonus increases when this weapon's super mode is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器获得目标捕获能力、瞄准速度、抖动抗性的被动加成。启用此武器的超能模式时提升此加成。

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器达成最后一击将提高此武器的伤害和性能，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Rewind Again
perks.description: Can return shots to the magazine and open a time portal.
perks.descriptionZh: 可以将子弹返还弹匣并开启时间传送门。

perks.name: Be the Danger
perks.description: Unrepentant final blows refund Unrepentant.
perks.descriptionZh: 不知悔改最后一击可补偿不知悔改。

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用其他武器造成最后一击，可提升此武器的瞄准速度、精度和空中效率，且持续时间延长。失调协议效果激活时，最后一击会返还弹药。

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage significantly increases precision damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成精准伤害会大幅提升精准伤害。

perks.name: Health Forged
perks.description: +3 Health
perks.descriptionZh: +3 生命值

perks.name: Enhanced Stability
perks.description: +10 Stability
perks.descriptionZh: +10 稳定性

perks.name: Linear Fusion Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Linear Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高线性融合步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Dynamo
perks.description: Reduces Super cooldown when using your class ability near targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 在目标附近使用职业技能时缩短超能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Elemental Armaments
perks.description: Combatant weapon final blows with a damage type that matches your subclass element have an escalating chance to spawn an elemental well.
perks.descriptionZh: 用符合你的分支职业元素类型的伤害类型取得战斗人员武器最后一击有更高几率生成元素井。

perks.name: Cabal Arrival
perks.description: Adds a Cabal drop pod appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个卡巴尔空降仓外观。

perks.name: High Noon
perks.description: Readying this weapon grants a brief period of bonus precision damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器准备就绪后短时间内可造成额外精准伤害。

perks.name: Auto Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Auto Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的自动步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Transformative
perks.description: Future drops of this weapon will have random rolls.
perks.descriptionZh: 以后掉落的此武器将拥有随机特性。

perks.name: Radar Tuner
perks.description: Radar immediately returns when you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 当停止瞄准时雷达立即返回。

perks.name: Sweet Shielding
perks.description:
Picking up a piece of Candy grants Overshield.

Only one mask upgrade can be active at a time. Activating this mask upgrade will deactivate the others.
perks.descriptionZh:
拾取糖果会获得覆盖护盾。

一次只能激活一个面具升级。激活此面具升级将停用其他面具升级。

perks.name: Spark of Intellect
perks.description: Spark of Intellect
perks.descriptionZh: 智慧火花

perks.name: Overpressured Munitions
perks.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage against Cabal targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器可对卡巴尔目标造成更多额外伤害。

perks.name: Indomitability
perks.description: Final blows grant grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 玩光能分支职业时，最后一击可提供手雷能量。玩暗影分支职业时，最后一击可提供近战能量。

perks.name: Lightning Rounds
perks.description: This weapon fires faster and more accurately the longer the trigger is held. Continuous damage generates stunning lightning strikes.
perks.descriptionZh: 扣动扳机时间越长，武器的射速和精度越高。持续伤害可产生眩晕闪电打击。

perks.name: Atomizing Rounds
perks.description: Detonate explosive ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 引爆爆炸弹药。

perks.name: Ghost Pink
perks.description: Adds a pink Ghost ring to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个粉色机灵环。

perks.name: Toxic Overload
perks.description: Landing a final blow or multiple precision hits triggers a burst that inflicts nearby targets with potent corruption.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击或多次精准射击命中后可触发一次对附近目标施加强效腐化的爆炸。

perks.name: Arc/Strand Siphon Combo
perks.description: Combines the Arc and Strand Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将电弧和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Solar/Strand Siphon Combo
perks.description: Combines the Solar and Strand Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将烈日和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Void/Strand Siphon Combo
perks.description: Combines the Void and Strand Siphon mods into one.
perks.descriptionZh: 将虚空和缚丝虹吸模组合二为一。

perks.name: Origin Perk Specialization I
perks.description: Greatly improves the benefits provided by the Head Rush, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Unsated Hunger, and Cursed Thrall Origin Traits.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升热血上头、纳米技术追踪火箭、未足之饥和诅咒怨魂原始特性提供的增益。

perks.name: Diviner's Discount
perks.description: All Scavenger mods are discounted.
perks.descriptionZh: 所有回收器模组均享有折扣。

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.
perks.descriptionZh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。

perks.name: Unburied Treasure
perks.description: Readying this weapon grants an increased period of rapidly decaying accuracy and range. Swords gain increased lunge distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器准备就绪后会在一段时间内获得更多快速衰减的精度和射程。刀剑获得更远的前冲距离。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Completed Lighthouse Passage
perks.description:
Lighthouse Passage completed. Match wins will grant you bonus rewards based on your longest win streak achieved this week.

Continuing to play on this Passage will match you versus other players with similar weekly performance.
perks.descriptionZh:
灯塔入场券已完成。比赛胜利将基于本周最长的连胜记录提供额外奖励。

继续使用此入场券游戏将与其他周常表现相似的玩家匹配。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Spark of Resilience
perks.description: Spark of Resilience
perks.descriptionZh: 韧性火花

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Void Weapon Channeling
perks.description: You gain a temporary bonus to Void weapon damage after you defeat a target with a Void weapon while at least one of your Void abilities is fully charged. This damage bonus increases based on the number of fully charged Void abilities you have.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你用一把虚空武器击败目标，且至少有一个虚空技能完全充能时，你将获得临时的虚空武器伤害加成。该伤害加成根据你完全充能的虚空技能的数量而提升。

perks.name: Rain of Firebolts
perks.description: When you have Firebolt Grenades equipped, gain a second grenade charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备烈焰手雷时，获得第二发手雷充能。

perks.name: Threaded Blast
perks.description: Destroying a Tangle with a Strand weapon creates a larger and more damaging explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝武器摧毁缠结可造成更大、伤害更高的爆炸。

perks.name: Prismatic Transfer
perks.description: When you cast your Super, each member of your fireteam with a Super type different than yours gains a bonus to weapon damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放超能时，你的火力战队中与你的超能类型不同的每位成员可获得武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Traveler's Wake
perks.description: Adds a Traveler theme to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个旅行者主题。

perks.name: Surge Detonators
perks.description:
Arc grenades disrupt combatants, stunning them, delaying ability regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
电弧手雷会扰乱战斗人员并使其眩晕，延缓其技能回复速度并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Exhumation
perks.description: Charged heavy attacks turn you invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 充能重攻击可让你进入隐形状态。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Carrion Munitions
perks.description: Final blows on tougher combatants create insectoid robots that chase combatants and explode.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击会产生追击战斗人员并爆炸的类虫机器人。

perks.name: Ignition Trigger
perks.description: Sustained fire overheats the weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续开火会导致武器过热。

perks.name: Vortex Frame
perks.description:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重旋转攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

perks.name: Gordian Knot
perks.description: Special reload and then fire to create a Grapple Tangle at the targeted point.
perks.descriptionZh: 特殊弹药填装后射击会在目标位置制造一个抓取缠结。

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.description: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.
perks.descriptionZh: 在进行一次成功的近战打击后，在一小段时间内——或直到发射完三枚子弹前——武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度会提高。

perks.name: Eyes Up
perks.description:
This weapon gains reload speed, range, and slightly increased damage against combatants for a short time when combat begins.

Final blows extend and enhance this bonus.
perks.descriptionZh:
战斗开始时，此武器在短时间内获得填装速度、射程，并略微提升对战斗人员的伤害。

最后一击会延长和强化此加成。

perks.name: Energy Transfer
perks.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 在受到伤害时进行防护可产生职业技能能量。

perks.name: Stunloader
perks.description: Stunning a Champion partially refills this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士可从备弹中填充此武器的部分弹匣。

perks.name: Solar Glow Pack
perks.description: Armor glow packages rotate daily. This package is available only on Solar days.
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲炫彩包裹每日轮换。此包裹仅可在烈日日使用。

perks.name: Spark of Mobility
perks.description: Spark of Mobility
perks.descriptionZh: 敏捷火花

perks.name: Major Spec
perks.description: Deals extra damage against powerful enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强大敌人造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Tangled Shore Resource Detector
perks.description: Detect resources within a 30-meter range while on the Tangled Shore.
perks.descriptionZh: 在纷争海岸上探测30米范围内的资源。

perks.name: Stochastic Vengeance
perks.description: At 5 stacks of Markov Chain, [Alternate Weapon Action]  - switches between your melee attack and Monte Carlo's bayonet. Landing a bayonet melee hit grants melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 叠加5层马尔可夫链时，[替换武器动作]  - 在你的近战攻击和蒙特卡洛刺刀之间切换。刺刀近战命中可提供近战能量。

perks.name: Alloy Completionist
perks.description: Completing all clan challenges in a week grants an Ascendant Alloy.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成一周中的所有公会挑战可奖励一个上维合金。

perks.name: Overload Pulse Rifle
perks.description:
Your equipped Pulse Rifles fire disrupting rounds which stun the target, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你装备的脉冲步枪会发射扰乱子弹，使目标眩晕，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Adept Handling
perks.description: +10 Handling
perks.descriptionZh: +10操控性

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用这款武器瞄准可在短时间内减少抖动。

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高腰际射击时的精度、稳定性和精准命中能力。

perks.name: Only the Finest
perks.description: Adds a Black Armory theme to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个黑色军械库的外观。

perks.name: Signal Processed
perks.description: Adds a firing synapse to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送特效添加一个燃烧突触的外观。

perks.name: Guiding Light
perks.description: Adds a guiding star to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送特效添加一个指路明星的外观。

perks.name: The Past Unearthed
perks.description: Adds an unearthed tomb visual to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个出土古墓的外观。

perks.name: Long March
perks.description: Detect enemies on your radar from farther away.
perks.descriptionZh: 侦测雷达上位于远处的敌人。

perks.name: Immovable Object
perks.description: Dealing ranged damage grants increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
perks.descriptionZh: 保持不动举起护盾时造成远程伤害可提供更多的武器能量。

perks.name: Whisper of Refraction
perks.description: Defeating slowed or frozen targets grants you class ability energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭被减速或被冻结的目标可为你提供职业技能能量。

perks.name: Unstoppable Grenade Launcher
perks.description:
When you ready or reload a Grenade Launcher, for a short period, that weapon stuns Unstoppable Champions.

Strong against [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你准备或装填榴弹发射器时，短时间内，这把武器会眩晕势不可挡勇士。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Void Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Void Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Void Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Void Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Void Damage Resistance
perks.description: Reduces incoming Void damage from combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少来自战斗人员的虚空伤害。

perks.name: Refreshing Thirst
perks.description: Becoming Drained of Light grants you an armor charge. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 光能耗尽时得到一层护甲充能。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Lesser Core Harvest (Gambit)
perks.description: Defeating invaders in Gambit has a chance to award an Enhancement Core.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中击败入侵者有几率奖励一个强化核心。

perks.name: Greater Core Harvest (Gambit)
perks.description: Defeating invaders in Gambit has a chance to award an Enhancement Prism.
perks.descriptionZh: 在智谋中击杀入侵者有几率奖励一个强化棱镜。

perks.name: Tight Fit
perks.description: Dodging grants reload and handling for you and nearby allies. Dodge to increase gains, damage to get dodges.
perks.descriptionZh: 闪身会为你和附近盟友提供填装和操控性。闪身来提升加成，造成伤害来获得闪身。

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights. Increases blast radius.
perks.descriptionZh: 为火箭添加追踪能力。瞄准时锁定目标。扩大爆炸范围。

perks.name: Ahamkara's Eye
perks.description: Unleashes a beam of destruction.
perks.descriptionZh: 释放一道毁灭光束。

perks.name: Cursed Fist
perks.description: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击会触发一次诅咒怨魂爆炸。

perks.name: Power of the Son
perks.description: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于战斗中一段时间会逐渐获得更多对战斗人员的抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

perks.name: Luminous Entrance
perks.description: Adds a luminous appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个发光外观。

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.description: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
perks.descriptionZh: 当一名盟友被击败时，获得填装、稳定性、瞄准辅助和射程。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成提升。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Dreaming City Glimmer Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 幽梦之城微光回收利用
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 在幽梦之城中的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Impetus
perks.description: Reloading immediately after a kill increases weapon damage for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成一次击杀后立即填装可在短时间内提高武器伤害。

perks.name: Big-Game Hunter
perks.description: Fires a massive heavy bolt that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射一枚巨大的重型箭矢，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Unflinching Sidearm Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Sidearms.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用手枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 命中三个不同目标可在一定时间内提高武器操控性、稳定性、填装和射程。

perks.name: Solar Ability Module
perks.description:
Class abilities recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用烈日分支职业时职业技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Hammer of Sol
perks.description: Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 召唤一把燃烧的战锤对你的敌人造成毁灭打击。

perks.name: Spark of Instinct
perks.description: While critically wounded, taking damage emits a burst of damaging Arc energy that jolts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 在受重伤时，受到伤害会使你爆发出一股能造成伤害并震颤目标的电弧能量。

perks.name: Bitterspite
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage accelerates its next reload by an increased amount.

Taking more damage increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh:
装备此武器时，受到伤害可进一步加速其下次填装。

受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

perks.name: Flourish
perks.description: Defeating combatants with grenade abilities increases this weapon's damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用手雷技能消灭战斗人员会提升此武器的伤害。

perks.name: Animating Love
perks.description: Adds an animating love appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个赋生之爱外观。

perks.name: Spoils of War
perks.description: Defeating a Champion by using a finisher spawns Heavy ammo for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技消灭勇士会为你和你的火力战队成员生成重型弹药。

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.description: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 在两个或更多盟友身边时，武器造成的精准伤害增加。

perks.name: Delayed Gratification
perks.description: Grenades bounce. Delayed detonation.
perks.descriptionZh: 榴弹可弹跳。延迟引爆。

perks.name: Weaver's Call
perks.description:
Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活你的职业技能来编织三条线虫并部署任何你已息停的线虫。

造成伤害和击败目标将产生息停线虫。

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 与此武器匹配能量类型的最后一击会提升伤害，持续时间延长。光能最后一击可提升电弧、烈日和虚空武器。暗影最后一击可提升冰影和缚丝武器。

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.description: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.
perks.descriptionZh: 射空此武器的弹匣时，会根据命中次数从储存弹药中填装。

perks.name: Brawler Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Brawler archetype, which has Melee as its primary stat and Health as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落搏击手框架：近战为主要属性，生命值为次要属性。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Nano-Munitions
perks.description: Being near allies slowly builds up a partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 位于盟友附近时会慢慢积累部分紧急弹药，以备下次此武器弹药耗尽时使用。紧急弹药数量随着在盟友附近时间的增加而增加。

perks.name: Lightning Seeker
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot track targets across the ground, jolting them and unleashing chain lightning on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在地面上追踪目标，震颤目标并在命中后释放连锁闪电。

perks.name: Anti-Flinch
perks.description: Reduces incoming flinch for this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 为此武器减少受到的抖动。

perks.name: Photoinhibition
perks.description: This weapon deals improved bonus damage to combatant shields and targets with overshields. Breaking a combatant's shield disorients them; breaking an energy-matched shield also disorients nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾和带有覆盖护盾的目标造成更多额外伤害。击破战斗人员的护盾会使其迷失方向，击破能量相匹配的护盾还会使附近的战斗人员迷失方向。

perks.name: Starting Line Entrance
perks.description: Adds an inaugural appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个初始外观。

perks.name: Unbreakable
perks.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
perks.descriptionZh:
[手雷]  ：长按以召唤一个虚空护盾，它可吸引敌人火力并抵挡一部分伤害，逐渐消耗你的手雷能量并赋予一个覆盖护盾。

释放手雷键或耗尽能量时，你的护盾会释放出正面冲击波，它使战斗人员迷失方向，并基于已抵挡的伤害量造成更高的伤害。正面冲击波造成的最后一击会为你提供吞食。

接触到你护盾的战斗人员会暂时迷失方向。

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在击败目标后，此武器的射速、充能速度、拉弓速度都会减慢，但是会造成额外伤害，持续时间延长。

perks.name: SKIMMER CONTROLS
perks.description:
[Brake]  : Take to the air.
[Crouch]  : Grind the air.
perks.descriptionZh:
[刹车]  ：升空。
[蹲伏]  ：驭空。

perks.name: Air-Cooled Core
perks.description: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain further increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺可在短时间内提升排气或填装速度。处于低热量或满弹匣时，瞄准可获得进一步提升的操控性和移动速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Flechette Storm
perks.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to leap into the air, knocking nearby targets away and dealing damage.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to launch a cluster of damaging, unraveling projectiles. Repeatedly activating melee will chain additional throws.
perks.descriptionZh:
滑行时，激活你的充能近战技能可跃向空中，击退附近目标并造成伤害。

在空中时，再次激活你的充能近战来发射一连串可造成伤害的瓦解射弹。重复激活近战技能将连锁额外投掷。

perks.name: Balestra
perks.description:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用刀剑、偃月或任意近战攻击伤害目标会使其疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Stesso Tempo
perks.description: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑或偃月格挡攻击后，下次解除格挡时，会在短时间内获得针对目标的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Souldrinker
perks.description: Gain health based on the number of hits before reloading.
perks.descriptionZh: 根据填装之前完成的命中数恢复生命值。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Adept Targeting
perks.description: Greatly increases target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升目标获取能力。

perks.name: Balanced Heat Weapon
perks.description: Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 极低热量积累。[填装]  以释放武器热量。过热将强制持续排气。在极高热量时手动排气将大幅提高排气速度。

perks.name: Temporal Blast
perks.description: This weapon stores an improved portion of its damage dealt into charges. At 5 charges, the weapon's next shot creates an explosive blast on impact that damages nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会将造成伤害的更大一部分储存为能量。达到5次充能时，武器的下一发射击会在命中时产生爆炸冲击，对附近战斗人员造成伤害。

perks.name: Sunburn
perks.description: Explosive rounds. Highlights targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 高爆弹药。高亮显示目标。

perks.name: Cabal Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Cabal hologram entrance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个卡巴尔全息登场效果。

perks.name: Warsat Arrival
perks.description: Adds a crashing Warsat to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个坠毁的战争卫星效果。

perks.name: SIVA Emergence
perks.description: Adds a SIVA respawn to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送添加一个湿婆重生效果。

perks.name: Whisper of Fractures
perks.description: Shattering a frozen target with a melee attack grants a stack of Frost Armor.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击击碎一个被冻结的目标会赋予一层冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Whisper of Impetus
perks.description: Damaging targets with a [Stasis] Stasis melee reloads your weapons and grants you a temporary boost to weapon ready speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 用冰影近战对目标造成伤害会为你填装武器，并使你在短时间内获得武器准备速度加成。

perks.name: Whisper of Chains
perks.description: Defeating targets while you have Frost Armor has a chance to create a [Stasis] Stasis shard.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时击败目标，有几率生成一块冰影碎片。

perks.name: Whisper of Torment
perks.description: You gain grenade energy each time you take damage from targets. Having Frost Armor increases the amount of energy gained.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次受到目标的伤害时获得手雷能量。拥有冰霜护甲会获得更多的能量。

perks.name: Stun Ventilator
perks.description: Stunning a Champion vents heat from this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕勇士可为此武器散热。

perks.name: Tactical
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提升填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: Thermal Blooming
perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with [Solar] Solar or [Stasis] Stasis melee attacks creates an Orb of Power for your fireteam members.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日或冰影近战攻击快速消灭战斗人员会为你的火力战队成员生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Io Combo Detector
perks.description: Detect caches or resources within a 30-meter range while on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 在木卫一上探测30米范围内的缓存箱或资源。

perks.name: Contender's Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Guardian Games crest appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个守护者游戏纹章外观。

perks.name: Crucible Glimmer Scavenger
perks.nameZh: 熔炉竞技场微光回收利用
perks.description: Increase Glimmer gains by 10% in the Crucible.
perks.descriptionZh: 在熔炉竞技场的微光获取量提升10%。

perks.name: Wraithwalk
perks.description: Faster movement while invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 隐形时移速加快。

perks.name: Heavy Burst
perks.description: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射威力巨大的两发点射。降低瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面抖动。

perks.name: Crossing Over
perks.description: This weapon has increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal increased damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器增加了前半弹匣的射程和操控性，而后半弹匣的弹药能造成更大的伤害。

perks.name: Arcology Scout Reports
perks.description: Highlights nearby loot caches on the moon of Saturn for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你和你的火力战队在土卫六上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Worm God Incarnation
perks.description: Adds a vision of Xol to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个尸飕幻象。

perks.name: Plesiohedral State
perks.description: Adds pixelation to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个像素效果。

perks.name: AI-COM/RSPN: REBOOT
perks.description: Adds a Warmind flourish to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个战争思维花样。

perks.name: Celebrate Newness
perks.description: Adds a fireworks burst to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个放烟花的效果。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Hellas Basin Scout Reports
perks.description: Highlights nearby loot caches on Mars for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你和你的火力战队在火星上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Grand Overture Catalyst
perks.description: Omega Strike hits blind combatants. Defeating combatants with Omega Strike causes them to explode.
perks.descriptionZh: 欧米伽打击命中时致盲战斗人员。被欧米伽打击击败的战斗人员会爆炸。

perks.name: Ember of Benevolence
perks.description: Applying restoration, cure, or radiant to allies grants increased grenade, melee, and class ability regeneration for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对盟友施加恢复、治愈或焕光效果可在短时间内提升手雷、近战和职业技能的回复能力。

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.description: Rapidly improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续按住扳机可快速提升精度和稳定性。

perks.name: Collector Synth
perks.description: Armor Set—Collector +3
perks.descriptionZh: 护甲套装——收集者+3

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Scout Rifle
perks.description:
Scout Rifles you are wielding fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

Scout Rifles deal bonus damage against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你使用的斥候步枪可发射屏障穿刺子弹，眩晕屏障勇士。

斥候步枪对屏障勇士造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Psychohack
perks.description:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
此武器的持续伤害会在短时间内使目标疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 长时间处于战斗状态会提升此武器的伤害、操控性和填装速度，持续直到脱离战斗，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Sticky Grenades
perks.description: Grenades attach on impact; detonate when enemies are close.
perks.descriptionZh: 碰撞后会黏住的榴弹；敌人接近后引爆。

perks.name: Unending Curse
perks.description: Extends the duration of String of Curses.
perks.descriptionZh: 延长诅咒之绳的持续时间。

perks.name: Kinetic Scavenger
perks.description: Kinetic weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取该动能武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Transmutation
perks.description: Collapses targets into spheres of Void energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 将目标瓦解为虚空能量球。

perks.name: Vulcan's Rage
perks.description: Hammers shatter into explosive molten embers on impact.
perks.descriptionZh: 战锤会在命中后碎裂成会爆炸的熔合余烬。

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.
perks.descriptionZh: 长时间处于战斗状态会使此武器获得额外伤害，激活速度更快。战斗状态的时间稍有缩短，会使此武器获得更大的额外伤害，并周期性治疗使用者。

perks.name: Feast of Light
perks.description: Pick up Orbs of Power to overcharge your Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球来过载充能你的超能。

perks.name: Immovable Object
perks.description: Dealing ranged damage grants substantially increased weapon energy while you're stationary with your shield raised.
perks.descriptionZh: 保持不动举起护盾时造成远程伤害可提供大幅增加的武器能量。

perks.name: Foundry Sponsorship: Häkke
perks.description: Häkke weapons deal overcharged damage in Ops activities.
perks.descriptionZh: Häkke武器在行动活动中造成过充伤害。

perks.name: Vortex
perks.description: Nova Bomb creates a singularity which continually damages enemies trapped inside. Kills with Nova Bomb grant the Devour effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 新星炸弹 可产生一个奇点，对困在其中的敌人造成 持续性伤害 。用 新星炸弹 击杀敌人可获得 吞噬 效果。

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 与此武器相克的元素最后一击会在更长的时间内提升伤害。暗影最后一击强化电弧、烈日和虚空武器。光能最后一击强化冰影、缚丝和动能武器。

perks.name: Scion of Mercury
perks.description: Increased Glimmer and chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加微光获取量并有机会在水星上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Bray Legacy
perks.description: Damage with this weapon generates an improved amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成伤害，会为最接近完全充能的技能生成更多技能能量。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Pulse Rifle ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的脉冲步枪弹药数量。

perks.name: Ionic Blink
perks.description: Activate to teleport during Stormtrance.
perks.descriptionZh: 在雷霆万钧期间激活传送。

perks.name: Stasis Empowerment
perks.description:
While Stasis empowered:
- Stasis Supers have extended durations.
- Defeated combatants spawn Stasis mines.

On PRISM Day, Stasis empowerment is applied while using a Stasis subclass.
perks.descriptionZh:
在冰影赋能期间：
-延长冰影超能的持续时间。
-被消灭的战斗人员会生成冰影地雷。

在棱镜日，使用冰影分支职业时会应用冰影赋能。

perks.name: Fanatical Lance
perks.description:
Rapid final blows cause targets to explode into a pool of radiolarian fluid.

Hip firing launches multiple projectiles at once in a slower moving spread pattern. Projectiles detonate on impact.
perks.descriptionZh:
快速最后一击将使目标爆炸成一摊活性放射体液。

腰射可同时散射多个低速射弹。射弹将在命中时引爆。

perks.name: Arc Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Adept Accuracy
perks.description: +10 Accuracy
perks.descriptionZh: +10精准

perks.name: Colorful Motes Effects
perks.description: Adds colorful Motes to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加多彩萤光。

perks.name: Unstoppable Glaive
perks.description:
Glaives you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的偃月可发射一枚高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Randomized Perks + 1
perks.description: This item comes with randomized perks, as well as an extra perk in a random trait column.
perks.descriptionZh: 此物品自带随机特性和随机特性栏的一个额外特性。

perks.name: Void Weapon Surge
perks.description: Your Void weapons gain a small bonus to damage while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge now decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的虚空武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Tactical
perks.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: Enhanced Submachine Gun Loader
perks.nameZh: 强化型微型冲锋枪装填装置
perks.description: Greatly increases reload speed of Submachine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高微型冲锋枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Lucent Finisher
perks.description: Defeating a Lucent Hive Lightbearer or Champion with your finisher spawns Heavy ammo for you and your allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技消灭光明邪魔族负光者或勇士会为你和你的盟友生成重型弹药。

perks.name: Withering Heat
perks.description: Causing damage with a Solar ability weakens Champions for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用烈日技能造成伤害可以弱化勇士一小段时间。

perks.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升对重型弹药量表的所有计入效果。

perks.name: Sterling Entrance
perks.description: Adds a Dawning sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个曙光节印记外观。

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 阻挡伤害可从储备弹药中部分填装此武器。

perks.name: Machine Gun Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Machine Gun equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备机枪后，提高你找到重型武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Dire Artillery
perks.description: Grants additional Super energy on Energy or Power Grenade Launcher final blows.
perks.descriptionZh: 能量或威能榴弹发射器最后一击将获得额外超能能量。

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.description: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.
perks.descriptionZh: 电池满能时，下一次冲击将造成额外伤害并使敌人在死亡时爆炸。

perks.name: Colossus Armorer
perks.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Colossus archetype, which has Super as its primary stat and Health as its secondary.
perks.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落装甲兵框架：超能为主要属性，生命值为次要属性。

perks.name: Facet of Mending
perks.description: Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击会治愈你。超凡手雷最后一击可提升效果强度。

perks.name: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Super ▼
perks.description: +5 Health ▲ / -5 Super ▼
perks.descriptionZh: +5 生命值 ▲ /-5 超能 ▼

perks.name: Arc Soul
perks.description:
Cast your Rift to create an Arc Soul that fires at targets in front of you. Allies can pass through your Rift to get an Arc Soul. Your Rift charges faster when allies are near.

While amplified, your Arc Souls are supercharged and gain increased fire rate.

Arc Soul damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
施放你的裂痕以产生一个能射击你前方目标的电弧之魂。盟友可以穿过你的裂痕来获得一个电弧之魂。附近有盟友时你的裂痕充能更快。

在增幅状态下，你的电弧之魂会获得超级充能，射速更快。

电弧之魂的伤害会根据手雷属性强化增益进行调整。

perks.name: Utility Kickstart
perks.description: When your class ability energy is fully expended, your Armor Charge is consumed and you gain class ability energy for each Armor Charge used.
perks.descriptionZh: 在职业技能能量完全耗尽时，你的护甲充能会被消耗，每一层被消耗的护甲充能都会赋予你额外的职业技能能量。

perks.name: Latent Power
perks.description: Builds energy to fire explosive, weakening rounds.
perks.descriptionZh: 积累能量以发射爆炸性的削弱弹药。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Personal Assistant
perks.description: Shows critical information in scope. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准镜显示关键信息。克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Unstoppable Sidearm and Hand Cannon
perks.description:
Aiming down the sights of a Hand Cannon or Sidearm for a short time loads a powerful payload that stuns unshielded combatants. 

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
用手炮或手枪举枪瞄准一小段时间会填装强力载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间进一步提升伤害。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 移动时瞄准会提高移动速度和目标捕获能力。

perks.name: Anti-Barrier Machine Gun
perks.description: Your equipped Machine Guns fire shield-piercing rounds and stun [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的机枪会发射护盾穿透子弹并眩晕屏障勇士。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成精准击杀可以提高填装速度并使目标爆炸，对附近的敌人造成烈日伤害。

perks.name: Arc Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using an Arc subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用电弧分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Rainmaker
perks.description: Precision final blows have a chance to create a shower of Glimmer.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击有几率产生一阵微光之雨。

perks.name: Enhanced Heavy Lifting
perks.description: Gain greater bonus Super energy from Power weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 威能武器击杀可提供更多额外超能能量。

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.description: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装的弹药会根据先前完成快速最后一击次数造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 射击能量球会立即将其拾起。射击弹药盒会立即将其拾取，并自动从储存弹药中填充所有已装备武器的弹药。

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage but decreases target acquisition slightly.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准可提升身体射击伤害，但会小幅减少目标捕获能力。

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可在更长时间内增加腰射的武器射程、稳定性和精度。

perks.name: Mulligan
perks.description: Missing a shot has a chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 子弹未命中时有几率直接向弹匣返还弹药。

perks.name: Problem Solver
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
对勇士、初级首领或首领战斗人员造成持续伤害会使他们疲惫，并赋予此武器操控性和填装速度。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Deep Sea Locksmith
perks.description: When you redeem a Salvage Key, you have a chance to earn a Deep Dive Key.
perks.descriptionZh: 兑换回收密钥时，你有一定几率获得深渊潜水密钥。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Trace Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高追踪步枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Foundry Sponsorship: Tex Mechanica
perks.nameZh: 铸造厂赞助：特克斯机械
perks.description: Tex Mechanica weapons deal overcharged damage in Ops activities.
perks.descriptionZh: 特克斯机械武器在行动活动中造成过充伤害。

perks.name: Ice Breaker
perks.description: Defeating a target with this weapon causes them to explode. Precision final blows or shattering a frozen target instead triggers an ignition.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器击败目标会导致目标爆炸。精准最后一击或碎裂被冻结的目标会触发点燃。

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用此武器造成最后一击会提升爆炸的范围，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Io Scanner
perks.description: Chance to obtain additional faction consumables on Io.
perks.descriptionZh: 有机会在木卫一上获得额外的阵营消耗品。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: Recoil pattern is more vertical.
perks.descriptionZh: 后坐轨迹更偏向垂直方向

perks.name: Stoic When Panicked
perks.description: Gain damage resistance while you are standing on a plate, near a lantern or totem, or while you carry the relic Sword. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 站在石板上、在灯笼或图腾附近，或携带圣物刀剑时，可获得伤害抗性。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Trapper's Ambush
perks.description:
Activate your air move to consume your class ability energy and dive to the ground, damaging targets on impact. Damage is greatly increased if striking while you have any Void status effect.

Damaging opponents with this ability heals you. Defeating combatants with this ability grants Devour.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
perks.descriptionZh:
激活空中移动来消耗你的职业技能能量并朝地面俯冲，撞击目标时造成伤害。若你拥有任意虚空状态效果，撞击伤害将大幅提高。

使用此技能伤害对手会治疗你。使用此技能击败战斗人员会提供吞食。

当你的职业属性达到100或更高时，此技能伤害会根据职业属性而增加。

perks.name: Void Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using a Void subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用虚空分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Public Defender
perks.description: Increased loot from public events on all destinations.
perks.descriptionZh: 在所有目的地的公共事件中获得更好的战利品。

perks.name: Facet of Dominance
perks.description: Your Void grenades weaken targets, and your Arc grenades jolt targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的虚空手雷会削弱目标，而你的电弧手雷会震颤目标。

perks.name: Restorative Turret
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a healing turret on impact that provides Cure and Restoration to nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: [替换武器动作]  ：武器完全充能时，开火前消耗充能使你的下一次射击在命中后部署一个治疗炮台，为附近盟友提供治愈和恢复效果。

perks.name: Adept Counterbalance
perks.description: Greatly improves recoil direction.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善后坐力方向。

perks.name: Photogalvanic
perks.description: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 接受治疗时暂时为你的烈日武器提升抖动抗性、操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: Cauterize
perks.description: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速烈日最后一击会治疗你。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: King's Wings Entrance
perks.description: Adds a royal appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个王室外观。

perks.name: Heretical Entrance
perks.description: Adds a heretical appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个异端外观。

perks.name: Phoenix Dive
perks.description: Activate while midair to quickly descend and restore your health. While Daybreak is active, descend causes explosive damage and returns Super energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 空中激活可快速 下降 并 恢复生命值。 当 黎明 激活时，降落会 造成爆炸伤害 并返还 超能能量。

perks.name: EDZ Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 欧洲无人区缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while in the EDZ.
perks.descriptionZh: 在欧洲无人区中探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Void Empowerment
perks.description:
While Void empowered:
- Void Supers have extended durations.
- Void grenades and melee attacks deal increased damage.
- Crouching grants invisibility, Truesight, increased energy regeneration, and increased mobility.

On PRISM Day, Void empowerment is applied while using a Void subclass.
perks.descriptionZh:
在虚空赋能期间：
-延长虚空超能的持续时间。
-提高虚空手雷和近战攻击所造成的伤害。
-蹲伏时可提供隐身和真视效果、提升能量回复和敏捷。

在棱镜日，使用虚空分支职业时会应用虚空赋能。

perks.name: Caster Frame
perks.description:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.
perks.descriptionZh:
[重攻击]  ：发动一次重弹道攻击。
完全充能的重攻击更加猛烈。

perks.name: Glaive Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Glaives.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高偃月的收举速度。

perks.name: Explore the Infinite
perks.description: Chance to receive a Legendary engram when completing Heroic adventures on Mercury with your clan members.
perks.descriptionZh: 与公会成员在水星上完成英雄探险后有几率获得一个传说记忆水晶。

perks.name: Shocking Entrance
perks.description: Adds a flash of lightning to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送特效添加一道闪电。

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 与此武器相克的元素最后一击会在短时间内提升伤害。暗影最后一击强化电弧、烈日和虚空武器。光能最后一击强化冰影、缚丝和动能武器。

perks.name: Restorative Titan Armor
perks.description: Improved recovery.
perks.descriptionZh: 更强的恢复力。

perks.name: En Garde
perks.description: Quick attacks immediately after swapping to this sword do additional damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换至这把刀剑之后立即进行快速攻击可造成额外伤害。

perks.name: Unstoppable Shotgun
perks.description:
Shotguns you wield fire a powerful explosive payload that stuns unshielded combatants.

Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
你的霰弹枪可发射一枚高爆载荷，眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Grenade Font
perks.description: You gain a bonus to your grenade stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外手雷属性。你的护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 与此武器匹配能量类型的最后一击会在短时间内提升伤害。光能最后一击可提升电弧、烈日和虚空武器。暗影最后一击可提升冰影和缚丝武器。

perks.name: Ride the Bull
perks.description: Final blows reload the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击可填装弹匣。

perks.name: Seeker of Opulence
perks.description: Exotic drops from encounters in the raids "Leviathan" and "Leviathan, Eater of Worlds" have a 50% chance of being a Year 1 Exotic not already in your collection.
perks.descriptionZh: “利维坦”和“世界吞噬者，利维坦”突袭中的遭遇战所掉落的异域装备，有50%的几率是你的收藏中未包含的首年异域装备。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Splitvein Lineage
perks.description: While Devour is active, this weapon weakens on hit.
perks.descriptionZh: 吞食生效时，此武器在命中时会造成削弱。

perks.name: Enhanced Auto Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型自动步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Auto Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善自动步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Battleground Riches
perks.description: Spending a Defiant Key at the end of a Season of Defiance Battleground increases the chances of earning additional Defiant Engrams.
perks.descriptionZh: 在抗战赛季战场结束时花费抗战密钥可提升获得额外抗战记忆水晶的几率。

perks.name: Hitting combatants with the Relocator Launcher also affects their gravity.
perks.nameZh: 使用重定位发射器击中战斗人员也会影响他们的重力。
perks.description: Hitting combatants with the Relocator Launcher also affects their gravity.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用重定位发射器击中战斗人员也会影响他们的重力。

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准此武器一小段时间而不射击会使你的目标在你下一次造成最后一击时爆炸。计时器在停止瞄准后重置。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Minor Spec
perks.description: Deals extra damage against rank-and-file enemies.
perks.descriptionZh: 对普通敌人造成额外伤害。

perks.name: +15 Class ▲
perks.description: +15 Class ▲

perks.name: Distribution
perks.description: Reduces all ability cooldowns when using your class ability near targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 在目标附近使用职业技能时缩短所有技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Techeun's Foresight
perks.description: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集虚空裂口后，你下一次使用虚空武器造成的最后一击会触发爆炸。收集虚空裂口后迅速触发的爆炸更强力。

perks.name: Gift of the Ley Lines
