perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空能量快速击败战斗人员会生成虚空裂口。

perks.name: High Priority
perks.description: Improves Trace Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善追踪步枪。

perks.name: Stat Penalty
perks.description: -10 Recovery
perks.descriptionZh: -10 恢复

perks.name: Unflinching Hand Cannon Aim
perks.description: Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Hand Cannons.
perks.descriptionZh: 降低使用手炮瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: [Aim Down Sights] : Dash forward with a damaging Arc effect.
perks.nameZh: [瞄准] ：带着伤害性电弧效果向前冲刺。
perks.description: [Aim Down Sights] : Dash forward with a damaging Arc effect.
perks.descriptionZh: [瞄准] ：带着伤害性电弧效果向前冲刺。

perks.name: Vernier Thrusters
perks.description: [Dodge Left] , [Dodge Right]  : Quick lateral movements.
perks.descriptionZh: [左闪避] ，[右闪避] ：快速横向移动。

perks.name: Adept Draw Time
perks.description: +10 Draw Time
perks.descriptionZh: +10拔枪速度

perks.name: Cosmology
perks.description: Kills with this weapon cause enemy targets to detonate and spawn Void projectiles that track targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 击杀可引爆敌方目标，并生成可追踪目标的虚空弹头。

perks.name: Harsh Truths
perks.description: 5-round burst. Heals on ally death.
perks.descriptionZh: 五发点射。友军死亡时生命值恢复。

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.description: Final blows with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用任意武器造成最后一击会提高此武器的伤害，效果持续时间延长。

perks.name: Enhanced Cheer
perks.description: You are using Enhanced Cheer to earn Dawning Essence at an increased rate. Your fireteam has an elevated chance of receiving additional Dawning Essence upon activity completion.
perks.descriptionZh: 你正在使用强化欢呼增加获得曙光精华的速率。你的火力战队将会有更高几率在活动完成时获得额外曙光精华。

perks.name: Synergy
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon have a greater chance to create an Elemental pickup matching its damage type, or an Orb of Power for weapons that deal Kinetic damage damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 用此武器造成最后一击，有更高几率生成与其伤害类型匹配的元素拾取物，或为造成动能伤害的武器生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Spectral Blades
perks.description:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.
[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.
[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack and once again vanish from sight.
perks.descriptionZh:
召唤一对致命的虚空利刃，然后在暗影笼罩之下潜入战场。
[轻攻击] ：进行一次快速的近战攻击。
[重攻击] ：进行一次重攻击并再次从敌人的视野中消失。

perks.name: Class Font
perks.description: You gain a bonus to your class stat while you have any Armor Charge. Your Armor Charge decays over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 在拥有任何护甲充能时，你会获得额外职业属性。你的护甲充能会逐渐衰减。

perks.name: +5 Melee ▲
perks.description: +5 Melee ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 近战 ▲

perks.name: +3 Melee ▲
perks.description: +3 Melee ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +3 近战 ▲

perks.name: Emergency Reinforcement
perks.description:
When your shields become broken, you gain temporary damage reduction.

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting a longer duration to the damage reduction for each charge consumed.
perks.descriptionZh:
当你的护盾被打破时，你会获得短暂的伤害减免。

消耗3层或更多护甲充能。每消耗一层，会延长伤害减免的持续时间。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Scavenger
perks.description: Pulse Rifles get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时脉冲步枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Sniper Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding ammo while you have a Sniper Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备狙击步枪后，提高你找到弹药的机会。

perks.name: Sidearm Reserves
perks.description: Increases the amount of Sidearm ammo you can carry.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高可携带的手枪弹药储量。

perks.name: One-Two Finisher
perks.description:
Finishers restore melee abilities.

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting additional energy for each charge consumed.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技会恢复近战技能。

消耗3层或更多护甲充能，会基于消耗的充能层数赋予额外能量。

perks.name: Network Upload
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击为装备者和附近盟友提供近战能量。

perks.name: Network Admin
perks.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
靠近盟友会生成一个中继网络，提升装备者的操控性和填装速度。

靠近其他友方网络管理员额外提升装备者的生命值属性。

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次精准射击命中后蓄力时间大幅缩短，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Well of Tenacity
perks.description: Picking up a Void elemental well reduces the damage you take from combatants for a short period of time.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空元素井可在短期内降低战斗人员对你的伤害。

perks.name: Bring the Heat
perks.description: Improved Fusion Grenades.
perks.descriptionZh: 融合手雷效果更强。

perks.name: Burning Fists
perks.description: Melee kills increase melee damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战击杀提高近战伤害。

perks.name: Explosive Finisher
perks.description:
Finishers restore grenades. 

Consumes 3 or more stacks of Armor Charge, granting additional energy for each charge consumed.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技会恢复手雷。

消耗3层或更多护甲充能，会基于消耗的充能层数赋予额外能量。

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.description: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it. Handling is improved.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的手雷技能会填装一部分弹匣，并更改此武器的伤害类型，使其匹配你手雷的属性，直到你收起此武器。提升操控性。

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 冲刺一小段时间后滑行期间可获得额外伤害和充能速度加成。

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.description: Grants an improved short period of greatly increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.
perks.descriptionZh: 初次扣动扳机时可在短时间内大幅提高稳定性和精度，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Solar Rampart
perks.description: Solar kills recharge a Solar blast Barricade.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日击杀可重新充能烈日能量屏障。

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 击杀将生成手雷能量。使用手雷技能将从弹药储备中转移弹药对此武器进行填装。

perks.name: Howling Blizzard
perks.description: Adds a winter storm to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一场冬日风暴。

perks.name: Shower of Gifts
perks.description: Adds an explosion of generosity to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加爆炸式的慷慨效果。

perks.name: Radiant Light
perks.description: Casting your Super causes nearby allies with at least one Armor Charge to gain an additional one. Allies that have a different Super element than you gain an additional Armor Charge.
perks.descriptionZh: 施放超能时，会使附近所有至少拥有一层护甲充能的盟友获得额外一层。拥有与你不同超能元素的盟友再额外获得一层护甲充能。

perks.name: Enhanced Resistant Tether
perks.description: Gain powerful damage resistance while part of a tether chain. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 被吸附时获得大量伤害抗性。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.
perks.descriptionZh: 精准击杀可大幅缩短填装时间。

perks.name: Solar Ordnance Charger
perks.description:
Grenades recharge faster when using a Solar subclass.
  •  Stacks up to 3 times
perks.descriptionZh:
使用烈日分支职业时手雷技能的充能速度提高。
  •  最高可叠加3次

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto. Increases stability.
perks.descriptionZh: 扣住扳机时将以全自动模式进行射击。提高稳定性。

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击会造成额外伤害。近战和手雷最后一击会造成更多额外伤害，而且可叠加。

perks.name: Temporal Adapter
perks.description: Readying this weapon grants it bonus stability, handling, and reload speed for an improved duration that is borrowed from an alternate timeline version of the weapon. Swords gain bonus charge rate and guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器准备就绪后一段时间内可获得稳定性、操控性和填装速度加成，取自武器在另一个时间线的版本，持续时间延长。刀剑可获得充能速度和防御抗性加成。

perks.name: Another Dimension
perks.description: Reduces the activation time of Tesseract.
perks.descriptionZh: 减少四维超正方体激活时间。

perks.name: Flying Monster
perks.description: While you are airborne, sustained damage and final blows with this weapon to difficult combatants grant a Void overshield, reduce combatant accuracy, and return ammo to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你在空中时，使用此武器对强大的战斗人员造成持续伤害和最后一击，会获得虚空护盾，降低战斗人员的精度，并将弹药返回弹匣。

perks.name: Enduring Wells
perks.description: Increases the lifespan of elemental wells you create. Multiple copies of this mod stack, further extending the lifespan.
perks.descriptionZh: 延长你创造出的元素井的寿命。多个此模组可以叠加，进一步延长元素井的寿命。

perks.name: Well of Utility
perks.description: Picking up a Void elemental well grants you additional class ability energy. Multiple copies of this mod increase this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取一个虚空元素井会赋予你额外的职业技能能量。多个此模组会增强此效果。

perks.name: Reaper
perks.description: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 在使用你的职业技能后的短时间内，你的下一次武器最后一击会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中目标会向弹匣里返还两枚弹药。

perks.name: One with the Void
perks.description: Improves duration, damage, and durability of Void Souls.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升虚空灵魂的持续时间、伤害和耐久度。

perks.name: Horde Shuttle
perks.description: Damaging unraveled targets with a weapon occasionally spawns a threadling.
perks.descriptionZh: 用武器伤害被瓦解的目标有时会产生一个线虫。

perks.name: Hail The Storm
perks.description:
Shattering frozen targets and Stasis crystals deals increased damage.

Shattering Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
perks.descriptionZh:
击碎被冻结目标和冰影水晶会造成更多伤害。

击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

perks.name: Rays of Precision
perks.description: While radiant, Solar precision final blows cause combatants to ignite.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有焕光效果时，烈日精准最后一击可点燃战斗人员。

perks.name: Solo Operative
perks.description: While you are the only member of your fireteam, precision weapon final blows increase weapon damage until you are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你是火力战队的唯一成员时，精准武器最后一击会提升武器伤害，直至你被击败。

perks.name: Argent Ordnance
perks.description: Firing a Rocket Launcher consumes one stack of Armor Charge, granting increased damage and reload speed until you reload or stow your Rocket Launcher.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射火箭发射器会消耗一层护甲充能，在你填装或收起火箭发射器前可提升伤害和填装速度。

perks.name: Precision Frame
perks.description: Fires small auto-tracking rockets.
perks.descriptionZh: 发射自动追踪的小型火箭。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Photoinhibition
perks.description: This weapon deals bonus damage to combatant shields and targets with overshields. Breaking a combatant's shield disorients them; breaking an energy-matched shield also disorients nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器对战斗人员护盾和带有覆盖护盾的目标造成额外伤害。击破战斗人员的护盾会使其迷失方向，击破能量相匹配的护盾还会使附近的战斗人员迷失方向。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Dreaming City Experience Log
perks.description: Gain 10% more XP while in the Dreaming City.
perks.descriptionZh: 在幽梦之城中获取10%的额外经验值。

perks.name: Depths of Duskfield
perks.description: Duskfield grenades have a larger effect and reduce the damage that allies take.
perks.descriptionZh: 使暮域手雷的影响范围增加，并使盟友获得伤害减免。

perks.name: Myrmidon's Reach
perks.description: Improves your Shield Throw melee.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升圣盾投掷近战能力。

perks.name: Harbinger Seethe
perks.description: After activating Harbinger's Pulse multiple times, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to cause a rain of projectiles on your next direct hit with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 多次激活预兆脉动后，[替换武器动作] 以在下次使用此武器直接命中时造成射弹雨。

perks.name: Enhanced Unflinching Fusion Rifle Aim
perks.nameZh: 强化型稳定融合步枪瞄准
perks.description: Greatly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅降低使用融合步枪瞄准时因受到伤害而产生的画面颤动。

perks.name: Calm Amidst Chaos
perks.description: After not taking damage for a short duration, this weapon gains significantly increased aim down sight speed, handling and flinch resistance until the next shot is fired. Activates faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 短时间内未受伤害后，此武器会获得显著提升的瞄准速度、操控性与抖动抗性，效果持续至下一次射击。激活速度更快。

perks.name: Echo of Domineering
perks.description:
After suppressing a target, you gain increased weapon stat for a short duration, and your equipped weapon is reloaded from reserves.

Defeating suppressed targets creates a Void Breach.
perks.descriptionZh:
压制目标后，你的武器属性会在短时间内提升，并用储存弹药填装当前装备的武器。

击败被压制的目标会生成一个虚空裂口。

perks.name: Sundering Blast
perks.description: Stunning a Champion creates an explosive blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕一名勇士会造成一次爆炸。

perks.name: Sandcastle Effects
perks.description: Adds the illusion of a sandcastle to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加沙堡的幻象。

perks.name: Beach Ball Effects
perks.description: Adds the illusion of a beach ball to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加沙滩球的幻象。

perks.name: Improved Nessus Cache Detector
perks.nameZh: 增强版涅索斯缓存箱探测器
perks.description: Detect caches within a 40-meter range while on Nessus.
perks.descriptionZh: 在涅索斯上探测40米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Self-Repairing Nanofibers
perks.description: Increases this armor's recovery, allowing you to recover health faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高这件护甲的恢复值，以提高你的生命值恢复速度。

perks.name: Watchtower
perks.description: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时造成精准最后一击会提供伤害抗性，直至你停止瞄准。

perks.name: Field Expertise
perks.description:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意武器造成精准最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，在短时间内提升填装速度、目标捕获能力以及对非首领战斗人员造成的武器伤害。

造成非精准直接命中的武器最后一击将提前结束此效果。

perks.name: Void Ammo Generation
perks.description: Increases the ammo generation of Void weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升虚空武器的弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Right Hook
perks.description:
Dealing melee damage gives this weapon increased target acquisition and range for a short period of time.
Dealing melee damage again extends the effect.
perks.descriptionZh:
造成近战伤害会使此武器的目标捕获能力和射程在短时间内提升。
再次造成近战伤害可延长此效果。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: Gift Stack Entrance
perks.description: Adds a tower of presents to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个礼物塔。

perks.name: Nessus Scout Reports
perks.description: Highlights nearby loot caches on Nessus for you and your fireteam.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你和你的火力战队在涅索斯上标记出位于附近的战利品缓存箱。

perks.name: Rage of the Warmind
perks.description: Adds additional Solar damage to the explosions of Warmind Cells you destroy.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你摧毁的战争思维电池的爆炸效果增加额外的烈日伤害。

perks.name: Corrupted Nucleosynthesis
perks.description: Enrages when dealing or sustaining damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 在造成伤害或受到伤害时发怒。

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用你的职业技能后，使用此武器造成最后一击可获得额外的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Burning Souls
perks.description: [Solar]Solar final blows grant Burning Souls. Dodge applies Cure.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日最后一击提供燃烧之魂。闪身施加治愈。

perks.name: Wrath of the Colossus
perks.description: Fully automatic, slow-firing slug launcher with a charge time.
perks.descriptionZh: 需要充能时间的全自动、低射速重弹发射器。

perks.name: SUROS Legacy
perks.description: Half mag bonus damage and regens health.
perks.descriptionZh: 后半部分弹夹造成更高伤害并可触发生命回复。

perks.name: Cauterizing Flame
perks.description: Create a Sunspot when critically wounded or on Barricade cast.
perks.descriptionZh: 在重伤或释放屏障时生成一个太阳黑子。

perks.name: Temporal Loader
perks.description: This weapon loads an increased amount of ammo from reserves when dealing damage to targets that are slowed, frozen, or suspended.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器在对被减速、冻结或悬停的目标造成伤害时，会从备弹中填装弹匣，填装弹药数量提升。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +5 手雷 ▲

perks.name: +3 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +3 Grenade ▲
perks.descriptionZh: +3 手雷 ▲

perks.name: Arc Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Arc weapons over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 逐渐填装你已收起的电弧武器。

perks.name: Bottomless Bounty II
perks.description: Improves the effect of the Soul Drinker and Hot Swap weapon Origin perks.
perks.descriptionZh: 强化“饮魂者”和“热切换”武器原有特性的效果。

perks.name: Machine Gun Scavenger
perks.description: Machine Guns get bonus reserves when you pick up ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药时机枪获得额外弹药储量。

perks.name: Glaive Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Glaives.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高偃月的填装速度。

perks.name: Focusing Strike
perks.description: Grants class ability energy when you cause damage with a powered melee attack.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用充能近战攻击造成伤害时获得职业技能能量。

perks.name: Release the Wolves
perks.description: When firing from the hip, this weapon shoots in full auto and damage and rate of fire are increased, but accuracy and range are decreased.
perks.descriptionZh: 腰射时，此武器以全自动模式射击，提升伤害和射速，但降低精度和射程。

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 在盟友附近填装会过量填充弹匣。弓箭的开弓速度和刀剑的充能速度会加快。

perks.name: Lagrangian Sight
perks.description: Targeting system
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准系统

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会增加下一枚射弹的爆炸范围和伤害。

perks.name: Fusion Rifle Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高融合步枪的填装速度。

perks.name: Traveler's Sublimation
perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with Stasis weapons creates a Stasis mine that damages and freezes nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用冰影武器快速击败战斗人员可生成冰影地雷，它能伤害并冻结附近的战斗人员。

perks.name: Squad Goals
perks.description:
Performing a finisher while you are amplified grants Amplified to nearby allies. 

Performing a finisher while you have Woven Mail grants Woven Mail to nearby allies. 

Performing a finisher while you have Devour grants Devour to nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh:
在增幅状态下发动终结技可为附近盟友提供增幅状态。

拥有织造铠甲时发动终结技可为附近盟友提供织造铠甲。

在吞食状态下发动终结技可为附近盟友提供吞食状态。

perks.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
perks.description: After throwing an Arc grenade, gain increased grenade recharge for a short time. Arc final blows extend the duration of this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 投掷电弧手雷后，短时间内手雷充能速度加快。电弧最后一击会延长此增益的持续时间。

perks.name: Shock and Awe
perks.description: Arc final blows while you are amplified summon a burst of lightning that damages and jolts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于增幅状态时造成电弧最后一击可召唤出一道闪电，伤害并震颤目标。

perks.name: Supernova
perks.description: Picking up a Void Breach causes your next source of Void damage to create a large weakening pulse.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取虚空裂口可让你的下一次虚空伤害来源生成一次大型的削弱脉冲。

perks.name: Conductive Cosmic Needle
perks.description: Targets affected by Strand debuffs take increased damage from Arc and Void abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 受缚丝减益效果影响的目标会受到更高的电弧和虚空技能伤害。

perks.name: Soaring Fusilier
perks.description: Air dodge reloads weapons. Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle final blows make you radiant.
perks.descriptionZh: 空中闪避可重新填装武器。融合步枪和线性融合步枪最后一击将使你获得焕光效果。

perks.name: Gift Giver
perks.description:
Thanks to you, all players will receive a gift upon completing this activity.

No gifts will be awarded if you leave the activity early.
perks.descriptionZh:
多亏了你，所有玩家将在完成此活动后获得一件礼物。

如果你提前离开活动，礼物将会消失哦。

perks.name: Bow Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Bow equipped that uses Heavy ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备使用重型弹药的弓箭后，提高你找到重型弹药的机会。

perks.name: Air Brakes
perks.description: [Brake]  : Brake and corner more aggressively.
perks.descriptionZh: [刹车]  ：使用刹车或急转弯。

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击后填装，可为自身和附近盟友提供治愈。你有额外的时间来进行填装。

perks.name: Aura of Leadership
perks.description: Applies a gold crown aura.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加一个金色头冠光环。

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 当目标在附近时，最后一击会赋予更多的近战属性加成。

perks.name: Elemental Siphon
perks.description: Rapid final blows with a Kinetic weapon or a weapon matching your equipped Super create an Elemental pickup that matches your equipped Super.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用动能武器或与已装备超能匹配的武器造成快速最后一击，可生成一个与已装备超能匹配的元素拾取物。

perks.name: Creeping Chill
perks.description: Stasis final blows against slowed or frozen targets release a burst that slows combatants and grants Frost Armor to allies caught in the blast.
perks.descriptionZh: 对被减速或被冻结的目标造成冰影最后一击会释放可减速战斗人员的冲击波，并为范围内的盟友赋予冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Threaded Blast
perks.description: Destroying a Tangle with a Strand weapon creates a larger and more damaging explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用缚丝武器摧毁缠结可造成更大、伤害更高的爆炸。

perks.name: Press The Advantage
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield grants increased weapon stability, handling, and reload speed. Swords gain increased guard resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 打破战斗人员的护盾可以提高武器的稳定性、操控性和填装速度。刀剑可获得更高的防御抗性。

perks.name: Sustained Fire
perks.description: Continuously damaging combatants or healing allies with an Auto Rifle grants you damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用自动步枪持续对战斗人员造成伤害或治疗盟友可提供伤害抗性。

perks.name: Incendiary Rifle Rounds
perks.description: Solar Sniper Rifle precision hits scorch targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 烈日狙击步枪精准命中可灼烧目标。

perks.name: New Tricks
perks.description: Improved Skip Grenade.
perks.descriptionZh: 弹跳手雷效果更强。

perks.name: Abyssal Charge
perks.description: Become Charged with Light by defeating combatants with Void melee abilities.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空近战技能消灭战斗人员来充斥光能。

perks.name: Shotgun Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Shotguns over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的霰弹枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Nightmarish Opulence
perks.description: Increases the duration of the Psychohack Origin Trait and the effect of the Extrovert Origin Trait.
perks.descriptionZh: 增加“心灵骇入”原始特征的持续时间，并强化“外向”原始特征的效果。

perks.name: Trace Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Special ammo while you have a Trace Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备追踪步枪后，提高你找到特殊弹药的机会。

perks.name: Sidearm Holster
perks.description: Gradually reloads your stowed Sidearms over time. Multiple copies of this perk stack to reduce the time taken to fully reload.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着时间推移，逐渐为已收起的手枪装填弹药。此特性的效果可以叠加，以缩短完全重新装弹的耗时。

perks.name: Pulse Rifle Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Pulse Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善脉冲步枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Momentum Transfer
perks.description: Causing damage with a grenade reduces your melee cooldown.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷造成伤害可缩短近战技能的冷却时间。

perks.name: Iron Gaze
perks.description: Massively improves weapon target acquisition at the cost of weapon range.
perks.descriptionZh: 以牺牲武器射程为代价，大幅提升武器的目标获取能力。

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.
perks.descriptionZh: 友军在附近时，提高操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: Resolute
perks.description: Improved Fist of Havoc. Arc final blows grant a weapon damage bonus.
perks.descriptionZh: 改进浩劫之拳。电弧最后一击会提供武器伤害加成。

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.
perks.descriptionZh: 在最后一击或进入增幅状态后填装，会获得一段时间的伤害提升。最多叠加5层。

perks.name: Calculated Balance
perks.description: While in full auto mode, final blows or rapid hits with this weapon grant bonus damage, accuracy, and stability for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在全自动模式下，使用此武器达成最后一击或快速命中会奖励持续一小段时间的额外伤害、精度和稳定性。

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在短时间内使用所有已装备的武器造成伤害可为此武器提供伤害加成，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Colossal Quiver
perks.description: Maximizes quiver size.
perks.descriptionZh: 最大化箭袋容量。

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
perks.descriptionZh:
收集一个元素拾取物或摧毁缠结会赋予此武器一段叠加期，期间命中时生成手雷能量。投掷缠结会延长持续时间。

元素拾取物包括焰灵、虚空裂口、离子轨迹、冰影碎片和缚丝缠结。

perks.name: Hidden Hand
perks.description: Better target acquisition.
perks.descriptionZh: 更易捕获目标。

perks.name: Banshee's Favorite
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on any elemental weapon kills at an increased rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 在任意元素武器远距离击杀时以更快的速度生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Void Battery
perks.description: Activating Void class abilities grants an overshield. Increases cooldown of your class ability.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活虚空职业技能将获得覆盖护盾。增加你的职业技能冷却时间。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Rocket Launcher Ammo Finder
perks.nameZh: 火箭发射器弹药搜寻者
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Heavy ammo while you have a Rocket Launcher equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备火箭发射器后，提高你找到重型武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Melee Forged
perks.description: +3 Melee
perks.descriptionZh: +3 近战

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速精准命中目标会暂时提高稳定性和填装速度。

perks.name: Facet of Balance
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets with Light damage grants melee energy. Rapidly defeating targets with Darkness damage grants grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用光能伤害快速击败目标会提供近战能量。使用暗影伤害快速击败目标会提供手雷能量。

perks.name: Thread of Binding
perks.description: Super final blows emit a suspending burst from the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能最后一击会从目标身上爆发出悬停脉冲。

perks.name: Facet of Solitude
perks.description: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成快速精准命中会从目标身上爆发出割裂爆炸。处于超凡状态时，割裂爆炸威力更大。

perks.name: Mercury Cache Detector
perks.description: Detect caches within a 30-meter range while on Mercury.
perks.descriptionZh: 在水星上探测30米范围内的缓存箱。

perks.name: Unstoppable Melee
perks.description: Arc melee abilities stagger unshielded combatants. Strong against Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 电弧近战技能可 眩晕 无护盾的战斗人员。擅长对抗势不可挡的勇士。

perks.name: Dreaming Shimmer
perks.description: Adds an Awoken pointillistic appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个觉醒者点彩外观。

perks.name: Cannon Fodder
perks.description: Adds a cannon appearance to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个大炮外观。

perks.name: Silkbound Slayer
perks.description: This weapon deals bonus damage to suspended targets. Gain faster draw time for a short duration when you suspend a target from any source or damage a suspended target with this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 此武器会对被悬停目标造成额外伤害。当你通过任意来源悬停目标或使用此武器对被悬停的目标造成伤害时，可在短时间内获得更快的拔枪速度。

perks.name: Energy Accelerant
perks.description: Your Dragonfly, Chain Reaction, and Firefly explosions deal more damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高蜻蜓、连锁反应和萤火虫爆炸所造成的伤害。

perks.name: Abundant Ammo
perks.description: Grants slightly increased ammo generation.
perks.descriptionZh: 小幅提升弹药生成速度。

perks.name: Font of Might
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a temporary strong bonus to weapon damage of the same elemental type as your subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会暂时大幅提升与你分支职业相同元素类型的武器伤害。

perks.name: +10 Grenade ▲
perks.description: +10 Grenade ▲

perks.name: Spark of Amplitude
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets while you are amplified creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 在增幅状态下快速击败目标可产生能量球。

perks.name: Unstoppable Burst
perks.description: Aiming down sights loads a high-impact burst that stuns unshielded combatants. Strong against [Stagger]  Unstoppable Champions.
perks.descriptionZh: 举枪瞄准会装载一梭强力爆破弹药，可眩晕无护盾的战斗人员。克制势不可挡勇士。

perks.name: Enhanced Voltaic Ammo Collector
perks.description: Greatly increases the chances of finding Heavy ammo while you have the Voltaic Overflow buff. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅提高你在拥有电流丰盈增益时找到重型弹药的几率。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

perks.name: Guardian Blue
perks.description: Adds a blue Guardian crest to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个蓝色守护者纹章。

perks.name: Core Hound
perks.description: Completing a clan vendor challenge awards Enhancement Cores.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成公会商人挑战将会获得强化核心。

perks.name: Particle Deconstruction
perks.description: Dealing damage to a combatant with a Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle grants bonus damage with a Fusion Rifle or Linear Fusion Rifle against that combatant for a short duration. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用融合步枪或线性融合步枪对某个战斗人员造成伤害后，在一小段时间内使用融合步枪或线性融合步枪会对该战斗人员造成额外伤害。此效果最高可叠加5次。

perks.name: Scout Rifle Ammo Finder
perks.description: Increases your chance of finding Primary ammo while you have a Scout Rifle equipped.
perks.descriptionZh: 装备斥候步枪后，提高你找到主武器弹药的机会。

perks.name: Glaive Loader
perks.description: Increases reload speed of Glaives.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高偃月的填装速度。

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Dual Speed Receiver
perks.description: When aiming down sights, weapon rate of fire slows while weapon damage increases. Final blows while aiming down sights grant bonus Heavy ammo progress. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap to Spinning Up.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时武器射速会降低，但伤害会提高。瞄准时造成最后一击可提供额外重型弹药进度。[替换武器动作] 切换至旋转直上。

perks.name: Machine Gun Targeting
perks.description: Improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim down sights speed for Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 改善机枪的目标捕获能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Melee ▼
perks.description: +5 Grenade ▲ / -5 Melee ▼

perks.name: Deprecated Perk
perks.description: This perk has been deprecated and no longer functions.
perks.descriptionZh: 此特性已被弃用，不再有效。

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 消灭目标后填装可提高武器伤害力，持续时间延长。

perks.name: Enhanced Fusion Rifle Targeting
perks.nameZh: 强化型融合步枪瞄准性能
perks.description: Greatly improved target acquisition, accuracy, and aim-down-sights speed for Fusion Rifles.
perks.descriptionZh: 大幅改善融合步枪的目标锁定能力、精度和瞄准速度。

perks.name: Spark of Intellect
perks.description: Spark of Intellect
perks.descriptionZh: 智慧火花

perks.name: More Wolves
perks.description: Increases magazine size. Final blows with Wolfpack Rounds spawn a faster, more powerful micro-missile at the target's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高弹匣容量。使用狼群弹药对目标造成最后一击时，会在目标附近生成更快、更强大的微型导弹。

perks.name: Radiolaria Transposer
perks.description: Rapid final blows cause targets to explode into a pool of radiolarian fluid. Duration of pool is increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速最后一击将使目标爆炸成一摊活性放射体液，活性放射体液持续时间延长。

perks.name: Silver Dawning Lantern
perks.description: Adds a silver Dawning lantern to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个银色曙光灯笼。

perks.name: Unwound
perks.description: Sustained damage spawns Threadlings.
perks.descriptionZh: 持续伤害会生成线虫。

perks.name: Thread of Isolation
perks.description: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing burst from the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成快速精准命中会从目标身上爆发出割裂脉冲。

perks.name: Scoot to Loot
perks.description: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行会收集附近的弹药，并在短时间内为你的武器提供强化的填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: Shoot to Scoot
perks.description: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 用武器造成伤害会在短时间内提供强化滑行。滑行时会获得伤害抗性。

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.description: Stunning a Champion further refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and further improves recovery for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 眩晕一名勇士可进一步装填弹匣，触发生命值回复并在短时间内进一步提升恢复效果。

perks.name: Machine Gun Dexterity
perks.description: Faster ready and stow speed for Machine Guns.
perks.descriptionZh: 提高机枪的收举速度。

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.
perks.descriptionZh: 完成击杀可提高此武器的伤害，效果持续至切换或填装武器。

perks.name: Restoration Ritual
perks.description: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo.
perks.descriptionZh: 复活盟友或使用终结技击败战斗人员可填装此武器，并为下次此武器耗尽弹药时储备一次紧急弹药填充。

perks.name: Retinal Burn
perks.description: Rapid [Arc] Arc weapon precision hits consume an Armor Charge to trigger a blinding burst at the target's location.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速电弧武器精准命中会消耗一层护甲充能，在目标位置触发一次致盲爆发。

perks.name: Weakened Clear
perks.description: When using a Grenade Launcher, damaging a boss, damaging a Champion, or breaking a combatant's shield reloads your stowed weapons and weakens the combatant.
perks.descriptionZh: 当使用榴弹发射器的时候，对首领造成伤害、对勇士造成伤害、或打破战斗人员的护盾将填装你收起的武器并削弱战斗人员。

perks.name: Void Renewal
perks.description:
While Devour is active, [Void] Void weapon final blows have a chance to generate a Void Breach.

Picking up a Void Breach increases weapon reload and handling; Shotguns and Grenade Launchers are also reloaded from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh:
吞食生效时，虚空武器最后一击有几率生成一个虚空裂口。

拾取虚空裂口可提升武器填装和操控性；霰弹枪和榴弹发射器也会从备弹中填装。

perks.name: Curative Orbs
perks.description:
The first time you break a target's shield or break the shield of a Guardian using their Super, you create an Orb of Power.

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle grants you a small amount of health.
perks.descriptionZh:
你首次击破目标的护盾，或击破使用超能的守护者的护盾时，会生成一个能量球。

收集元素拾取物、能量球，或是摧毁缠结会为你提供少量生命值。

perks.name: Frost Renewal
perks.description: While you have Frost Armor, taking critical damage releases a burst that freezes nearby combatants and grants Frost Armor to you and nearby allies.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有冰霜护甲时，受到暴击伤害会释放爆发冻结附近的战斗人员，并为你和附近的盟友提供冰霜护甲。

perks.name: Debilitating Wave
perks.description:
Finishers emit a damaging wave that matches the element of your currently equipped Super.

Arc, Void, and Stasis waves apply Blind, Weaken, and Slow respectively.
perks.descriptionZh:
终结技会释放一道与当前已装备超能元素相匹配的伤害波。

电弧、虚空和冰影伤害波分别施加致盲、削弱和减速。

perks.name: Hail The Storm
perks.description: Shattering [Stasis] Stasis crystals releases shards of ice that damage and slow targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 击碎冰影水晶会释放出伤害并减慢目标速度的冰影碎片。

perks.name: Full Court
perks.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着射弹在爆炸前飞得越远，造成的爆炸伤害就越高。扩大爆炸范围。

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.
perks.descriptionZh:
最后一击会提供电光充能。
处于增幅状态时，最后一击会提供额外的电光充能。
没有电光充能时，获得的电光充能层数提升。

perks.name: Lethal Weave
perks.description: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败被瓦解的战斗人员会提供手雷技能能量。如果你的手雷能量已充满，则获得特殊弹药量表进度。

perks.name: License to Thrill
perks.description: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活手雷或纳米技术追踪导弹原始特性会为近距离来袭伤害提供可叠加的抗性。

perks.name: Gathering Light
perks.description:
Final blows grant stacks.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Refresh abilities.
perks.descriptionZh:
最后一击可叠加层数。
[替换武器动作]  ： 刷新技能。

perks.name: Forge's Kin
perks.description: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 黑色军械库武器最后一击会在武器再次被举起时短暂提供弹药生成、填装速度和对战斗人员的伤害。装备的每一件黑色军械库武器都会提升增益的强度和持续时间。

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.description: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你拥有织造铠甲、冰霜护甲或虚空覆盖护盾时，获得瞄准辅助、稳定性和抖动抗性。

perks.name: Bullseye Bolster
perks.description: Bullseye Bolster
perks.descriptionZh: 靶心加固

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants increased ammo to this weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取重型弹药会为此武器提供更多弹药。

perks.name: Panic Response
perks.description: Build up blight to fire Seekers.
perks.descriptionZh: 积攒凋零阴影，发射追踪弹。

perks.name: Supercharged
perks.description: With no augment, you gain a bonus to Resilience and Recovery, and your class ability recharges faster.
perks.descriptionZh: 没有增益时，你获得韧性和恢复加成，你的职业技能充能速度提升。

perks.name: Rasputin's Wrath
perks.description: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.
perks.descriptionZh: 范围效果伤害、烈日技能、第七炽天使武器或似像者武器最后一击提供战争思维充能。每层战争思维充能都会提升你的武器和手雷属性。

perks.name: Rasputin's Reprisal
perks.description:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
持有战争思维充能时，击败强力战斗人员、摧毁构造体，或摧毁缠结会释放一次烈日爆炸，对战斗人员造成伤害并治疗盟友。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Void Weapon Analyzer
perks.description: Generate Gunsmith telemetry data on Void weapon kills.
perks.descriptionZh: 在虚空武器击杀时生成枪匠遥测数据。

perks.name: Overload Rapid Fire
perks.description:
Uninterrupted fire from your equipped Auto Rifles and Submachine Guns grants bullets that stun combatants, delaying ability energy regeneration and lowering combatant damage output.

Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用装备的自动步枪和微型冲锋枪不间断开火可以射出眩晕战斗人员的子弹，延缓其技能能量回复并降低伤害输出。

克制过载勇士。

perks.name: Time Dilation
perks.description: Your decaying Armor Charge has a longer duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 延长护甲充能衰减时的持续时间。

perks.name: Null Factor
perks.description: Withering Blade creates Stasis crystals.
perks.descriptionZh: 枯萎之刃会生成冰影水晶。

perks.name: Fiery Spirit
perks.description: Adds a Solar sigil to your transmat effects.
perks.descriptionZh: 为你的传送效果添加一个烈日印记。

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.
perks.descriptionZh: 最后一击会储存多股能量，使你切换和收举此武器的速度增加。
